heading: Data Collection
content: In this study, the data will be collected from publicly available BDD (Behavior-Driven Development) repositories and test suites that use frameworks such as Gauge, Cucumber. These frameworks provide both specification files (written in natural language using “Heading-Scenerio-Steps” format) and their corresponding implementation test scripts (written in programming languages like Java or Python). The dataset will include multiple BDD projects containing specification–implementation pairs to ensure diversity in writing styles and domain vocabulary. The data that was previously gathered will be used to train and evaluate the NLP based model. The specification files will be used for natural language examination, while the corresponding implementation files will be used to validate the mapping, and detect test smells.

heading: Preprocessing
content: Prior to feature extraction, it is essential for the BDD specifications to be preprocessed in order to make them suitable for NLP analysis. Preprocessing includes several steps: Text Cleaning: The process of purging any extraneous characters, such as punctuation, special symbols, and unnecessary whitespace. This entails converting text to lower-case to guarantee uniform processing throughout the specifications. Tokenization: Divide the text into individual words or tokens. Tokenization aids in decomposing the specifications into smaller pieces for analysis. Stopword Removal: Remove common stopwords (e.g., 'and,' 'the,' 'is') that are not additive to the meaning of the specifications. This step is useful to reduce noise in the data, but some frequently used words may reveal something about the specifications.. Stemming and Lemmatization: Reduce words to their root form. Stemming includes cutting off word endings, while lemmatization uses linguistic rules to derive the base form.

heading: Feature Extraction
content: A crucial part of this research is feature extraction, which gives the system the ability to comprehend the structure and meaning of natural language BDD specifications. A thorough vector representation of each specification is produced by combining a number of significant feature types that are taken from the BDD specifications. Later on, this representation is used to precisely map each specification to the test implementation that goes with it and to identify possible test smells like redundant steps, imprecise descriptions, or unduly complicated scenarios. The primary objective is to automatically extract useful information from the specifications so that the mapping and test smell detection processes can be supported efficiently.

heading: Linguistic Features
content: The syntactic and semantic characteristics of the text are captured by linguistic features. When examining BDD specifications, the following linguistic characteristics are crucial: Spoken Words (POS) Tagging: Give each token a grammatical tag (such as noun, verb, or adjective). POS tagging facilitates comprehension of the specifications' grammatical structure. Recognition of Named Entities (NER): Determine and categorize the named entities (person, place, organization, etc.) in the text. Key elements of the BDD specifications can be identified with the aid of NER. Analyze the grammatical connections between words in a sentence using dependency parsing. Understanding the relationships between the various components of the specifications is made easier with the use of dependency parsing.

heading: Contextual Features
content:
The larger context in which words and phrases occur is captured by contextual features. These characteristics aid in comprehending the general purpose and meaning of the specifications: 
N-grams: To capture phrase-level meaning and local context, extract word sequences of n consecutive words (such as bigrams or trigrams). N-grams are useful for locating recurring themes and expressions in the specifications. Term frequency-inverse document frequency, or TF-IDF: Determine a word's significance within the context of the complete corpus of BDD specifications. Words that are important within specific specifications but uncommon across all specifications can be found with the aid of TF-IDF. Word Embeddings: To represent words as dense vectors in a high-dimensional space, use pre-trained word embeddings (such as Word2Vec and GloVe). Semantic relationships between words are captured by word embeddings, which aid in comprehending the specifications' meaning.

heading: Mapping Mechanism
content: An essential component of the suggested strategy is the mapping mechanism. By using the features that have been extracted, it aligns BDD specifications with the test implementations that correspond to them. To produce a thorough feature vector for every BDD specification, the mapping mechanism combines contextual, domain-specific, and linguistic features. Usually, cosine similarity is used to determine how similar these vectors are to the vectors of test implementations. For the specified BDD specification, the implementation with the highest similarity score is selected as the mapped implementation. By utilizing both linguistic and domain-specific information, this method guarantees that the mapping is precise and pertinent to the context.

heading: Abstract:
content: Neurodevelopmental conditions are the ones that impact the cognitive abilities of a person. The causes of such conditions are not known but genetics can be considered to have a major impact. Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is also a neurodevelopmental disorder that affects the behavioral activities of a person. The people having this condition are characterized by difficulties in social interaction and they also face challenges in learning and linguistic competence. With early diagnoses and targeted behavioral practices, such a condition can be improved significantly, positively impacting one’s life. Machine learning and deep learning have introduced intelligent systems which have revolutionized the traditional clinical diagnosis approaches which are costly and time-consuming as compared to the complementary diagnosis systems.  Considering ASD, in the traditional diagnoses setting, psychiatrists or psychologists conduct interviews with the parents which are followed by prolonged behavioral observations. This becomes troublesome for both patients and their guardians. To address these concerns, this project aims to streamline the ASD detection process by utilizing the most crucial behavioral traits that contribute to the ASD classification in the early stages of a child’s life. Q-CHAT-10 and AQ-10 datasets will be used to train the predictive models. These datasets contain behavioral questions that are related to a child social interaction. Various ML and DL algorithms like Support Vector Machines (SVM), Neural Networks, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) Networks and Gradient Boosting Machines etc. will be employed on the behavioral traits that are tailored for toddlers and adolescents. A comprehensive evaluation of these algorithms will be performed by using evaluation methods like Cross-Validation, Precision-Recall Curve, Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) Curve and Area Under the Curve (AUC) etc.  The trained model will then be integrated into a mobile application. The outcome will be a mobile application that would help the children navigating the challenges of ASD, by early diagnoses of the condition which have proven to produce better social outcomes in the person’s life due to the appropriateness of therapy and treatment.

heading: Introduction:
content: Some neurodevelopment disorders are not completely curable, but timely treatment can have a profound impact on the quality of one’s life and autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is one of them. It influences the social interactions and learning capabilities in a person’s life. Empirical studies have proven that ASD cannot be diagnosed with a straightforward clinical test . There are varying degrees of severity and symptoms for autism which makes it a broad-spectrum disorder. The symptoms often overlap with other neurodevelopment disorders which makes the diagnosis process a complex task. Several behavioral tests are used in the diagnosis process of ASD. Some of these include Q-CHAT (Quantitative Checklist for Autism in Toddlers) , DISCO (Diagnostic Interview for Social and Communication Disorders) , and ADOS (Autism Diagnostic observation Schedule) . These behavioral tests come with a set of challenges, for example, ADOS may not be suitable for non-verbal adolescents. Moreover, trained professionals are required for the administration of these tests. Furthermore, the tests are lengthy and costly. Consequently, conventional diagnostic systems underscore the need for a system that can facilitate early diagnosis of ASD and enable the healthcare providers to recommend appropriate treatment. The automatic diagnosis of ASD at an early stage will improve the adaptive skills of a person and will provide adult independence. The advent of Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) techniques has significantly enhanced clinical methodologies . However, the main challenge in developing an automatic ASD detection system using ML and DL techniques is the availability of adequate data of high quality. A child’s behavioral data is difficult to record and when it comes to a neurodevelopment disorder, parents or guardians hesitate to share such information. Moreover, recording a child’s behavior demands patience and it raises privacy concerns as well. To solve this problem, this project aims to leverage state-of-the-art ML and DL techniques for classifying ASD or Non-ASD cases. Additionally, we will identify the traits that significantly influence the technique's outcomes by utilizing datasets like Q-Chat-10 and AQ-10 . These benchmark datasets are most widely used for studying ASD. Furthermore, the analysis will extend to the attributes/traits of toddlers and children, exploring their associations with ASD. By comparing the results of various techniques, our goal is to determine the most effective method across all datasets. Towards the project's conclusion, efforts will be made to integrate ASD data from Pakistani children, if available, thereby contributing to a more comprehensive understanding of ASD across diverse populations. We believe the proposed solution will assist parents and healthcare professionals by providing timely ASD diagnoses and enable them to start potential treatment.

heading: Related Work:
content: ASD is a neuro-developmental condition that impacts social interaction, communication, and behavior, necessitating early identification for a productive intervention. It has been reported that in the United States alone, 1 out of 54 children are affected by Autism. Many studies have been published regarding the application of various ML and DL techniques which promise various aspects for enhancing accuracy and efficiency in ASD task. Ahmed Hadri  utilized a hybrid approach by combining machine learning models, SVM and Random Forest, with questionnaires to improve accuracy. The dataset was collected locally using various screening tools i.e. AQ-10, CBCL etc. An accuracy of 97.5% was achieved through the used methodology, indicating promising results for early ASD detection. Maitha  employed machine learning algorithms (XgBoost, Naïve Bayes etc.) to predict specific ASD symptoms in individuals and determine the optimal model for diagnosis. The data was based upon the AQ-10 screening tool and was collected via a mobile application. The dataset contains 1811 attributes after preprocessing. The analysis of the dataset reveals that the toddler age groups contribute the most data, with approximately 70% diagnosed with ASD. Muhammad Shoaib  applied federated learning with logistic regression and Support Vector Machine for ASD detection. Datasets were collected from Kaggle including Autism image dataset for children and Autism Screening on Adults. FL technique achieved an accuracy of 98% in children and 81% in adults for Autism detection. Dipti  used Machine Learning approaches (Random Forest, SVM) on a questionnaire model M-Chat; however, the dataset used is not specified by the author. Random forest showed better accuracy of 86% compared to SVM, contributing to an automated autism detection system. Gennaro  applied ML algorithms: Random Forest, Naïve Bayes, Support Vector Machine, Logistic Regression and K-nearest neighbors to investigate the Q-Chat for autism screening. The ML achieved an accuracy of 90% overall, with SVM being the most effective at 95%. H. Abbas  trained in two algorithms using structured parent-reported questionnaires and key behaviors from home videos. Feature selection, engineering and encoding techniques were applied to handle data challenges. Clinical data from thousands of at-risk children for Autism were included in the dataset. As a result, significant improvement in screening accuracy compared to standard tools was demonstrated through metrics such as AUC, sensitivity, and specificity. The SHIFO AI team  developed the Autizm AI application available on Apple AppStore. The model used in the application is trained on collected data of over 1,054 children. The data is based on the behavioral questions listed by the Q-Chat screening tool. This model allows the user to predict the presence or absence of ASD with 97% accuracy. Similarly, an application named ASDetect  developed at La Trobe University is available on the Google Playstore. This app enables parents and practitioners to review early possible signs of Autism in childhood. With actual clinical videos of children with and without ASD, each question focuses on specific social communication behavior i.e. pointing or social smiling. Concludingly, the above listed studies have employed various ML and DL techniques for ASD detection, have contributed largely to advancing the field. However, these techniques come with certain drawbacks, i.e., time-consuming, resource-expensive, and financially burdensome. Studies that involve behavioral, facial expression, structural emotional, mental disorder analysis, and medical imagery often demand huge time and financial investments. These techniques may showcase promise in accuracy and efficiency, but their implementation could be impractical for widespread adoption due to costs and resource requirements.

heading: Project Rationale:
content: The project addresses the challenges of the traditional methods for ASD diagnoses which are time-consuming and expensive. These traditional diagnosis processes include a series of interviews with the guardians and long behavioral observation of those affected by ASD. Moreover, society is not very educated about such neurodevelopmental disorders which makes people hesitant to seek professional help for such issues. To address this issue and provide a valuable solution for early detection of Autism, the main aim of this project lies in transforming the ASD diagnostic process. The proposed intelligent system, that will be developed as an outcome of this FYP project, will provide an easy and effective method for parents to improve their child’s lifestyle. Early therapy has been proven to be crucial in improving the social skills of people affected by ASD which can be achieved through this project. The objective will be achieved by using behavioral questionnaire data and applying various classification techniques to mark a case as ASD or NON-ASD. All the techniques will be evaluated and compared to find the most accurate one. The outcome will be mapped to user-friendly and robust application that would be readily available to the parents for improving developmental outcomes. The application will support the individuals by providing early diagnoses which will enable them to start early necessary therapy.

Algorithm implementation: Once the data has been prepared, various machine learning algorithms will be implemented to develop the predictive model. Our goal would be to create a robust and accurate model that will be capable of predicting Autism based on responses from the Q-Chat-10 and AQ-10 surveys. Model evaluation and comparison: These developed models would be evaluated using various evaluation metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score. This phase aims to assess the models’ performance and identify any kind of over-fitting or under-fitting issues. Multiple models will be compared to evaluate the most effective one, for considering both the sensitivity and specificity in Autism diagnosis. Behavioral trait analysis: After a successful model development, our focus will be shifted toward understanding the connections between various behavioral traits identified in the surveys and ASD. Statistical measures would be employed to analyze the relationships and gain insights into the importance of specific traits for the diagnosis process. This analysis would contribute to the interpretability of the model and enhance the understanding of Autistic characteristics. heading: I.	ABSTRACT
content: Pakistan's economy depends heavily on agriculture, however rural farmers do not have access to many advantages, such as weather information, current expertise, and scientific farming practices. Traditional methods alongside literacy issues and poor connectivity hinder farmers from applying innovative solutions, and hence they face low returns and economic losses. The biggest problem is that farmers usually do not receive timely information regarding government schemes, correct crop calendars, and scientific information regarding soil and irrigation. Additionally, illiteracy limits their access to text-based programs, and in remote locations, unreliable internet makes online-only solutions unfeasible. To overcome these challenges, this project puts forth PakFasal, a Flutter-based mobile application that offers localized learning content, voice-to-text communication for uneducated farmers, offline data storage, and an immediate marketplace to bridge farmers with businesses. The app also incorporates weather prediction and IoT-based soil sensors (pH level and moisture) to provide real-time field information. Some of the expected outcomes are better decision-making in crop management, maximized water use and fertilizers, lowered reliance on intermediaries, and increased farmer participation. By combining mobile technology, voice interfaces, and IoT sensors, the app aims to empower farmers with knowledge and tools that increase productivity and support sustainable agriculture.

heading: 1.1	Domain Background
content: Agriculture forms the core of Pakistan's economy and provides employment to almost half of the labour force and adds considerably to GDP. Though critical to economic growth, the sector suffers from many challenges, especially in the rural sector, as farmers do not have easy access to information and technologies of modern farming methods. Farmers continue to use traditional farming methods handed down through generations, without scientific proof in many cases. This leads to low yield from crops, poor quality of farm products, and ineffective utilization of water and fertilizers. Modern farm methods, when utilized appropriately, are capable of raising productivity considerably, but there is a significant hurdle in the way of such knowledge becoming available in localized forms and versions so as to be understandable to farmers. All the latest developments in the sector of Information and Communication Technology (ICT), especially mobile applications, have brought forth new ways to enhance agriculture-related activities. Even rural communities are now familiar with smartphones, and their potential needs to be utilized to present educational information, weather information, and direct marketing links. Apart from that, integration with Internet of Things (IoT) devices like moisture and pH sensors of the soil provides farmers with information in real time about their fields, enabling data-based decision-making. If localized voice-based support is also integrated with such networks for non-literate farmers, these networks have the capability to revolutionize the way knowledge of agriculture is distributed and practiced. Furthermore, the application of machine learning and decision support systems also makes agriculture smart. Machine learning applications can draw very precise predictions and customized suggestions by verifying huge databases of up-to-date and past data (such as weather, crops performance, soil health, and prices at the markets). The DSS can apply this data and assist producers in making critical decisions regarding which crops to grow, and at what time and frequency to plant and irrigate them, and how they can combat pests and diseases. When combined with local language assistance and vocal support for illiterate farmers, such technologies can transform conventional farming into smart, sustainable, and lucrative farming, bridging long-existing gaps between information sharing and resource use.

heading: 1.2	Problem Statement
content: The three key challenges faced by Pakistan's farmers are: (1) inability to get timely localized agriculture information, such as government programs, crop calendars, and disease management strategies, (2) literacy and connectivity issues since most farmers are illiterate or semi-literate and inhabit regions with weak internet connectivity, and (3) reliance on unscientific agriculture practices, wherein irrigation and use of fertilizers are done on a guesswork basis without any scientific inputs. There are currently existing mobile applications and SMS platforms that have tried to solve some of these problems, but none of these solutions have offline capabilities, real-time weather forecasting, or connectivity with low-cost IoT devices. In view of, a complete, focused on farmers solution is urgently needed. Farmers in Pakistan lack localized information, are illiterate, have connectivity issues, and have no access to intelligent, mostly offline, sensors (IoT) based decision support system DSS.

heading: 1.3	Proposed Solution
content: To address these problems, this project proposes PAKFASAL, a mobile application developed in Flutter that provides agricultural education and decision support in a farmer-centric manner. The app will deliver tutorials, articles, and videos in multiple local languages, ensuring accessibility for farmers across Pakistan. A voice-to-text interface will allow illiterate farmers to interact with the app naturally, while offline caching will make content available even in low-connectivity regions. The system integrates real-time weather forecasting and IoT-based soil sensors (pH and moisture), offering actionable insights on irrigation scheduling and fertilizer usage. In addition, the app will feature a farmer–company marketplace to eliminate middlemen and a query portal where farmers can upload crop issues (text, voice, or pictures) for expert or AI-driven responses.

heading: 1.4	Results or Outcomes
content: The social and economic outputs of PAKFASAL are anticipated. Farmers will have access to the correct, localized, and timely agricultural information, facilitating increased productivity and the quality of crops. Live weather and soil sensor integration will encourage scientific farming techniques, conserve water and enhancing soil health. The marketplace function will empower farmers by enabling them to buy inputs directly from firms at reduced costs and without the exploitative intermediaries. The addition of offline capabilities and voice functionality provides accessibility to illiterate and far-flung farmers. In sum, the system is designed to enhance agricultural production, lower expenses, and empower the farmer with information and technology, promoting sustainable agriculture and better livelihood.

heading: 2.	Problem Statement
content: Farmers in Pakistan face a range of interrelated hurdles that highly impede agricultural productivity and sustainability. The first hurdle relates to the relatively timely and localized agricultural information informing such as government support programs, crop calendars, and disease/pest management practices. Farmers therefore cannot make informed choices without such information sources. The second hurdle relates to the many illiteracy and connectivity challenges. Many farmers are illiterate or semi-illiterate and live in rural locations where connectivity is the most inadequate. This blocks those individuals from using digital tools or accessing newer knowledge of practices and innovations. Additionally, many farmers remain committed to using traditional or un-scientific practices and often make decisions around irrigation, fertilizer and pest management from instinct instead of from supporting data or information. While some mobile apps or SMS applications exist to challenge some of these issues, little exists to provide offline tools or real-time weather forecasts or connect with cost-sensitive IoT devices. In this context, we need to produce a solution that is holistic, farmer-centred and that could be used, even in low-connectivity situations, to build on intelligent decision support systems (DSS) based on sensors.

heading: 3.	Project Objectives
content: The overall goal of the PAKFASAL project is the creation of an intelligent farm platform that will supply location-based precise recommendations to the farmer with an integrated Suggestion System and Decision Support System (DSS).The platform is designed to support famers at making decisions on which crops to use, time of planting, irrigation scheduling, and disease management by processing real-time information on current weather and soil conditions and local farming practices. PAKFASAL distinguishes itself from other static sources of information by creating customized and personalized recommendations that address specific locations and requirements of each farmer, helping them be highly productive and take minimal risks. By its decision support functionality, the system enables famers to embrace sustainability, optimize use of sources, and overall increase efficiency in farm operations, which leads directly to enhanced crop output and agricultural development within Pakistan.

heading: 4.	Related work
content: In the last few years, there has been an interest in using Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) in agriculture to assist farmers in decision-making and management of resources. Some mobile applications and IoT solutions have been created globally, but most of them have not been localized, supported offline, or made accessible for illiterate farmers. One major category of related work is mobile-based agricultural advisory systems.

heading: 4.1	mKrishi Platform:
content: The mKrishi platform in India provides location-specific advice to farmers via mobile phones [1]. Although it has enhanced farmer knowledge, its SMS dependence restricts its applicability for illiterate farmers.

heading: 4.2	Digital Green Program:
content: The Digital Green program utilizes community videos to educate farmers but relies mostly on facilitators for implementation [2]. These systems show the potential of digital tools in agriculture but fail to offer interactive and self-service solutions.

heading: 4.3	IoT-Based Smart Farming System:
content: Another area of research is IoT-based smart farming. Studies have shown the effectiveness of soil moisture and pH sensors for irrigation and fertilizer management. For instance, Jain et al. [3] recommended an IoT-based system that senses soil condition and sends data to the central server for data analysis. Such systems enhance efficiency in the use of resources but prove too expensive or complicated for small farmers in developing nations. The inclusion of affordable sensors on an easy-to-use mobile platform continues to be a gap in this technology.

heading: 4.4	Weather forecasting Integration:
content: Weather forecasting integration is also becoming increasingly significant in precision agriculture. As per Mittal [4], the availability of weather information in a timely manner can play a major role in sowing and harvesting decisions, minimizing crop failure risks. However, most weather programs are designed for the public rather than farmers. Results can be improved by bridging this gap by combining agricultural recommendations with predictions.

heading: 4.5	Voice-Based and Multilingual Interfaces:
content: Voice-based and multilingual interfaces have also been tested to make technology accessible to illiterate farmers. A study by Rahman et al. [5] proved that natural language interfaces enable illiterate users to interact well with mobile apps. However, few Agri-apps have employed this method, particularly in South Asian languages. In contrast to these current solutions, PAKFASAL is a one-stop-shop platform by integrating localized educational materials, offline usability, voice-to-text functionality, live weather forecasting, and IoT sensor integration within a single mobile app. This integrated approach not only overcomes technological but also social and language challenges of farmers in Pakistan.

heading: 5.1.1	Requirement Elicitation & Analysis:
content: This step involves gathering both functional and non-functional requirements while focusing on farmers’ needs such as regional language support, offline usage, voice features, weather updates, and sensor data. User and business requirements are documented to guide development.

heading: 5.1.2	System Design:
content: UI/UX mock-ups for the mobile app are created, the backend architecture and database schema are defined, and the data flow from IoT sensors to Firebase and the app is planned.

heading: 5.1.3	Mobile App Development (Flutter):
content: The mobile application is built using Flutter with content in local languages. Voice-to-text and text-to-speech features are added for farmers with low literacy, and offline coaching using Hive or SQLite ensures the app works without an internet connection.

heading: 5.1.4	Backend, Clouds & ML Integration:
content: Firebase Firestore is used for real-time data, Firebase authentication handles secure logins through phone or email, and Firebase Storage stores farming-related images and videos.  Historical and streaming data is processed by a cloud-based Machine Learning module that creates insights such as recommendations for crops, irrigation time, and pests and disease detection. The insights are then provided as input to the Decision Support System that involves decision rules and models for customized recommendations through the app to the farmer.

heading: 5.1.5	IoT Sensor Integration:
content: pH and moisture sensors are connected using Arduino or ESP32. Data is transferred to Firebase using MQTT or HTTP protocols and displayed in real time on the app for farmers to monitor field conditions.

heading: 5.1.6	DSS & Weather API Integration:
content: We use trusted weather APIs for giving local current weather, early warnings, and environmental information. The DSS is valuable where water use decisions need to be taken on the spot, decisions on planting, and avoiding extreme weather conditions such as heat waves, frost, or heavy rainfall etc.

heading: 5.1.7	Farmer–Company Marketplace:
content: Farmers can browse, and purchase verified products like seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides, and communicate directly with vendors through a chat feature.

heading: 5.1.8	Query Portal:
content: Farmers can send questions using text, voice, or plant images. Experts or AI provide answers, which are stored to build a useful FAQ section for future reference.

heading: 5.1.9	Validation and Testing:
content: Android automated testing is performed along with integration testing for IoT devices, APIs, and backend systems. Pilot testing with a group of rural farmers ensures the system works effectively in real conditions.

heading: 5.1.10	Deployment and Maintenance:
content: The application is deployed by releasing APKs for Android. NGO workers and extension officers are trained for distribution in rural areas, and Firebase Admin is used to manage regular updates and improvements.

heading: 5.2	System Architecture
content: Architecture of PAKFASAL suggested is of the following layers:

heading: 5.2.1	Data Layer (the Storage & Database)
content: •	Firebase Firestore organizes and preserves user, request, and crop data. •	Firebase Storage is where study materials, pictures, and videos are kept. •	FAQs, crop calendars, and articles are cached offline.

heading: 5.2.2	Presentation Layer (Mobile Application)
content: •	Cross-platform interface designed. •	Farmer-friendly UI with multilingual and voice support. •	Shows tutorials, weather information, sensing data, crop calendar, and question answering,

heading: 5.2.3	Application Layer (Backend Services)
content: •	Firebase/Node.js handles request handling, authentication, and business logic. •	APIs retrieve sensor data and weather information. •	Crop disease forecasting AI/ML component (in the future).

heading: 5.2.4	IoT Integration Layer
content: •	ESP32/Arduino connected soil moisture and pH sensors. •	Information transmitted to Firebase using MQTT/HTTP. •	The application retrieves sensor data that has been extracted and visualized.

content: Testing and Evaluation After successfully building the hardware and completing the programming, we tested the system to check if it works correctly. Our goal was to measure the voltage, current, power, and energy for each of the three phases and send the data to the cloud and web dashboard for monitoring. LCD Display To check the sensors, we linked our system to a three-phase power supply and checked their response. For every phase, the analog voltage signals from the ZMPT101B sensors were just as expected and the current in each line was measured correctly by the ACS712 CT sensors. The signals coming from the sensors were recorded by the microcontroller using its analog pins. EmonLib processed the information from the signals and came up with the proper results. We displayed the real-time values on a 20x4 LCD connected through I2C. It showed readings like: Voltage of each phase Current of each phase Real power and apparent power Energy consumption (kWh) Power factor Figure 5.1 LCD displaying voltage, current, and power of Phase 1 Figure 5.2 LCD displaying voltage, current, and power of Phase 2 Figure 5.3  LCD displaying voltage, current, and power of Phase 3 The readings on the LCD were clear and updated in real-time. Cloud Monitoring with ThingSpeak The ESP32 was connected to Wi-Fi and successfully transferred its data to ThingSpeak. We made three independent channels to handle voltage, current and power measurements. I saw the data from my Arduino on the ThingSpeak dashboard like this: Each phase has its own line graph for both voltage and current. Charts showing electricity use updated on a regular basis Easy access from any device with internet With this cloud platform, we could observe electrical parameters from a distance and in a convenient way. Readings are a depiction of the real electrical characters of the connected system as conducted in monitoring. heading: 2.1 Literature Review
content: The literature which we have studied for our project are as follows.

heading: Image Processing System
content: This system [3] is used as robot to diagnose, identify and classify the wheat crop disease. At first, the designed system takes photos with the help of web cam which is connected to ARM microcontroller. This system uses image processing techniques to find the area ratio of disease spot and to diagnose the disease level. The whole process is applied on the image and then the results are shown on the LCD display. According to them, their system has accuracy rate up to 96.6% in recognition and 92.3% rank accuracy which is near to human eyes judgment accuracy. This is overall a good system, because it is not only identifying the disease, classifying the disease and finding the area ratio o f disease spot but it is also diagnosing the disease level. It would be more perfect system if infected crop area measurement functionality feature is added to system by recording the longitude and latitude of the crop area. 2.1.2 A Novel Machine Vision System for Identification of Yellow Rust in Wheat

heading: Plants
content: This system [4] is used to determine the nature of disease and its depth into the wheat crop. They are also using the image processing techniques. In this system, the crop plants images are taken by using a camera for the detection of any disease from then these images are transferred to PC and represented in MATLAB software. This system identifies one infected leaf that may lead to infect the whole crop. The purpose is to identify the infected one. This is a good system that identifies the disease and area of disease in leaf but doesn’t diagnose the disease level and area of infected wheat crops.

heading: 2.1.3 An Identification of Wheat Rust Diseases in Digital Images: A Review
content: In this study  [5], there are many  methods which had been implemented to detect the crop diseases by taking samples and after analyzing these methods they are trying to identify wheat rust and then train fuzzy neuron networks which further analyze all generated result. They are also using image processing techniques. They are identifying wheat rust disease in good way but they are lacking in the way that they are not diagnosing the disease level and infected wheat crop area. Page 14 of 59

heading: 2.1.4 Leaf Disease Severity Measurement Using Image Processing
content: In this study [6], they are actually trying to measure the severity level of leaf disease. They are using image processing techniques and using simp le threshold and triangle thresh olding method to segment out the leaf infected area. According to them, their accuracy is found to be 98.6%. This is not much efficient in term of time because during image acquisition infected leaf is to be placed on a white background. They are only measuring the severity level which is helpful for farmers to use the specific quan tity for pesticides but not identifying the disease type.

heading: 2.1.5 Disease Detection and Diagnosis on Plat using Image Processing
content: This study [7] is used to detect the diseases with the help of image processing techniques. During the phase of image processing,  infected region is detected and then different multiple features are found. Next step is to apply classification techniques for classifying the diseases. Different feature extraction techniques are used such as color space, Gabor filter, Sobel edge detector and color histogram. They are identifying disease in good way but they are lacking in the way that they are not diagnosing the disease level and infected plant.

heading: 2.1.6 Automatic Detection of Yellow Rust in Wheat Using Reflectance
content: Measurements and Neural Networks In this study [8], at an early stage the development of the yellow rust disease the difference in spectral reflectance are investigated between healthy and diseased wheat plant. Disease detection algorithms are developed which are based on neural networks. Basically, they are developing a cost-effective optical device for detecting disease at an early stage by mounting a spectrograph at boom spray for taking spectral images in field. By doing this, they are targeting pesticides more precisely in the field.

heading: 2.6.1 Agile Model
content: The software development process model that we are using for the development of this system is the agile model. The agile model is a combination of iterative and incremental process models. In the agile model a working product is delivered after each iteration; this is the basic reason behind choosing this model. It is also best suited because it will be relatively quick and as we have time constraints to finish this project we would like to have working versions available. By using this model, we would be developing our system in stages with every working version having more features than the previous one. This would largely decrease the complexity of the project and after each iteration we would be able to get feedback from users on any possible shortcomings which we would then be able to improve in the ne xt iteration. By doing this the product that we would get at our final iteration would be one that would have all the features initially planned for and any variations that would arise when getting feedback from the users. Due to the fact that we are going  to be working iteratively, we would have a sub system or program after each iteration.

heading: 5.1.2 Feature Extraction
content: We have tried two feature extraction techniques which are as follow

heading: 5.1.2.1 Histogram
content: A histogram is a graph that shows frequency of anything. Usually histogram have bars that represent frequency of occurring of data in the whole data set. A Histogram has two axis the x axis and the y axis. The x axis contains event whose frequency you have  to count. The y axis contains frequency. The different heights of bar shows different frequency of occurrence of data. We have applied histogram technique on HSV and RGB of an image and shows accuracy in table no 22.

heading: 5.1.2.2 Local Binary Patterns
content: LBP is a type of visual descriptor used for feature extraction in image processing. LBP  is a simple yet very efficient texture operator which labels the pixels of an image by thresholding the neighborhood of each pixel and considers the result as a binary number.  Due to its discriminative power and computational simplicity, LBP texture operator has become a popular approach in various applications. It can be seen as a unifying approach to the traditionally divergent statistical and structural models of texture ana lysis. Perhaps the most important property of the LBP operator in real -world applications is its robustness to monotonic gray - scale changes caused, for example, by illumination variations. Another important property is its computational simplicity, which m akes it possible to analyze images in challenging real - time settings.

heading: 5.1.3 Model/Classifier Training
content: We have used many classifier techniques to train our model that are as follow Page 45 of 59

heading: 5.1.3.1 Supervised Vector Machine SVM
content: In machine learning,  support vector  machines (SVMs, also support vector networks) are supervised learning models with associated learning algorithms that analyze data used for classification and regression analysis. SVM is a classifier formally defined by separating hyper plane. When we give labeled training data the algorithm outputs an optimal hyper plane which categorizes new examples. In two dimensional space this hyper plane is a line dividing a plane in two parts. There are different types of SVM but we have tried only two type of SVM: • Linear Supervised Vector Machine  (Linear SVM) • Quadratic Supervised vector machine (Quadratic SVM)

heading: 5.1.3.2 Medium K nearest neighbor method (KNN)
content: KNN is a supervised learning algorithm where the result of new instance query is classified based on majority of K-nearest neighbor category. The purpose of this algorithm is to classify a new object based on attributes and training samples. The classifier do not use any model to fit and only based on memory. KNN used neighborhood classification as the predi ction value of the new query instance.

heading: 5.1.3.3 Bagged Decision Tree
content: Bagging is used when our goal is to reduce the variance of a decision tree. Here we create several subset of data from training dataset randomly. Than each collection of subset data is used to train their decision tree. As a result we find different prediction from all subsets. Average of all the predictions from different trees which is more perfect than single decision tree.

heading: 5.1.3.4 Random Forest Algorithm
content: It is an extension over bagging. It takes one extra step where in addition to taking the random subset of data, it also takes the random selection of features rather than using all features to grow trees. When you have many random trees. It’s called Random Forest.

heading: 7.3   Summary
content: Wheat Guard systems are application software which are made for farmer’s use. This systems is used for detection of wheat leaf diseases (Yellow rust). If disease is present on crops our system will tell the severity of diseases. Our system also have pest control portal that will guide farmers in controlling pest that are harmful for crops. We will try to reduce all the complexities that existing systems have so that our system can be used easily and we will pr ovide a user friendly interface which can be easily operated by the novice user as well. The main focus of our system will be to detect wheat leaf diseases which can be helpful for farmers in interrogation and it will help in research work related to wheat and to get the researchers experience through diseases and to make the research more better growth of wheat crops. Our system will have the key specification of being interactive, user friendly interface with less complexities and one the most important secure to use. Our system will generate results about the severity of wheat leaf diseases which will be helpful to determine how much efficient and how much beneficial our system is to use.

heading: Abstract
content: We are in the era of Information Technology. Methods of human-computer interaction are moved towards cloud computing. Cloud computing has become a scalable service consumptions and delivery platform in the field of Service -Oriented Computing. The usage of services particularly in Cloud environment has rapidly increased in the form of SaaS, IaaS & PaaS. In this congested scenario, it is difficult to choose or consequently trust/rely on a particular service or a service provider. Hence the idea of Trust as a Service (TaaS) has emerged. Whenever the user purchases something he will make sure that the product is reliable. So, for this purpose we are developing a dashboard to build the customer trust. Dashboard is the key factor to develop a user interest. Differ websites are providing the dashboard for different products, but this work is scattered as these dashboard is especially for a certain product or services not for all product or services. So, we are providing an interface that shows all product or services performance in a single sc reen called dashboard. It facilitates the user to make decisions about a product or services whether customer needs to purchase it or not. Page 6 of 65

heading: 2.5.1 Incremental software development model
content: Incremental Model is a process of software development where requirements are broken down into multiple standalone modules of software development cycle. Each iteration passes through the requirements, design, coding and testing phases.

heading: Figure 8: Incremental Model
content: Page 28 of 65 The system is put into production when the first increment is delivered. The first increment is often a core product where the basic requirements are addressed, and supplementary features are added in the next increments. Once the core product is analyzed by the client, there is plan development for the next increment.

heading: 2.5.2 Characteristics of Incremental module
content: • System development is broken down into many mini development projects • Partial systems are successively built to produce a final total system • Once the incremented portion id developed, requirements for that increment are frozen

heading: 2.5.3 Justification of Incremental model
content: • Requirements of the system are clearly understood • When demand for early release of product arises • When team resources are not very well skilled or trained • Such model is more in use for web application and product based companies

heading: 2.5.4 Advantages
content: • Software will be generated quickly during the software life cycle • It is flexible and less expensive to change requirements and scope • Thought the development stages changes can be done • This model is less costly compared to others • Customer can respond to each built Page 29 of 65

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: Young drivers’ road traffic crashes are a major public health concern. The introduction of various engineering and enforcement measures has led to substantial improvement of road safety in the high-income countries. On-road driver training and test, on the other hand, is generally regarded as safety-ineffective. Different causes of this ineffectiveness have been reported in the literature: higher order skills are insufficiently trained, training is psychologically unsound, there are insufficient opportunities to take fare tests, and there is a lack of standardization and objectivity in assessment and feedback. Driving simulators are increasingly recognized throughout the world as tools for training and assessment. We Page 9 of 52 recognize the problem that these advantag es of driving simulators are not optimally exploited. This project will focus on driver assessment in particular. Simulators offer accurate measurements of driver performance; every second, a simulator provides an abundance of information from the simulate d vehicles. It is possible to calculate simple measures related to steering and speed control, speed limit exceedances, turn indicator usage, lane deviations, time to time collision, and so forth. The first aim of this project is to develop a method that c an process data obtained from driving simulators into a valid applicant-profile on driving skill and driving style. Research is conducted that investigates how to get the most out of objective driver data with the aim of answering the question: Who is the applicant? What are his or her strengths and weaknesses? Current research and development in simulation -based test (also including defense and aviation) makes continuing progress in the area of hardware and software, so as to provide a more realistic virtual experience. We recognize the problem that no agreement exists regarding what levels of fidelity (i.e., realism) are required for effective simulation -based driver test. Therefore, the second aim of this  project is to develop fundamental knowledge regard ing how simulator fidelity relates to test effectiveness. There were no facilities for online application to apply for learner license. The mode of application is hard written, which is very time consuming processes. heading: Abstract
content: Technological advancements these days always demand ease and comfort to common User’s life. The basic purpose of this application  is to provide users with relevant information about brands and franchises in which they are interested. Users can view two main categories at homepage which include restaurants and food. User can select any category which he/she wishes to and then view li st of companies and upon selecting any company he/she can view products of that company along with a franchise button which will show list of franchises  Users can Subscribe to any company or any franchise for which they shall be receiving updates of promot ions and discounts in form of push notifications. User can rate/review products. IOS application will be developed which will be configured with the centralized database.. Rating system is available as well as user’s review about any product which will ens ure quality is maintained and it will help user’s find best product around them.  Companies can request registration with application which will be approved by admin. Companies can then add, delete and update products and franchises can manage these produc ts. This platform where companies interact with users so cheaply will minimize their advertising expense, which will encourage them to be a part of it. This application will only act as source of connection between franchisers and users as no online servic es will be provided.

heading: 1 Introduction
content: Technology has revolutionized  today’s modern wor ld, people want easy and efficient ways to their problems. Life in this era is full of technological improvement and in this technological age, it is very difficult for any management to survive without tak ing the advantage of technology. People are too much busy with daily dealings they don’t have time to check any application or website to know about available discount s and promotions. We have focused to provide a platform where brands can connect with their customers. Customers don’t have to waste their time in applications that send various notifications which customers mostly find useless. They are only interested to  know about any promotion or discount which best matches their own interest so it is better to provide them with an application thorough which they can get notifications of discounts and promotions of their favorite brands. Notify U is an IOS application with web based admin panel which opens a new and efficient way for both major stake holders which include users and brands. Customer can view two categories which include clothing and restaurants. Brands in these two domains can register with this application and they can then add their franchises and manage them accordingly. Customer can view products and franchises of registered brands and he/she can rate their products. They can also find locations of these brands on map and they can subscribe to any bra nd or any of its franchise and for this they will get notifications of promotions and discounts only available at their subscribed brand or franchise. NotifyU is a platform for brands to advertise the ir products with no cost and promote their items with this application. Brands will find efficient way to connect to their customers and also know about quality of their products through rating system as customer can rate their product. This will help brands to work on quality assurance and make necessary cha nges to their products. User can view all brands and franchises from IOS application and brands can manage their products and franchises from admin panel of web. This application will only link users and brands and it will not provide any online delivery s ervice where customers can place their orders. This application will only keep users updated with any promotion and discount available at their subscribed brand or franchise. This project consists of four modules. First and the most important is Customer module on IOS application then comes  Admin panel for admin, Company panel for companies, franchise panel for franchises. Below is brief description of how these modules will work.

content:  Can approve any company  Can disapprove any company  Can view all companies and their details  Can view list of franchises which are registered with their respective company  Can view ratings of company and franchises.

Franchise panel  Can view its panel after it’s respective company adds them form their panel  Will receive list of products from company’s panel  Can manage products making them available or unavailable  Can view its subscribers  Can send notifications of promotions and discounts to its subscribers. IOS Mobile Application for  User  IOS mobile application.  Sign up option which will require email and other details.  Can view two categories which include Restaurants and clothing.  User can select a complete company or he/she may select any franchise from that company to subscribe them.  User receives notifications for promotions, discounts or any new update for only those company or franchise which he/she subscribed.  Users can rate and review products  User can find locations of their desired franchise

heading: 1.1 Objectives
content: Our main objective is to facilitate user to maximum extend in which user is provided with information of his/her own interest. In their busy routines of everyday commitments users must be provided with a platform where they are ensured about safe guarding their own individual interest. Mostly users don’t find th ese type of applications worthy because they are not provided with automatic notifications of their own choice. They feel annoyed of  irrelevant notifications for which they don’t have much time to see. Providing information about different products is not a difficult task as many of the applications are already working in this sector but to maintain consumer’s interest and his relevancy is the core objective which this  project focuses on. Due to ease and comfort  most of the people are shifting to applications which provide online services or provide them with relevant information. Figure 1: Trends in online services According to Information and communication technology (ICT)

From the above graph the trend is evident that people are shifting to modern day means of services which are online services. With every single year number of users who are using or viewing online services is increase. The core objective of this project is to target this audience and encourage them to use online services  which include mobile ap plication. This can only happen when users will get interesting, easy, and relevant information which they wish to get. This project does not aim to be a mediator who will be providing online services and act as a middle man in between the franchisers and users. This project will only provide relevant information to users and users will get notifications as earliest as franchisers have generated it but only of those franchises which they have selected. Another core objective of this project is to provide Companies a platform where they can interact with their customers in such a way that they can provide them with their product details and features. They usually advertise and spend large sum of money in their discounts and promotional campaign. Our objective is to give them a home where they can display their brand free of cost. They can view their rating which will help them generate any promotion or discount to any specific franchise depending upon the traffic. This application will provide a relevant platform to both users and Companies  where interests of both the stake holders will be protected

heading: 1.2 Problem Statement
content: Everyone these days is too much busy to waste their time in useless and unhelpful application. These applications keep on sending unnecessary notifications which users are annoyed of. These applications are only trying to sale maximum of their products wit hout any prior filtering that either this customer is interested in this domain or not. People rarely find a time to investigate for any discounts and promotions available at brands. There is no such work done in which user is kept in his/her comfort zone  showing him/her all items of their own interest and demand. If they want to search for food they have to go through food applications beside this if they want to locate cloths they need to visit different clothing websites and application. This domain is targeted in this project as we are providing both these categories under one roof. A survey was conducted in this regard in which One hundred people were questioned that weather they find notifications in online applications relevant according to their ow n interest and requirement. The results are shown below in pie chart. Figure 2: Pie chart From the result above it is evident that most of the people find these notifications irrelevant and they feel annoyed because in their busy schedule they receive these notifications frequently and most of the times they are irrelevan t to their own individual context. When people were asked about their option they stated that their perception about these applications is always high that it

will be according to their own individual interest and they will be provided with easy, fast and relevant solutions but the actual world is different. They receive notifications of almost everything and they don’t have choice to filter and at last they are annoyed that they eventually uninstall that application Women are always interested in shopping and they want to buy almost everything when it comes on sales and promotions. They are eager to know about sales and promotions on clothing brands but they have a busy schedule working as house wives, business and jo b working women. They want something which can inform them timely for any promotion and discount available. This can save their time and much of their energies and they can give time to their family. Living in a Muslim society some women are not allowed to  visit markets most often or they them self -avoid going out excessively. For these women it is very important to provide them a relevant platform where they can avail promotions and discounts on products of their own interests and needs. Franchisers and b rands invest huge sum of money in reaching to their consumers in efficient manner. They need some efficient and cheapest means of advertisement through which they can make people hear about them

heading: 1.3 Assumptions and constraints
content: The project is chartered assuming that:  Brands in both categories will allow us to display their menu on our application.  Brands will encourage a platform where they can advertise cheaply  User will welcome a platform where he/she can manage notificatio ns and get data relevant to his/her domain  Brands will generate promotions and discounts as this application stands on notifications for promotions and discounts.

heading: 1.4 Project Scope
content: Mostly people are too much busy and they hardly find time to watch television and use  other social applications to inquire for any discounts and promotions available at brands. Analyzing these observations it worked as motivation for us to develop this app lication for customer’s ease and comfort. Brands do advertise about their sales and promotions and there is complete promotional campaign held by brands but not everyone gets benefits from it as they are unaware of such sales and discounts due to their busy schedule and daily life dealings World is becoming online day by day and people want quick and efficient solutions to their Problems. User will be given full freedom to manage about what notifications he/she wants to get User can view all products of various brands which come under two categories that Include restaurants and clothing.  He can subscribe to complete company or its specific Franchise as well. User can view location of any franchise which he/she wants and he/she can Also rate any product and view company and franchise overall rating Initially scope of the project is to cover major brands which come under two categories which are discussed previously. This project as wide scope as it provides franchisers with a platform where they can interact with their customers in a way that they can advertise about their discounts and promotional campaigns in cheap and efficient manner. Brands spend huge amount of money on such promotional campaigns which offer discoun ts so our application will be a place where they can easily do so without wasting huge sum of money on such campaigns. This application will work as connector between brands and their customers. This application is not providing any online delivery services as users can only view products and get notifications of discounts available. We as admin our not charging anything at initial level from brands or any other stake holder. This application will just provide a suitable platform for both customers and brands where they can get benefit from each other.

heading: 2.1 LITERATURE REVIEW
content: Currently there is no such online application which is providing services in this domain that users will only get notifications which they wish to. Data relevancy is the core target and objective of this project. Many other applications and websites are wo rking in this domain but their mode of work is different.

heading: Daraz [1]
content: Daraz.pk is one of the trend setters in market with vast range of online services which they provide. From electronics to household items daraz covers almost everything in their product line. Their business model is to provide products through various vendors and they provide these products at user’s door step through home delivery services. They are not information providers or linkers between common users and other brands. They have the ir own product line which they sale through online services. Daraz only covers products of brands which they have available in their stock. They don’t c over detailed products of each and  every brand such as clothing brands and others as well. Their primary focus and objective is to earn maximum revenue by selling their products online. Daraz has its own discount mechanism and they do not need any brand’s promotional campaign or discount offer to be displayed on their platform. Sales which brands offer are not reflected by daraz. They only offer discounts on products which they wish to. Daraz has many local brands and vendors and they operate in a way that they provide cheapest of products from various brands. Their target market is not only those brands whic h are famous among common user. They provide you with what you want at cheapest of rates in which quality is also compromised. They work on cash on delivery mode or online payments are also accepted for any order which you place. Order is dispatched within  two-three working days and user can only check the product on the spot at the time of delivery.

heading: Food Panda [2]
content: Food panda is another attractive application which provides relevant data for all restaurants around your town. User can view all nearby rest aurants and their menu list and he/she has the option to order online for which they charge a small sum of amount. They have collaborated with many restaurants which enables them to offer promotions and discounts on various brands but there is no mechanism  or feature which helps user to select any of his/her favorite restaurant for which they shall receive notifications of any discount or promotion available. The domain as evident from name is only food and they are only targeting food brands.  Food panda a lso sends notifications to users but these notifications are random and sometime people find it annoying

heading: Eat Oye [3]
content: Eat oye is an application working in the domain of food sector. They provide online services and you can locate your nearest restaurants and order anything from them which you want. They also charge a fixed amount as per their delivery charges. They have some discounts available on different brands subject to their collaboration with these brans. This is very similar to food panda and the ir operational management is same. They also send notifications to users but these notifications are not always useful as they don’t have any prior knowledge about what each
individual wants. They don’t offer any such feature through which user can customize their interests and get only those notifications which they wish to.

heading: Kaymu [4]
content: Kaymu operates in many countries which includes Pakistan as well. They have a platform where you can buy or sell products. For buyers on kaymu they can discover many products across many categories. They can share their feedback and reviews about products with other members which use kaymu. If there is some seller you want to favor kaymu allows you to follow him/her. There are notifications generated for buyers whenever any deal is available for them. Upon their trend to visit different products a wish list is created in which most frequently viewed category or products are displayed. Similarly sellers on kaymu can post their ad in order to sale their products. They can also promote their products to other members. Kaymu provides i ts user with online services in which users can order and kaymu send that shipment to their door step. They are working on cash on delivery system and also with other payment options which include credit cards and debit cards as well. If you want to sell anything you just have to post a ad by taking a picture of that product and filling other required details as well which include product’s price, category and other details as well. Kaymu is a platform where you can get various products from various categories but again they work on a business model in which they are providing online services and earning handsome money. There are promotions and discounts available on kaymu which they are offering as a result of collaboration with different vendors and brands. They don’t not reflect the sales which appear on many brands such as summer and winter sales. Their purpose is to sell products through their own platform and not to l ink customers with brands where customers can get required information and product line of different brands and then they can personally visit those brands to buy them.

heading: Lootlo [5]
content: Lootlo is another online service provider. They work on the same model which is to provide users with various products covering many categories and these products are shipped to customer’s door through home delivery services. The quality  of product is only relia ble to this extend that you can check it once at the time of delivery only. This is valid for many products but for mobile phones and other products for which companies provide annual warranty, they do offer warranty as per the company policy. They have ma ny vendors associated with them which enable them to provide with discounts and other promotions as well. Lootlo does not reflect big sales which major brands offer. Their goal is to sell everything from their own platform. They are not information providers who connect customers with sellers. They are service providers earning huge profits over their vast product line by providing users with what they want through online services.

heading: ANALYSIS FROM LITERATURE REVIEW
content: There are many service providers in market  who provide online services to common users in many different ways. Some of them cover only single domain such as food which include Food panda [2] and Eat Oye [3]. Both of these restrict to food domain only and beside this they provide online delivery se rvices. Daraz [1] and lootlo[5] are supplying with various products at customer’s door step and with kaymu[4] you can place your order as well as sell any product. All of these applications work in their own specific domain. None of the application describ ed above

has this specific feature which we are offering which is that use will select his/her brands and he/she will only be notified in case these brands generate any discount or promotional campaign. Almost all the application discussed previously send notifications to their users but these notifications are random and consumers find them annoying sometimes. With our application when they have an idea that the notifications which they are receiving is only and only relevant to their own selected or favored interest then they will surely view his notification. This will ensure that they don’t miss any discounts available on their favored brand. At the back of their mind they will have an idea that this application provides us with notifications which we want. This will ensure end user’s interest is maintained in the application as this will be relevant to their own individual context. These applications don’t reflect the mega sales which brands offer they only have one business model which is to sell e verything through their own platform. For instance they do not pass on winter and summer sales which major brands offer. Source  URL Daraz                https://www.daraz.pk/about/

Software development life cycle The software development life cycle which we used in our project is iterative model Iterative model Is a model in which process starts with simple implementation of small set of software requirements which are gathered previously Fu rther iterations are performed to the evolving version until complete system is formed which is ready for deployment Following are the reasons why we used this model  In this model we can produce high level design of the application before we actually built the product and define the design solution for entire product. Later on we can design and built a dummy version of that, and then produce the design based on what had been built earlier  In this model we always build our product step by step along wit h its improvement so we can easily locate faults at early stage which later helps to avoid any downward flow of the faults  In this model we can get reasonable user feedback because when we are presenting sketches and blueprints of the product to users for their feedback, we are efficiently asking them to imagine and tell us about how the product will work  In this model we spend much of the time in designing the project and less time is spent on documenting it

heading: 1. Creating an app that is different from existing apps:
content: Due to immense competition in IOS application market it is a big hurdle for developers and idea generators to create an app that makes a difference. Designing an application that looks different, creative, have usable features and intuitive design. It should provide a wholesome experience

heading: 2. Dealing with IOS versions & device sizes:
content: Users have devices of different sizes and software versions. Creating an app that tar gets only one version of IOS will be a biggest problem and will down rate the application in market. Keeping in view the limitations based on screen sizes, intensities, OS requirements.

heading: 3. Making an interactive application:
content: In every application interactions are equally important as responsive design. Making sensors in an application will be a plus however dealing with sensors will be challenging during design phase. Consider successful applications with sensors & extracting ideas from them will be a challenge.

heading: 4. Performance vs. Battery usage:
content: Making an interactive app with attractive design is one side but making an app that gives a fast performance & uses minimum battery is a big challenge for developers. Making an app that runs equally well on every version of device is a considerable thing for developers because most apps that work well on latest devices and have sensors may not work on old versions. Running test cases and prototyping is a good solution to this issue.

heading: 5. Mobile content management:
content: As content in the app is ever growing and every app includes images, videos and animations. Altogether content takes a lot of power & bandwidth. Wireless connectivity failures and frequent connection drops may disturb the content of application. Content must be simplified according to the need & reliable content must be available to get good performance from the application.

heading: 6. Patent issues:
content: Several IOS features may give rise to patent issues. So, using features and implementing ideas should be considered as a challenge before developing an application.

heading: 7. IOS market search engine:
content: IOS application market is ever growing and versions of IOS devices change rapidly there are more than 8 million apps and creating an app that is different & innovative in IOS market is a biggest challenge.

heading: 5.2 Future Work:
content: As it is evident that our target audience for this application is elite class carryin g IPhone with them. Later on this project intends to increase its scope in future by developing it in android which will give quality services to android users as well. This project aims to bring ease to consumer’s life by maintaining his/her interest in o ur services by giving them only that material what they wish to get. New features shall be introduced for efficient advertising for franchisers which shall maintain their interest in this application We also plan to provide some new features to both customers and brands where customers will be able to interact and ask questions from brands which they like and brands will be able to answer their queries. Another feature which will allow customer to place an order online and we will supply details of order t o brands who will then deliver the selected products at customer’s doorstep. Building this application on android will be great future scope as there is a noticeable population who uses android smart phones. These new features when added will help this application flourish and achieve its objectives by creating ease in customer’s life and by giving brands better and better environment to reach to their clients efficiently and cheaply.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary:
content: This project is  about and interactive IOS application which is our primary goal and the management side is covered on a web panel where admin, companies and franchises can  perform their functionalities This application links brands and companies with their customers. The se brands can add, delete and update their products. They can also generate notifications for their customers which includes a push notification for any available discount or promotional campaign. These notifications are of two different domains. One is that company can send notifications which mean that all franchises which are registered with that specific company will reflect this discount or promotion. In this case customers who have subscribed complete company will receive a push notification which will convey them the available discount and this discount will be available at all franchises of the company. The second domain includes franchise notification which means that this notification will only be available for customers who have subscribed this specific franchise. This feature will help user to build his interest in the application as he will not be annoyed by notifications and at the back of his mind he will have an idea that whatever notification I am receiving is of my own interest and this notification is due to my subscription on the application. In this way user will be updated with all discounts and promotions from the brands which he/she like. This application will only work as an intermediate between customer and brands. This application will not provide any online delivery services to clients. They can only view product list of various brands under two categories which include clothing and franchises. It will work as a platform where both major stakeholders who include customers and brands can get benefit from each other. User can see all franchises which are registered with that specific brand and he can view location of that specific franchise from this application and he/she will be on her way to grasp available discount. Brands invest huge sum of money to advertise for their promotional campaigns and sales which they initiate in order to promote their brands. This application will provide them the cheapest way to advertise about such campaigns. They can view number of subscribers and products ratings which will help them work on their quality management skills and strategies. It will create ease for both brands and customers as both are getting aid from each other. .
