heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: It is known all around that, in today's market; it is extremely difficult to begin another little scale business and survive the opposition from the entrenched and settled owners. In this modern era, when people are getting more and more busy, the larger p art of individuals are finicky when it comes to placing a food order. With the help of our automation system the user will not have to worry about the cash inflow and outflow (Expenses and cash) that does not match. The user just has to create an account and can enter m enu in the Restaurant Automation  system and use tablets to take order from the customer and all of its details will be sent to kitchen so that they can know what dish they have to cook easily and in the accountants hands for cash. In this sy stem you can also enter your stocks of meat, rice, other food etc. to check there is no problem anywhere. You can also enter the salary of your workers (cooks, order taker, waiter) on daily basis and monthly basis so that you will have a proper idea if you r restaurant is going in profit or in loss and what things you have to change to make your Restaurant a profitable one and of good quality. Web based requesting framework that I am proposing here, incredibly disentangles the requesting procedure for both t he client and the restaurant. Cashier and staff can pick at least one things to submit a request which will arrive in the Cart. Once the request is set it is entered in the database and recovered in basically constant. This enables Restaurant Employees to rapidly experience the requests as they are gotten and handle all requests productively and successfully with negligible postponements and disarray.

heading: 4.3 Unit Testing
content: We have applied unit testing because in unit testing individual components of the software are testing and this gives the detailed outcome that exact module is working properly. The purpose is that each unit of the system performs as it is designed for . For unit t esting we perform:  Module Testing: To test correct data flow of the software.  Output: valid outputs are generated.  Data structure: data structures with proper convention are used.  Data Integrity: While interacting with database, data is correctly stor ed in correct database.  Boundary Value Evaluation: Boundary values are tested for modules. We divide our Software system into sub modules considering each as one module and performed unit testing to ensure proper functionality of these modules.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: Restaurants are the best business and they never stops. They have very large amount of data that they have to manage and maintain. In order to fulfil this need we have created an automation system which will allow different store owners to register and interact wit h our system and use the facilities provided by our system to manage and make sales. With the help of our management system the user will not have to worry about the cash inflow and outflow (Expenses and cash) that does not match. The user just has to crea te an account and can enter menu in the Restaurant Management system and use tablets to take order from the customer and all of its details will be sent to kitchen so that they can know what dish they have to cook easily and in the accountants hands for ca sh. In this system you can also enter your stocks of meat, rice, other food etc. to check there is no problem anywhere. You can also enter the salary of your workers (cooks, order taker, waiter) on daily basis and monthly basis so that you will have a proper idea if your restaurant is going in profit or in loss and what things you have to change to make your Restaurant a profitable one and of good quality.

Web based requesting framework that I am proposing here, incredibly disentangles the requesting procedure for both the client and the restaurant. Cashier and staff can pick at least one things to submit a request which will arrive in the Cart. Once the request is set it is entered in the database and recovered in basically constant. This enables Restaurant Employees to rapidly experience the requests as they are gotten and handle all requests productively and successfully with negligible postponements and disarray.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Online residentia is basically finding a suitable place for temporary living; this proposed system tackles problems faced by paying guests and. In other words, online residentia refers to finding a desired place for living within the budget and area suitable fo r the person. Online residentia  takes advantage of the information provided by the owners on our website in finding people a suitable place to live in within their reach. Paying guest accommodation is a house fully furnished and owned by a person. Paying guest lives for a temporary period by paying some amount to the owner, it is a fastest way of earning. The rent for a paying guest accommodation is being put on th e basis of one person. Owner provides enough space and facility to the paying guest.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: Our project is inspired by the failure of other projects which provide and facilities with discriminating factor. Many other websites like olx.com and bolee.com are used for same purposes but there is no customer satisfaction. By analyzing the problems of present application and websites we aim to provide a platform to avail best service. The concluding benefits from it is in future this application would be the best and more beneficial source of paying guest as compared to present running application by solving security issue. The main objectives of the proposed system can be enumerated as follows: • Owner and paying guest would be sign up through web or mobile application. • During sign up required information would be first name, last name, CNIC and location for both users. • User can also sign up through Facebook account where application would take his data automatically and other necessary thing would be provided on demand like CNIC and location. • Owner would create a profile and then his rental services would be automatically posted. • Services would include rooms with furnished or simple having dimensions e.g. single bed and attached wash room etc. and other services which may be food laundry and internet. • Owner would post his room’s pictures with different perceptive for those users who want to accommodate • There would be an agreement between owner and paying guest for security of both pa rties and agreement would be online form which would be saved in our database. • Owner’s phone and location would be visible to everyone who would be registered through application. • Paying guest would search his nearest locations through Google map and would  contact through phone number when he /she finds his best option. • Owner profile would be ranked by feedback of his paying guest.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: Online residentia is a system which helps people in finding suitable a ccommodation with the help of our android app and website as well. The system will help in identifying the actual identity of the paying guests, and owners, different information’s are gathered and evaluated for identifying the identity of the persons. People will find place according to their budget. Our app will save time and money both.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & Constraints:
content:  User will be having a valid username and password to access the system  The system will be free of cost.  The system will provide good security agreement.  Extensive documentation will be available with the user.  The  system provides nearest location to the user

heading: 1.5 Project Scope:
content:  Ease of finding accommodation  Time  saving

heading:  Secure
content: In many countries paying Guest concept is increasing rapidly. At early stages paying Guest needs a middle man to get accommodation from the  owner. Later on many applications are developed worldwide to facilitate the people to get their nearby accommodation by the simple access of internet. Similarly, in Pakistan people wants to avail this facility but there is no proper way to find a suitable  paying guest accommodation. Although many applications are developed but they face many flaws like security issues or may be owner does not provide the accurate description about the house and provided facilities. So, we  have developed android application  and web based system  to solve all the problems regarding paying guest accommodation. In our system  we will provide an online agreement paper to reduce the security issues. Besides this we will provide a comparison through which the person, who wants to ta ke an accommodation, chooses the best according to his requirement.

heading: 2.1 Literature Review / Existing System Study:
content: We have researched and found some similar working Systems and we have described about the features that following systems contain and also the features that our system is offering  and not present in the already existing systems. Existing systems along with their features are described below:

heading: Introduction
content: PGO is an Indian android app which provides different categories of accommodation with sharing opportunity and varieties of amenities such Wi -Fi, food and so on. Guests can book online room for short term or long term basis, Guest can speak to house owner, this application with all varieties of accommodation under one roof [1].

heading: Features
content:  It helps user to search a place according City name wise.  It lists two categories paying guest and hostels and user can choose according to requirement.  Paying guest can book room for daily and monthly basis.  Paying guest can list favorite places.

heading: Critical Analysis
content: PGO is an Indian application which covers not globally end user because user can search within the boundary of India territory. PGO is based on android platform only and there is no website for dynamic database and user have no option to write or read anyt hing through website. There is no way in application to detect the nearest location.

heading: Introduction:
content: Olx.com.pk is Pakistani advertisement classified website where differe nt forms are given according to requirement for advertisement. So there is also a  portion of subpage paying guest where ads are posted and paying guest can search and hosts can post their places’ ads [2].

heading: Features:
content:  This website has a subpage “paying guest and roommates” where ads can be post with description and pictures.  Places can be search with “most recent “, “lower price “and “high price” tags.  Ads counts number of visitors and every new visitor can see number of visitors.

heading: Critical Analysis:
content: As this website is not specified for one thing it has many aspects so subpage, related paying guest category, has no number of options like online booking, filters and not easy to determine whether current place is suitable for user or not.

heading: Introduction:
content: Trivago is globally android app for travelers who move from one place to the other for a short time. User can find hotels according to his business plan or trip holidays. More important thing is that user can manage and schedule plan in advance to overcome the problem to find suitable place according to budget and taste [4].

heading: Features:
content:  Compares hotels and find room from hundreds of booking sites worldwide.  Discovers hotels for great price, find travel discounts.   Searches hotels according user budget and helps to plan a trip within financial range.

heading: Critical Analysis:
content: Trivago, android  app, facilitates  tourists and businessmen who want to make their trip planned and avoid  any inconvenience. Trivago is not for those who want homely environment and sometime searching through application hotels are displayed which are too expensive for some user. So this type of application cannot facilitate the all type of user.

heading: Introduction:
content: Home away is a social marketplace where you can locate and book cool places owned by local "Hosts" across the globe [5].

heading: Features:
content:  Paying guest can easily find accommodation according to budget and other needs.   Similarly, paying guest may have special discounts by host.  Paying guest can book places through credit card and can see reviews of previous guest.  Host can keep track of incoming booking and can accept or decline the reservation.  Host can communicate on real time and respond to guest’s inquiries directly from phone

heading: Critical Analysis:
content: We are developing application where there is no widely concept of using credit card so we are focusing on cash by hand after assigning the affidavit by both users. Home Away application offers to communicate users through personal phone and there is online chat system to respond inquiries while using app.

heading: Abstract
content: Nexkey Project is to develop an android keyboard capable of identifying frequently used words to provide personalized and improved typing experience using its prediction system that would use Android API to implement a keyboard with elastic layout that would modify the selected key which is predicted to be clicked next and the victim key which is predicted to not be clicked in case of the word that is being typed by giving selected key more width and reducing the width of victim key. The application will always look for the  victim key from keys which are on either side of the selected key. This app will provide an alternative to already available keyboards on the app store which provides suggestion on-screen which for some people is rather annoying. This will result in user typing their messages at high speed without needing to glance at their keyboards and will reduce the use of backspace key. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Smartphones have quickly become the most important gadgets of our life and provided us with many features that use to require laptop and desktop syst ems. Every year  cell phone industry is progressing towards larger and better displays on their devices by reducing the size of bezels hoping to provide users with distraction free interaction with their device. This means there is no place for physical keyboards instead virtual keyboards are the future. Our Final year project is to develop an Android Keyboard App that will help in avoiding or reducing the mistyping of words due to speedy typing or accidently pressing the key right next to the correct key. Like other available smart keyboards this keyboard will also create a database of words but instead of giving suggestions above the keyboard this app will suggest and predict the next alphabet the user is going to type from previous usage of words thus predicting next alphabet. The app will work in a way that when user clicks an alphabet, it will predict the next alphabet that would be used on the basis of the recently pressed alphabet key and the previously used words that had those same alphabets in same order. As soon as an alphabet key is pressed, the next suggested key will be twice regular key width as one of its neighbour would be selected as a victim key . As user continues to type the word every next alphabet will more specific to the word that is bei ng typed In this way, the user keeps pressing the keys and it will keeps suggesting the next alphabet key leading to the word the user wanted to type. Keyboard will assist user typing by changing the colour of the key as well as increasing its width . Keyboard will also provide the word that is most likely being typed in space bar so user is not forced to type long words completely. Other than users personalized words database would also contain most frequently used stop words in English language. Following image is illustration of the interface, where left side image is for keyboard layout itself, and right side image displays elastic layout activity. heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: Our objective is to create an optimized virtual keyboard that can:  Reduce the attention required during typing process  Eliminate the use of backspace key from user typing experience.  Provide a unique alternative to already available virtual keyboards.  Improve typing experience on smartphones.  Improve typing speed on smartphones.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: Most changes brought in cell phone industry by the revolution of smartphones are welcomed but new way of typing is not one of them.  Although virtual keyboards have replaced physical keyboards on touchscreen displays one cannot argue that overall typing experience on physical keyboard was better. Typing mistake are common when using virtual keyboard on smartphones. To avoid these typos and speed up typing many keyboard now feature autocorrect and personalized suggestion. Although these keyboards are quite popular these days many users still don’t prefer autocorrect feature as this feature itself can cause mistakes due to misinterpretation of the word being typed. There are also users th at tend to turn suggestion off on their keyboards. We aim to create an app that facilitate users by speeding up their typing and reducing mistypes without forcing any suggestions on screen or modifying already typed words.

content: Nexkey Keyboard is  a virtual keyboard that can enhance typing experience  and reduce typing mistakes for smartphone users who do not prefer traditional autocorrect and suggestions in virtual keyboard by modifying the execution of  autocomplete. heading: 6.1.1 Victimization
content: First major hurdle was to ensure that always correct key gets victimized. Majority keys have two neighbours, Application needed to ensure to victimize the neighbour that has lowest probability of being used in the word that is being typed right now. If two predicted keys were to be side-by-side that posed yet another challenge along with keys at the edges which only have once neighbour. Ideal solution for this was to give user partial assist in typing. Instead of changing colour and width of the key to make it easier for user to type application would only change the colour of the keys whose neighbours do not meet victimization criteria.

heading: 6.1.2 Database Overhead
content: Another problem encountered in the devel opment was the implementation of database for saving all the words that user types along with their frequency. Assuming that average users typing vocabulary would range within five thousand to ten thousand words, using a full fledge relational database might not be ideal. This is rather small amount of data that could be stored inside a plain text file or spread sheet file to form a flat file database which should result in faster access for reading and writing without any opening and closing connection overhead.

heading: 6.1.3 Flexible Layout
content: Application was required to change the widths and colours of the keys which had highest probability of being tapped next. Android API does not provide access to key background directly as these are private variables for the Keyboard View class. Same background is applied to all keys regardless. Only option was to extend the Keyboard View Class and override the on Draw method as desired. As keyboard is frequently updating itself with every press on Draw method plays and important role. It was also necessary to save the original widths and locations of the keys so they could be restored when keyboard updates itself for the next set of predicted keys.

heading: 6.2 Project Summary
content: Virtual Keyboards are now primary means of integration with Android smartphones. App store has plethora of these keyboards available most of them offering similar execution with different implementation behind the scenes. Nexkey (Mistype Resistant Keyboard) aims to enter this market with different approach in its execution to make it typing friendly. Where majority of the keyboards are focused on sentence construction and suggestion system, Nexkey’s Primary focus is to ensure typing without mistakes. Using users data on previously typed words Nexkey would change its layout, width of keys and their colour in real-time to ensure Eyes-Free text entry on the smartphone.

heading: 6.3 Future Work
content: There are many plans and ideas to improve this application further in the future and make it one of the most used application on the Google’s Play Store. Once the application is released on the “Play Store” we would gain access to large amount feedback and response which can be used to evaluate and improve Nexkey. One more feature that is going to be added to Nexkey is keyboard theme support and word suggestion system for users who prefer it. There is also plan to migrate core Nexkey prediction system from Prefix tree and Frequency Based prediction to Character level Neural network. Another important functionality that is planned for Nexkey is to introduce elastic width, which is depending on the depth of the word that is being typed predicted key would get three times wider than its original size victimizing two keys.

heading: 2.1.1 Fun-Based Learning > Chemistry > Element Quiz
content: About the Game: It’s a quiz based chemistry game played on web  (Dun n.d.) . It is just a simple quiz with 15 questions. The game progresses as you give answers. With every correct answer a pop -up box appears on top of the web page with a message.  Only 3 -4 lines additional information about the element is provided and user is told that his/her answer is correct. And if the answer is incorrect a pop-up box again appears with a message that the answer was not right. The help option is provided with every qu estion which tells the user that click the answer according to their knowledge, a message will pop up letting them know if it’s correct or not, if any of the answer is wrong it will come up again until user gets it right Comparison with Chemical Forest- Game: Chemical forest-game is comprised of 2 levels. The first level is a quiz. This game level asks the user a chemical formula of a substance or a compound . And if the quiz question is answered incorrectly an alert will be s hown that the answer is wrong, the player dies and the level restarts. Second level of the game has a very interactive playing theme. The  player is running in a fore st scenario on a straight path  and a captivating environment. The player have to select the correct answe r and have to a void the hurdles ( wrong answers). If the player selects the wrong answer he loses the level. With every correct answer the game pauses for some time and the properties of the substance are provided in the pop-up box. This piece of information is very helpful as well as entertaining.  Our game has better graphics and an interacting environment which is not present in this game.  The score feature of the game will motivate user to lea rn from their mistakes and they will play again and again to increase their learning as well as their score.  The score feature also gives the user a sense of healthy competition.

heading: 2.1.2  ACS > Chemistry for Life > Bugs on the Run
content: About the Game: It’s a multilevel 2D game about chameleon and bugs. (Society n.d.) The game scenario revolves around a static chameleon which is hungry and user have to send bugs in order to feed it. The more bugs user sends, the more will he/she scores. For each level to win there are specified of bugs required. If user fails to send needed number of bugs then the level is failed. The only chemistry involved in this game is the molecules are in -closed in piston, water and balloons.  The only physical property of molecules thoroughly defined in this game is that everything around us is made up of atoms and molecules and these molecules are always in state of constant motion. This game tells the user that if the molecules or atoms are given external energy they expand and when they cool down their movement is limit ed or they contract, this phenomena is explained in all levels with just three items(piston, balloons and water pond). The game is played with mouse controls, the mouse is used to move the switch which in return controls the movement of the piston, balloon s and water. Mouse is also used to freeze water or melt the ice. At the end of each level only one fact is repeatedly shown that everything around us is made up of molecules and this stuff is called matter. This game has a scoring mechanism of stars. One star is for completing the level. Two stars is for completing the level in less than 60 seconds. Three stars is for getting all the bugs to the end. Our game provides intensive, interactive scenarios which involves users deeply. The 2 levels are totally based on secondary year chemistry . Our game provides theoretical information along the entertainment factor. heading: 2.1.6 Jefferson Lab > Chemistry > Element word scramble
content: About the game: This is also a guessing game.  (https://education.jlab.org/elementmatching/ n.d.)  User have to rearrange the words. heading: 2.1.8 Chemistry games > Chemistry > Matching
content: About the game: This is a simple game with no interactive graphical interface.  (Learning. n.d.)  It’s a simple matching board in which you have to select two relevant options out of the 4 by 4 grid. There is no help there is no time limit and there is no scoring mechanism present. There are no further stages present. This matching box doesn’t even ha ve any option to quit the game. No story line given. Comparison with Chemical Forest-Game: Our game is based on 3D environment. heading: 2.1.9 Imangi Studios> Temple Run
content: About the game: Temple Run is an endless and pointless running game developed by Imangi studios for android, IOS and Windows (Imangi Studios n.d.). Its theme is just to run when the character steals a statue from sacred temple. The character then runs from the monkeys who chase the character endlessly in an enchanting graphical environment. Throughout the game there is no end point. The aim of the player is to keep running forth by either jumping, sliding down or to move left, right. This game has coins (yellow, red and blue) and different power-ups which the character can collect. The coins can be used to open targets or to buy special features and  to buy other characters. Power-ups can be used instantly or can be used later too. Comparison with Chemical Forest-Game: Chemical Forest is a 3D game which is based on secondary level/high school chemistry. This game has 2 levels, based on entirely different story line. The first level is a quiz. This game level asks the user a chemical formula of a substance or a compound. When the user shoots the correct answer given above the forest beast, the game progresses. The question should be answered in the provided in the given time. Second level on the other hand is a running game. But this level has no endless or pointless running. The player is running in a forest scenario with multiple paths and a captivating environment. During his run in the forest he en counters different question about chemical bonding of different compounds and elements.  The player have to select the correct answer and have to avoid the hurdles (wrong answers). If the player selects the wrong answer he loses the level. With every corr ect answer the game pauses for some time and the physical and chemical properties of the substance are provided in the pop -up box. This piece of information is very helpful as well as entertaining. And with every wrong answer collected or bumping into the hurdles the player will lose the level and has to restart it again. Keeping in mind that this game is not endless,  the user will be asked specified number of questions only  and once the player answers the each question correctly the game terminates automatically. Our game also has coins and power -ups which character collects along with the right answers. The main plus point of our game is that it provides educational learning through an interactive entertaining game-play. Our game is not aimless nor does it only focus on learning. It maintains a balance between learning and fun. 2.1.10Research papers:  Spanish University for Distance Education Madrid, Spain: (Raquel 2014) Spanish University developed interactive games for students to learn chemistry in an innovative way, including “Protective Clothing” and “Balancing Equations”. They discovered that it was a successful way to teach the students along with entertainment. Our game also uses this approach to teach chemistry effectively. Existing game: Uses this interactive learning technique. Our game: Uses interactive learning, edutainment for students.  Karl M. Kapp’s Research: (Kapp n.d.) Karl found that diversion based approach created huge information level increments over the customary case-based educating strategies. We’ll use this concept as we are providing a game-based learning environment. Existing game: Existing games just give computer based approach for learning. Our game: Provides diversity through innovative and detailed learning on each level.  Khalifa University, UAE: (S. S. Ling 2015) Khalifa University conducted a research on its students by dividing them into two groups and conducted two types of quizzes after each lectures. One group was evaluated through conventional paper-based quizzes while the other through computer -based quizzes. They found out that computer -based quizzes proved more efficient than conventional ways. This motivated us to introduce game-based learning for our intermediate students. Existing game: Provides computer based quizzes and no motivational learning. Our game: Provides self-assessment, motivation and evaluation through a learning game. The correctness will lead you to next level.  Bengal Institute of Technology, India: (Maya Agarwal 2011) This institute developed a game called “Atoms to Molecules” to test the knowledge of atomic bonding of their students. We are also developing a game that tests the chemistry knowledge of students. Existing game: Evaluates basic chemistry knowledge of stud ents, does not provide any further information. Our game: Our game not only provides the chemical formulas of atoms and molecules, but also their chemical equations and additional information.  Bournemouth University, UK: (James Birchall 2011) The university staff developed a game called “Elemental” to test the students’ knowledge of atomic structures. Our game also assesses the knowledge of molecular structures of different elements present in the intermediate level curriculum. Existing game: Tests the student knowledge. Our games: The game itself has difficulty levels and different stages to assess the knowledge of molecular structure.

heading: GDLC:
content: GDLC consists of 6 phases: Initiation, Pre-production, Production, Testing, Beta and Delivery. Initiation:  Developer decides about the game to be devolped, game innovative ideas are un der process. Pre-Production: This phase constistutes of the design and requirement Documentation. It also provides the first game cycle which shows  thw game play (this is also called release of first game prototype). Production: This is the main development phase of GDLC. The game assets and code scripts are written. The result of the final prototype is the playable game Testing: This pahse verifies and validates the game features, its concept, its design and working. Testing also finds errors, bugs and faults that should be removed or changed. Beta Phase: It is also one of the testing technique which is not used by the developer himself. This testing technique is conducted by publisher, expected users or the commercial reviewrs. Release Phase: This phase delivers the outcome that is bug -free, playable game. This phase also covers the marketing strategies for the game launch in the market.

heading: Chapter 1: Introduction
content: This chap ter gives sheds light on the CORE components and technologies used in this research project:

heading: 1.1 Internet of things (IoT)
content: Internet of things is the concept to connect and control the noncomputational devices over the internet. Devices can be accessed anywh ere in the world when they are digitally connected with an internet server [1]. The basic idea of IOT is to collect data and transferring it to the server from the devices having IP addresses. This technology of accessing the real objects helps them to int eract with the external environment [2]. Growth and data association has made things and connections important by creating business and industrial opportunity to the world [3].

heading: 1.2 Home Automation
content: Home automation is providing controllability of devices in the house with a single click of the button. Moreover, activities like table lamp can be turned on or off at an impulse. More advanced features like camera surveillance can be attached to the system for surveillance with integrated lock system for live mon itoring and control of home security . In the modern era, home products like locks, light and temperature control system can be controlled through IoT devices. 1.3 Security in Home Automation. Home automation System uses the technology of IOT to provide rem ote access to household electronics. The idea is to make appliances and electronics of your home smart enough to control and use remotely. One of the major challenges of IoT system is the security as connecting appliances, especially locks and other electr onics and also control them over WAN is an insecure approach [4]. In the IoT-based home automation, the  sensors and controllers are situated inside the home to control and manage its operatio ns. These controllers are associated with the cloud server through a remote medium for information gathering and investigation. A standout amongst the most  imperative issues is to safely transmit the gathered information from the sensor s to the user endpoint. In this way, a few systems have been proposed the solutions including conventional encryption procedures [5-7]. 8  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7

heading: 1.4 Motivation
content: Our work is greatly inspired by the CASA Jasmina project.  The project  has been nominated for 21 projects in the ACADEMY AWARDS and won the ED ITORS CHOICE award IOT 2015/16[8 ]. In the project, the team maintained an apartment totally based on IOT and declared it as an open source project to let people work on the sensors installed in that apartment. They provided an integrated IOT system for home automation and allow the developers to contribute. [9]. The motivation is to build the system which is not only one point complete home automation but must be secure enough to implement it even at sensitive places such as banks. To achieve that we have studied the multiple cryptographic algorithms that can be implemented on open communica tion between client, server, compared them, and propose the solution which is best for the system. CASA CONSOLE is to provide the one point home controller for all the appliances installed in the house. The system not only provides the complete control but ensures the ownership of the user by providing the data including history of actions performed on the system and the user related information on the microcontroller which is owned by the client and present inside the home of the client.  Furthermore the communication between the end points is encrypted with strong encryption algorithm AES which makes it secure enough to implement the system on security critical buildings as well.

heading: 1.5 Objectives:
content: The objectives of our project are as follows: 1. In our daily life, Electrical appliances are the most utilizable items, without these devices, our life will be difficult. Imagine if the appliance is left on and nobody is at home, In order to save user energy and money, our target is to provide remote access of these devices to users so that they can shut them off from anywhere using the application. We tend to provide  the user more feasibility of accessing appliances. 2. Security is the basic utility of every house t o contribute in th at matter our app will provide a secure door lock system over  the web so that a person can 9  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 control the locks remotely. Our app will only allow access to  the authenticated user to restraining any hacker or irrelevant person  which will be done by token-based authentication system. 3. We will try to build an optimized and secured home automation system whose response time will be faster after adding security mechanism. 4. In contrast to earlier work, we are adding water level monitoring feature in our project. The  water level monitoring will allow the user to have a complete control over water pump. The user will be able to monitor water level remotely from anywhere around the world through  the web application  and Android application and can perform on/off functionality.

heading: 1.6 Overview of the modules involved in the project
content: The project consists of the system containing three modules hardware, web application, and Android Application. The basic flow of the system is to provide the user a complete remote control and mo nitoring of all home appliances with encrypted communication through the AES encryption algorithm and token-basedauthentication.

heading: 1.6.1 Hardware(Raspberry Pi 3B) and server installation
content: The hardware involvedin this module is Raspberry Pi3, relay module to c ontrol the switches of the system and water level sensor. The microcontroller Pi3 is a one of kind it is a 35$ credit card sized chip with the processing power of 2.5GHz and 1 GB of Ram. In the system, we have designed such an architecture which utilizes t he computational power of the controller properly. We have installed the server on the Pi which will communicate to the clients and perform the actions on the hardware as the client wants. Moreover, to build the sense of ownership of the client we have cre ated the databaseon the Pi module so that the user actions and basic information is stored on that and the data related to the user is under the ownership of the owner. To utilize the full control we have implemented the encryption algorithm on the Pi as well.

heading: 1.6.2 Web Application
content: The web application is developed using the MVC framework Laravel. The client can login into the app and can control all the home appliances from the app. The admin can add more users whom he wants to utilize the system to have th e control of the 10  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 appliances and have water monitoring system. The major function of this module is to provide a complete history of the actions performed by all the users. The admin can monitor each and every action of every user of the system with the tim e on which action is performed and the status of the appliance.

heading: 1.6.3 Android Application
content: This module is to provide the true sense of mobility to the user it is to provide an interface for the actions a user wants to perform say open and close the appliance with the runtime monitoring of the installed appliances of the home. From the application, a user can not only switch on or off the appliances including water motor but also monitor the water level of the tank.

heading: 1.6.4 Security Algorithms
content: To make the whole  system secured we have worked on each endpoint of the system and made it as secure as possible by applying encryption algorithms. The communication is encrypted by the most secure encryption technique AES, the Rijendal Cypher Block’s Chain Block Cypher mo de is used to encrypteach status message on the door. Moreover, the SHA encryption is applied to the login for the security of every user’s password for token-based authentication. As the server is installed on the Pi3 so physically it will be in the owner ship of client himself so the person whose data is involved has the data at his home.

heading: 1.7 Problem statement:
content: There is no such system which provides one point full control of home appliances with the monitoring of actions over WAN through Android or web application. The main challenge in the  existing home automated system via mobile is that they are expensive and not much secure. We aim to provide a secure  and affordable system to avoid vulnerabilities.

heading: 1.8 Assumptions & constraints:
content: • We have assumed that there is uninterrupted power supply we have electricity 24/7. Electricity is very important as our system will run on it. 11  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 • The other assumption we are assuming is that we have internet available all the time so that our raspberry pi relates to  the internet all the time so that it can communicate with  an android app to retrieve permission and to send and receive notifications. • We are assuming if the person using the app is connected to the internet. • We assume the user has basic knowledge of using android smartphone.

heading: 1.9 Project Scope:
content: Currently, there exist such types of home automation systems which provide acce ss to appliances but they do not provide a complete system from one point control with complete monitoring of user actions for each appliance. The major issue in the system is that they are not much secure . We came up with an idea which can be added to the similar systems. We have decided to build a system which will not only provide house owners accessibility to their household appliances remotely, based on the decision of the system but we will make  a secure connection between hardware , server and controlling applications like Android and web portal. It will be cost-effective and easily accessible to every common person and  will be easily operated. We  have worked on the main door of the house, appliances like motor, television power ON/OFF and w ater tank level status . The users of today’s era need accessibility on just one tap.  The application will provide a secure control of appliances from one system with the ownership of the personal data involved in the system which will be made possible by installing the database on the Pi which will be owned by the user. 12  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7

heading: 2.1 Literature review:
content: The world is evolving towards technology and smart systems. It is in the human’s nature to always have the ea se and less difficulty in life.  IoT and automation systems are the result of that nature to have freedom from worries and problems in life. In the modern era, there are many automation system and projects that help a person to make their life easy and a much less from worries. But still, they lack some features that do not make a human life total tension free and dependent on the system. The project we are building will not only provide a total remote control of the appliances but will allow control to the several users within total secure environment on which a person can rely upon. The products in the market are very costly and do not cover different types of household appliances from one app/system. Our focus is to not only provide the system which will cover a different type of household control but also a complete monitoring system so that a user has an eagle eye at his place form anywhere around the globe.

heading: 2.1.1 Existing Systems and related work
content: Following are the related home automated systems that already on the market but are with limited scopes as described below. • In the 21st century, the Internet of Things (IoT) is one of the most constructive and dominant wireless communication models. It is the common conception of things that are identifiable, readable, controllable, addressable, and locatable via the Interne t. In the IoT surroundings, all entities of our everyday life can be associated with the Internet owing to their computing and communication capabilities. IoT enlarges the perception of the Internet and makes it more suitable for different applications. Du e to this reason, IoT has become more beneficial in numerous domains such as health monitoring, assisted living monitoring, and smart home automation systems whi ch are already being proposed [10]. 13  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 • For the smart locks, the security over the web is crucial [11]. The smart locks which are already on the marketdo not give remote access over Wide area network(WAN) but only on local area network(LAN). In short, they provided the keyless entry rather than a remote access [12 -14]. Among them, most of the locks are based upon the system in which they provide only monitoring over the web but does not provide remote access because of the security concern. The current study shows that the basic challenge in IOT based automation is the security of internet for the provis ion of control rather than only monitoring of locks. • The smart appliances are quite popular nowadays, many companies provide appliances based on IoT technology which give control to the user on the android app. And for that user must buy only that appliance in which the smart system is installed. • Water tank control is  a basic part of the home automation system . The only automation for the water pump available in the market is the switching on/off water pump at the certain water level  of the tank with out the concern of the owner [15]. • ‘AUGUST SMART LOCK’ [16 ] is the most popular smart lock of the year 2017. It sends the user a message whenever someone tries to open the door. And if the person is of known and can enter, the user will generate a key and send that key to the person who is at the door only than he can open the door. The limitation of the system is that a person outside the door must have a system which is integrated with the lock, which is he must have an iPhone as the product can be controlled t hrough Siri or he must have an application installed in his mobile phone otherwise there is no way to make him enter the house. Our system will allow the user to open/close the door remotely from website as well as from android app through cloud by sending  the signal to raspberry pi installed at the site., which then open the door if commanded by the user so there is no need for the visitor to have an application or some sort of system with him. • ‘Home kit’ [17] application developed by Apple for iPhone user s. The iPhone user should buy the system from the company in return they provide an application to control the appliances and the list of gadgets which are 14  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 compatible with the system. This system provides the automation of home appliances through a mobile application. The sensors and control units integrated with the system are those which are only reliable or approved by the apple company which means the user is restrained to use only those appliances. Also, this system does not give monitoring of previous records and does not give all under one app, that is there is no water level monitoring in the system. • ‘OMNISITE Water Monitoring and Metering Application’ [18] OMNISITE is the industrial automation providing company. They provide a complete water level monitoring system but as it is an industrial system so their focus is only on the monitoring of water tanks and they provide services which are required in the industry thus not cost efficient and not suitable for the home. What we are providing is a comple te monitoring system over web and control of water pump over the internet so that user not only monitor the water level but also can start the water pump at that time which is suitable for him. • ‘NuBryte Touch Point Console’ [1 9] developed by NuBryte compan y. The system provides the complete lighting control system and home security system with the monitoring of energy consumption. The user should get installed the system separately for each room. The application is provided with the system which can be installed only on smartphones having latest Operating Systems. To access the full control of the system remotely user must connect his smartphoneto the same router with which the touch point console is installed. To make the system remotely accessed from anywh ere from  a smartphone a secure connection is needed which is our aim in this project.

heading: 3.1 Introduction
content: Cryptography is referred to as the study of security but in term of computer science, it means the encryption or decryption o f the message which has to be secured and n eeds to be communicated from one endpoint to another. The message is made secure from the attackers by applying different encryption algorithms. As defined in RFC 2828  [20], the cryptographic system is "a set of c ryptographic algorithms together with the key management processes that support  the use of the algorithms in some application context." The definition describes the complete system that provides a mechanism of security and that is required in internet netw ork and implemented by algorithms.

heading: 3.2 Goals of Cryptography
content: Every system that provides the security for applications must provide some methods to secure the system. The se methods are referred as the goals of the system for the security. The goals can categorize into five points [21]. Authentication: This is a functionality of having an authenticated sender and receiver means a before sending or receiving any data an identity of the point must be confirmed first. Secrecy or Confidentiality:  This is referred to as only the authorized person or the users who have been authenticated in the first step, must only be able to interpret the message sent to them. Integrity: data communicated between the sender and receiver must be free from any type of modification means in between communication the data must not be changed and passed on as it is sent. Non-Repudiation: It is to refer to the sender and receiver must not deny that they have sent or receive the message in other words an acknowledge system must be integrated. Service Reliability and Availability:  Secure systems often get attacked by intruders it is upon the system that at such times the service must be available and the system 32  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 must not be crashed or stop down. There must be the availability of the data at all time for quality of service.

heading: 3.3 Algorithms comparison
content: There aredifferent types of algorithm available right now but the main thing is which algorithm to choose and which is the best for the application you want to develop, for this one must know the advantages and disadvantages of the algorithms only than one can decide which is most suitable for the system. Some of them are more secure while others are efficient the goal is to maintain the balance cryptographic system which not only provides the security but also the efficiency to some extent. Following are some famous and strong cryptographic algorithms and their key functionalities.

heading: DES:
content: DES (Data encryption Standard)  the encryption technique is made standard by NIST (National Institute of Science and Technology) it was introduced at the end of the 20th century since then many attacks and exploits are recorded exposing the weak points of the system. Its key size is too short making it a weak algorithm for the security [22].

heading: 3DES:
content: This algorithm is ba sically the reuse of DES by implementing 3 instances of DES the data is encrypted thrice with the same method as in DES ofcourse that makes it much secure but also it requires too much computational power for the machines. Making the technique too much heavier for the system to implement [22].

heading: AES:
content: (Advanced Encryption Standard), is the  encryption standard recommended by NIST to replace DES. Rijndael (pronounced Rain Doll) algorithm was selected in 1997 after a competition to select the best encryption stan dard. From now on a lot of work has been done and better implementation has been launched for this algorithm and it is one of the most secure algorithms of the time. AES has keyed consists of AES -128, AES-192, and AES-256. The key encrypts and decrypts blo cks in 128 bit s, 192 bits and so on. For each key, there are  different rounds. Every  round processes the plaintext and turns it into ciphertext. For 128-bit there are 10 rounds, 192-bit has 12 rounds and 256-bit has 14 rounds [23]. 33  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 Since AES is a symmetri c key encryption, the key is pre-shared by the sender as well as a receiver to decrypt the data.

heading: Blowfish:
content: Blowfish is one of the known encryption algorithm developed by the Bruce Schneier (considered as the father of encryption techniques) blowfish is a v ariable length key with 64 bit of block cipher it is efficient but has a problem of weak keys [23]. Efficiency Comparison of the algorithms: In the journal  [23] an experiment  is performed  to test the efficiency of the three algorithms using same machine a nd specification. They used the wrapper classes of AES, DES, and blowfish available in java.security package. The system on which the experiment was done has 2GB of RAM to have the consistent results they performed the Figure 5. Cryptographic Algorithm comparison graph series of experiments with different sizes of data. The results shown are described below. From the comparison carried out in section 3.3 the competition is in between AES and Blowfish in term of efficiency the blowfish overcast the AES but in terms of security, 34  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 AES is more secure and less vulnerable than other algorithms. To design the system for any application one of the two must be compromised.

heading: 3.3.1 AES over Blowfish
content: As the security of the system is critical and the control of the doors  and other appliances has to be carried out through the information communicated. Secondly, the size data we have to communicate for this purpose is small and according to the Figure 3.1, the results show that on smaller data sizes the efficiency of all th e algorithms are same especially when the data size is between 3KB to 10 KB. In 2012 AES NI (Advanced Encryption Standard New Instructions) was introduced by Intel It is a hardware update that can be used to accelerate the performance of the AES algorithm this consists of six instructions by Intel by using them the performance can be enhanced to 3 to 10 times as that of before [24].

heading: 3.3.2 CBC Mode
content: CBC (Chain Block Cypher) is the mode in which a random Initialization vector is used with the pre-shared key to encrypt the message. In the system like ours in which the message is always the same as Open door or close, we must use this mode to make it totally secure from the hacker. In other modes of AES, there is only one pre -shared key that encrypts the data whi ch is only suitable for the variable or dynamic data. There is a security risk if use any other mode in our project as the data is same every time and if a hacker is constantly listening to the communication he can interpret the message by hit trail or by strong computational processing but in CBC because of IV (initialization vector) which is random every time the attacker has no chance to interpret even with high processing  [25]. The code snippet that encrypts the basic message is described below. public function encrypt($x) { $t = ''; // 16-byte block to hold the temporary input of the cipher $y = ''; // returned cipher text; $y_block = $this->iv; // 16-byte block to hold the temporary output of the cipher $xsize = strlen($x); for ($i = 0; $i < $xsize; $i += 16) { for ($j=0; $j<16; $j++) { // XOR this block of plaintext with the initialization vector $t[$j] = chr(ord(($i+$j)<$xsize ? $x[$i+$j] : chr(0)) ^ ord($y_block[$j])); } $y_block = $this->encryptBlock($t); 35  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 $y .= $y_block; } return $y; }

heading: 3.4 Security of previous Automation systems and their flaws
content: Just consider having a device connected tothehome automation systemand the communication is not secure. The criticality is very high considering if the device can control the heating system of the home. Or say it could control the front door lock, the home automation system poorly design that allows the hackers to attack can cause a disastrous damage or could be the cause of theft or ransacking.

heading: 3.4.1 Security of ‘Smart Things’
content: In 2016 a  paper was published on the security flaws of the smartthing a framework owned and launched by the Samsung company which supports third-party applications [26]. In the paper, it is concluded that the attackers can steal the codes and create their own door lock codes making it extremely vulnerable and dangerous for the user. Flaw: The encountered flaws were related to the architecture of the system more than 55% of the smartapps are overprivileged and can have full privilege even if they need a little access to perform the minor functionality making the framework too much exposure for every third-party application if the application is not designed properly which more than 80% are not it can expose the whole system for the attackers [20]. The analysis categorized following flaws in the system. • Overprivileged third part smart applications. • Data which is sensitive and needs protection was not secure enough for the insecure and malicious applications. • The insecure interaction between application and framework. • Unrestricted external inputs without proper  authentication of the users [26].

heading: 3.4.2 Security of ‘Homematic’
content: Homematic is the home automation system developed by the German Company which can control the door locks and other motion sensors. At the 30th Chaos 36  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7 Communication Congress held in Hamburg in December of 2014, hackers demonstrate by enteringinto the system with unauthorized access to the system [27]. Flaw: The flaw was of the company they use the same default key rather than different self-generated one to encrypt the data which allow the hackers to enter into the system to enhance the security of the system a company should have to resolve the encryption key issue and then ask all its users to change it accordingly [27].

heading: 3.4.3 Security of ‘Xfinity Home Security’
content: The Xfinity home security system communicates over Zigbee which is awireless language use to connect everyday devices with one another [28 -29]. The system has major flaws overall the system can be jammed by radio -jamming equipment. The signals at first were controlling the door and windows of the home. After the reconnection, the system fails and there is no record of communication break between hub and client on either side [28 ]. This is an example of a bad design a system like home automation mus t not be designed in such a way a service as simple as radio jammer can block the whole system. 3.5 Actions to overcome the vulnerabilities. In order to eradicate the existing systems flaws we are providing following functionalities in our system which is explained below:

heading: 3.5.1 Protection of data integrity and encryption
content: In our web applications, there is an intensive exchange of data via different protocols, like HTTP, between client applications which presented  a browser, mobile, and server-side applications. The importance and confidentiality of data may be different depending on the specifics of the web application, and the possibility of interception by a third party increases with the perfection of hacking techniques in the world of IT. In our IOT project, we will be using AES technique to encrypt communication between client and the server. AES is a symmetric encryption algorithm. It uses the same key for both purposes like encryption/Decryption. Large amounts of data can be encrypted using a symmetric encryption algorithm. 37  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7

heading: 3.5.2 Authorization
content: Authorization mechanism is used for identifying the user. This mechanism authorizes the user to access the system for relevant data. These are few features of access control mechanism our application will deliver. • Admin user can grant permissions dynamically to its sub-members. So,  the system will provide a simple way to authorize user actions against a given resource. • User access should have well-defined roles (Role-based Authorization). Then with the help of defining an access to only once to the schema, easily assigns it to thenew user each time. Otherwise, each time creating a new user we must define a new schema which duplicates the code and chances of error increases.

heading: 3.5.3 Authentication
content: Authentication is the core of our system security module. In our project, we will be using token-based authentication. The reasons to choose token based authentication are: Stateless: It is easy to authenticate multiple devices to web API. Token contain information for identi fying the user, it helps to eliminate  the need for session  and cookies to maintain state. Reusability: It is easy to build an application that shares permissions with another application. There can exist many servers which can run various domains and platforms we reuse the same token for user authentication. Security: As cookies are not stored for security, there is no need to protect against attacks like cross-site-request-forgery (CSRF). The token transmission will be over HTTPS to avoid man-in-the-middle attacks. Performance: We do not have a server-side lookup for desterilize the session on each request. We must calculate the keyed-hash message authentication code to validate the token and then parse it. Therefore, it will reduce response time. 38  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7

heading: 6.1 Introduction
content: The main objective is to develop a secure home automation system with the integration of raspberry -pi microcontroller and sensors synchronized with the web application and Android app to provide efficient and secure remote control and monitoring system to the user. The success of this project depends upon many aspects as it is an amal gam of form than one technology to provide a broad single system because of more versatile nature of the project there are many risk factors which directly effects on the success rate of the project.

heading: 6.2.1 Challenges for Authentication and Encryption to Manage IOT
content: The authentication of encryption is the biggest risk in IOT based systems. There are some encryption techniques which big companies use fortheir systems but the need of the hour is that a lightweight system Is needed for the a pplication which is developed at low level with less development and have  a low-level database so that the system runs efficiently and smoothly for the devices.

heading: 6.2.2 Data sending complexity
content: In most of the systems, it is common practice that they send sen sory informational data directly to the cloud server or to the database which can cause risk issues and can leaks the information out very easily if attacked by outside hacker.

heading: 6.2.3 Absence of Standard data protocols
content: The basic problem is that there are no  standard protocols for the IOT system to adopt by the developer to avoid the major security issues faced by the IOT world.

heading: 6.2.4 Lack of knowledge (Design Risk)
content: Customer’s inadequate knowledge is another milestone to achieve secure platform.

heading: 6.2.5 Data storage and security breach Risk
content: Services from external companies by connecting to cloud or data centers is a useful approach but, the centralized data center enhances the risk of being accessed by the hackers. 62  of 65    2 6  D e c e m b e r  2 0 1 7

heading: 6.2.6 DOS / Loss of Server
content: There isn’t a lot of  difference between an attack to deny you service (DOS), the Internet going down, your wireless router rebooting, or your microwave oven going crazy. heading: Chapter 7: Conclusion
content: CASA CONSOLE is the system which gives the one point home controller for every appliance introduced in the house. The system not only gives the entire control but also provide the se cure communication of data with every user. The users of the system are authenticated by token-based authentication and all the critical data is encrypted with AES encryption algorithm.

heading: 7.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: The main problem faced during the project was connectivity of Android application to Raspberry Pi over the inte rnet; System wants the users to have access to the system wherever and whenever they wish. There were multiple solutions to thi s problem i.e. using firebase, php page or creating a web server. The finalized solution was creating a web server which has its own database and it provides two-way communications from android to the raspberry pi and vice versa. We learned many new things which we never experienced e.g. working on Raspberry Pi, creating an android application, Connection with a web server over the internet.

heading: 7.2 Project summary:

heading: Abstract
content: This project aims to develop an Android application to allow users to top up their mobile accounts with just scanning the top -up card string. The need arouse as som e people are unaware of the method that how to recharge the card or do not know what is the activation string of the network to recharge the mobile account. Some age groups are regular users of mobile phones but they merely know how to recharge their phones. Some users are unable to clearly see the string and dial it and some are irritated by entering and matching the long strings. People get irritated by calling the helplines and following long procedures to top -up their accounts. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Mobli will be an Android mobile application. It will make the mobile card top up and mobile network package subscription simple and easy that anyone can make it done by just a single click. The number of mobile users has remarkably increased in today’s World as compared to the last decade but many of them are unaware of the technology they are using due to which people face extensive problems in their daily routine. On the other hand, there are people who do know the use of technology but they are easily offended by following the long procedures. Technology demands advancement. The users now a days are too busy that they find it irritating to match the whole top up string a nd dial other packages strings. As it is difficult for every user to match the string character by character and they have to memorize the whole strings whether they are for SMS, Calls or Data connection packages. At present the mobile network companies d o provide the active helplines to activate different packages but this is still very difficult because the users have to listen the whole instructions sets and press the instructed keys step by step which is very time consuming and hectic for the user. There are also the helplines to top up the mobile accounts but this still wants the users to enter the top up strings after being instructed by the helpline operator but there is no any user friendly mobile application with this much interactive UI (User Interface). This application will make things easy for users by providing the easiest way to recharge their mobile accounts and in a way to subscribe and unsubscribe from the desired packages and check balance if they do not remember the strings. The tiresome habit of remembering the strings irritates the users of any age group whether they are young and regular technology users as users, now a day demand automation or ease in each and everything and this application would prove to be the best solution for the problems stated above.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: 1. This proposed application will help people to Subscribe packages, top up their account by taking just a picture of the card and manage their mobile network with just a click of a finger. With this you do not have to make l ong calls to network’s customer care helpline. Neither people have to dial long strings nor they have to send subscription SMS to different numbers. 2. Our main objective is to build a user friendly mobile application with user friendly interface to help users easily top up their account and make package subscription far more easy. This proposed application will be tested and validated according to the standard rules and regulations in order to make it a bud free android application. 3. Once completed, this application will be launched, with full introduction user manual and all the other deliverables that are required to be published. These deliverables will help Page 11 of 78 user to understand the correct use of this application.  All this is to make everything in handy for every kind of users so they do not have to worry for their phone related problems anymore. People will have quick access to nearest mobile shops with the help of mobile shops locator and will be notified when the subscribed package is about to end so that they might prevent losing balance in their mobile account.

heading: 1.3 Problem statement
content: The purpose of this idea is the fact that people’s routine is becoming hectic day by day because of which people do not have enough time to go through the long procedures for mobile account top up and other packages more over majority of the population desires to use the mobile phones but they don’t have enough time to memorize and type the long strings so most of the time they don’t go through the long procedure which creates the problem. Then people seek help from others which make them rely on other people all the time and as you know relying on other people is not a good idea and manually typing and dialing the strings is very tedious and irritating and everyone avoids it. So, we will provide this fully automated system. What we plan to do is to provide the user with a solution to their problem they are facing.It has always fascinated me to imagine what if we can load our mobile top up card just by taking a picture of the card instead of entering that 16 digits long series and subscribing the different packages only by a single click? Or being notified when the package is coming near to the end time and other mobile related services near them and being aware of the new arriving packages and offers. We thoroughly reviewed these subscription procedures to provide the users with a much more easy and simple way to manage his mobile network account. These were the general problems we shortlisted to deal with if we are to achieve a product that stands out from the rest.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions &constraints
content: • This proposed android application will be free of cost. • This proposed android application will not require any registration to use it. • This proposed android application will be easy to install and use for any kind of users. • The developer will deliver the milestones and deliverables as per time mentioned in the plan. • This proposed android application must be completed by the end of the May. Page 12 of 78 • No new external hardware will be required to install the application.

heading: 1.5 Project scope
content: People are now a days looking for faster solutions. As the life is becoming faster now a days  so everyone needs the ease of use, whether it is mobile or anything else. This type of application will provide the user with a very easy method of managing their mobile network. With the help of this fully automated  application, users will be able to r echarge their mobile accounts from the top up cards . Users can subscribe to the desired packages from the list of available packages for SMS and data connection. Users can also transfer the credit to their contacts using the same network as the users’. This unique feature will prove to be a backup in emergency. If the user is already subscribed to a certain package and wants to unsubscribe from the package the application will also allow the users to do so by selecting the unsubscribe option in front of that package. The users can also check the status of their package in form of remaining SMSs and MBs by the help of this application. Furthermore, this application will let users check the balance in their mobile accounts. Notifying the users about the package about to be finished will help them in re-subscribing to the offer without any hazard of losing the balance in case the package ends without user being aware. heading: 2.6 Software Development Life Cycle Model
content: The software development process model that we plan on using for the development of this application is the agile model. The agile model is a combination of iterative and incremental process models. In the agile model working product is delivered after eac h iteration; this is the basic reason behind choosing this model. It is also best suited because it will be relatively quick and as we have time constraints to finish this project we would like to have working version available. By using this model we woul d be developing our application in stages with every working version having more features than the previous one. This would largely decrease the complexity of the project and after each iteration we would be able to get feedback from user on any possible shortcomings which we would then be able to improve in the next iteration. By doing this the product that we would get at our final iteration would be one that would have all the features initially planned for and any variations that would arise when getting feedback from users. Due to the fact that we are going to be getting working versions after every iteration it insures that at no point in time would we be completely blank or have nothing to show for our efforts. As we are developing an application it i s utmost importance to make mobile transactions more efficient for user otherwise they would have many other options to choose from rather than our game so a constant feedback from them would help us in achieving this. heading: 3.4 Software Architecture
content: The software architecture that we have selected for this project is a hybrid architecture. We have focused on the C2 architecture and layered architecture. C2 architecture focuses on the independency of the components. The components can only interact via the connectors. It helps grouping the components in one component as well. While the layered architecture helps grouping the components that are similar and can form a topology. As you can see in the figure 3.19 there are two components that are connected together via a connector. These components are made up of further smaller components. This system will help to improve the people standards and let them to get quick and fast service without wastage of time.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Today we are living in a digital world, where everything is being turn into digital for the ease of human life. Service applications or automated systems are being introduced which can do wonders for the society, whether it has been used for time productiv ity, solve problems, social engagement, entertainment, knowledge or as a way to facilitate or help human daily life issues and problems. In this modern era of technology, service seekers people still wasting their precious time in finding and searching of skilled and reliable service providers and workers, they have to go outside from their homes in search to hire and discover nearby service providers and workers for the work, moreover they have to consult others to get feedback and review about any service  provider or worker before hiring them. Sometimes they also face problems due to unavailability of skilled workers and reliable service providers in their local area. There are many applications being introduced to resolve such issues of human life which provide them ease and access to locate and discover services and their locations. Google Map [1] , Uber [2], Careem [3], Daraz.pk [4], OLX [5], Pakwheels [6] and Easyticket [7] are some of the proud examples of endless applications which provide easiness t o the human daily lives. But these applications are providing limited services and functionalities to the users in just a particular niche. So users have to go with different applications for different services, which sometimes make them frustrated and som etimes the level of competence becomes intense due to the complex functionalities that frustrate the user and end up having a depression or discarding that application. This application targets the mind and heart of a user with its simple and catchy graph ics. The performance in real time user interface will outstand the rest of applications. What separates this application from others is its exceptional theme to help service seeker users who are looking for skilled and nearby reliable services and it also provide a platform to skilled service providers and workers to earn independently. With this application you can locate and discover the local nearby service providers around you and you get help through their profiles, ratings and reviews to select the be st and suitable option for the job. Moreover you can also locate them, get their contact details and information or even fix the appointment and meeting date time. It also let users to post images/videos or description of their problems and issues for which they are looking for the service and the workers can see the nearby user’s service requests and can accept their service request and set appointment with the user or contact him for the job details.

heading: 2.6 Software Development Life Cycle
content: The software development life cycle which we used in our project is the  RAD and Waterfall Model. Following are the reasons why we used this model:  We used Rapid Application Development RAD model for clear requirement gathering from users.  We used waterfall model because as this model is very simple and eas y to understand and use. As it is suitable for small projects where requirements are clear and well understood. So, it’s the best option for our application to develop under waterfall model, because the requirements of our application are clear and fixed, so there are no risk of changing requirements.  The amount of resources required to implement under waterfall model is minimal.  Moreover, it is easy to manage due to the rigidity of the model – each phase has specific deliverables and a review process.  It is helpful where quality is more preferred than cost and schedule.
