heading: 1. Introduction
content: Introduction of Topic In the past, ASP (Application Service Provider) Model was being used in which if we have multiple groups of users having different requirements from the other groups but the requirements inside the group are approximately same. In that case we’d to make different versions of the software to meet every group’s requirement, which increases the software updating, monitoring and maintenance overhead, With Multitenancy, the application data source is one, but the experience of different groups is completely different from each other according to their own requirements. Each group has isolated experience which doesn’t interfere with other groups. The data from the data source is filtered based on the requirements of that specific group and only the relevant data is showed.

heading: Multi-Tenancy
content: Multi-tenancy is an architecture in which we host a single copy of software and this instance then serves multiple tenants. Tenant is a group of users with similar requirements, for instance the end- user of a specific organization or business. Tenant have the privilege to make changes in same parts of application for instance, change the theme color, or some business rules but they have no privilege to modify the underlying application’s code [1]. By developing this multitenant architecture, we’ll be providing platform to developers to develop diverse apps on the top of this architecture and we’ll also be developing apps on this multitenant architecture. Many companies with web applications don’t target end-users, but they target other businesses with customers of their own. A web application can be engineered in many ways to meet the requirements of these businesses. Sometimes, one instance per customer is developed meeting its distinct requirements called as single tenant system. On the other hand, when it can be anticipated that many customers have identical requirements, then it is possible to make a single instance of software that can accommodate the identical requirements of all the customers named as multi- tenant application [2] Advantages of Multi-Tenant Application  Lower Maintenance cost: Applications developed on top of multi-tenant architecture only requires a single instance of the software and they only need to be deployed in a single location, as a result they only require single instance of each resource (cache, database, log, etc.). When there is a request of change or error from any end-user, then the developers don’t need to decide first on which instance the error has occurred or request of change is coming from, instead, as there is only one instance working, so developers already know where to make the change. Also when the error occurs, it’s tracing is much more easy because only one log is maintained for the single instance. After the maintenance, deployment is also fast because it needs to be deployed in one site and changes will be reflected to all tenants.  Easy Customizations: With applications based on multitenancy, we can provide tenant an additional layer for the customizations, while the customers change that layer according to their requirements, the underlying codebase remains same for all the tenants [1]. Page 13 of 80  14 May 2018 Benefits Provided to User  Customizability: The ability to modify the application for a distinct tenant in various ways such as adding or eliminating features, changing colors and logos, or even adding their own code or script [1].  Availability: Distinct tenants want the application to be repetitively available, perhaps with agreements defined in an SLA. Again, the actions of other tenants should not affect the availability of the application [2].  Costs: Costs are lower than using an assigned, single-tenant application because multi- tenancy allows the distribution of resources.  Scalability: The application assures to meet the claim of individual tenants. The existence and actions of other tenants should not shake the performance of the application.  Isolation: The actions of distinct tenants do not affect the use of the application by other tenants. Tenants cannot contact each other's data. It seems to the tenant as though they have limited use of the application.

heading: Goals
content: The multi-tenant application will provide following features:  It will classify to which tenant each line of output goes.  It cannot permit cached data (e.g. views) to outflow between tenants.  It will isolated insistent data for each tenant and its operators.  It needs to identify the customer (or tenant) that any specific web request is for.  It needs isolated background jobs for each tenant.  It will has to keep apart configuration for each tenant. Introduction of the Application (Go-Invoice) This project covers the missing aspects of multi-tenancy in existing invoice apps by implementing the 3rd approach and accommodating tenants with varying needs. The main goal of this project is to redesign an existing invoice application. The existing invoice application uses a single tenant architecture, in this project the application implemented, and has a multi-tenant architecture. This Go Invoice application has functionality of generating online invoices to customers. The methodology of the application is that the user creates an account on the website, then he/she enters the businesses/services which he/she is providing. Similarly a customer who is looking for a service will contact the user, user will generate online invoice and send the client via email. This application generates graphs on the maximum profit basis, most sold product basis, annual sale basis, daily sale basis, monthly sale basis & most profitable customer. The application will generate monthly reports & annual reports. The user can have more than one businesses & one business can have many products. Every business will have different clients, the user will send invoices to those clients via email. This all is being handled using multi-tenant architecture. Another feature is that this application uses a real time currency rate of more than 100 countries and convert the rate of the current currency to the target currency. Secondly the application uses real time date for generating graphs. Page 14 of 80  14 May 2018

heading: 2.8 Software Development Life Cycle
content: In this project, incremental model has been used. Incremental Model is a procedure of software development in which requirements are cracked down into several separate components of software development cycle. Every iteration passes through the requirements, design, coding and testing phases, and every subsequent release of the system enhances functionality to the past release until and unless entire functionality has been fulfilled.

heading: 2.8.1 Characteristics of Incremental model
content: Development Activity is cracked down into several small development activities Incomplete systems are consecutively made to produce a ultimate full system Maximum importance requirement is undertaken at first Once the incremented share is made, requirements for that increment are held.

heading: 2.8.2 Phases in the model
content: The first and foremost phase is to examine the requirements of the client. These requirements comprise of both functional and non-functional requirements. The second Phase is to develop the combined requirements which contain designing interface of your application. The third and most important step is writing the source code of application. The fourth step is the testing of the application The fifth step is to review your application After these phases are followed, the 1st increment of the application is deployed. If there is any problem in the 1st phase then it is resolved by following these steps again and releasing the 2nd increment. Page 37 of 80  14 May 2018

heading: 5.3 Project Summary
content: This project is about a Multi -tenant Application is our primary goal and it is designed on top of Laravel Framework based on the back end, and Angular 5 Framework based on the front end. Multi-tenancy is an architecture in which we host a single copy of software and this instance then serves multiple tenants. Tenant is a group of users with similar requirements, for instance the end- user of a specific organization or business. Tenant have the privilege to make changes in same parts of application for inst ance, change the theme color, or some business rules but they have no privilege to modify the underlying application’s code [1]. This Multi-Tenant Application includes a consolidated administration to conserve a common code based application and run common instances of application for multiple tenants. This procedure confirms that the personal data for each tenant is protected from any others tenant. Multi-tenant web applications are becoming very popular in recent times to deliver controlled code to the users of the same domain. There are many different architectures of developing such applications ranging from single database to different databases for each tenant. This application will only work as an intermediate between user and his clients. This appl ication will not provide any online inventory services to the client. The user can view product list, graphs, reports and lists of various businesses, clients & invoices . It will work as a platform where both major stakeholders who include users and minor stake holders which include clients, can get benefit from each other. Page 65 of 80  14 May 2018

heading: 1.1 Introduction:
content: Barbero is an online platform which is providing a way to barbers to show their loyalty to customers by showcasing their abilities and portfolios to maximum number of customers. Barbero also provides facility to barbers to reinforce their brand as Barbero explicitly providing marketing facility for the barbers. With the help of Barbero, barbers can target maximum number of customers with much less effort, time and money, also it will benefit the barbers to increase the accessibility because with Barbero anyone can look up for the saloon’s work, pricing, location and customers feedback. Barbero will allow the customers to make an appointment at some desired/suitable saloon.  Whereas general users of Barbero can look up maximum number of barbers near to their location. They can look up the portfolios of barbers for which saloon provides the rates and work the customer is looking for. Barbero will also provide a customer with other customers’ feedback of the saloons so that they may decide which saloon will most suit their budget and time. Barbero will provide a communication medium for barbers and customers to fix time and appointment for each other. This will help save a lot of time of customers a nd barbers. Further, barber will be providing an online customer care center for both, saloon barbers and customers, to help deliver services to the particular customers fulfilling their best interests.

heading: 1.2 Objectives:
content: • Barber will have Admin console available at play store and website  which will provide them facility to upload  his portfolio and location at the Barbero platform and he will be able to confirm or reject the appointment request. • User will have android application available at Google Play store and website  in which user can look up all the saloons near to his location also user can request for appointment at any saloon and can give review about it. • Admin will have admin panel which will let admins to manage the Customers, Barbers and saloons registered on their portal. • Our main objective is to build a user frie ndly application with attractive interface to help user interact easily with the system. The proposed application will be tested and validated according to the standard rules and regulations in order to make it bug free application. • Once completed this app lication will be launched with full introduction user manual and all the other deliverables that required to be published these deliverables will help user understand the concept and techniques of this application.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: In recent years we have seen that in Pakistan, businesses are getting automated and people are willing to using modern technologies like uber and careem people are now willing to save up their time even if they have to learn some new technology to bring comfort to their lives. So, we identified a gap at the process of barbers’ shop where people have to wait two to three hours for their turn and still they don’t get for what they came to the shop/saloon, even after spending handsome amount of money and time.

heading: 1.4 Assumption and constraints
content: • This proposed application will be available free of cost • This application will allow the user to install the application at any android device having a version 4.0 or above without any difficulty • The developers will deliver the mile stones and deliverables as per time mentioned in the plan. • The proposed application must be completed by the end of October. • No external hardware will be required to perform functionality of the application.

heading: 1.5 Project Motivation and Scope
content: • This platform has a potential to earn handsome amount of money because if we are giving a large amount of customers to barbers then they can share their profit with us. • It can provide facility to the barbers to use a handy android application and grab an opportunity to target maximum number of customers by showcasing their work to maximum number of audience. • It can save a lot of money of customers by providing them with details and location of saloon which matches their requirements and budget. Also it can save a lot of time of customer because it is providing a facility to take appointment by using a mobile application • In future we can promote different beauty products. There are many sponsors that are willing to pay handsome amount for the promotion of their products and we can also work as affiliates of beauty product. Chapter: 2 Requirement analyses

heading: 2.6 Software Development Life Cycle Model
content: The software development process model that we plan on  using for the development for this application is the agile model. The agile model is the combination of incremental and iterative process. In the agile model working product is delivered after each iteration this is the basic reason behind choosing this model it is also best suited because it will be relatively quick as we have time constraints to finish this project we would like to have working versions available by using this model we would be developing our application in stages with every working version having more features than the previous one this would largely decreases the complexity of the project and after each iteration we would be able to get feedback from users on any possible short comings which we would then be able to improve in the next iteration by doing this the finalized product would be one that would have all the features initially planned for any variations that would arise when getting feedback from the users. Due to the fact that we are going to be getting working versions after every iterations it ensures that at no point in time we will be completely blank or have nothing to show for our efforts. As we are developing application it is of the utmost importance it will solve the problem we identified otherwise within 2 to 3 months after release of our application many competitors may grab your market share by providing solution of the problem.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: We have faced a lot of problems and challenges in completion of this report. First problem we have faced was defining the scope and requirements of this project. There are thousands of applications available at Google Play store and due to so much advancement in technology and technological education number of developers are increasing exponentially and rather than doing job people prefer to make their own applications and generate revenue for them so what we had to do was to find the gap so that we can fill gap and introduce an application which solves the common problem. We reviewed a lot of literature from around the world in order to define scope required to solve the identified problem. Secondly, developing UML’s was another big problem and defining software architecture was another major problem we faced during this phase. Because we didn’t have any experience in doing it for mobile application and we only did it for small applications or little modules but fortunately after reading different articles, research papers and most importantly with guidance of our supervisor we managed to complete it effectively and efficiently. These were the major problems we faced but rather than taking them as problem we took those as challenges and by our effort and blessings of Allah Almighty we managed to complete it on time and most importantly we gained a lot of knowledge from these problems.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: Development of mobile application was different from development of Website or desktop application which were mainly focused during all of our degree. Using the knowledge and skills we have managed to learn during all of our six semesters we had to relate and find similarities between what we have taught and what we are doing in our final year project. With the help of our teachers and supervisor we have managed to complete this documentation. We have been quite fortunate to have been taught courses like software engineering, requirement gathering and software quality assurance, software design and architecture and software project management name a few. These courses helped us a lot in gathering requirements, developing UML’s and construction of related diagrams. Now, our schedule, structures, requirements and scope are completely defined.  These things are going to help us a lot in our development phase because we have defined our schedule also structures are defined and requirements are clear so now we can develop our project effectively and efficiently.

heading: Abstract
content: Locus is an online platform which helps to find places i.e. (hostels, hospitals and restaurants) near to the location of the user. Our platform is very helpful for students to find hostels near to their university  in Lahore. It has two modules web  application and android application. Web application module is totally controlled by administrator and application module will be for users. In web module admin can add places, update places and calculate the bills of hostel rooms. On the other hand user can view the details of that places and locations on google map. User can book a room of hostel from application and bill will be calculated also.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Locus is an online platform which is providing a way to people to show the places near to them. It has two modules. ). In the first module (Android), there will be an app that helps user to find hostels, restaurants/hotels and hospitals near to its location. In the second module (Web), all the hostels administrators, hospitals administrators and restaurants/hotels administrators will enter the required detail into website by which our app will show the entered details by administrators. Our application will help students so that they can find hostels near to their institution and people who are professionals and do some kind of job can also find rooms on rent to stay. Mostly People come to Lahore for family tour, by using our app they can find out the best restaurant/hotel to stay. We will also include rating feature so that a customer can judge the standard and quality of restaurant by its rating.  We shall give all the details of each place to our customer. Mostly people don't have any idea that where are the best hospitals, our app will help them to find best one, also in case of emergency, it will be very helpful to find hospital near to the desired location.

heading: 2.1.6 Location Based Service (LBS)
content: Location Based Service (LBS) LBS is mobile service that has the capability to provide real time information based on the user’s location. Geographical Information System (GIS) has been the heart of LBS in order to provide all the functionalities in LBS. First, we may send location information to remote parties. This set of services are commonly used today, e.g., in location tracking applications. Second, use location information to make communication decisions, e.g., a user agent may automatically disable instant messaging when driving. Third, location changes can trigger communica tion actions, e.g., when a person’s user agent gets a location notification indicating the person enters a room, the user agent may automatically turn on the light of the room. Sending location information to remote parties for location tracking Locations are usually represented in geo spatial coordinates or civil addresses for tracking. By enabling to upload real time location and to create the content “on the spot”, we can expect more variety of location-based services. [6]

heading: 4.2.3 Unit Testing
content: Unit testing is a technique in which small units or modules of the system are tested individually. Unit testing can be done manually. Unit testing refers to testing of each module that has been built against functional requirement collected in software requirement specification, each module is built and tested. Following are the techniques of unit testing:  Black Box Testing: Input is provided and output is generated against an interface of the system module.  White Box Testing: The behaviour and the patterns of the functions are tested.  Gray Box Testing: This is used to tests risk and the assessment methods.

heading: 4.2.4 Integration Testing:
content: Integration testing focuses on the interface of the system. It is performed on the individual modules and units, integrated together to check their errors, reliability and interactivity with each other. Integration testing is important because the individu al function or sub -functions when combined do not produce the desired results. Therefore, we apply integration testing to check the working between the modules after integration. We created different modules individually, first module was basically our web  module where hostel administrators, hospital administrators and restaurant administrators will upload all the details. This module consists of classes, sub -classes, data properties and object properties of our project. The next module is android module where user can see places near to its locations and their details. We created all the quires of database.

heading: ABSTRACT
content: Considering the current scenario of Pakistan, millions of people travel on the roads, streets, highways even around the city 24/7. In that case many of them face the difficulties towards their rides they carry with them for example: cars, bikes, auto even vans & busses. Most of the times the people face the difficulties when the problem arise with their vehicle like if the bike tire is punctured and any kind of issues related to mechanics similar is the situation with cars & even all the kind of automobiles and there is no such dedicated systematic approach for those people to help them. Mostly they call their homes or to their relatives in order to seek help or those people find mechanics voluntarily by themselves and should have to pay them more than usual to come along with people for help. If there is any system that is to help them is available then they charge a lot more than usual. For example: dealership offers their customers to call them whenever they required help in vehicle broke down situation but the problem is that they charge a lot more than usual for their service and in the end the technician who does everything gets nothing but only his daily wage so that technician is having no benefit. The main motivation is to do something for that person who is going all the way down there and help him. Who took all the money and came back to the dealership and submit it at the counter of the dealership. According to the informal survey, it is asked from that person whether he is alright to go for the help on just a simple amount in exchange for that like 30 or 50 Rs and then charge the customer according to the service he provides and takes all the profit in the pocket. The mechanic is thankfully happy with it who wants to work. The person is working anyway so it doesn't hurt him to take all the charges of his services for himself only. This could give him an opportunity to do something for himself and to escape from the  wage system and provide the service with honour and respect. The idea is to propose a system, an all-in-one platform to cater all above-mentioned issues people will be maintained according to the categories of them for the other people to choose their best option. The system will smartly guide people to call help for them in case of any emergency on the road related to mechanics. heading: 2.6 Software Development Life Cycle Model
content: We are using agile model for our project and the reasons why we chose this model are as follows:  Stakeholder Engagement. This software development model provides us multiple opportunities for stakeholders and team engagement before, during and after each sprint. It provides us high degree of collaboration between the clients and project team by involving the clients in every step of the project, which provide us way to better understand the client’s vision. Delivering working software early and frequently increases stakeholder’s trust in the team’s ability to deliver high quality working software and encourages them to be more deeply engaged in the project.  Transparency: This approach provides a unique opportunity for clients to be involved throughout the project development and designing phase, from prioritizing features to iteration planning and review sessions to frequent software builds containing new features.  Early and Predictable Delivery. By using fixed schedule strategy that is 1-4 weeks, new features are delivered quickly and frequently, with a high level of predictability. This also provides the opportunity to beta test the functionality if needed.  Predictable Efforts and Schedule. Because each sprint/module is a fixed duration, so the cost is predictable and limited to amount of work that can be performed by the team in the fixed schedule time-box. Combined with the estimates provided to the client prior to each sprint, the client can more readily understand the effort of implementing each feature, which improves decision making about the priority of features and the need for further iterations.  Allows for Change. This methodology provides opportunity for development team to modify the sprint according to the needs of the stakeholders or customers. New or changed backlog items can be planned for the next iteration providing the opportunity to introduce changes within a few weeks.  Improves Quality.  By breaking down the project into manageable units, the project team can focus on high quality development, testing, and collaboration. Also by producing frequent builds and conducting, testing, and reviewing each iteration, improves the quality by finding and fixing the defects quickly and identifying expectations mismatches early.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Country Paper & Board Mills (Pvt)  Ltd. is paper manufacturing company registered by Lahore chamber of commerce. Workflow of the company totally based on existing manual system. Record related to all departments is maintained manually on registers. Company consist of various departments, mainly purchase, sales, production, store and finance management. All work related to these departments is maintained manually. So, company is suffering from various problems in shape of extra staff, extra time consumption and slow work process. heading: 2.1 Introduction
content: Country Paper & Board Mills (Pvt) Ltd. is paper manufacturing company registered by Lahore chamber of commerce. Workflow of the company totally based on existing manual system. Record related to all departments is maintained manually on registers. Company consist of various departments, mainly purchase, sales, production, store and finance management. All work related to these departments is maintained manually. So, company is suffering from various problems in shape of extra staff, extra time consumption and slow work process. Hence, the proposed project will provide all services on a single platform using web-based application. heading: Abstract
content: Human identification is very important for security purposes. There are many unimodal biometrics in use for human identification but they rely on single source of biometric information due to which they are not able to produce most efficient result and they have one major problem, they are not useful if we have different biometric information from database. To increase efficiency and reliability, we proposed a method and developed a system which is capable of identify human by multiple source of biometrics information and by multiple features of a single biometric. For more discriminant results we appl y different classifier with different biometrics dataset, list and accuracy of these classifier with dataset is listed in table. Our system work with three different biometrics which include Face, Iris and Palm. System has multiple option, you can select any biometric to identify with or you can select live run time face recognition option. On the other hand we proposed feature level fusion to produce better accuracy. One more benefit of fusion is that it allow us to train system with multiple source of inf ormation but at testing or runtime we can test with a single and multiple source of information. We fuse multiple biometric as well as multiple feature of single biometric, HOG(Histogram of Oriented Gradient) and LBP(Linear Binary Pattern) is the main features used in our system and method. Image processing, computer vision and deep learning are the major technique s used in our system. ATT  (Face) dataset and BIT (Palm and Iris) dataset are used for system training and testing, for live identification we used own data which contains data of 8-10 persons information.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: There are many dreadful activities happening on daily basis and many people lose their lives in these activities. To stop these activities, we require digital systems that can identify peoples. Best way to identify a person is through his/her biometric because biometric of every individuals is distinctive and measureable. Well known biometrics used for human identification are fingers print, iris, DNA and face. Every individual has different pattern of these biometrics. There are already many biometric systems available in market but mostly these systems are unimodal, means they rely on single modality of biometric. These kind of systems have low efficiency because unimodal system often face lack of accuracy due to noisy data. For more efficiency we are proposing a system that have both properties. It can use multiple modalities of biometrics or it can use multiple features of a single modality of biometric depends on situation and availability of individual’s data. In both cases we required fusion to combine different vectors in a single vector. The method of fusion can occur at three different level i.e. feature level, matching score level and decision level. At feature level, feature extracted from different modalities and combined for processing/training. At matching score level , feature from two or more modalities work alone and end scores are compared to produce answers. And at decision level feature from different modalities work alone and result are combined using techniques such as majority voting or s um rule. Decision level and matching score level are very popular in literature  methodologies because these fusion techniques are simple and applied on obtained results. But feature level is more efficient than these two level because of its more discrimin ant power and it work with features rather than results. In our proposed methodology it is proved that fusion is better when single modality fail to provide better accuracy. So fusion at feature level is believed to provide more efficient results [2]. Feature level consider as more difficult from other because in feature level vector from two or more modalities are combined into a single one to produce results that’s why this fusion considered more discriminant. Gesture recognition [3] also become optimize by this feature level based methods by combining the different gestures. Our system also work with  feature level fusion because efficiency is always  priority of security systems and feature level fusion provide more efficiency then others. Scope of our system is not just bounded to one technique, but it can work as single unimodal to work with single biometric as well as it can work as multimodal with two techniques. First is it use two features of a biometric and second is two biometrics with single or multiple features. For instance, we use face as single biometric system will extract pattern of more than one feature such as Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) and Local binary pattern (LBP) and combine them to match from database or  we take face and palm  as our two biometrics, our system will extract pattern template of face and iris and combine them to match from database. Many other biometrics can be used in this like gait, fingerprints   etc. For training of our system ATT face datasets, BIT Iris datasets and BIT Palm datasets are used. For runtime identification we trained system with our own face datasets.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content:  Our goal is to develop a system to enhance the security.  Identification of human by using multimodal biometrics for more efficiency.  Identification of human by multiple feature of a single biometric.  Develop a system that will helpful in unauthorized restriction.  Provide a system with high discriminant power for human identification.

heading: 1.3  Problem Statement
content: One of the most important issue of society is security. And in our country there is not a good security system that can help for security purposes. With the passage of time crime rate is increasing rapidly. Most of criminal incident occur because criminals walk around freely and no one can recognize them by just looking at them. Criminals can enter at any public place without even recognized. There are cameras installed at most places but these cameras are just recording videos and these system are not able to recognize peoples. So criminal walk around freely in front of these cameras without any fear of get caught. With these system we can’t reduce crime rate because with these system we will never able to caught criminal before he/she perform any criminal activity. In some buildings suc h system installed that can recognize people and allow only authorized person into the building. But most of these systems are unimodal which mean they recognize person by only single feature of single biometric. And these system are not much reliable because they provide less accuracy. A good reliable security system can reduce criminal incidents by recognize people before allowing to enter in any place.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions
content:  Security system are often developed desktop version but user may require android based  or IOS based system as in this modern no one want to sit in front of desktop if required functionalities can be phone based. But our assumption is desktop application because we have experience and knowledge about that.  Our assumption is there is an admin who have the system for human identification and the staff which are working under that admin.  Quality of sensors and cameras can effect system performance.  An expert required to monitor system at all time, that expert need to have deep knowledge about system. But if any mishap happen with expert which lead to personnel risk, new expert will be hired who need to learn which will very time consuming and difficult for new person to learn every detail of system.

heading: 1.5 Constraints
content:  Security system need to upgrade regularly to avoid any mishap, and for every upgrade we need a team that can upgrade system accordingly and these upgrades will require high cost.  System will need large database which need to maintain accordingly.  As this system need training on large dataset so compatible computer system require for training and validation of system.

content: We are making a system by fusing multiple feature of single biometric a nd multiple biometric. This wil l allow system to work as unimo dal and multimodal. These biometrics are trained wi th two classifiers NN (Neural Network) and SVM (Support Vector Machine). For multimodal, feature level fusion technique is proposed, both feature descriptor are fused for single biometric multi feature requirement and same feature of two and three biometric are fused for multi biometric fusion requirement.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: Before starting this project we don’t have detailed knowledge about human identification. We don’t know about procedure of system and have a very few knowledge about machine learning. So problem we faced is when we apply different dataset on al ready built system,  number of features differ and we needed to resize every picture of that dataset into form in which algorithm is designed to work which is very time consuming. Another problem that we faced is that for better runtime identification we need good cameras. After some research we learn that we don’t need to convert dataset, we can modify algorithm to do work with new dataset into its original form. Modifying algorithm is less time consuming and not very complex.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: Human identification is important for security purposes and it is must needed thing these da y. But in our country this field is not getting proper attention. So we proposed a system methodology in which we test two different classifier which include SVM (Support Vector Machine) and NN (Neural Network) with three biometrics Face, Iris and Palm, obtained accuracy is shown in accuracy tables. Palm is our weak biometric because we have both Palm of a person to consider them as one class that why accuracy of Palm is lower than others two biometrics. Fusion of Palm with other biometrics increase its accuracy but it decrease other biometrics accuracy. Accuracy of fused face and iris always increase and just decrease in case when already accuracy is too high. In our system interface we include live runtime face identification feature, which can identify person by taking picture.

heading: Abstract
content: Getaway is an Online Multiplayer Card Game developed using the Unity3d engine, c#  scripting language and Photon Networking Services. The game is intended for Android platfor m and will require an internet connection to work. The game has a server lobby and each server wi ll have a player lobby where players gather to play a match. Master client is the one who creates a server and the rest are standard client. The game follows a client server architecture where all the clients communicate with master client where validation functions execute. The overall int ention of the game is to provide entertainment anywhere anytime which was till now not possible wi thout having to gather with friends to play this game.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Our project is a Multiplayer online card game which we named Getaway. The game is played all around the world especially in Pakistan and India and is one of the most played games which uses a sta ndard deck of cards, since now, people have been playing this game with real cards physical ly by planning a meet, they physically had to be together to play the game, so we have decided to provide a digital mobile version of the game to the players to play with their family and friends anyti me anywhere without having to arrange a meeting to play. We believe that this digital version of the gam e will provide the more entertainment to the players as people are more prone to use smartphones. This game will  also save time and effort of having to go somewhere and play just by sitting and using their  smartphone from wherever they are. Internet availability is not an issue since everyone owns an internet con nection in their homes or have mobile data when outside. The main topic of our development is the implementation of an online multiplayer  architecture and structure, how the client side app will communicate with each other through the server and to synchronize and allow communication among the connected client apps. Our game is a turn based [6] multiplayer game meaning that out of all the connected players in a match one player can take a turn at a time which is conveyed to the server and then the server updates the rest of the connected clients, conse quently the other players in the match will be able to see the action taken by the user who to ok the turn, and then the flow of the game will continue allowing the next player in the match to take the turn according to the rules of the game. We are using Unity 3D engine for our client side app (The interface of t he game) although most of the aspects of the game are in 2D. All the card models and logic will be implemented in unity engine with the programming language C# to code. Built in android plugin is available to support android smart phones (the platform of our game). Photon Networking is used to implement the online multiplayer aspect of our game. 48 cards (Jacks dealt out of the game) are distributed among 4 players in the match. These card are random and distributed by the master client after shuffling. 12 card are given to ea ch client and on the count of 4 players in game the match starts. Master client always takes the first  turn and then the game flow starts in clockwise direction. Each card here is drag-able within the hand to users to arrange their cards as they want and they can double click or double touch to throw a card.

heading: 2.2 Game Rules
content: The Getaway Game Rule set and Game-Flow Described:  This game uses a standard deck of cards (with no jacks) which is dealt out completely to the players. The object of the game is to get rid of all your cards. The last person with cards loses and is named "Bhabi." The Bhabi is the loser of the game - all other players win the game.  The Master client starts the game by throwing the first card. Play proceeds clockwise with each player following suit if possible. Players must play one card of the suit that was lead (thrown in the beginning) if they have one, but may play a card of any value of that suit.  If all players have played one card of the same suit, play stops and the complete round of cards is removed from the game (placed in a discard pile). The player who played the highest card of the suit now has the lead and may play any card from his hand to start the next round.  If, on his turn, a player cannot play a card of the suit that was lead, he may pl ay any other card from his hand. Play stops immediately and the player who played the highest card of the su it that was lead must pick up all the cards in play (all the cards of the suit  that was lead, plus the one out of suit card that stopped play) and add them to his hand, this action is called ‘Thulla’ in Punjabi. This player now has the lead and may play any card from his hand to start the next round.  Play continues in this manner until only one player has cards left. They are the Bhabi [1], and have lost the game. All other players have won.

heading:  Special Rule 1:
content: On the first round, if a player plays out of suit, play continues until all  players have played one card. All these cards are added to the discard pile, even if one or more players has played out of suit. For this reason, turn order is not important on the fir st round and players may all throw out a Spade (or another card if they have no Spades) as soon a s they have their hands arranged.

heading:  Special Rule 2:
content: If there are more than two players left in the game, and all players have played a card of the same suit to complete the round, but the player who played the highest card of that suit (the player who should therefore start the next round) has no cards left, that play er has become one of the winners by getting rid of all their cards and is out of the game. The player on that player's left will start the next round.

heading: 2.8 Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
content: Since our project is a mediocre level project in length and difficulty so waterf all model has been chosen. But since our project contains additional functionalities like text and/or voice  chat, invitation feature, report system, email system other than the basic functionality, the multiplayer game, we have decided to use an iterative and incremental model which basically consists of mini waterfall  models in each iteration or increment. We are using this model because the game these are independent featu res which do not rely on each other so they can be planned, developed and tested separately, hence a waterfall model for each feature in each iteration or increment is required.

heading: 2.8.1 Waterfall Model in Increments
content: A waterfall model consists the following phases: 1. Planning and Analysis. 2. Design. 3. Coding. 4. Testing. 5. Maintenance/deployment. Planning and analysis phase consists of planning the software and analyzing the requirement s and specification. Requirements gathering is conducted and then the work flow or work structure is planned accordingly. In the Design phase a software architecture in selected for the feature/game and appropriate pre requirements for coding is implemented. Coding mean to write or develop the software/feature, integration of the software. heading: 6.1 Yates Shuffle Algorithm
content: Shiffer –Yates Shuffle algorithm is a very well-known and popular algorithm used for the shuffling of cards in digital card games. Almost every card game uses this algorithm for shuffling the deck. The following function implements the algorithm in one of our project classes: public void Shuffle() { if(!PhotonNetwork.isMasterClient) { return; } for (int i = 0; i < 48; i++) { myData.shuffleIndex[i] = i; } int n = 48; while (n > 1) { n--; int k = Random.Range(0, n + 1); int tempVar = myData.shuffleIndex[k]; myData.shuffleIndex[k] = myData.shuffleIndex[n]; myData.shuffleIndex[n] = tempVar; } }

heading: 6.2 Network Calls
content: Photon Unity Networking (PUN) API provides function calls which are executed on the target machines (can be from client to all other clients, master to client, client to master etc.). We use photonview static class to access these functions. The code below sends the message to execute the function in quotations on all other connected machines, hence the Photontarget.Others parameter. { photonView.RPC( "RPC_LoadGameOthers", PhotonTargets.Others); }

heading: 6.3 Networked Functions
content: Networked functions which are executed on target machines must have a [PunRPC] tag above them for the compiler to understand their significance. The following function has the [PunRPC] tag and is executed across the network. [PunRPC] private void RPC_Distribute() { PlayerConn.Instance.DistributeMyCards(); } The above functions tells the client to distribute their cards which were provided by the master client after shuffling.

heading: 7.1 Project Summary
content: Using the client server architecture we are allowing the users to play online wit h their friends through a server. The game provides a digital platform for this card game. 4 players are requi red to start a match, they can be strangers from the internet or their own friends that the user adde d through their unique alias or email. The client (user end) interface displays the game layout and cards where the users plays their moves which then get updated to the server, the server updates the move to all the connec ted clients so they can see what their opponent did. This is a turn base multiplayer game meaning onl y one user is allowed to take turn at a time and then others are allowed to take turns accordin g to the rules and flow of the game. The user are offered casual and competitive modes, where they can play casual ly without any worries or compete for higher ranks against other players of their skill lev el. This way players can increase their rank and show-off to their close ones of their skill level.

heading: 7.2 Future Work
content: Since internet is not always available to the user, a mode should exist to allow them to play offline against AI bots as opponents. These AI bots must exist with various difficulty levels to all ow diverse variety of users (different skill levels) to play against Bots of their skill lev el. This can be accomplished by using neural networks to train Bots to play like humans and provide human-like challenge rat her than hard coded difficulty levels of the bots that won’t make a mistake if the difficulty is set to high. Other than this allowance for custom rules for the match created by any player and the game may work  according to those rules. A server list available in the app which will show the availabl e servers hosted by friends or strangers and joinable when available.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Travelling among locals is the best hobby now days. Today the new technology is emerging so the system is also adopting accordingly. Throughout the world tourist guide apps has adopted from ancient way to new i.e. offline maps, GPS locations etc. but it is not that good yet developed because no application is providing the location of friends. Keeping in view this point we want to introduce a good and reliable tourist guide app in Pakistan. The proposed application will give benefit to everyone  to plan a tour to different areas of Pakistan. The user will sign up first to use the application. The proposed system will be very simple and reliable for the users; they will be able to search the desired places by using the advanced search and they can book hotel and v ehicles for a ride or tour  using contact information . User can see the photos of the places along with a blog that will provide the information about that place. The Sign-up process is simple. User can sign up using his/her Facebook account. Then they will be able to avail all the functionalities of this app. And from list he/she can add friends, which will be the users of this app they can see location of everyone on the map. User can also give their reviews.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: Following is the basic goals and objectives of proposed app: 1. The app will facilitate any person to make their journey better and entertaining. 2. This app will open a new way to the world of tourism within Pakistan. 3. It will be designed such that to provide user a reliable platform to organize their tours in a better way. 4. Online application will become an easy approach for anyone because it will make the tours easy. 5. The app will help user to select a place for tour by seeing the photos with a blog about that place. 6. User will be able to see the location of all his/her friends on map.

heading: 1.3 Problem statement
content: Tour planning has gone through drastic changes over the years and people want to get their tour planned as swiftly and efficiently as possible. The software designers now require a means by which they can efficiently get the requirements of their users and understand the needs of user by the help of an application which help them plan their tour easily.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & constraints
content: • Complete guidance. • Sign up for free. • Sign in is compulsory for every user. • Users can see the location of friends and family when travelling. • Hotel booking. • Transport booking. • Plan trip according to budget and time.

heading: 1.5 Project scope
content: Application with the features to show the user the location of his/her friends on map during a trip and that can guide you to plan a tour is not yet developed so we want to introduce this application in Pakistan. The proposed app will open a new space for tourists throughout Pakistan. It will provide a good platform not only for  those who are going on a tour but also for a person who wants to travel according to his/her budget inside the parameters of a city. This app is to make the traveling easy for everyone. This app is especially very helpful when a group is traveling in different vehicles to same place and they face the problem of losing someone behind. User can add friends from the list of users of this app and then he/she can see the location of friends on map . This app will unite all the group members and will make their j ourney better and entertaining. User can plan their trip, and to do so user just have to enter their budget, number of persons and their destination along with number of days and type of vehicle. The application will show the estimate cost of their trip and hotels according to their budget in that particular area. User can make reservations of hotels and transport sing this app by sending the messages on a button click.

heading: 2.6   Software Development Life Cycle Model
content: The software development process model that we plan on using for the development of this application is the agile model. The agile model is a combination of iterative and incremental process models. In the agile model a working product is delivered after each iteration; this is the basic reason behind choosing this model. It is also best suited because it will be  relatively quick and as we have time constraints to finish this project, we would like to have working versions available. By using this model, we would be developing our application in stages with every working version having more features than the previ ous one. This would largely decrease the complexity of the project and after each iteration we would be able to get feedback from users on any possible shortcomings which we would then be able to improve in the next iteration. By doing this the product that we would get at our final iteration would be one that would have all the features initially planned for and any variations that would arise when getting feedback from the users. Due to the fact that we are going to be getting working versions after every iteration it insures that at no point in time would we be completely blank or have nothing to show for our efforts.

heading: 1. Introduction
content: This chapter is mainly about the introduction of e-learning system, which will tell about the goals and objects and other constraints. This chapter describes the problem statement, assumptions and constraints and project scope. At the end of this chapter there is short description of all other chap- ters.

heading: 1.1 Introduction of E-learning:
content: E-learning system is a web based system, which provides the education for students on their door step. System will also provide the live streaming sessions for main stakeholders i -e students and teachers. Through this system online evaluation of courses via assignments, quizzes and exams are possible. Our application will also suggest carrier counseling guidance for students. This applica- tion can provide facility for easy availability of course contents for students. Through this , system Administrative power i -e new user, delete users ,input data, modify data an d search data from database and database backup service will be provided. As the idea of E-learning getting popular dramatically so the opportunities for such type of system has increased and getting more in future. Our existing systems of education have only websites, which inform only their 0registered students for only up to announcements, delivery content maximum. This System should secure highly and efficient so that online quizzes and live streaming classes done accurately and immediately.  The System is to conducting online quizzes, students admission, course registration, managing results. Moreover, the system manages courses, exams section. The system is recommended have a unique username and password so that nobody can miss use it. This system must be right protected and rights of every category of user must be clearly described so that limits of every user access are defined.

heading: 1.2 Goals and Objectives:
content: The objective of “E-learning system “is to provide better information for the stakeholders of this system for better results.

heading: 2 | P a g e
content:  Simple System for learn ing with modules of registration , results, Preparation, teacher , student, library, live streaming for classes, download and u pload course contents, query box. Exam box.  Easy data entry for student registration.  Students list for record maintaining.  Live streaming function save both teacher &student time.  User privileges to control what staff and student can see &do.  Backup function to disk or flash/memory stick.  Instant remote support always available.

heading: 1.3 Problem statement:
content: Our educational system is not able to provide advance and easy way of learning for the students. Current systems of education do not provide the mentorship to the students. Moreover we do not have a online complete e learning system which can provide the quality mentorship. . There are many e-learning sites available but it is quite difficult to come up with that grasp the attention of everyone in the world. The purpose of this system is to enhance the experience of the users of this generation, to give an easy way of learning and mentorship. So the problem is to solve the shortcomings of the existing solutions and tools that are belonging to this category. We plan to do is to provide the user learning with their own requirements and facilitation.. We thoroughly read the available solutions and their shortcomings and come up with a solution which will more relaxing and entertaining and remove the all past hectic hurdles of study system for both students and teachers,

heading: 1.4 Assumptions and constraints:
content: This proposed system is free of cost for un-registered persons but for institutions it will not free of cost, and only purchased customers can use all features. This system provides the user installation and accessing without any difficulty. The developers delivered all the milestones and deliverables as per time mentioned in project plan. No so special external hardware need to use this system.

heading: 1.5 Project scope:
content: E-learning system is very popular and new topic now -a-days. How to study with new age and manage their time is disturbing everyone. People are looking more than daily google solutions, which provide a defined solution with authority of recognition. It is not only a specific content related website it provides the solution to all problems we face A to Z almost in our education system i-e travelling ,weight of hundreds of books, notes etc. Now a day everything is going to be systemized and computerized so it is a time to made Education through system so that the cons of the manual system can be eradicate and save the time of students and teachers by providing services at their own place. The basic purpose of E-learning to identify and address the challenges associated to achieving real time safety, dependability, availability and security of the coming generations of E-learning system. Its main aim is to simplify and improve the efficiency of the learning and teaching process for both teachers and students, minimize manual data entry and ensure data accuracy and security during Different process. Student are also able to view their courses, attendance, resu lts, assignments, quizzes   and  to have a visual confirmation that the process done accurately. Moreover, live streaming classes are also available. It is an online system of University, which is made for educating students of rural areas. Thus in limited scope features of the system are:  Online registration of courses for available course contents.  Log in for security purpose.  Course evaluation i-e quizzes.  Assignment Submission process.  Marks lists and result.  Uploading course contents.  Downloading course contents.  Live streaming conference classes.

heading: 1.1 Overview
content: Pakistan is a famous tourist and vacation spot for local as well as foreign tourists. People from all over the world come to visit Pakistan and see its pleasing beauty and astounding cultural heritage. In the past few years the tourism industry was greatly affected by terrorism, but due to military’s operations against terrorists in northern areas and improvement in the infrastructure the security situation is con siderably improved. Now once again Pakistan’s tourism industry is growing rapidly. Pakistan Tourism Development Corporation (PTDC) data showed that foreign tourists have increased three times since 2013 to 1.75 million in 2016, while local tourists have jumped to 38.3 million. Domestic travel spending is expected to increase 5.3 percent in 2017 to Rs1.24 trillion and jump 5.6 percent per year to Rs2.13 trillion in 2027 [1]. The tourism industry contributed 7% to total GDP of the country in 2017 [2]. The attractions for tourists in Pakistan ranges from the historical areas of ancient Indus Valley civilization to the peaks of northern areas. Pakistan is fortunate to have some of the highest peaks in the world. The weather conditions and breath-taking sights of hills in northern areas make them a heaven for tourists. Due to advancements in technology every area of our lives has been affected so is the tourism industry. We are blessed to be born in the era of information technology, now almost everyone has access to a smartphone and internet. Information Technology has empowered people to stay in touch with others all around the world and made our lives easier than they were ever before. The traditional ways of planning our trips by doing everything ourselves from  booking tickets to selecting the place to stay and places to visit. People now a day like their trips to be planned from the comfort of their home. A lot of local, small and large tour planners are there for this purpose. These tour planners plan the comp lete trip for you, if someone wish to go on a trip they simply have to register themselves with the tour planner of their choice and they are ready to go without any hassle of planning the trip themselves. Developed countries are using information technolo gy start-ups like AirBnB and TripAdvisor to make travelling safe, easier and fun for all people in the world [3]. Whereas in our country there is a huge space for development in this industry. The problem is that there is no unique platform Page 13 of 114  December 27, 2018 for tourists to find a suitable trip, they have to search a lot to find a tour planner or tour package of their liking also tour planners doesn’t have a similar platform to post the details of tours, packages and offers provided by them, they have to post the details of tours on different social media platforms and forums. Moreover, in Pakistan you have the option to either travel with a group or plan the complete trip yourself. We aren’t aware of the good places to stay and places to visit during the trip. The purpose of this application (TriPlan) is to provide a unique platform to all the tourists and tour planners. The platform will allow the tourists to see the details of tours posted and notified by different tour planners so they can select the trip of their choice e asily without hectic searching. Moreover, this application will allow tour planners to  create trips according to their own choices and post it with the  details of the t rip, packages and discounts provided by them. Besides tour planner’s individuals can als o post details of a tour so anyone can join their tour  by booking it . Due to all the information at a single platform about all the trips arranged by different tour planners it will be easy for everyone to choose the best tour/trip according to their budget, taste and availability. Tourists will also be able to check the reviews/ratings given to different tour planners by other tourists after completing trips with them  and decide which tour planner or trip will be suitable for them. Tourists can post the feedback related to any trip on Trip Feed. Tourists can post their places of interests in the trip feed section so that trips can be planned according to their interest. Before going on a trip, they can check the do’s and don’ts of the area they hope to  visit from the trip feed posted by other tourists to protect themselves from any fraud during their trip. In this application tourists and tour planner can open the camera and point it towards a direction and it will show them all Point of Interests (POIs) including the restaurants and places to visit in that direction and show these restaurants and other places augmented in front of them with their name and distance from the current location. This application is adequate for tourists and tour planners to fulfil all their tourism needs in a convenient way, aiming towards an improved tour planning. Initially, people would worry about planning a trip or going with tour planners without having adequate information or reviews about them but with this application, this is no longer an issue [3]. content: The tourists and tour planners  need bulk and collective information about tours to choose tours according to their choices but there is no unique platform for tourists to find a suitable trip at a single place, they have to search a lot to find a tour planner or tour package of their liking also tour planners don’t have a similar platform to post the details of tours  provided by them, they have to post the details of tours on different social media platforms and forums. It is like a to -do-list but instead of list of things it shows you the trip and its related things [7].

Furthermore, we can share this detail with anyone we want to keep them aware and updated of our trip [10].

heading: 2.6 Software Development Life Cycle
content: Waterfall Model along with Rapid Prototyping Model: We are going to use a mixture of two SDLC Models one is Waterfall Model and the second is Rapid Prototyping Model. 2.6.1 Why use Waterfall Model? Waterfall Model is used when the requirements are clear and certain in the beginning, product definition is stable and the technology to be used is well understood. 2.6.2 Why use Rapid Prototyping Model? Rapid Prototyping Model is used when our customers are non -technical and they have no idea of what they want and what they can have. As the requirements are unclear there are moderate chances of requirement changes, due to these constraints we will use Prototyping Model and provide prototypes to our user to get update from them which will help us in making the requirements clear based on the feedback provided by the users, we will continue till all the requirements are captured and cleared. After that we will use Waterfall Model and implement these captured requirements. As Waterfall Model requires clear requirements, so these requirements will be used to start the Waterfall phases. In Waterfall Model we get a complete document at the end of every phase that verifie s the implementation of the requirements according to the plan, this makes the maintenance of the application easier. heading: 3.2.1 MVP Architecture
content: The Software Architecture which will be used in this project is MVP (Model View Presenter). Model View Presenter (MVP) separates the code for the views, models and presenter. View define what user sees (interface). Model holds all the data that is related to user and will be shown to them. Presenter works as a bridge between model and view and m ake the interaction easy. MVP helps in making automated testing easy and fast. The proposed system gives collective information to people about the tours. This promote tourism and planning and creating trips will become easy as decision can be made after c omparison of different tours, tour planners the  services they are providing . The proposed system includes the modules listed below.

heading: Figure 15 Application Architecture
content: Figure (15) the Application A rchitecture for TriPlan shows that a user with an android device having GPS and connected to internet can browse the application user interface, where users are first authenticated by the user’s data stored in the database located on the serv er providing data through a RESTful API, which provides a secure way to store the data in the database. Users can Page 64 of 114  December 27, 2018 then use different modules of the application; the augmented reality module interacts with the camera and maps in the system to augment objects of interest.

heading: 3.2.2 Modules
content: The main modules of the project include Tour Planner Module, Tourist Module, Trip Feed Module and Augmented Reality (AR) Module.

heading: 3.2.2.1 Tour Planner
content: The tour planner module provides the facilities the tour planners to create and post trips for public which will be shown to multiple audiences. People will book their trips according to the interests, budget or likings they have. They can create multiple trips according to their choices, offers and discounts or according to the interests of the people which they provide on trip feed. It will be easy for tour planners either individuals, small agencies or large companies to create trips through this application because it provides a detailed form with a sequence of steps for creating trips with each and every detail which is needed to create a trip complete and detailed trip. All the details will be provided by the tour planner in ‘Create Trip Form’ and then it will be submitted to create a trip. A user’s created trips will be shown in a separate screen so tour planner can later edit or d elete it. The created trips will also be publicly shown on a different screen and people can view its details or they can book it after verification from tour planner’s side.

heading: 3.2.2.2 Tourist
content: The tourist module facilitates the tourists as they face a lot of difficulties in finding and searching feasible and suitable trips for themselves. Different platforms are available for searching trips purpose but tourists have to search separately on each and every platform (social media, tour planning websites or other public forums) available related to trips. This module will ease user by providing all the collective details at a single place and they don’t have to search different trips on separate platforms (social media, tour planning websites or other public forums). Tourists can view all the trips created and posted by different tour planners in a separate section. It will have all the trips which any user has created for public to view and join. Tourists will be able to view the details of all the trips as well as they can view the tour planner ratings and feedback on their profiles in order to get an idea about what feedback other tourists have for them or their trips. Tourists can easily compare different trips and tour planners available according to rating/feedback g iven to them or the feedback that is provided to their trips on the trip feed and then they can book a trip Page 65 of 114  December 27, 2018 accordingly to their observation. After booking and completing a trip tourist can provide feedback or rating to the tour planner with whom they have completed a trip which will be uploaded to the tour planner’s profile.

heading: 3.2.2.3 Trip Feed
content: Trip Feed module is like a public forum available to tour planners and tourists where both of them can exchange their views, likings, interests, do’s and don’ts related to a trip as every post on trip feed must be related to a trip. Tourists and tour planners can also comment on the posts available in Trip Feed to share their views  about the post  and in order to interact with public. Comments will also be publicly available. On Trip Feed a tour planner or tourist can either post a textual post or they can also post image to share their thoughts or views with others. Beside this they can also post image along with their textual thoughts to interact with the public.

heading: 3.2.2.4 Augmented Reality
content: Augmented Reality module included in the application is searching Point of Interests (POIs) using Augmented Reality (AR) which can be used by both the tourists and tour planners. This AR feature allows the users to search their point of interests by pointing the camera towards some direction and all the point of interests will be augmented on the screen having the  name of that location along with the distance from current location . People can move the camera left and right and all the point of interests keeps on changing according to the change in location. It will use the device Accelerometer and Magnetometer sensors data along with Google's Places APIs. When a user access this feature of the app back camera opens and shows the augmented reality preview over the screen. 1. Location is accessed by Google APIs. 2. Orientation is accessed by Accelerometer and Magnetometer Sensors data. Page 66 of 114  December 27, 2018

heading: Abstract
content: Single flowers and bouquets are part of every event including marriage,  birthday, funeral, anniversary, special days like mother day,  friendship day etc, so bouquet itself have huge scope in every event,  in Lahore hundreds of bouquet are sold every day  and the re are thousands of vendors in L ahore. People have to cope with limited designs and high prices and still they are unable to get bouquets of their choice. We will give them high range of bouquets and flowers for specific events, Moreover they will get chance to design their own bouquet according to their choice at their doorstep.  We  will contact directly flower suppliers in flower market. We will make contract for supply of customer made bouquets.  In future we will add special events designing like stage designing,  room designing and car designing for events like marriage.  Our system has huge scope for every event and normal day gifts,  including customized bouquets that is introduced first time in Pakistan.

heading: 1.1    Introduction:
content: The trend of online shopping has increased many folds quite rapidly in Pakistan. The country has witnessed a massive increase in e -commerce businesses in the past few years. Most of products are moved to online stores .People prefers to buy things by just having few clicks rather than going market and searching for desire product. We are motivated to capture this trend. Our project is online bouquet store with an extra feature of customize d bouquet, where user can design his/her own b ouquet by selecting flower options given on page. We will make sending fresh flowers easy, whether you want to send to a friend or a relative across the country. You can browse our website and order online or to place your order. User can add gift baskets for special occasions. User can get register simply adding his/her information, bouquets of different kinds will appear in options, after selecting his/her bouquet  he/she can order it moreover he/she can customize the bouquet according his/her wish. After Selecting bouquet user can also add special gifts and can get gift  basket according to wish. . Last step will be sender’s address and delivery address and after that bill will appear on the screen.

heading: 1.2    Objectives:
content: ▪ Our main objective is to provide Attainable, Relevant, and Timely product with customer satisfaction. ▪ We want to provide a platform where user can design his/her bouquet and choose gifts. ▪ Sending emotions and feelings with help of flowers will be now easy. ▪ Our main goal is provide options to user to design bouquet and save their time getting fed up of given options. ▪ We will offer bouquets for every occasion and special events ▪ User can get customize bouquet or send gift to anyone by just simple clicks rather than going market ▪ We will offer different deals including special gifts according to occasions ▪ Our project is first of its unique kind in Lahore and it will get customer attention because of some innovative features. ▪ Users can get special offers for events like marriage and funeral. ▪ We will provide bouquets and floral products of customer’s choice and taste at their doorstep. ▪ We will strive to match and surpass the expectations that our customers expect from us and our products.

heading: 1.3   Problem Statement :
content: The e-commerce sector has grown to a great potential in Pakistan and all over the world. More and more people are attracted towards e -commerce rather than traditional markets. Unfortunately, previously there is no marketplace focused towards flower industry. Some website have bouquet but as a sub category. The problem is to find a customized bouquet or floral products of own choice with affordable price at our doorstep.

heading: 1.4     Assumptions and Constraints:
content: ●  This proposed website will require registration to create the profiles. ● Our servers should be able to support large traffic without crashing. ● This proposed website will allow the user to check its analysis without any difficulty. ● The developers will deliver the milestones and deliverables as per time mentioned in the plan. ● This proposed website must be completed by the end of December. ● No new external hardware will be required to open the website.

heading: 1.5     Project Scope:
content: Many websites, applications and different online platforms are developed for online shopping. In the recent decades, a lot of work is done on e -commerce and many platforms are available for sellers but on this platform which we are going to create is very effective for printing brands and print media designers. ● Our system is related to bouquet (different categories) and floral products. ● Our system will allow user to customize their bouquet and select template according to their taste. ● User can buy bouquets for different events. ● User can add gifts with their selected product. ● Our system will be covering major areas of Lahore which will be enhanced as per demand. ● More customized products and floral items will be added afterwards.

Whole home page is covered with background having just a few buttons and Search bar is not much obvious. They offer same day delivery and cover occasions in a calendar year.  Their pricing is much higher than other local bouquet.  its built wi th plenty of web programming languages, frameworks, and technologies that ensure its stable work, scalability, security, and much more. Delivery date and address is asked that allows user to send flowers to another destination.
