heading: Source: [43]
content: Chapter 3: Tools for Knowledgebase representation and simulation of Robotics Knowledge Representation is very vast and growing field of artificial intelligence that helps to solve problems by representing information in a way that computer can utilize it to solve complex tasks i.e. having conversation with machine in a natural language or di agnosing any defect on the basis of knowledge or suggesting medicine to patient after diagnosing disease [44]. Knowledge representation follows phenomenon of human psychology about how human solve problems[44]. It additionally joins discoveries from hypothesis to automate different sorts of thinking, for example, similarity between different sets and subsets or the application of models [45]. There are distinctive ways to organize knowledge, the most widely recognized qualification is firmly associated with human memory i.e. declarative and procedural [45]. Declarative knowledge refers to prior knowledge of an agent to verify whether a statement is true or not. To verify this, it should initially consult with other agent, or must investigate the environment to discover what is valid [46]. An agent must take both activities to discover the appropriate answer. Agent doe s not have to perform searching if the answer is known. Procedural knowledge ensures that how an agent manipulate sequence of actions to validate that a statement is turn out to be valid [46]. To decide if the knowledge is proced ural, an agent can ask different questions depending on scenario. If the question is valid, then it may be considered as procedural knowledge. Few oftheknowledge representation, manipulation and processing tools are described below:

heading: PROLOG:
content: PROLOG is util ized for the improvement of interpreters of specific languages. Keywords of different language are reserved and have fixed meaning. It is relatively explicit to build up a prolog program that can recognize such keywords and interpret these keywords into th eir correct semantic meaning. Prolog is already trained to facilitate and truly establish center of the dialect [47]. Utilizing abstraction is favored by many people when developing a logic for the problem to avoid as unessential material as could reasonably be expected and to concentrate on the problem that extremely matter. It also enables to develop interactive GUIs [47]. Prolog is essential for the development of software systems by following reasons: Data Structure: Prolog facilitates to implement any basic data structure like array, queues, trees, lists, etc. A single data structure re ferred to as the foundation of language and the whole language is organized to manipulate the referred terms [47]. Variable Declaration:  Unlike Java or C where int, char, are necessary to define the type of variable. Whereas in  prolog types of variables are not to be explicitly declared. It becomes relevant when a certain action performed on a variable [47]. This provide an ease to programmers that decisions during the development can be delayed till the end. Logic Programming: Prolog is an intelligent language. It is characterized and comprehended in terms of Horn Subset predicate logica [47]. Along these lines, this is the scientific establishment of the language clarifying its dominance. Syntax Equivalence: Program and data fit in with a similar language structure, it is explicit to translate the data of other programs. This component is obviously extremelyhelpful when creating translators for languages [47]. Adaptability: A prolog framework can be broadened and altered. It is even convincible to change the prolog language and to adjust its language structure and semantics to the necessities. Prolog is not an object oriented programming languag e but it can adapt object oriented programming [47].

heading: AILOG:
content: As opposed to the programming language Prolog, AILog is a reasoning and knowledge representation framework based over prolog. Ailog language is fundamentally similar to prolog [47]. Following facilities are provided by AILog:  A knowledge based system that provides several probabilistic and logical reasoning [47].  An ask-advice interface that enables clients to speak with AILog[47].  Enabling users to investigate why and how the system did or did not determine a specific fact [47].

heading: YAGO:
content: YAGO (Yet Another Great Ontology) is  freely available [48] knowledge base model developed at Max Planck Institute of Computer Science . YAGO contained information that is extracted from Wikipedia which includes categories, redirects, infoboxes, Wordnet includes synsets, hyponymy and GeoNames(graphical database). Present version of YAGO contains knowledge of more than 10 million entities which includes persons, organizations, cities etc. [49]and has knowledge of more than 120 million facts about these ent ities[49]. YAGO is special in many ways:  The confirmed manually evaluated accuracy of YAGO is  95%[49].  Information in YAGO that contains  entities and facts from 10 Wikipedia in different languages[49].  YAGO combines clean classifications of WordNet  with plenty of category system of Wikipedia, by assigning the entities of more than 350000 classes[49].  YAGO is anchored with time and space. It  also contains some temporal and spatial dimensions to facilitate many of its facts and entities[49]. To provide integration with linked data cloud, YAGO has been linked with SUMO(Suggested Upper Merged Ontology) [50] Ontology and DBpedia Ontology [51]. YAGO has been used in IBM Artificial Intelligent systemWATSON[52]. WordNet: WordNet is a huge database related to English words. Some parts of speech noun, adjective, verb, adverb are gathered in set of cognitive synonyms each set representing separate concepts. Cognitive synonyms also known as Synsets that interlinked with conceptual-semantic and lexical relation. WordNet is openly and freely available for download for the usage of its various natural language processing purposes [53]. WordNet resembles technically with book of synonyms and concepts re lated with it. WordNet defines semantic relations label among words, whereas grouping of words in synonym does not follow any explicit pattern other than meanings resemblance [53]. Hence the WordNet has main relation between w ords is synonymy like open and clear or neat and clean. Synonyms are unordered set (Synsets) they convey the same concepts. Each of Synset are linked with other Synsets by means of small number of “conceptual relations” [53]. Furthermore, Synsets contains concise definition and in most cases one or more than one short sentences elucidate the use of synset members. Words form with several different meanings are represented in various different synsets. Hence each forming pair is unique in WordNet[53]. Most often encoded relation among synsets is super -subsidiary relation also called hyponymy, hyperonymy[53]. It links more universal synset like {furniture, piece_of_furnitur e} to increasingly particular ones like {bed} and {bunkbed}. Hence the WordNet explains that category furniture contains bed, which in turn includes bunkbed so these concepts like bed and bunkbed make up the furniture category. Hierarchies containing noun ultimately go up the root node{entity}. Relation exist in hyponymy is transitive for example if chair is a kind of furniture than armchair that is category of chair also a kind of furniture. Instances in their hierarchies are always on leaf nodes. Sematic relation that hold between objects and its parts are known as Meronymy.  Chair has various parts like legs, back, backrest. Parts are inherited from their parent categories: if a chair has legs then armchair has legs as well. Parts are inherited only on sp ecific kind of objects like chair and its kind has legs but furniture other kinds does not have legs like bed[53][54]. Verb Synset also part of hierarchies that arranged and places at bottom of trees  troponyms expresses specific manner in characterizing an event as in {communicate} -{talk}-{speech}. The particular expressed manner depends on the semantic field as we expressed in our previous example [53]. Verbs are linked w ith each other that describing events unidirectional and necessarily i.e. {buy}-{pay}, {pen}-{write}. Adjectives in this database are organized in term of antonymy. Some pairs of direct antonyms like boy -girl, black-white reflects the strong semantic relation of their members. Each of these opposite adjectives are also linked with their similar meaning semantics like boy is link with young man, guy, youngster and girl is linked with lady, young women, she. We call these semantically similar related words indirect antonyms [53]. Relations in WordNet connect words from the same parts of speech. Hence WordNet consists of four subnets one for each noun, verb, adjective and adverbs with a few Parts of Speech pointers. ConceptNet: ConceptNet is open source semantic network designed to make computer understands semantics (meaning) of words that people use. ConceptNet is a crowdsource based project Open Mind Common Sense launched in 1999 at MIT media Lab. Open Mind Common Sense is a p roject based on Artificial Intelligence whose purpose is to build and utilize a large commonsense based knowledge with thousands of people contribution across the web. OMCS composed of knowledge of various kinds. Some statements in OMCS expressed as simple  phrases of natural language example is “The tea is very hot”,” winters are cold” and few statements convey relationship between objects and events. Database also contains information on emotional content “spending time in class makes sleepy”,” Little Happ iness makes person alive”. Furthermore OMCS also contains information on person goals and desires “People wants more salary”,” Peoples want tasty food” [55]. It has grown by seeking knowledge from crowdsourced resources also inc lude resources of experts created and games with a purpose. To utilize this knowledge, we have to transferred it into some structured representation. ConceptNet is based on information in OMCS database. ConceptNet is expressed as directed graph nodes in co nceptnet are considered as concepts and edges are statement of commonsense about these concepts. Concepts are sets of natural language phrases which contains noun phrases, adjective phrases, verb phrases and clauses [56]. The ne w Architecture of ConceptNet make very much improvements and provide ease to work with and its new Architecture provides searching in complex queries that are necessary to find analogies of common sense and new improvements in architecture provide ConceptNet more accessible to different developers of artificial intelligence applications[56]. ConceptNet is a RestApi from which you get data in form of JSON-LD. Figure 5: ConceptNet Architecture

Chapter 4:Implementation of Perceptual Semantics In the previous chapter, different knowledge representation tools are discussed and the simulation of robot with MORSE simulator. This chapter representing a model, which is working with other models for object detection and recognition to establish perceptual semantic network. Common Objects in Context(COCO): Common Object in context is an open source large image dataset developed by Microsoft. COCO provides object detection, segmentation, captioning dataset and includes some other features like Recognition in context, Object Segmentation. COCO dataset contains photos of 91 objects and label ed of 2.5 million instances in 328k images. While previous dataset focuses on object bounding, image classification, segmentation of semantic pixel level and segmentation of individual object instances. COCO is richly annotated dataset of images describing  everyday complex scenes of common object in their natural context. If an image contains smaller objects or ambiguous appearance, then only way left to recognize object is context. In contextual reasoning scenario image depicts scenes  [60] rather than objects isolation. COCO has lesser categories as compare with previous models PASCAL VOC and ImageNet but have large instance for each category. The main difference in COCO as compared to other dataset is number of labeled instances per image which helps in learning contextual information. Below is the example given of  number of categories of other datasets and instances per image with COCO [61]. Figure 21: COCO model categories and instances MSCOCO provides both trained and untrained model available on website. We can also utilize coco dataset with TensorFlow API for object recognition and various purposes. TensorFlow: TensorFlow is freely available and numerical computation software library developed by Google. TensorFlow follows a model of dataflow programming. Dataflow programming is a way of programming that follows directed graph behavior of data flowing between operations in a sequence[62]. Nodes represent mathematical operati ons and edges represent multidimensional arrays and tensor(data) flow between them. For constructing and evaluating a graph TensorFlow API is available in many languages like python, csharp, c++, Java, Go, swift. But now python api is most appropriate and complete api provide ease to use and its integration with project is easier and it provides some additional advantages over other languages in graph execution [63]. To make its better execution google also design TPU’s tensor pr ocessing unit it is application specific integrated circuit hardware chip specifically created for machine learning and tailored for TensorFlow. TPU is microprocessor used to accelerate hardware components for artificial intelligence applications like neur al networks, computer vision and machine learning because it provides high throughput for low -precision arithmetic (e.g 8 bit). Google also running TPU’s inside their data centers and observed better performance per watt for machine learning [64]. TensorFlow architecture is very flexible provides computation to one or more CPU’s GPU’s in mobile like android and IOS, server, tablets, desktop with same code procedure don’t need code for each device separately. TensorFlow also provi des data visualization toolkit known as TensorBoard. TesnorFlow is machine learning application use for neural networks. TensorFlow is also very helpful for doing different kind of perceptual and semantics like language understanding task. These models con tain much reality that actually helps computers to see and make them able to understand after perceiving object for example what type of image is and what is in an image. The main purpose to make it open source to provide ease for research to easily deploy in any product so that they also participate in its further development and research operation. TensorFlow Programming Model: TensorFlow programming model is described by directed graph a set of nodes and edges. Nodes represent operations and values flo w among these operations using edges and edges are multidimensional arrays. Dataflow computation represented by graph that allow nodes to maintain and alter persistent state and for looping and branching control inside the graph by following structure of N aiad[65]. Nodes contains zero or more outputs and zero or more inputs and represents operation instantiation. Tensors are values that flow in this graph. Model of graph in TensorFlow represents mutable state means source node f or control dependencies must finish execution before destination node starts execution. These control dependencies also enforce ordering otherwise result will unordered independent operations i.e control of peak memory usage. Operations in TensorFlow invol ves abstract computation for example matrix multiplication and matrix addition and have particular name. These operations also contain attributes and these attributes must be inferred at graph -construction time for operation instantiation. The one purpose of attributes to make operation polymorphic over different element types of tensor (two float type tensors addition or two float type tensors addition). A certain implementation of operation known as kernel that can be run on particular device i.e CPU and GPU. TensorFlow binary files represent sets of operations and kernel available through registration mechanism. Program written by clients interacts with TensorFlow through session[66]. Session interface provides extend method to  merge current graph with additional nodes and edges[66].

heading: YOLO:
content: YOLO stands for You Only Look Once. YOLO is real time state of art system for object detection. YOLO provides efficiency and accuracy in real time to a great extent. Prior detection model systems reversion classifiers and localizer to do good detection. YOLO is more efficient and accurate because YOLO does not follow classifier technique. Classifiers, localization technique apply model on different parts of ima ge and detection considered on the basis of high scoring parts[67]. YOLO uses very different and unique approach it applies neural network at whole image and distribute image in regions and predicts bounding boxes and calculate probabilities of each region. Weight on these bounding boxes assigned by these predicted probabilities. Furthermore, YOLO predictions on the basis of single network evaluation which makes it incredibly fast than others. Until now YOLO launches its three v ersions and most updated version is YOLO v3. Purpose of Launching different versions is to ensure higher accuracy and efficiency as compare with previous versions. content: ImageNet: ImageNet is a database composed of images and classified according to WordNet. Every node in hierarchy is represented by a large number of images. ImageNet plans to populate most of the 80,000 synsets of WordNet with a normal 500 -1000 spotless and high res olution images [69]. This result in a huge number of defined images sorted out by semantic order of WordNet. ImageNet expects to give the most extensive and assorted inclusion of the image world. The present 12 subtrees compris e of a sum of 3.2 million illustrated images spread more than 5247 classifications [69]. ImageNet composes the distinctive classes of images in a densely occupied semantic chain. The fundamental resources of WordNet [54] found in its semantic architecture i.e. its cosmology of ideas. Additionally, WordNetsynsets of images in ImageNet are interlinked by a few kinds of relations. One can outline dataset with violent marks into a semantic order by using WordNet, the categorization of ImageNet incomparable to others [70]. ImageNet is built with the objective that objects in image ought to have variable positions, appearances, focuses, acts like well as foundation and barriers. While trying to handle the troublesome issue of evaluating image diversity, the normal picture of every synset and measure JPG record estimate which mirrors the measure of data in image. Synset containing different images does not result in a blurrier pict ure, the outrageous being a dim picture [71]. TinyImage[72] is a dataset of low resolution pictures, established using WordNet by sending all words on internet as questions to image web indexes. Syn set of TinyImage dataset consists of 1000 images. In spite the fact that TinyImage dataset has had accomplishment with specific applications, the low resolution images and the abnormal combustion make it less appropriate for universally useful for training , development and evaluation [69]. Contrasted with TinyImage dataset, ImageNet contains outstanding synsets with high resolution images. ESP dataset procured through a web based game [70]. Two players freely propose names to one image with the objective of coordinating whatever number words as could be allowed in a specific time limit. Many images are named through this amusement, yet its speedy nature additionally represents a noteworthy disadvantage. ImageNet in any case, exhibits a considerably more adjusted dispersion of images over semantic hierarchy. Another basic contrast among ESP and ImageNet is sense of rendering. The precision and convenience of ESP is influenced by ambiguity [73]. However, these issues are resolved by ImageNet and performs efficiently in different scenarios. Pascal VOC: Datasets of Pascal VOC were given as a major aspect of the Pascal Visual Object Classes test from 2005 to 2012. The objective of the datasets is to perceive objects form various visual object classes from real scenes [74]. It is basically a supervised learning issue in that labeled images are provided with training set. Pascal VOC challenge comprises of two segments: (i) an openly accessible dataset of images and comment, together with institutionalized assessment programming; and (ii) a yearly rivalry and workshop [74]. VOC2007 dataset comprises of clarified buyer photos g athered from the flicker2 photograph sharing site. Another dataset with truth explanation has been discharged every year since 2006. There are two challenges in Pascal VOC: classification “does the image incorporate any cases of a specific object class?”, and location “where are the cases of a specific object class in an image?” [74]. Furthermore, there are two backup challenges, on pixel -level division allot every pixel a class label, and person layout restrict hands, head and feet of individuals in an image. The difficulties are issued with due dates every year, and workshop held to think about and examine that year’s outcomes and techniques. The datasets and related illustration and software are consequently discharged and accessible for use whenever needed. A typical analysis of this dataset tended to by the VOC challenge, is that the images are generally without mess, variety in posture is constrained, and the images have been physically adjusted to diminish the fluctuation i n appearance. These components make the dataset less relevant to real world assessment than the images accommodated the VOC challenge [71]. The annotation rules [75] gave directions to annotators on which pictures are used to explain anything which could be annotated with certainty. The utilization of a solitary source images tended to issues experienced in past challenges, e.g. in VOC2006, images from Microsoft Research Cambridge Database [76] were incorporated [74]. The MSR Cambridge pictures were taken with the motivation behind catching specific object classes. The utilization of computerized accumulation strategy additionally kept any dete rmination bias being presented by an analyst physically performing image selection [75]. The segmentation methods are evaluated by a common measure, percentage of correctly labelled pixels. heading: Conclusion:
content: Working with actual robot for perceptual semantics and to establish resemblance between perception and knowledge is very expensive and time consuming. To deal with such kind of problem, a virtual robot is able to understand and identify the objects through  semantic memory. Perceptual semantic ability in robotics is a first step to symbol grounding problem. Perception is an identification of an object. Semantic is a usability of particular object. Mapping of perception and semantics is a cognitive behavior of an agent. For this project, we worked on two operating systems; Ubuntu and Windows. On Ubuntu, we dealt with perceptual memory.  MORSE simulator is used for virtual robot. ROS is acting as a middlew are between MORSE and YOLO  to access the sensors of robo t and to apply detection algorithm.  At the backend of YOLO , COCO model’s dataset is used for object detection which is serving as a perceptual memory. On Windows, a Neo4j database is used as a semantic memory which communicates with thrift server running over localhost. Thrift server receives object detection perceptual string from thrift client runnin g on Ubuntu embedded with YOLO  code. After receiving string, thrift will pass string to neo4j through python code and neo4j query. Query will return list of semantics and send these semantics through thrift server on Ubuntu. Thrift client will receive this string. By integrating the work of Windows and Ubuntu, we built cognitive architecture for virtual robot by using perceptual semantics as a foundation and achieved our project requirements.

heading: Project Abstract
content: A web and Android based application that recognizes an input user image from a celebrity database and finds out the most resembling celebrity. The facial recognition will be carried out depending upon face shape and facial features of the user image. Then by using artificial face modeling through pixel composition of two images, this application (on Android) will map the celebrity face on the user image/camera video stream giving an impression that user is that celebrity. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: The idea is to make an entertainment application that gets a user image and compares the image with hundreds of celebrity pictures and provide the most resembling (celebrity) image on the bases of facial features and resemblance percentage. After matching and comparison, the application would apply a live face -map of celebrity image on the user’s face, giving an impression of celebrity.

heading: 1.2 Problem Statement
content: Face recognition and augmented reality filters are new and interesting applications of modern world, MyCelebMatch is a project that combines the two major interests in a single application. Where the user can upload his/her image on both Android and Web browser to find his closest resembling face match in the celebrities around the world. Along wit h finding a match this application would also be able to augmentedly apply the facial features of the celebrity on user's face.

heading: 1.3 Project Scope Problem Statement
content: To implement total image processing and find out considerably resembling celebrity match, unlike other commonly famous applications, this project will actually compare the user image with a database of celebrity images. • To allow the user to find their matching celebrity, across the world. • Correct face mapping. • Movement of face on another face. The trend of face recognition and face detection in android applications new is its demand is high and Google has already bought some face recognition firms like Viewdle. The final application will be available to all android users across the globe and the main target user group is the youth.

heading: 1.4 Goals and Objectives
content: • Web and image processing learning. • Formation of a complete Android application. • Formation of a web based application. • Actual image processing unlike previous applications that just show a random celebrity image.

• Masking of face on another face. • To collect the data of people’s names and faces in bulk. • To earn from in-App purchases and ads from web on web application. • Google and Microsoft have recently purchased several such projects, in which program demonstrated behavior recognition, Eye movements and optimized image overly. So it would be an aim to get a reputed company buy the product.

heading: 1.5 Assumptions and Constraints
content: • It is to assume that Internet connection is always available to the user. • The user picture is always taken under good illuminance. • The user image acquisition device has reasonably good resolution.

heading: 2.1 Related Work
content: The live face mapping techniques are currently being used by various applications on net but they only use the Vector based (2D animated) images to be mapped on user face, hence it is not much useful but can be made far more interesting, by using real and Raster based celebrity images. Snapchat: It is a 14.3 billion Dollar enterprise [1], that also started with a similar project, based on augmented facial filters. The filters consist of vector graphics that ar e separately designed for specific purposes. The Figure: 1  shows some screenshots of the application that allows live animated face filters. Figure 1: (Augmented face mapping in Snapchat) [2] Masquerade: (MSQRD) is   a   mobile   application   that allows users to change their human appearance during video -chats in real time. The application is based on the 3D face tracking technology, works on both iOS and Android. MSQRD creates animated masks and places them over human faces. Each mask exactl y fits the user’s facial features and repeats his or her movements. The full application name is “Masquerade – animated masks for selfie -videos.”[3] The application uses some specific filters that are vector in nature and can be overlaid on the face of user. The figure 2 shows some screenshots of the Masquerade application that allows live face mapping to users with preinstalled face filters. Figure 2: MSQRD (Masquerade) App - Live Filters for Selfies & Videos [4]

FaceApp: The app uses facial recognition technology to enable users to manipulate photo portraits via present filters, making people appear older, younger, a different gender - or simply adding a smile to their face. This is capable of adding two different kinds o f smiles to your photo, making you look younger, or aging you or swapping your gender. There's also a filter called "Flash," which seems to lighten and smooth skin. The figure 3 shows some screenshots of the FaceApp application that do not apply any filter s on face instead it manipulates the pixel composition of image such that user’s face appears completely different. Hence it is not performed in live video stream, this application processes images only. Figure 3: FaceApp, the app that can age your face or swap your gender [5][6]

heading: Figure 4: Use Case Diagram
content: This use case diagram Figure 4 for the project describes important functionalities that when accomplished in order, provide the required output and fulfill the purpose of this project. The project starts with the working of the web crawler. Web crawler takes a Celebrity name from Website admin in the provided field then it searches for face images of that celebrity. Approximately 7 -10 images of that celebrity are saved into our Server folder for further processing. The web-based server sorts these images in order that not null and fac e containing images are listed up from those image 3-5 images are selected. Then the Server runs the image processing on these images. The image processing code is written in java and deployed at server. The php -based server uses Php-Java bridge to fetch i mages from folder and run the image preprocessing on these image. The Opencv has been configured in java code, at the server. The Opencv functions in the java code help to detect face in image. When face is detected it is cropped out, histogram equalizatio n applied and resized to specific size for recognition. Final image is saved in the Database and given the name of that particular celebrity whose name was entered in crawler. The Trainer gets images from the database and forms datasets (i.e templates, av erage image, matrixes etc.) These datasets are used by the Recognizer to find match of user and provide the

nearest match. The server sends the image replying to Android and Mobile via API. This image is then converted to a Mask. The user’s mobile application detects the face in live video stream and Maps the mask on user’s face.

Image Pre-processing:  The application would first apply Voila-Jones algorithm to detect a face in an image.  The image is saved in internal memory of the smart phone / computer, in a New folder.  Crop-out the face region from image.  Apply histogram equalization.  Resize the image to particular size for recognition.  Save the cropped face in the smart phone memory and in Database. Server End (Php -JAVA Bridge):  The web -server is currently running in Php so, for it to communicate with the android device and perform JAVA based image operations it needs to be provided by a bridge for wrapping of java classes into Php. Device-Server Communication:  When the picture is uploaded to the server from either Web or Android device, the server runs the Recognition code to find out image’s matching photo by fetching through the facial database. Server-Database Communication: Celebrity images will be stored in the facial database to train the algorithm and then it will be able to recognize some faces from user image. Celebrity images will be stored in the facial database to train the algorithm and then it will be able to recognize some faces from user image. The Server-Database communication is done with the help of API.

Image Recognition : The computations include, the accessing of our celebrity database, there after various operations the templates of celebrity images are created then compared in recognition.  Communicating with the database to get celebrity images and datasets.  Dimension reduction and template generation using the Principal Component Analysis.  Template comparison of the uploaded image with all templates stored on server database using different distance metrics.

heading:  Recognition:
content: • Pass the image path as a string. • Read the image file. • Determine Image type. • Convert to vector • Subtract the Average face from image vector • Multiply the image with face space to make template. • Compare the difference between this template and all columns of Celebrity template matrix. If the difference is less than the provided ‘threshold’, find the celebrity with closest match and return the celebrity name and image.

Augmented filter: The feature location pixels from the ‘celebrity image’ will be overlaid on the user image with eye features on eyes and similarly other features, giving an impression that the celebrity itself is in the video. The face shape constraints will be handled by face s crambling techniques on celebrity image to fit the exact user image that looks acceptable on screen. The whole augmented filter process will take place on user end device which is the smart phone. The main functions for live image Augmentation will include:  Live face detection from the image in image view in user device.  Live face tracking by the help of OpenCV or Android’s FaceDetector configured and installed in application package.  Facial features of the celebrity image in form of an image or matrix.  Placement of facial landmark points on user’s face in live video stream.

content:  It is a source of communication of Php with the java virtual machine  It requires less resource on the web-server side  One of the most important component of this project is Php-Java bridge.  Faster and more reliable than direct communication via the Java Native Interface.  It requires no additional components to invoke Java procedures from PHP or PHP procedures from Java.  For the tasks of Face Detections and Determination of facial points in image, “OpenCV” needed to be embedded in java that will be eventually run on the Php. Web Crawler: The crawler is accessed from the website. It automatically fetches celebrity images. Fetch 3-4 images, of particular celebrity from internet.  “Include OpenCV in Java program to be run on Php -Java bridge” (integrating OpenCV with Php)  Import the face detecting cascades of OpenCV in Java program.  Include OpenCV jar file and provide the Opencv.dll file in resources to be run on Server.  OpenCV helps to detect (most prominent) face in image.  Run IsFace module to find any faces in image.    If frontal pose of face is found in image.  CascadeClassifier faceDetector = new CascadeClassifier( "resources\\haarcascade_frontalface_alt.xml");  isFace Module gets an image as argument and returns true or false for face.  When the isFace returns “true” for an image, the image is passed to extractFace module for further image operations. Website: The website in this project will be used to provide additional platform to the users where users can upload their images. As described in th e use case description the crawler is accessed through the website and it will collect the images of a particular celebrity, preprocess them and save then in database. heading: 7.1 Lesson Learned
content: • Making an Android application from scratch. • Understanding different dependencies of Android application in java code and xml files. • Understanding the dependencies of Android’s gradle in imported libraries (Google vision) • Web-Server and Android-Server communication through a web application. • Formation of local host to run and test website and Android services. • The need to form a Php-java bridge for java code to run on Php server. • Writing an image file on two locations (Server and Database) by the image to a single Phpfunction. • Process of formation of Php-java Bridge. • Accessing root files from java code being run on bridge. (OpenCV cascades) • Formation of an API for server to Database communication. • Face detection and retrieving face details from image in OpenCV. • Working with OpenCV in Php based web server. • Sending and receiving textual and pictorial data to mobile from server. • The process of pattern recognition in Principal Component Analysis. • Dimension reduction for images in recognition to avoid data loss. • Making, saving and using the datasets of images in form of matrixes. • Capturing image and saving to internal memory of mobile (Android). • Importing OpenCV SDK in Android. • Loading resources to OpenCV deployed at Php-java Bridge. • Image preprocessing operations like Face detection, cropping out face from a big image, resizing the face image to particular size for recognition and applying Histogram equalization on each image. • Formation of a standalone web based image crawler. • Fetching images of a particular celebrity from the internet. • Fetching images of celebrity making sure that a particular image has face of that celebrity. • Histogram equalization in colored images and adding Alpha channel in RGB images. • Using the Java matrix package for 2D array operations (Recognition). • Forming valuable datasets from images, when images are converted to 1D arrays and interconversion of 2D arrays to matrix. • Integrating two modules of Android application such that each  module has its different layout, different data and different functionality (no help online). • Tracking the face in video on Android’s Screen. • Making mask out of an image in Android. • Changing the bit configuration of image, to match the need, in Android. • Resizing the mask image according to user’s face in continuous input video stream (20Fps). • Draw a new resized, image at a particular position on Android’s screen via onDraw(). • Perform server-based on operations on uploaded images and retrieve from server.

heading: 7.4 Project Summary
content: A web and Android based application that recognizes an input user image from a celebrity database and finds out the most resembling celebrity. The facial recognition will be ca rried out depending upon face shape and facial features of the user image. Then by using artificial face modeling (masking) through pixel composition of two images, we will map the celebrity face on the user image/camera video stream.

heading: Abstract
content: ‘Career Counselling System’ is platform for providing information and knowledge to guide students for choosing a particular field for Studies. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Career Guidance Platform Consists of a Laravel Web Application  and an Android application, where students can see various career opportunities for graduation After having 12 years of Education.Students Can Visit Website Where they  shall Signup and/or login into the System. Initially They Fills an interest form. Next the system allows user to give a t est which is a series of Quizzes of different academic Subjects. After test completion a score is calculated for test. Based on those results the system manipulates and calculates the best career or degree program for that  user/ Student.The system also includes an Ebook Library. Here user may click to read career guidance ebooks in their browser. With Increasing the use of smartphone each a day , user can have Access to the Quizzes Via an Android application. He/ she Shall R egister/Signin to take Quiz.After taking Quiz the Result will be Shown . And Then Student May want to access Ebook Library for gaining more Knowledge about Technical Skills,   System allows robustness and enhances experience by handling a huge number of visitors with efficiency. The admin can login to the Website and Update Quiz  and Ebooks Available.  Changes made in Database will Depict in the the android app too because both the laravel app and the android app share the database . However android app do not  have an admin panel So these changes (Add/Delete Quiz/Ebook) can not be made through Android app.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: The objective of this project is to provide up to date information and knowledge to students who are seeking a specific career path and are interested in seeking new knowledge and information. Our web application shall provide information about Preparing for several universities and colleges Entrance test by preparing Students through Quizzes .Career guidance (counselling) system also pro vides Several Ebooks for Technical Knowledge. System conducts Quiz checking an individual’s Academic Knowledge, and general knowledge.On the basis of it, it shall generate a Result / Report that will guide the students in their related fields.

heading: 1.3 Problem statement
content: The problem lies in that specific phase of student’s life where they are unsure as to what path they must choose to ensure their success in the future. This problem specifically occurs after they have completed their F.SC and/ Equivalent program. Our Caree r Counselling System provides a solution to this specific problem. It creates a wide and open platform for students to check their knowledge and Interest upon Which a Report /Suggestion is Generated. Students gain insight to their capabilities and put on t he right track where they are benefited in the future.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & constraints
content:  This proposed application will be free of cost.  This proposed application will require registration to be used.  This proposed application will allow the user to gain additional knowledge and information.  The developers will deliver the milestones and deliverables as per time mentioned in the plan.  The web application shall be completely based on cloud infrastructure.  The web application shall be designed for both the faculty and the students.

heading: 1.5 Project scope
content: Career Counselling Systems are common now - a-days. As the increasing level of competition in all the fields and less job opportunities people are often worried about their future. Hence they need proper guidance where to go and where to put their skill set to the test. Our scope of project is to provide information and knowledge related to academic level and to ensure proper academic achievements and qualification.  Our web application is a proper platform for con ducting tests and generating r esults that define the Knowledge of students.With the rapid growth of technology people find it more convenient to use an android application other than visiting a website Therefore  One can Also have acce ss Through a simple Android App available to take the Quiz.

heading: 2.1.1 Literature Review
content: There is a lot of work done by foreign colleges and universities for career guidance including some Pakistani univ ersities like GCU and some others by organizing a career guidance program where students can go for a professional career and guidance for higher studies. But there's no such program available online for students having 12 years of education in Pakistan.

heading: 2.1.1.1 Career LiftOff [1]:
content: It is a platform for choosing a Professional Career Of your Interest. It Provides careliftoff interest inventory (CLII) in 20$. CLII is a test which suggests a career in 3 steps ,  Identify your interests , Learn about Different careers and choosing a career by sorting out your priorities.

heading: 2.1.1.2 Big 5 Personality Traits [2]:
content: It's a quiz which calculates extraversion , openness, neuroticism, agreeableness and conscientiousness based upon the answers provided by the user.

heading: 2.1.1.3 Student counselling Services [3]:
content: Provides guidance to students for study in foreign countries, apply for scholarships And apply online to other universities and check the status of your Application.

heading: 2.1.1.4 Life Planning Education Bureau [4]:
content: A Chinese Website which provide guide for the people of china to select a career on basis of their expertise.

heading: 2.1.1.5 Education and Career Guidance (ECG) [5]:
content: (ECG) is a Program launched by Ministry of Singapore which equips students with different sk ills and necessary knowledge to make best decisions for their educational career.Social emotion qualities and competencies are assessed and self-awareness and direction is provided to them via this program.

heading: 2.1.1.6 Career Counselling Portal [6]:
content: An online Website  where experts reply to your queries about career selection. Also you can register for different workshops and interviews with experts which help you find a career.

heading: 2.1.1.7 Eduvision Online Career Planning Test [7]:
content: It's an a pakistani website which conducts aptit ude assessment test.Test depends entirely upon your input. You have three phrases in each step, you can select 1, 2 or all phrases, you have open choice. for ease, statements are given both in English and Urdu so that you can understand it easily.

heading: 2.1.1.8 GCU Career Guidance and Placement center[8]:
content: Program was established in 2002 and focuses on help students identify their talents.The program is led by full time clinical psychologists who provide assistance to students regarding their career and academic p lanning.They conduct different Workshops , presentation and interviews to examine interest , Self -Rate abilities , evaluate experiences and prioritize values in order.

heading: 2.1.2 Goals and Objectives:
content: The goal of this project is to provide guidance to students for s electing a graduation degree best matching their interest and Knowledge while providing following benefits  To Assess skills and interest of students.  To help students avoid conceit.  To Map skills with related degree program.  To provide quality guidance and realistic career approach education.  To save time and effort spent in search for proper guidance.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: Completing this document has not been without its challenges. We had  decided to develop a Web Based System To provide Guidance to Students who are unaware of their skills,. By making this choice we had already prepared ourselves for a challenge. The various modules of this document were not new to us we had worked on them  throughout the course of this degree but applying these to a Complete System were relatively new to us. Working on Both Android And Web Simultaneously Was a Challenging Task for us.learning laravel from scratch was quite time taking and challenging too. The first real issue we faced was when deciding the scope of the System. When you are Developing a Web Based System , You want to Put Many Features in it Due to which you can forget your real purpose , This is Why we have to limit the scope and focus on our Goals and Objectives . Although This would not have been an issue if we were familiar with development at this stage,  we had no idea how much time it would take to finish a certain module so we had to think long and hard before deciding on adding a feature to our System. Gathering requirements was another problem. This was only really a problem because of the extremely short list of stakeholders. Student as being a customer, We had to play the Role of a student, Administrator and Developer As well Which was very challenging for us. The requirements mainly came from the developers, being us, and the potential need of the user. Developing use case models, sequence diagrams and the software architecture to be used was another problem because as mentioned earlier doing these for a System was completely new to us. With the guidance from our supervisor we managed to complete that. These were the major problems that we faced during this phase. We would refer to them as challenges rather than problems and we got to learn from them.

heading: 5.2 Project summary
content: Developing a new system is completely different from what we had learn So far in our  degree , which is where the main focus has been throughout our degree of software engineering. Using the knowledge and skills acquired over the course of seven semesters we have had to relate and find similarities between what we have been taught and what  goes into developing a System. With the insights of our  project supervisor a we have managed to complete this documentation. We have been quite fortunate to have been taught courses like software engineering, requirement engineering, software quality en gineering, software design and architecture and software project management to name a few. These courses have gone a long way in helping us develop the models, gather requirements and construct related diagrams. Through this we have briefed in this documen t all the various techniques we will be using and what structure we would follow and the process by which different activities will be carried out. A clear goal and a clear path have now been set up for us to work on the implementation. We have clearly defined the requirements, so we would have no issues of creeping requirements or missing out on any critical requirement during the development phase. We have come up with the suitable architecture for this project, so we would have a more structured approach  and the work we will produce will not be a haphazard one. The software process model to be used has also been defined. By working on this document we have insured that the development phase passes without any major hurdles. In The development phase learning laravel from scratch was a headache but on the other hand developing android app was Quite familiar. Laravel web application is responsible for Admin rights whereas Android app can not be used to make changes in the Database.Android application has no admin authority.

heading: 5.3 Future work
content: In The Future we plan on adding a new component That Is Experts Portal, That will Allow Students To Ask Questions from Experts directly and they can also have meetings with the experts of Career Guidance Depending on the suc cess of the launch we will then be looking to migrate the System from Web to android and iOS as most people are shifting from computers or consoles their smartphones. Smartphones these days are built with features that are at par with computers so people f ind it more comfortable to perform all their tasks on their smartphones. A big reason behind choosing a web System is that Web is Platform independent and is widely Available.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Today is the Time of Technology. Internet has changed the World into a Global Village and from that point forward a BOOM of technology shifted the World and Humans into a new Path. This Path has many new Scientific Theories, Inventions, Innovations and Gadgets. All these things were made in accordance to Humans requirements to help make their daily life easy. But with many Companies releasing all these new Gadgets every day, there comes a problem in selecting the gadget you require for your needs. Since these multiple gadgets have a single purpose, it is quite difficult and frustrating to select a single gadget for your needs among many and most of the times People ends up selecting either expensive or wrong or not so compatible gadget for their needs. Our Project is an Online Tool/Website that will ease up the selection process of any Gadget for consumer. The consumer or user will simply specify the primary attributes that they require in the gadget and it will automatica lly compare the gadgets and then select the One that suits the consumer’s needs the most. This Online Website will save User from reading and comparing technical specifications or having to search online about the product. Since there are thousands of gadgets now available at this time, we will start with only one gadget. For that, we choose the most widely used gadget called “Smart Phones”. Since we are developing a tool to ease up selection process for consumer, we have to design a very user friendly interface that can provide great user experience so that user don’t have to scratch their way through website. We want to keep it as simple and friendly as possible. User will be presented with primary attributes of the smart phone or user can change selection attribute from listed attributes. They will prioritize the attributes they want or prefer more by modifying the given graph accordingly, it will dynamically compare the smart phones as user prioritize the attributes and in the end it will select a smart p hone that contains the required attributes or functions thus easing up the selection process.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: The outcome of the Project is an online website that will compare and select a gadget on behalf of the user’s preferred attributes or functions. It will ease up the selection process for user and user can decide whether to buy that gadget or not.  User will be able to surf through different cell-phones.  User will not have to read lots of technical specifications.  User can easily find a gadget suited for their requirements.  User will have access to millions of gadgets (cell-phones) at a single place.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: Mostly people buy products by just considering the Brand Name such as Samsung or Sony and there are some who thinks that if it is costly it must be good such as Apple. Just because the gadget is famous doesn’t mean that it is good or is made for you. Sometimes you can get a much better gadget by spending less money on the right thing if you know what are you buying or you are looking for or you do a little research. But all of this stuff requires brainstorming or spending some time online doing research and lot of people don’t want to do that. Problem with current comparison website on internet is that they compare technical specs of gadgets and to fully utilize these websites capability user needs to have a lot of technical information on the product they want to buy and spend a quite amount of time reading them. The motivation for this website are following:  Consumers don’t know what they are buying.  Consumers had to brainstorm what to buy.  Consumers don’t know whether they are buying the right product.  The gadget they bought was worth the prices or not. So this website will do all of that for them save them from this hectic process and help them in finding/selecting the best possible product for them.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: This Project is an Online Gadget Selector that will help consumer select and decide a gadget on consumer’s behalf according to information provided to meet their requirements or needs. System is being design to avoid buying mistakes and make selecting process easier for people who wants to buy a gadget but don’t know what to buy or have technical information regarding their desired smartphone. This Project will be completed and tested before January 2018.

heading: 2.1 Literature review
content: Our Project is an Online Selection Tool so it will be working through searching and sorting of data. The tool will gather data, sort it according to defined criteria and search from it. The working of website is quite simple but is only efficient if done correctly. The data will be gathered using a Web Crawler. Crawler will crawl related webpages on regul ar basis to collect up to date data. The collected data will then be scrapped out and only relevant data will be kept. This new data will be sorted and then stored in database in a way that it is easier and fast to search and retrieve. For the tool to work and perform the described functionality, we need different Web Technologies such as:  Adobe Photoshop & Adobe Illustrator for design Interface.  HTML & CSS for converting design interface to Webpages.  Jquery & Ajax for making webpages Dynamic.  PHP & Java for providing Back-End functionality to webpages.  MySQL for creating and managing Database.  Web Crawler to scrap data and crawl webpages.  Data Structures and Algorithms to Sort and Search data.  Virtual Server to Host Web Application. To use these technologies efficiently, we need to learn about them from books, internet and tutorials so we can use develop a highly accurate application. The most important technologies for this project are Web Crawler and Algorithms. Table 1 Literature review resources

heading: 5.1.1 ASCII ID
content: The first  hurdle we had to face was to find a way to assign a Primary Key for each Cell phone. We were going to scrap thousands of cell phones and store them in database but issue with these cell phones were that they don’t have any unique ID. Without having a Primary Key it would be almost impossible to find cell phones or create relation between different tables in database. To overcome this Problem we Hash It!! While scraping the name of cellphones, we made of copy of every cellphone name and convert them to their ASCII value. But just using their ASCII value would create a very lengthy Primary Key so then we decided to take sum of each names ASCII value thus providing us a Unique ID for every cellphone.

heading: 5.1.2 Dynamic Graph
content: We wanted the design and look to be different and unique than all other conventional websites. So we decided to create a  Graph system that will be used to prioritize attributes.  We Used a Library called “Spider Graph” to create a Graph but the problem with this graph was that it was Static. To generate this graph, we have to pass value to it in the backend code. To overcome this problem, we had to convert this Static Graph to Dynamic so that graph can be generated in Real Time by user itself. For that we used JavaScript to make it a Dynamic Graph.

heading: 5.1.3 Criteria Selection
content: This functionality was difficult to implement and caused quite issues. We are using a Dynamically changing Graph as well as AJAX to run each query without having user to refresh the webpage. So when user adds new attributes of their choice we need to not only to change the look/design of Graph but also the backen d functionality so that Priority Selection should also include the newly added attributes. So to achieve this functionality, we had to create a Procedure that treats this entire functionality dynamically. As soon as user adds new Attributes to Selection Graph, a temporary table is created and all the data of attributes (currently set in graph) are inserted to that table. Now as user prioritize the attributes using the graph, Priority Selection functionality is applied on that temporary table and generated result is shown to the user. This method allow us to include the attributes added by user in the Priority Selection.

heading: 5.1.4 Priority Selection
content: The major issue we had to face was to find a way apply priority to each attribute according to user’s given priority through Graph and then generate a feasible answer from it by combining them or sorting them so we can output result. After brainstorming and testing multiple strategies such as sorting or adding values and many others we decided to perform Equalization. This process works as follows: First of all User has to define a Price Range thus allowing us to slice out a range of cellphones. After setting the price range, a temporary table is created and  filled with mobile attributes having user defined price range. But before anything else can be done, the table data is equalized. All values of all column are divided by the highest/largest value of that column. Then Priority values are multiplied with every value of every column accordingly. This gives us a Prioritized table. Now we add all the values of all the columns in a row generating a sum. This sum is then arranged in order (highest to lowest). This sum is used to find 6 mobiles having highest sum value.

heading: Abstract
content: The aim of this project is to provide a quality rehabilitation and improve the lives of physically disabled people. This project provides the users an application t hrough which they can communicate with their Doctors/ Family and can easily control their surroundings by just blinking and controlling their attention and meditation level s. We use Neuro Sky MindWave EEG (Electroencephalogram) headset to monitor the patien ts’ attention and meditation levels as well as their blink strength. This information allows the user to select between different options, one for Home Automation, second for communication and few more to ease his/her daily life. The patient will be able t o select these options through his/her intentional eye blinks. Communication will allow the user to type in words through an On -Screen Keyboard and then use text -to-speech method to convey their message effectively. Home Automation will allow the user to c ontrol the Lights, Fan and different House appliances of his/her room. Motivating a physically handicapped person back to health can be a very difficult job due to premorbid personality, handicap and the difficulty faced by the patients to communicate with their doctors and family. This Project improves the basic ability  of th e patient  to increase his/her  motivation to have a successful rehabilitation. Successful Rehabilitation must focus on practical ways of coping with daily life. Physical impairment can increase inferiority feelings and the need for dependency which can create a major setback in the patient’s life, taking a major psychology toll on the patient and increases the risk of stress and tension related disease . With the help of this project the patient can feel independent and as he/she can communicate and control the surroundings he will be plenty motivated to get back to his/her life.

heading: 1 Introduction
content: At New York in 1999, the first meeting was held on BCI, which describes Brain computing interface as the system which depends on electrical signals generated due to coupling and decoupling of neurons [1]. An interface which can detect user’s emotions and work according to the user’s inclination. There are many situations in which the nervous  system causes the motor neurons to degenerate. For example paralysis, spinal cord injury, Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS) and brain stroke. Under such circumstances, it is impossible for a disabled person to communicate. A BCI-based application enables the user to communicate and control the appliances. The Brain activity of the individual is detected using EEG sensors, these signals can be used by BCI application as an input to communicate and control the appliances. A simple Brain-Computer Interface, how it works and the main and essential features are elaborated in Figure 1.1. Figure 1.1: BCI components [2]

heading: 1.5 Brain-Computer Interface
content: The BCI creates a communication channel between the human mind and a digital computer [5]. It detects brain signals, and translate them into commands that are sent to an output device that carries out desired function [6]. The main focus of Brain - Computer Interface is on developing on new and better augmentative communication and control of technology for those who suffer from paralyzes, locked in syndrome or ALS disease [7]. There are two kinds of BCI classifications that are currently available; 1-Invasive, 2-Non-Invasive. In invasive B CI the patient undergoes brain surgery and chips or EEG -sensors are directly attached to the brain, this is not the

heading: 14 of 56  16 January 2018
content: recommended procedure as it cost a lot and there is a risk of the patient not recovering from the surgery. We are using Non -Invasive BCI in our project which doesn’t require any additional procedure the patient just need to wear our EEG-sensor on his head and the signals are captured from there. BCI research and development is growing at an extremely fast rate, as the number of papers written,  products introduced to the general public and research done has seen a great growth in this field over the past decade [5].

heading: 1.6 Brain Waves:
content: There are 5 types of brain waves of different frequencies.

heading: 1. Gamma waves
content: Gamma waves are the highest frequency brain w aves ranging from 40 Hz to 100 Hz. Their appearance is widely associated with attention and memory, information processing and cognition.

heading: 2. Beta waves
content: Beta waves produced when the person i s fully conscious and focused on  the external world. Their frequency is ranging from 12 Hz to 40 Hz.  These are the dominant waves and people mostly experienced such waves at daytime, when they are fresh and focussed on what they are doing.

heading: 3. Alpha waves
content: Alpha rays produce when the brain is in relaxing state,  such type of rays emerges when a person is in relaxing mood sleeping or doing meditation . Their frequency is ranging between 8 Hz to 12 Hz. Such type of waves produces frequently when a person is in sleep and during drowsiness. Alpha brain waves regulate the mood, these are the feeling of calmness, positive thinking, and stress relief.

heading: 4. Theta waves
content: The frequency of these waves is between 4 Hz to 8Hz, such waves emerge when a person is relaxing and performing any repetitive activity.

heading: 15 of 56  16 January 2018
content: The frequency range of Delta brain waves is between 1 Hz to 4 Hz. Such type of waves is emitted when a person is in an unconscious state and mostly in deep sleep. [8]. Most of the BCI systems use Electroencephalography (EEG) as it gives pretty accurate readings without causing any harm to the patient.  In Stanford University, clinical res earch paper led by three participants with paralysis controlled an on-screen cursor by simply thinking about the movement of their own hands. This research is focused on the brain area called “motor cortex” . The motor cortex is responsible for generating m ovement on the opposite side of the body. Even in cases where the person has paralysis, those cells, those neurons in that area of the brain are still active, through electrical sensors they pick up the electrical activity inside the brain, they record the  tiny signals from the brain and decode them using a computer. The participants could type at rates anywhere from 12 to up to almost 40 characters per minut e, which translates to in the best cases about 6 to 8 words per minute. heading: 3 System Design
content: Our Project consists of several components. It contains 2 main categories, first is the BCI system, and second is the Home Automation system.

heading: 3.1 BCI Structure
content: The BCI phase of the project can be further divided into following stages.

heading: 3.1.1 Detection of EEG-Signal
content: An EEG-Electrode is placed on the forehead of the patient, with a ground attached to ear lobe. The number of electrodes attached on the scalp varies from device to device, NeuroSky uses a single electrode while Emotive EPOC uses more than 16 electrodes to measure the EEG-Signal.

heading: 3.1.2 Processing of the raw data
content: This process involves of processing the EEG -Signals in addition to amplification, filtering, noise cancellation and digitization of the Brain signal.

heading: 3.1.3 Feature Extraction
content: This process classifies the raw data in a particular range after extraction of certain frequency from the processed raw data. These frequencies are checked against pre-defined algorithms to give the value of blink strength and meditation and attention values.

heading: 3.1.4 Controlling the Application
content: According to these values received from the EEG -Sensor the application control certain things. Type in a word or control house appliances is set according to the user’s measured values.

heading: 3.2 Feedback of the BCI system
content: As our products main users are disabled it is essential for our system to give some sort of feedback to the patient. The type pf feedback used in a BCI system varies from developer to developer [17]. Some application uses an animation to clearly tell the user whether their action was performed successfully or not. This feedback and the data extraction takes a lot of time to compute which makes the system a bit slow and harder to use. To avoid errors and making the system a bit fast eye blink is used.

heading: 3.3 Training for better result
content: BCI systems are new and slow so training the patient to able to use the system effectively is a must. To increase the accuracy of the system the patient needs to be trained so that he can understand how the system works, how his blink is detected, how his attention and meditation level changes and how fast the EEG -sensor is measuring these results.

heading: 3.4 BCI system results
content: There lays a problem evaluating a BCI performance as the results obtained from one BCI system varies to another, hence this makes BCI system difficult to compare with each other. The results obtained from Eye Blink Technique are better and more effective than the ones acquired from Attention and Meditat ion techniques respectively. As the values acquired from later two techniques are not stable and it is quite complicated to control attention and meditation values and  a lot of training is required in this scenario. Hence, the Eye Blink Technique has been designated as the most efficient and effective way to perform actions or control devices, etc. [18].

heading: 3.5 Classification of BCI
content: BCI system are classified into two main categories.

heading: 3.5.1 Non-Invasive and Invasive BCI system
content: Brain Neurons generates Electric impulse as soon as they are active. This ionic current causes a local cellular potential change which is termed local field potential (LFP). This LFP has a vast range of frequency spectrum. Invasive BCI uses tissue- penetrating electrode that is directly attached to the brain, which measures the LFP with more than one electrode or a complete grid of around 100 microelectrodes. These microelectrodes are very small of around 1.5 mm in length. EEG is mostly used as a Non-Invasive method. It measures the Potential field from the scalp or forehead with electrodes of around 1cm long. These scalp potential are a modified version of LFP in the Brain. This modification causes some problems, like electric field decay which causes the LFP to substantial attenuation as it reaches the electrode on the scalp [19]. Figure 3.1: Invasive and Non-Invasive BCI [19]

heading: 3.5.2 Synchronous and Asynchronous system
content: BCI systems can further be classified into two more categories, in Synchronous BCI a cue system is used which is restricted to a predefined time frame, for

content: example, the user has to perf orm a certain task with in a given time. In asynchronous, the system keeps on monitoring the patient’s brain wave. No matter what the patient is doing whethe r he is in resting stage or trying to perform a task his brain waves are being measured [20].

heading: 4.5 Testing
content: As BCI is a pretty new technique, it isn’t quite accurate so we went through a thorough testing through -out our project from developing the first prototype to successfully completing the project. Most of our time was consumed due to heavy testing every single module in our project. We didn’t have any test data on which we could base our assumption so we had to modify every single aspect from the speed of the selector to the strength of an intentional blink. As research on BCI has proved the accuracy and pre cision of non -invasive method being a bit low than any other method we had to consider that as a physically disabled this might be even a bigger challenge. Basing our control on intentional blinks of the user made our system quiet accurate, precise and easy to use.

heading: 4.5.1 Testing the EEG-Sensor
content: As MindWave is a pretty cheap EEG-Sensor consisting of only one EEG-electrode and a ground to detect the brainwave, its a ccuracy is precise up to a certain level. By increasing the number of electrodes attached to the user’s head we can increase the accuracy of the data but it also increases the cost of the whole system. So in order to utilize the most from the resources we had, we thought to use something easy to control and which showed the least inaccuracy.

heading: 4.5.2 Functional Testing
content: After developing the complete application we carried out certain experiments on multiple users to test the reliability, accuracy , and usability of ou r proposed technique in this system. Our main focus of the testing was on Eye blinking technique to determine a base value for our application’s control. The second feature of the tests was to determine the ability of a layman user to control their attention and meditation value based on simple psychological tests.

heading: 4.6 Test Design
content: The questions for these tests revolved around appropriate outcome measures for efficient design and included concepts such as:  How outcome measures might vary depending on the level and type of impairment.  User satisfaction.  Minimum time required to input a word.  Accuracy.  Usability. These tests and their results revealed the answers which became the foundation of our application. We had a set of 1 0 people willing to test our application. These test subjects were given a relaxed environment, they all were seated in a comfortable chair with the Tablet running the application approximately 0.5m away from the subject. The set of subjects involved in th e test sessions included 6  healthy people and 4 disabled people with different kind of disability satisfying our applications demand.  Figure 4.10 shows one of the subject testing the application. Figure 4.10: Test being conducted

heading: 46 of 56  16 January 2018
content: The test involved three main features:  The speed of the Selector.  Length of the Word to type-in.  Switching On/Off different house appliances. While the subjects performed these tests, their accuracy and time taken to complete the desired task were recorded.

heading: 4.6.1 Testing Variables and Results
content: The speed of the Selector, the test carried -out on all the subjects were repeated 3 times with 3 different speed of the selector ranging from 0.75 second, 1 Second and 1.5 Second. The Subjects were given the constant length words to keep the test as accurate as possible. The results for this set of tests are given below in Table 4.1.

heading: Table 4.1: Selector Speed
content: These results made us conclude that even though increasing the speed of the selector makes us assume will increase up to the speed of typing but as its accuracy decreased it made the test subject to wait longer to correct their mistakes in the long run. Decreasing the speed to 1.5 seconds made the user uncomfortable and wait too long to type in the word which caused frustra tion and made the ap plication less user - friendly. 1-second speed of the selector was the most suitable as its accuracy was acceptable and the subject didn’t have to wait too long.

heading: 5.1 Experiences
content: We got to learn a lot while working on this project, it taught us time management, team work and most importantly it thought us how blessed we are and how difficult it is for the physically impaired people to have a safe transition back to health. This motivated us to achieve so much in this project. We were able to successfully participate in DICE 2017 held in COMSATS  Institute of Information and Technology Lahore and in Frontiers of Information Technology 2017 (FIT). We successfully presented our project to different panel of judges and received many positive comments on what we were trying to achieve and how our project will help our user in so many different ways. We also has a great experience while testing the project on patients from Life Hospital, their staff was very helpful and guided us on what can be done in order to help the disabled and how our system would be helpful to those in need.

heading: 5.2 Future Work
content: BCI can be great in Virtual Reality (VR), as there is some development going on, that will show the user a 3D scene and by measuring the Brain activity they will be able to control an aspect in the environment [ 23]. Imagine controlling your virtual character by not moving or pressing buttons but controlling it through your mind as you think you want to move forward the character moves forward. As the technology grows, you will not only control your virtual characte r but can control robots. Imagine moving a robotic arm, controlling what the robot does by just your thoughts. Paralyse want be a disability anymore as the mind -controlled robot will do whatever its controller wants it to do [24].

heading: 5.3 Conclusion
content: BCI technology  is a very recent development in the field of health and medical sciences. It is completely open -source and engineers are developing more and more applications and tools to accommodate this fast growing industry [ 21]. Our Project is user-friendly as it doesn’t require any physical input from the user. The interface is as simple as it can be, as the application was developed keeping disabled people in mind. We wanted to create an environment that not only helped the patients to get motivated but also provide  them with the opportunity to overcome their disability. This goal might not be easy, but things that are worth doing are often not easy. There could be several improvements possible as BCI is at its beginning, in fact the first mind wave detector was buil t just 8 years ago.  This project can help in both education purposes and can solve many health -related issues, as it provides a way to help the patients overcome their disability and make them stay positive and have a healthy transition back into their life.
