heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lesson learned
content: While documenting this project, we have faced many problems as we were working on a web-based project. In a web -based project, one must have perfect command over several languages and the concept of the project should be original. We faced many problems in the design phase as we wanted to better the design so that all type of audience could benefi t from “Stitched Out”. Requirement elicitation and use case description took a little more time than expected as these are the initial step towards documentation of a project, so we gathered all the requirements very carefully. In chapter 3: System Designs , some designs were easily made but some took a lot of time as we didn’t want to miss any functionality of our system. We wanted to show all the functionalities “Stitched Out” has to offer. We have spent about 40% of our time on this phase. Another issue was building the “Vendor” module as it wasn’t part of the initial project but we had to add this module as to make our project more unique. While documenting this project, we have learned many things. Since it’s a web -based project, we worked on our web development skills and mastered PHP, JavaScript, Laravel etc. We divided many phases of the project but also learned each phase from each other so we could grasp each and everything about our project.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: “Stitched Out” is a tailoring managem ent system as well as an online store for customer where they can buy clothes and hire tailors for their services. “Stitched Out” will be a platform for all (Customers, Tailors, and vendor). A customer can make their account, give measurements, purchase cloth and hire desired tailor to stitch their cloth. A tailor can also make their account here, accept/reject customer’s request (as they see fit), update their pricing and advertise their work and skills through “Stitched Out”. The vendor (brand) can promote their specific brand’s products and add new products for the customers to purchase from.

heading: 5.3 Future Work
content: We have planned many things for “Stitched Out” as it will be enhanced by adding:  A chat bot that will guide its users through any problem that they are facing while using “Stitched Out”.  Multiple payment options will be provided to the customers such as PayPal, Credit card, Easy Paisa etc.  Better security will also be provided so that the credentials of the users could be protected more effectively.  “Stitched Out” will be functional for the foreign countries. It will provide its service outside of Pakistan as well and in all of Pakistan.  An online chat system will also be provided for the communication between the customer and their specific tailor.  A new category will be introduced where tailors can offer their own cloth to sell to customers. This will help them in expanding their business through our website.  Vendors will be able to promote special discounts and sales being offered in their stores on “Stitched Out”.  A complaint box will be created for the complaints.  Tailors will have the power to “block” a customer if they disrespect the tailor. The customer will be reviewed and if the allegations are true then the tailor can go through with the process.

content: While studying about CPEC (China Pakistan Economic Corridor) the idea strikes in my mind to do something in this special mega project to keep in mind my team capabilities. When I was further researching on CPEC, I came to reach on certain issues. The coordination between administration, surveyor and clients is a flaw for both countries. The purpose of this project is to build an automated application which will address such issues; this will reduce the paper work and helps to maintain the construction process securely and efficiently. We also proposed construction management module in Pakistan which is EPC (Energy Performance Certificate).  We mainly focus on three modules which are further divided in sub modules, first we deal with the construction control management then coordination management and we also deal with the property services management.

heading: 1.1 Introduction:
content: The project aimed to build a web application which covers many aspects related coordination and construction management the main tasks we are planning to cover is to address these issues. The main task related construction issues are named as construction control which is further modelled in sub tasks that includes administration control, surveyor management, client management, project execution control, and payroll. The second main task related coordination issues named construction tracking system. In property services we proposed the concept of EPC (Energy Performance Certificate) in Pakistan. We worked on the property services management in our project, in which we deal with the client management in which client reports, invoices and order keeping of records will be maintained. We also deal with surveyor management in which surveyor reports and invoices will be maintained. In product management we deals with two types of products one will domestic products and other will commercial products. Clients and surveyor reports are also managed. In file upload section a file will be uploaded by surveyor when the order will complete. An SMS service will also add in this section, in this when the order will register the notification will be sent to the surveyors who deals the order, the same notification process will be recalled when the project will be finished, order keeping of records will also be maintained. In construction control we deals with administration panel in which we assign the roles and share the limited access as sub admin, in this administration can add or delete sub admin. After this order management is also maintained, in this admin can change order status and assign order to relevant surveyor. Admin can also maintain client and surveyor invoice. In inventory control, we manage the supply of construction items including domestic and commercial products. In payroll section we manage the invoices of clients and surveyors. In client control section we receive orders from clients and start working on client’s requirement. We also add an SMS service in our project, in this when the order will register the notification will be sent to the employees who deals the order, the same notification process will be recalled when the project will be finished. In construction tracking control we deal with the issues regarding coordination between stakeholders. In this panel when an order is assigned to surveyor, surveyor requests the company for construction items according to the order requirements. Company accepts or reject the order according to company resources. If the order is accepted by company a worker is assigned against that order, surveyor confirms order proceeding and close order.

heading: 1.2 Project purpose:
content: The purpose of this project is to fulfil the needs of construction management process, it is mostly managed manually and is much time consuming and costly, the manually stored data

can also be lost or dispersed sometimes, the need of automated construction management system in market is increasing day by day. There is not satisfactory work done in this domain, the limited work done in this domain is too costly which is hard to bear for the companies which are doing small projects. While keeping in mind the all discussed issues we are going to introduce an automated construction management system which will address all above mentioned issues efficiently in a tolerable cost.

heading: 1.3 Objectives:
content: The project objectives are as follow:  Want to build an automated construction management system that fulfil the business needs of construction management process, it is mostly managed manually and is much time consuming and costly, the manually stored data can also be lost or dispersed sometimes, the need of automated construction management system in market is increasing so we introduced a system which will done construction activities manually.  To test the infrastructure of construction management system within 30 days and the deployment of complete implementation of system within 75 days.  Reduces the amount of bugs and errors in construction management system by 70% within 4 months and the system is open for intended operations at the starting of year 2018.  To provide a customer complaint service, which allow customers to register complaints online and receive response within 24 hours.

heading: 1.4-Problem Statement:
content: There are few systems which are entertaining the construction tasks  with limited access  but we are going to introduce a system which have some updated functionality which the other construction systems lack like EPC (Energy Performance Certificate)  concept in Pakistan, construction management in which we ensure the availability of application  as well as surveyor and client management.

2.6-Software Development life cycle model The software development life cycle model, also known as development cycle for an application used in information and engineering systems, to describe the planning, analysis, design, implementation, testing and maintenance of processes. These concepts are also applying in software as well as hardware applications as we know that the system is the combination of software, hardware or both. Figure2.8- SDLC model
Our project best suits the Incremental model.

heading: 2.6.1 Incremental Model
content: In this whole project is divided into multiple builds, this also called multiple waterfall cycles. Cycles are divided into manageable modules. Each module is classified into design, development, implementation and testing phases. Figure2.9- Incremental model

2.6.2 Why use Incremental model? We use incremental model because:  Requirements are well known.  Product or project definition is stable.  Technology to be implemented is understood.  A lot of resources are not available.  We also implemented our project on new platform, initially it is implemented on web but in future we further proceed it on IOS and android.

heading: 2.6.3 Advantages
content:  Early and quickly generates the working software.  Small modules will be tested easily.  Much flexible if scope creeps.  Risk management is easy.  Feedback will be given after completion of every module.

heading: 2.6.4 Disadvantages
content:  Needs well planning and thorough design.  Before system break down into modules there must be clear and complete definition of system.

WBS Description: The construction management system is passing through different stages like project definition, detail design, project construction, project verification and validation and then project closure. In project definition project initiation takes place in which project management deliverables will be completed in the form of report. Then the project management deliverable is mapped in detail project design document in which different diagrams are included which give a map to implement the project requirements. After this project construction phase will be implemented in which all modules of the project including the main systems like construction control, property services and transport tracking will be implemented. After this project verification and validation phase will be taken and make test cases against the project requirements and then apply unit testing, integration testing and complete system testing. At the end close the project by appropriate project closure mechanism by submitting final report.

heading: Abstract
content: Natural  Language  processing  and  artificial  intelligence  has  made  immense  progress over the years. People have been provided the facility to communicate with each other through communication channel that translates one language to another. Roman Urdu is less recognized in the world therefore there is no messenger application that translates Roman Urdu to other languages. In this project we want to eradicat e the language barriers among people living across the border and provide the ease of communication in texting. Urdu is our national language as well. So this is our little effort to bring our national language back into business.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Trans Messenger Project is a messenger application which provides the facility of translation from Roman Urdu to different languages such as Urdu, English, French and etc. But our main focus is to translate Roman Urdu to Urdu from there we can further translate the message to any other language. Trans Messenger is a mobile based application which enable user to transliterate text written in roman Urdu script to the Urdu language and vice versa. Our main focus is to translate Roman Urdu text to Urdu and once we achieve that we can translate it to different languages around the globe.  User will type in hi s preferred script and t hen the algorithm will take that text as input and will translate it to the other script as required by the receiver. English is the language of modern age. It is spoken, understood and written worldwide. So there is no doubt in its importance. But there a re 1 billion people in world that speak or understand Urdu. So this application is tend to promote Urdu language as these people are way more comfortable with Urdu than any other language. As it will be providing a SMS system to communicate, so the people who cannot read roman Urdu will not face any difficult y. Over 5cr people in Pakistan have access to mobile technology but are unable to make full use of the facilitates  it  has to offer because of the lack of understa nd ing of the language English. Additionally, for people who cannot write in Urduthey can also communicate with the ones who just know Urdu  via this service. This  is also helpful for the younger generation of today getting connected to the older generations. There is a lot of work that needs to be done to promote our natioanl langauge, this is an little effort  to promote our language urdu in the global spectrum . This could also be a stepping stone to furutre develpoments in the field of urdu language and its  applciations. As it’s a messaging application so user will find an additional button to translitrate and on one click this job will be done.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content:  This project main objective is to translate Roman Urdu to Urdu then further translate it to different languages.  Our goal behind creating this application is to eradicate the language barriers among people living across the border  Provide the ease of communication in texting.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: By developing this project we can overcome the flaws in the existing transliteration messenger applications that are transliterating other languages and not Roman Urdu.  Writing text in Urdu can be a hectic task because people are not use d to writing in Urd u especially when it comes to mobile. That is where our system will let the user to easily convert the roman Urdu text to Urdu and eliminate the need of writing in Urdu.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & Constraints
content: While we are doing transliteration of Roman Urdu text  we will first have to convert that text into Urdu by doing so it will be easier for us to further translate it into any other language using Google API’S. We are only translating text so there will be no option for sending voice speech as it is not in our  scope .

content: We are looking forward to remove the language barrier and our main focus is to provide facility to translate Roman Urdu Text which is very common in Pakistan into any other language such as Urdu or English. Scope of our project  is only text we are translating text into required language by the receiver, our messenger application would focus on text communication only. By developing this project we can overcome the flaws in previously existing system which could not translate the exact wording. Also it’s quite a new field for us to work with a huge scope.  There is a big gap between non english speaking users and the technology. Paksitan over 5 crore have access to mobile technology but are unable to fully make use of the facilitit ies. It has to offer because of the lack of understaing of the language english. Additionally, for people who cannot write in urdu, they can also communicate with the ones who just know urdu via this service, this is also helpful for the younger generation  of today that know how to text in Roman Urdu but don’t know english. This will help them to communicate with friends,relatives or even buisness patners around the globe by using Trans messenger.

heading: Instant Translator

heading: Features :
content:         Instantly Speak another Language Speak to the app to get your words instantly translated to another language.         User-friendly Text Mode Type or copy text from emails, messages etc . To get them instantly translated to more than 100 languages.

heading:         Speaks Out Translations
content: With the auto speak option the app will instantly speak out translations. You can als o listen to translations by shaking the device or tapping the play button.

heading:         Supports Over 90 Languages
content: Supports 99 languages for text -to -text translation,  37 languages for speech - to -speech translation and 41 languages for text -to -speech translation

heading:         Sharing Options
content: Share translations via email, messages and social media Roman to Urdu Transliteration using word list This paper discusses transliteration of Urdu words from roman script to Urdu script. We propose a word list based approach that gives a better transliteration to the Persio -Arabic letters that have same or similar sound but are written as different letter in Urdu script. We give a rule based system for roman to Urdu transliteration. As the roman script for Urdu does not follow any standard and a single word can be written in multiple ways, the proposed rule based system covers the different ways of writing and give the best possible Urdu transliteration based on word list and roman to Urdu script mapping rules.

heading: Algorithm Steps
content: Step 1:  Except ‘a’, ‘e’, ‘i’, ‘o’, ‘u’ , ‘y’ and ‘h’, change the case of all the characters of roman word into capital. Explanation: As vowel mapping need more complex processing than one to one replacement, the encoding is applied on consonants only. A character in capital case means a rule is already applied on it and the following low priority  rule will not be accidently applied on it.

heading: Page | 13
content: Example:  We start with the word pakistan  so it in step 1 it will be converted to PaKiSTaN Step  2:  If the two consequent capital letters ar e the same, delete one of those double letters. Explanation: This steps deal with words tashdeed which means to put pressure on word such as ullo or buddhu double letters are used to put pressure on word. It deletes  one of the double consonants because the germinated consonant is written only once in Urdu script. Example:  The word PaKiSTaN does not have double letters so this rule doesn’t apply on this word. Step  3: If the word begins with a vowel append ‘A’ at the beginning of the word. Explanation: We need an extra ‘a’ sound character before a vowel at the start of the word in Urdu script. content: Forward-backward Machine Transliteration between English and Chinese Based on Combined CRFs [ 2]This paper proposes a forward -backward transliteration system between English and Chinese for the shared task of NEWS2011. Combined recognizers based on Conditional Random Fields (CRF) are applied to transliterating between source and target languages. Huge amounts of features and long training time are the motivations for decomposi ng the task into several recognizers. To prepare the training data, segmentation and alignment are carried out in terms of not only syllables and single Chinese characters, as was the case previously, but also phoneme strings and corresponding character st rings. For transliterating from English to Chinese, our combined system achieved Accuracy in Top -1 0.312, compared with the best performance in NEWS2011, which was 0.348. For backward transliteration, our system achieved top -1 accuracy 0.167, which is bett er than others in NEWS2011. Rule Based Transliteration Scheme for English to Punjabi [3] Machine Transliteration has come out to be an emerging and a very important research area in the field of machine translation. Transliteration basically aims to preserve the phonological structure of words. Proper transliteration of name entities plays a very significant role in improving the quality of machine translation. In this paper they are doing machine transliteration for English - Punjabi language pair usin g rule based approach. They have constructed some rules for syllabification. Syllabification is the process to extract or separate the syllable from the words. In this they are calculating the probabilities for name entities (Proper names and location). Fo r those words which do not come under the category of name entities, separate probabilities are being calculated by using relative frequency through a statistical machine translation toolkit known as MOSES. Using these probabilities they are transliteratin g our input text form.

heading: 2.6 Software Development Life Cycle
content: We  have  followed  the  Exploratory  Development  Life  Cycle  (EDLC)  in  which empirical  research  methodology  is  used.  Figure  2 represents  the  working  flow  of EDLC. In  the  EDLC  first  phase  includes  the  process  of  research  in  which  all  the previous  knowledge  and  work  related  to  the  field  and  domain  of  project  is critic ally  analysed  and  explored.  In  the  second  phase  concepts  are  developed from  the  knowledge  that  was  learned  from  the  first  phase.

heading: Figure 7: Exploratory Development Life Cycle
content: Once the knowledge is extracted and the concepts are built, comes the time to assess the problem statement on the basis of those concepts and uncover different aspects of the problem and its proposed solution. In the next phase (Knowledge Acquisition and Analysis), basic model of the implementation is developed and requirement analy sis is carried out in which functional requirements and non -functional requirements are specified. Possible solutions and ways of implementing the concepts are tested to uncover possible risks and limitations that may occur during the implementation phase. After this, Design and Implementation phase comes. We design and implement the model according to the functional and non -functional requirements that were finalised in the previous phase. Next we test our system against each functional and non -functional requirement. If some test case result is not according to our requirements, we adjust and modify the design. Testing is performed again and until the test case result is positive. Testing may reveal mistakes related to knowledge acquisition. When this happ ens the control  move s back  to  Knowledge Acquisition and Analysis phase where knowledge is refined along the adjustment in requirements.

heading: Abstract
content: In the world today, with billions of users online on websites and mobile applications, evolves a technique from using ‘cookies’ to something much more efficient, robust and intrusive: ‘device fingerprinting’ or ‘device profiling’:  uniquely identifying users over the digital mass. The project is related to studying and deploying various device fingerp rinting techniques used by third parties, including but not limited to: banks, advertising agencies, online stores, social networks, data providers and online publishers. We would be developing a web and an android application to identify unique users and forming their digital fingerprint in a database regardless of the traditional ‘cookies’ method. The day of using cookies as a means of tracking users or identifying them are long gone now, it was a starting era for tracking users. Cookies can be easily man ipulated and circumvented, we are headed to complex, more detailed and efficient techniques in means of tracking. As we are aware, deleting cookies can be done in mere clicks and that destroys all of its purpose, leaving no choice for the concerned parties, but to step up their game and head to device profiling techniques. [1] Our project will incorporate the techniques used by third parties to track users on the web and mobile applications by forming their digital fingerprints and preventing them for abusi ng the system as required: blocking multiple registrations, tracking and preventing fraud etc.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Online tracking is an essential aspect, as more and more companies emerge, so do the consumers and there arises the need of tracking the individual users and to collect their data, in order  to make leads, mine the data and predict their movement. After all, data is everything that manoeuvre the businesses. Our project has 2 aspects of development; a web and an android application based on the proof of concepts of profiling techniques. Our we b project will collect relevant information from client -side using: JavaScript, Flash, Canvas and HTTP Headers. Using these components over the web interface, once a user visits our website we will fetch the relevant attributes including but not limited to : browser -version, OS version, client time -zone, client location, device resolution, fonts installed, plugins installed, navigator object. We will combine these attributes to an extent to which they are calculated to be unique. The fingerprints on web are  measured according their entropy bits. A fingerprint consisting of 3 -bits of entropy would uniquely identify us among 2^3 =8 people. A 12 -bits entropy would identify uniqueness from 4,096 people and so on, the more the attributes used as identifiers, the more entropy we get, hence improving the fingerprint [2]. This technique of web fingerprinting will help us identifying unique users where cookies are turned off or users browsing in incognito mode. By storing the fingerprints, we can identify a user’s dev ice and mark them as ‘good’ or ‘bad’ and identify any future activity that emerges from the same device. On mobile devices, web fingerprinting can be used, but there are certain limitations. Like a few fonts installed, not support for: html 5, flash and pl ugins in the browser and so on. These issues decrease the entropy bits which are collected and hence reduce the effectiveness of the fingerprinting technique. But, one rarely uses browser on mobile and the purpose of mobile devices is to have mobile applic ations installed. That’s where the power of Android API calls come in, the complex operations they perform by yet simple API calls will enable us to harvest the data required from the device. We will collect the attributes of the user’s device using android application which will include but not limited to: Unique Device Identifier (IMEI, MEID, ESN), Android ID, MAC ID, WLAN ID, Serial Number, GSF ID, Advertising ID and SIM Subscriber ID [3]. Together, they form very efficient entropy bits and a robust iden tifier (hashed). As these values are mostly hardware embedded and improbable to change by the user, we can generate a unique fingerprint and tie it to user’s device for future analytics or tracking device behaviour. In android project we will be deploying this technique to retrieve user’s device fingerprint and storing it on back-end storage (it can be a web based server or a local storage). Our project will be incorporating the techniques discussed above for web and android applications, to a level generating unique fingerprints.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: • Develop a website that can uniquely identify users and generate their fingerprints • Develop an android application having the functionality to detect known devices based on fingerprinting techniques • Educate the people about new technologies being used in the field of tracking and tagging users • Understanding the limitations and evasiveness of using ‘cookies’ as a form of identification • To help users detect and block fraud by using this technique in their applications • Improve fingerprinting techniques as technology advances • Offer an open source project • Help businesses prevent fraud and maximize profits

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: There are a lot of techniques being used today to circumvent fraud. A lot of them are based on data collection like: Proxy identification, Data Analytics, Rule Based Engines, KYC Verification etc. But a clever fraudster can easily  work around these techniq ues, like using identity theft to appear legit and whitelisted IP Address and location. Fraudster can spoof these details with trial and error and can get a lot of information about how the fraud prevention method works. There needs to exit a black -box fraud prevention measure that works in invisible layer, without letting user know anything about it. This way a user or a fraudster will never even know if there exists any fraud prevention mechanism and won’t interfere with it. The fraud detection will work in background silently and do its job in the backend. This type of fraud detection can be achieved by device fingerprinting technique. By using digital fingerprinting method, we can tag users by calculating their digital hashed fingerprint and storing it i n a database. This way we can know about all our users, new or returning, and identify them whenever they visit.  A fraudster commits fraud by creating multiple accounts using the same device with stolen information obtained from black-market or deep web. We can use fingerprinting method to tag individual machines and flag them if we detect fraud, making that device unusable on our site by displaying generic error message.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions and Constraints
content: As technology is ever changing  and develops rapidly , we may face difficulties in maintaining and developing the device fingerprinting technique. The web languages being used and the way browser(s) work and supports them may vary and change anytime . Depending on the developer of browser(s) and the concerned programming language(s), there may arise issues which we may or may not be able to overcome. Fraudsters are aware of this technique  but face difficulty in evading it,  as it’s not open sourced and black-boxed. Eventually, clever fraudsters with enough knowledg e and development details may be able to overcome the fingerprinting method and modify their fingerprints. On the other hand, continued development and support of this project will help developers to counter fraudsters’ strategies to overcome this mechanism. This is a  cat-and-mouse game which will be played for the long run.  This method is not 100% fool -proof, but works effectively and efficiently with 90-95% success rate.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: Our main motivation is to spread the knowledge and educate pe ople about the much needed, yet intrusive techniques of fingerprinting, used by tech -giants all over the world including: Facebook, Google, Microsoft, Yahoo etc. Our generation is still living in the dark ages and have no idea of how much development has been made in the web and mobile applications to track the user’s movement without their consent, after all the companies thrive on user’s data. Most users still think that we are still under the reign of cookie tracking and they can hide by simply deleting it, which is not true at all! We need to educate people about what’s going on behind the scenes and how their data is being collected, tagged and tracked over the internet. Using Tor browser or incognito is not enough. It’s just a safety illusion that the users fall prey to. By doing this project we would be able to successfully show how the modern device profiling techniques are being used and developed. We have to spread the concern that these techniques are very useful in identifying fraudsters, spammers , hackers, bots all over the world, but if abused by the wrong parties like black hat advertising agencies and networks whose sole purpose is to sell user information illegally, it can be very lethal! Just like your biometric fingerprint is unique, so is y our digital fingerprint. What if it’s sold over the internet and the third parties can track you without you even knowing? We are developing this project so that the web and mobile application developers can use and embed the aforementioned device fingerprinting techniques in their applications and websites to carry out their tasks with ease.

heading: 2.1 Literature Review
content: There are plethora of companies offering fraud prevention systems for e -commerce and banking sectors. All of the them use different techniques and tools in order to identify the fraud and duplicate users. They use different mechanisms including: Data Leads , Proxy Detection, KYC Verification, Machine learning, Blacklist Database, Geolocation IP, Automated Workflow etc. Our focus is on ‘device fingerprinting’ technique to identify the fraud. Many companies are actively working in this domain and it’s been evolving very actively, improving with time. Some popular companies offering fraud prevention solutions based on device fingerprinting technique are showcased below.

heading: 2.1.1 Maxmind
content: Maxmind offers ‘minFraud’ service to combat fraud. It is a device tracking technolog y which is based on information collected from visitor’s device and assigning it Unique ID. They collect device information along with IP address to refine and maintain their database. Figure 1: Homepage Preview of Maxmind Maxmind uses Javascript and provides customers with Javascript API in order to integrate their services on customer’s end.

heading: 2.1.2  Iovation
content: Iovation was among the pioneers of device detection and fraud prevention. It has gained much reputation in recent years. They offer ‘FraudForce’ service which boasts about knowing behavior of about 3 billion devices and claim to detect device anomalies and suspicious behavior to detect fraud. They use device intelligence (device fingerprinting) with various other methods to fight fraud. Their customers include: AT&T, US Credit Union Bank, Western Union. Figure 2: Homepage Preview of Iovation Iovation is involved in the device intelligence business since 2009 and steadily competing against other companies offering similar solutions.

heading: 2.1.3 Threatmetrix
content: Threatmetrix is a renowned company in today’s corporate e -commerce world. They offer top notch cyber security solutions including fraud detection and state that the main components in detecting fraud are: Unique Identifier, Graph Visualization, Confidence Score, Trust Score. ‘SmartID’ and ‘ExactID’ are their two main techniques to identify the users using device fingerprinting technology. Figure 3: Homepage Preview of ThreatMetrix ThreatMatrix has secured very high -profile customers includ ing: VISA, Netflix, Lyft, Airbnb and Alipay.

heading: 2.1.4 Critical Analysis
content: All of the aforementioned companies offer paid solutions and they can be very expensive for a start-up business to combat fraud online. Moreover, they are quite discreet and maintain secrecy in the methods involved in device fingerprinting. They are not open - sourced or free, so there needs a solution to exist to offer all small and medium sized businesses an efficient way to prevent fraud using the very state of the art device fingerprinting techniques.

heading: 2.2.1 User
content: Users can login and register to any website which has implemented our digital fingerprinting mechanism. Device attributes of the user will be collected and digital fingerprint will be computed upon registration. A user can at most register only 1 legit account and multiple registrations will be prevented. After a user has successful ly registered an account, he may login to the website and continue shopping or browse as usual. If the user’s fingerprint is flagged as ‘fraud’ by an admin, the user will be unable to register or login from the same device.

heading: 2.2.2  Admin
content: The admin account is for managing and viewing the collected database of hashed fingerprints. Admin can view/edit/remove fingerprints from the database as required. If there is any false -positive related to any user or device, the admin can remove the fingerprint from database so that the user may be able to login/register again and continue with the services.

heading: 5.1 Problems Faced and Lessons Learned
content: We faced several problems during the development of our Website. First of all, we had to research device attributes to be collected, which took quite some time and then had to code JavaScript for it. Later, it was realised that some of the attributes were not compatible and supported by all browsers. We had to redefine our strategy and rethink the device attributes which could be utilized. Moreover, we faced issues of ‘collision’ and inefficiency in Hashing algorithm(s). The hashing algorithm we used earlier was not so effective and sometimes produced different hashes on page refresh for same device(s). There were also chances of hash collision for different words. We tested out several Hashing methods which are being used world -wide for non-cryptographic purposes, and came to a conclusion that ‘Murmur’ hash was the most appropriate choice. Data tampering was anothe r concern which we faced . Since Jav aScript is at front-end and can be manipulated by client side, we needed a way to secure its integrity. We learned that this could be done in a number of ways, including: Obfuscation techniques and JavaScript minification . These techniques manipulate the JavaScript and to some extent encrypts it , so that it is hard to understand and modify the code or abuse it. In Android application, we found out that  there are some functions which are not supported by older devices running older Android OS. We had to search alternate techniques to perform our objective on older devices as well. Devices running minimum on Android 4.4 or later are supported.

We will try to research and analyse possible and efficient methods to communicate with dev ice’s hardware and collect more robust and un -changeable identifiers, to form more efficient and effective Unique Device Fingerprint.

heading: Abstract
content: In today’s corporate world, demand of data analysis is growing rapidly. Competition among organisations based on new strategies and expert abilities to predict the future trends for the market and customer demand. Due to increasing impact of business intel ligence and data analysis among corporate firm data become most beneficial asset for organizations. In our project, we have collected the data of enterprise to analyse the impact of factors on trends. We applied Machine Learning algorithms to get prophetic statistics. It helps in making beneficial decisions for the business growth. Along with the predicted values our tool will provide data visualization of actual and predicted values.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: By the time and the increasing demand of Data analysis, business intelligence is increasing so fast that today every organization calculate and analyses their data on speculations. heading: Abstract
content: The fundamental motivation behind our project is to create a system for students which will facilitate them to register their classes by eliminating time clashes in their registered courses. The system will help students to identify suitable slots in which they can register their desired course. Moreover this application will also facilitate faculty and university management to identify and reserve rooms to conduct makeup lectures. COMSATS Academic registration staff will be automated

content: This report has been complied as part of our FYP supervised by Dr. Salman Khan. The supervision and guidance that he gave played a vital role in the development of this project. The project made us realize the value of working together as a team and gave us a new experience regarding the working environment, which changes constantly and poses new challenges. heading: 1.1 Introduction:
content: In this modern era, there is a rapid growth in the field of computer science. For the ease of humans, the computerized revolution has brought a significant change in different range of areas including education. There are three main purposes of our system: 1- Students can register his/her courses automatically by keeping itself away from the clashes. 2- Faculty can view the currently teaching courses, can update the leave/late status and also can arrange a makeup of any batch within a few minutes. 3-Staff work is automated by handling all the academic record online. COMSATS wasn't providing facility to their stakeholders (Students, Faculty & Staff) in some matters which as a student we also faced many times so we put together all the possible problems under one roof to make it more reliable and more efficient for all. Student within no time can register him/herself into the courses and can manage to view the new timetable that includes the current batch timetable with the newly added courses. Moreover Student will be having the option of downloading the updated timetable in the form of pdf as our university provides. Faculty will have two major options. Faculty can view the registered batches that he/she will teach. Faculty can have the feasibility to update the status so that the registered batch’s stude nt will get the update on their portal regarding late/leave or if the teacher arranged a makeup. Academic Staff work is made automatic up to some extent so that any duplication or error chances will be reduced. Staff will also be known as Admin and will be  taking an overview on the students enrolled, faculty added, which faculty is teaching which subject to which batch and will be generating the timetable for all the subjects. The main aim of our project is to save time of Students, Faculty, and university  Staff. As it is a very time taking process to manually identify clashes and difficult for the staff to check a vacant room whose teacher is on leave. But with the help of our system student, faculty, and university management can easily resolve their prob lems in just a few clicks. This development is accomplished through following steps: • The front end designed in web languages including PHP, HTML/CSS and Bootstrap • The Backend is purely designed under the LARAVEL Framework • The data of all students and faculty will be stored in database through MySql database. • If university grant us the permission, our system will be connected to CIIT system which will automatically make the timetable and will allow the user to see which slots are free. Alternatively, we will download timetable from COMSATS website and then add it to our database but they administration didn't gave us the premises therefore we had to design our own module for generating timetable

content: The objective of developing such a computerization system is to reduce the paper work and safe time of students, faculty and university management. There by increasing the efficiency and decreasing the work load. Our project/system provides the flexibility of generating the required documents on screen as well as on printers when required.

So they take makeup classes to cover their syllabus. But it's difficult for them to manually check all the free rooms in their desired slots. So our system will handle this issue and serve for all the teachers. By this system teachers can reserve their rooms in specific slot   on the basis of “First Come and First Serve”. 3 As our motive is to free teachers and student in less time as possible. Our system will resolve all these problems.

heading: 2.1 Literature review / Existing system study:
content: In literature there are various studies that report about time table generation for classes and efficient resource management. The following sections describe some of the work reported in literature.  [2][1] Tauja padale et al., in [7] explained that creating a good and efficient time table is a very complex and time consuming job. According to him, when creating a time table one should have to go through a lot of thinking, scenarios and look for multiple things to  provide an efficient and error or clash free time table that is perfect for majority of people that are going to use it. The solution which they proposed for this problem is to create an application that will perform all those said things itself and devis e an error free and highly reliable time table in a manner of seconds or minutes. [2][2] Milind Deshkar et al., in [8] explained that  manual way of creating time table was very time consuming and full of errors. Same goes for hand written time tables. They described that there should be an automatic and intelligent way of creating error free time table that was accessible easily for everyone and can be easily modifies if needed. Their application was based on this logic. It automatically created time tables  that were efficient and error free and were easily modifiable.[2][3] L.R. Foulds and D.G. Johnson in [9] described an easy to understand, menu-driven choice emotionally supportive network that can be utilized to develop university timetables. The framework was composed in Microsoft Access, inside the Microsoft Windows condition, for a  MS-DOS PC. A contextual analysis was accounted for, including the effective utilization of the framework in the condition that propelled its improvement, in particular course timetabling at a New Zealand university.[2][4] Mehdi Yadollahi et al., 2012 in [10] portrayed that the planning was such an enormous issue and numerous broad techniques were utilized to determine this issue. Booking issue was dispersed into two gatherings: exam timetabling and university course timetabling. In any case, the most criti cal issue in this field is booking of university courses that ought to be settled. This was a NP -significant issue and numerous imaginative strategies were utilized to deal with this issue. Hereditary calculation was another strategy that finds the appropr iate response all the more quickly by diminishing the issues. [2][5] Sandeep Saharan and Kamna Kadian in [11] tackled the examination time table problem. It was a very old and classical problem that was being faced by almost every educational institute. Ex amination scheduling was a very hard problem with high rate of error and clashes among students, classes and subjects. To propose a schedule one has to take a lot of things in consideration such as time, available classes, classes being used etc. For this problem they proposed a better way of doing things. According to them application will use objective based genetic algorithm that will perform error checking while creating schedule and will color-code the time table according to classes available.[2][6] E. K. Burke et al., 1994 in [12] clarified the issue of making a computerized framework for use with timetabling was normal. Many projects are available for this undertaking, however they per formed just specifically, disengaged circumstances. Right now being created is a typical framework that will have the capacity to deal with the persistently changing necessities of various establishments including colleges and universities. In this article , diverse techniques have been depicted to determine this issue. In this article, it was likewise depicted that how inside a framework we can deal with numerous basic elements of timetable. The issues of unmanageability were controlled by delivering a spre adsheet-sort framework which can direct an administrator in helpful way. It permitted the client control of the hunt and proposes the chance of backtracking where no simple and helpful arrangement exists, while as yet permitting the heuristic calculations is valuable. Such an approach can't ensure a perfect arrangement, yet it can give an answer which is valuable for a client. It is assumed that any client tending to a timetabling issue in a college is qualified to assess whether an answer is fitting. This gives the customer control of the request and offers the probability of backtracking where no sensible game plan is found, while up 'til now giving the heuristic calculations a chance to do the diligent work. Such an approach can't ensure an ideal arrangement, however it can ensure an answer with which the customer is happy.[2][7] In addition to above mentioned literature there are some online systems which are being used in Pakistani universities and are related to our system up to some extent. These syste ms have been described in following subsections.[2][8]

heading: 2.6 Software development life cycle model:
content: There a numerous models that can be used for this project but Iteration model in this case fits best. We want our project risk free and to be able to add extra features in the system in future. Keeping this in mind, Iterative model is the best for risk reduction or if changes have to be done in future. Since functionality for this project may add up or enhance in the future therefore iterative model would suite best. It uses an incremental approach through each iteration. Iterative model is divided into 4 phases:

heading: • Test
content: A software project repeatedly passes through these phases in iterations. Adding functionality according to user in incremental steps is easy when working with this model. The requirements also in this project can vary greatly and may change over time therefore this model helps in coping in such a dynamic environment and is very useful at handing complex requirements similar to what are present in our project. Throughout the development cycle, changes in our project can be implemented and tested in an efficient manner using prototypes at every stage.  Division of project into smaller parts to handle risky modules at an earlier stage reduces risk and makes development hassle free. Although this model suite  us best, still some difficulties can be experienced in terms of complexity in managerial tasks, documentation complexity and an uncertainty of what the end product may be like. These constraints can a lso be reduced by competent knowledge of the tools being used and good team work which would be our goal to be achieved from this model.

heading: 4.2.1 Unit testing
content: A large system with complex requirements like ours has to be built in modules and each module is to be tested to confirm that there are no bugs or performance lags. Each module that we build will pass through a number of tests to ensure that quality product is made in the end. The modules that are to be tested are:

heading: • Logout

heading: 4.2.2   Integration Testing
content: During the integration it is to be ensured that everything is running the way it was subsequent testing. With large number of modules to be integrated, the testing becomes more complex. So, we plan to keep our major focus on integration testing In integration testing following functions are performed by primary actor

heading: 4.2.3 System Testing
content: During the system testing we aim to perform the black box testing, to check the proper working of functionalities provided by the system. For the system test, we plan to make potential users of the testers. We plan to perform ‘thinking aloud’ test in this context so we may get a proper feedback from the actual users about the improvements that may become a part of application in the future updates.

heading: 4.2.4 Acceptance Testing
content: Our team aim to deploy the system following it’s formally acceptation by the people who will use it and the environment where it is to be used. We will ensure proper training to the people who will be performing the acceptance test.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned:
content: Quite many hurdles came up while implementing this Final Year Project, The main problem was encountered during the development process, which was not being able to find the appropriate resources i.e. instructions/tutorials and guidance about the Web development in LARAVEL Framework. Not being a taught a web development course made the path towards the goal much more time taking and challenging at some points. As with any project, many valuable lessons were learnt. The most significant of those lessons was to realize the value and impact of the Web Handling.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: There was a big need have a platform where the remaining time taking activities from every side of CIIT should be resolved and to make this happen we gathered all the possible problems and tried to resolve them on  a single platform so that it will be feasible for everyone to use and management to handle it properly. This web application will be beneficial for all the stakeholders including Students, Faculty and Administrator. This project is secure as it contains the authentication process for every user and also a time saving machine that requires a little effort from the user side and will perform the remaining task by its own. On the student side we had added the three functionalities in which student will be able to view his/her current timetable within few seconds. Moreover Student will be having the possibility to add new courses in his/her current timetable and the application will identify if there is any clash between the timetable and new course added if n ot then it will be added in the current timetable of that particular student now there can occur two types of clash 1- Clash between the current batch course and newly added course In this case the system will prompt a message that there is a clash between these particular subjects. 2- Clash between two newly added courses In this case system will ask for the user opinion to add which of the subject ( two subjects having the clash) and then user will select one subject and that will be added to timetable. After the addition student will also have the feasibility to view his/her updated timetable and it will also get download. Faculty will have the feasibility to view the allocated subjects in the current semester and can contact to the batch that he/she is teach ing via the update system. Update system allows the faculty to update status regarding leave, late or makeup and it will be directly shown to those students who are enrolled with the current teacher. Faculty can now arrange makeup by their own in a short time just by reserving the class room with the required date & time. Administrator will have the ability through this application to handle the entire academic records. Administrator will enroll the students, Add the Faculty, Add the courses details, batc h, class rooms, and will make a timetable of every course. This Application is made to overcome the possible problems that everyone was facing and to make every task more accurate.

heading: 5.3 Future work:
content: Some future plans for this project include providing statistical analysis to the Admin that how many a faculty is arranging a makeup, providing the feature of direct communication by adding the message system so that faculty and admin will be able to contact directly through web and student can also send the inquiry message to the respective teacher.

Porting this app to other platforms such as Android or IOS may also be considered.

content: -----------112 31Chapter 1 Introduction 1.1 Introduction: In this modern era, there is a rapid growth in the field of computer science. For the ease of humans, the computerized revolution has brought a significant change in different range of areas including education. There are three main purposes of our system: 1- Students can register his/her courses automatically by keeping itself away from the clashes. 2- Faculty can view the currently teaching courses, can update the leave/late status and also can arrange a makeup of any batch within a few minutes. 3-Staff work is automated by handling all the academic record online. COMSATS wasn't providing facility to their stakeholders (Students, Faculty & Staff) in some matters which as a student we also faced many times so we put together all the possible problems under one roof to make it more reliable and more efficient for all. Student within no time can register him/herself into the courses and can manage to view the new timetable that includes the current batch timetable with the newly added courses. Moreover Student will be having the option of downloading the updated timetable in the form of pdf as our university provides. Faculty will have two major options. Faculty can view the registered batches that he/she will teach. Faculty can have the feasibility to update the status so that the registered batch’s student will get the update on their portal regarding late/leave or if the teacher arranged a makeup. Academic Staff work is made automatic up to some extent so that any duplication or error chances will be reduced. Staff will also be known as Admin and will be taking an overview on the students enrolled, faculty added, which faculty is teaching which subject to which batch and will be generating the timetable for all the subjects. The main aim of our project is to save time of Students, Faculty, and university Staff. As it is a very time taking process to manually identify clashes and difficult for the staff to check a vacant room whose teacher is on leave. But with the help of our system student, faculty, and university management can easily resolve their problems in just a few clicks. We want our project risk free and to be able to add extra features in the system in future. Keeping this in mind, Iterative model is the best for risk reduction or if changes have to be done in future. Since functionality for this project may add up or enhance in the future therefore iterative model would suite best. It uses an incremental approach through each iteration. Iterative model is divided into 4 phases: • Analysis (System/Business/Unit Requirements) • Design (System/Module/Architecture Design) • Code • Test A software project repeatedly passes through these phases in iterations. Adding functionality according to user in incremental steps is easy when working with this model. The requirements also in this project can vary greatly and may change over time therefore this model helps in coping in such a dynamic environment and is very useful at handing complex requirements similar to what are present in our project. Throughout the development cycle, changes in our project can be implemented and tested in an efficient manner using prototypes at every stage. Division of project into smaller parts to handle risky modules at an earlier stage reduces risk and makes development hassle free. Although this model suite us best, still some difficulties can be experienced in terms of complexity in managerial tasks, documentation complexity and an uncertainty of what the end product may be like. These constraints can also be reduced by competent knowledge of the tools being used and good team work which would be our goal to be achieved from this model. On the student side we had added the three functionalities in which student will be able to view his/her current timetable within few seconds. Moreover Student will be having the possibility to add new courses in his/her current timetable and the application will identify if there is any clash between the timetable and new course added if not then it will be added in the current timetable of that particular student now there can occur two types of clash 1- Clash between the current batch course and newly added course In this case the system will prompt a message that there is a clash between these particular subjects. 2- Clash between two newly added courses In this case system will ask for the user opinion to add which of the subject ( two subjects having the clash) and then user will select one subject and that will be added to timetable. After the addition student will also have the feasibility to view his/her updated timetable and it will also get download. Faculty will have the feasibility to view the allocated subjects in the current semester and can contact to the batch that he/she is teaching via the update system. Update system allows the faculty to update status regarding leave, late or makeup and it will be directly shown to those students who are enrolled with the current teacher. Faculty can now arrange makeup by their own in a short time just by reserving the class room with the required date & time. Administrator will have the ability through this application to handle the entire academic records. Administrator will enroll the students, Add the Faculty, Add the courses details, batch, class rooms, and will make a timetable of every course. This Application is made to overcome the possible problems that everyone was facing and to make every task more accurate. 5.3 Future work: Some future plans for this project include providing statistical analysis to the Admin that how many a faculty is arranging a makeup, providing the feat ure of direct communication by adding the message system so that faculty and admin will be able to contact directly through web and student can also send the inquiry message to the respective teacher. Also adding the reminder module that if a teacher update s the leave status then the system will recall the faculty after sometime that particular class was missed and want to arrange makeup then it will be directed to the makeup module that we had already made. Porting this app to other platforms such as Android or IOS may also be considered. heading: Abstract
content: In this project we create a mobile discount android application. This application is developed to solve problems for the one who is new in town to search out  discount on different products. It will facilitate user to search latest  offers. User will login from our application. Then  different categories will be displayed. Now they only need to select their required ite m on category i.e. food, beauty & health  etc. After that map showing different shops name will be displ ayed. User can view all the outlets  near to them. Our application is targeted  to bring discount offers  of various  products with their shops locality in a single platform that simply comprehendible by one and all.

heading: Introduction:
content: Mobile discount directory is an android application that generally based  on discount offers but with renovated facilities like take advantage of area wise shop’s location for the person who is unfamiliar from shops in town. In modern era revolution made by the mobile technology made life easier as it endowing with new services as we ll as related techniques with  more availability.[2] In this application we use GPS system which identify user’s current location and shop’s location which he gets after clicking on categories. The search facility helps the users to find desired shops locality without wasting much of their time. This application brings convenient to users and helps them store intelligence . [1] Easiness for the user is what we wanted to achieve in our discount directory. It will use global positioning system for discount offers and promotion of user’s current location. [1] Currently there are many websites on social media that is related to discount o ffers like Browser for Groupon, [3], Big discount [4 ], Peekaboo [5] etc. But no one is focused to bring promotions on different products with their shop’s locality in a single platform which is easily understandable for the person who is new in city  so discount directory will be a marked as an innovative step towards android application. Our expertise lies in giving the required information asked by the user. The main focus is to resolve the issue of time and money by visiting different shops and out lets in the search of cheap and good quality products. heading: Abstract
content: As a developing country, one of the many dilemmas that engulf Pakistan is the exponential increase in water pollution that is rapidly becoming one of the biggest environmental threats to our health. Like many other environmental hazards, water pollution is also a result of our own negligence, but the majority of its detrimental effects are easily preventable by nation-wide application of a handful of practices to ensure safe and clean drinking water for our people. Contamination of water bodies (e.g. lakes, canals, rivers and seas) by large amounts of harmful chemical, physical, radioactive or pathogenic microbial substances results in chemical, physical or biological changes in the quality of water that have adverse effects on any living thing that drinks, uses or lives in it. The recent wave of industrialization in Pakistan, its ever-growing population and the lately popular commercial approach towards agriculture are the major inciting factors that have greatly contributed towards water pollution in recent years. Polluted water bodies are hazardous to humans, as well as to the aquatic life and ecosystem. The team of this project aims to provide a solution to detect impurities in water before it is utilized by common man for everyday use to ensure a healthy living environment. A tangible solution for preventing usage of contaminated water (notably in household application) lies in conducting real-time tests on water before it is distributed for use.

heading: Introduction
content: The main goal of the project is to provide a potential solution to prevent the use of contaminated water. Amid the many environmental crisis, water contamination is one those that directly and significantly causes a negative impact on the quality of life. A wide multitude of causes contribute to water contamination; it is a multi-factorial phenomenon. The industrial waste that is drained in rivers and streams is one of the major causes of water pollution. With increase in industrialization in recent years, not much attention has been paid to the environmental sustainability of industries and factories. As a result, majority of factories and industrial plants lack proper waste disposal systems. Tones of chemically and physically polluted water, laden with harmful acids, alkalis and heavy metals, are dumped by industries into local water bodies daily. Untreated domestic waste that finds its way into water-bodies is also a major source of water pollution. The population explosion in Pakistan has produced countless unplanned slums all over the country. These places have no proper sewage disposal systems. So, all the domestic waste and garbage is often deposited in the local lakes, canals and rivers. Agricultural products that run-off untreated in the nearby bodies of water further intensify the detrimental situation of water pollution. Agriculture in Pakistan is rapidly becoming commercial-oriented. The widespread use of DDTs is poisonous for aquatic life as well as for humans. Nitrates and other fertilizers cause unrestrained growth of unwanted plants in water thereby disturbing the balance of nature in the aquatic ecosystem. The situation aggravates upon the consumption of this toxic waste via water. There is a dire need to set up proper measures that will keep the toxicity of the water in check through real-time testing. Impurity of a liquid can be monitored based on its acidity and alkalinity. This group of students is of the opinion that developing a system that will measure the purity of water based on its pH levels will be very valuable in ensuring that only healthy and good quality water reaches our households and workplaces, thereby significantly reducing the rate of transmission of water- borne diseases. Therefore, we shall strive to develop such a system whereby pH of water is being continually measured and warning is sent out electronically if the pH deviates from the preset standard range.

heading: Objectives
content: By fulfilling our prime objective of developing the “Aqua Impurity Scanner”, we aim to provide a real-time water testing system that is both economically and practically implementable at household as well as large scale levels. A major role in achieving this objective will be played by the development of the network system that will link the pH sensors in water storage tanks and reservoirs with end-users and water regulation authorities, respectively, thereby warning them of significant changes in pH levels of water promptly. This shall help ensure timely action and thereby prevent consumption of unhealthy water by the users. Problem statement The goal of this team is to create a healthy environment for people by helping the water authorities become more efficient in their response to water contamination occurrences. Projects related to Aqua Impurity Scanner have been worked on before by other teams as well but the end results do not fit everyone’s budget. Our product prototype promises an economical solution with satisfying results. Assumptions and Constraints

heading: Assumptions:
content:  Contaminated water’s consumption is a major factor in causing health diseases.  People need a proper solution to keep their water purity in check.  Product needs to fit an average man’s budget.  Easier installation/setup would attract more consumers.

heading: Constraints:
content:  Such devices aren’t very popular in the market  Needs to work along with a water purifier to ensure the supply of water is clean.  Needs internet connection to make the most it.

heading: Project Scope
content: This project has a very wide scope as it holds the potential to formulate the basis of many further developments in the field of water purification. We hope to develop a system that shall be applicable on all levels; it can be implemented to monitor water pH not only at a small-scale, such as in swimming pools, individual household water tanks, local water reservoirs distributing water to local residential societies and water supplies to various industries, but also at a large-scale, such as at district, provincial and national levels by being adopted by organizations such as WASA. Furthermore, pH detection is just one of the many ways to determine purity and fitness of water. There are many other parameters that can also be incorporated in this system. once the system and the network

heading: 6 | P a g e
content: connecting the sensor and users is developed, other sensors such as for oxygen-level of water, carbon dioxide-level of water nitrites-levels of water etc. can also be added into the developed framework to ensure better and more precise monitoring of water being distributed from the reservoirs. One way to prevent water contamination is to detect and curb the source of contamination. Our sensors can also be implanted at various set check-points in running water bodies to detect changes in water pH and other parameters, thereby detecting nearby sources of contamination of water bodies from industrial, agricultural or household waste. Therefore, Aqua Impurity Scanner is a project with endless possibilities. It can pave the way for establishment of a modern-day water scanner system that is feasible for implementation on small-scale as well as large-scale, primarily owing to its ease-of-use, economical cost and operational flexibility.

heading: Overview:
content: MQTT protocol is a Machine to Machine (M2M) protocol widely used in Internet of things. This is a message-based protocol and as it is immensely light-weight, due to which it is embraced by IoT ecosystem. MQTT protocol is accepted by almost all IoT platforms to exchange data from smart objects. There are several implementations for different IoT boards like Arduino, Raspberry and so on. MQTT Message pattern The publish-subscriber paradigm decouples a client that issues a message (“publisher”) to other clients that receive the message (“subscribers”). Since, MQTT is an asynchronous protocol there is no blocking of the client while waiting for the message. Using this protocol, there's also no need for the publisher and client to be connected at the same time. MQTT Publisher-subscriber pattern (MQTT Broker, MQTT Client) MQTT uses publisher-subscriber pattern. The main crucial component in MQTT is the MQTT broker which is responsible for dispatching messages to the MQTT clients which it receives from the publishers. As the message is being sent, topic is used by the MQTT broker to filter the MQTT clients that are to receive the message. The topic is a string and can be combined to create topic levels. A topic which is a virtual channel links a publisher to its subscribers. This topic is managed by the MQTT broker. Through this topic, the publisher is decoupled from the subscribers and the MQTT clients do not have to know each other to exchange data. This makes this protocol highly scalable without a direct dependency from the message producer (“publisher”) and the message consumer (“subscriber”). heading: 1 Introduction
content: The main goal of this project is to develop new methodologies which will result in industrial level efficiency through Research and implementation of self-driving vehicle simulation. These software systems are Lane Detection, Traffic Signs Classification, and the Simulation. Self- driving vehicles are comprised of Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning systems. These systems alongside dedicated sensors are continuously working with the hardware to drive the vehicle. Artificial intelligence is intelligence showcased by machines to carry out various task assigned to them. This project would emphasize on efficient machine learning model which will enable the system to understand without being hard-coded to have the ability of image classification through which it will be able to identify the certain situation that it has been presented with and follows the protocols in accordance to that situation. A model in machine learning is a learning algorithm which is provided with trained data of its domain. The term machine learning model refers to the model artifact that is created by the training process of an algorithm. We will utilize computer vision techniques which will provide us with the high level of understanding of the images or videos. The main concern of Computer Vision is to extract the valuable information from image or video automatically and then analyse and understand it. The main focus will be computer vision, its ability to identify objects, scenes and activities in unconstrained environments.  First and foremost, Objects are detected by using image processing techniques. Objects include traffic signs, road lanes, vehicles. Then for identification of objects, this requisite training data is provided to efficient or best possible neural network for image classification. During image classification, we’ve also worked on traffic sign detection and classification and choosing a network architecture to enhance performance. The advanced techniques for lane detection with curved roads, adverse weather, and varied lighting are done to ensure the proper and continuous road lanes detection of the Self Driving vehicles. Vehicles are tracked using the image processing and image classification techniques along with positioning of the vehicle. This tracking is necessary to gain road sense as it is an important feature so that vehicles are aware of their surroundings to avoid collisions with objects like other vehicles. Pedestrians are also an important constraint of the road sense when it comes to awareness of surroundings of the vehicle.

heading: 2 Related Work
content: The literature review is provided for the Lane Lines Detection, Traffic Signs Classification and Autonomous Vehicle Simulation Systems below:

heading: 2.1 Lane Detection
content: Figure 1 - Classification of Road Detection Approaches [1] The main objective of literature review is to explore and find the advantages of lane lines detection techniques and algorithms and stating various existing problems in given techniques and algorithms. The desired target of this literature review is to identify the intervals in available researches and methodologies with some suggested solutions to fill these gaps. RALPH system was proposed by Pomerleau et al (1996) [2], which was utilized to control the position of the self-driving vehicle. This system used techniques that perform alignment and adjustment of the detected template of road to the mean of line intensity template for determining the curvature of lane and offsets. GOLD system was developed by Broggi et al (1998) [3], which utilized lane lines detection algorithms based on edges of lanes. The captured image sample of the road is warped to a bird’s eye view (also known as perspective transformation) to get the vertical lane line markings and thresholding techniques (quasi vertical brightened lines) were applied to make nearly clear black backgrounds displaying concatenated/joined lane lines only. LOIS algorithm was proposed by Kreucher et al (1996) [4], which gave a templating method by deforming samples. Shapes and positions of lanes were given in sets to provide all the possible methods of appearance of lane lines in an image. A method was implemented to match the pixel data to the defined parameters of an image sample and then return the proportional values. The detection of lane lines is done by identifying the shape of lane line for an image while maximizing the method/function. B-snake spline was used by Wang et al (2004) [5], for representing the road as a geometric model. The images were then processed for extraction of parameters, which are required for the geometric model, by using Canny and Hough Estimation of Vanishing Points technique. The stated method was robust and could successfully overcome the effect of shadows on lane lines detection.
