The line edges detection, angular estimation of squares and Hough transformation was applied by Jung et al (2005) [7] to make an estimation of the lane lines. This algorithm works well other than the effect of shadows. A real-time algorithm was proposed for detection of urban road lanes by Aly (2008) [8]. The bird’s eye view of road image was taken and filtration/smoothing was performed using Gaussian kernel with RANSAC spline fitting method for detection of lane lines afterwards. This algorithm was efficient and only had problems when crossing walks, overtaking cars and crossing streets appeared. Another efficient system was proposed, for handling problems like lane curvature detection, challenging lane markings, changes and different types of augmented lines, by Kim (2008) [9]. Particle filtration and random template matching made the basis for this algorithm. This algorithm also provided a lot of real-time diagnostics of lane line occurrences and new directions for research. Another comparatively fast real-time algorithm was proposed by Khalifa et al (2009) [10], showing a promising result on effect of shadows and lighting. Hough Transform was applied to the extracted region of interest to detect the lane lines. Both un-marked and marked roads were possible positive candidates for this algorithm while accommodating different weather effects. This algorithm assumes that the cars as moving on a flat surface/road with very low curvature values. This algorithm fails when sharp curvatures and shadow effects are present on the road. A new approach was proposed by Meuter et al (2009) [11], which combined detection and tracking algorithms using combination of Extended Kalman Filters. This was done using the Interacting Multiple Models algorithm. The proposed algorithm performed well on weak road lane markings and when the noise was present. This could be used when the slope and position of lane segments is desired to be detected. Another algorithm was proposed, for the detection of a road with marked lanes, by Zhou et al (2010) [12], which was compiled using the Gabor filter and the geometric model. This algorithm can be utilized when a warning is desired when lane is left (like the lane departure warning system present in some luxury vehicles). The four parameters including start position, original orientation, lane width and curvature of lane are contained in the geometric model of the lane. The estimation of orientation in each pixel and filtration of lane line is done by Gabor filter. The proposed algorithm can be robust while tackling the common lane lines detection problems occurring due to the detection problems of edges like in shadows etc. Comparatively, the algorithm achieved high performance on detection of lane lines in different noisy cases etc. Another real-time lane lines detection system was proposed by Lin et al (2010) [13], which was identifying the type and position of lane lines in the image frames extracted from the video. Combinations of lane marking and edge linkages were considered as features to prove the generated hypothesis of the lane line. The production of robust edge linkages was done by an edge linkage algorithm while the process of searching the marked lane line candidates was being carried out. A live Bayesian model was also being used to estimate the probabilities of lane lines continuity. This algorithm was having no requirements like models for surface, background and additional parameters like in some other methods. So, this was more universal and adaptive. A bar filtration-based method was proposed by Teng et al (2010) [14], which included the integration of cues. This filtration method is efficient in detecting the objects which are shaped like a bar e.g. a lane line and Hough transformations. Particle filtration is used to provide real- time better lane detection. Ultimately, this method improved curved lane lines detection and

heading: 2.2 Traffic Signs Classification
content: There exist a lot of papers that are targeted to recognize the traffic signs in real scenarios [17-28]. The approach used most commonly consists of two steps mainly the detection of signs from an image and then the recognition of traffic signs. In first step, the region of interest is identified, segmentations are applied (usually based on colour information) and the shapes of traffic signs are recognized in some forms. The detected traffic signs are then identified or classified as false positives (rejected) during the step. Multiple techniques are used for performing traffic signs classification while some are stated below. The traffic sign candidate detection is carried out using template matching techniques [29], and in many cases using the Support Vector Machines (SVMs) [17], [18], [24]. Some cases have also reported the artificial neural networks to be used in identification/detection of the traffic signs in image [30], [17]. While carrying out the research, a lot of usage of colour information segmentation-based system was seen in effect [22], [24], [31-33]. In these systems, there is a big challenge of adverse weather and light conditions on the performance of detection of the traffic signs. To tackle this problem, various colour-spaces were utilized in these papers. Like YUV colour-space [25], CIECAM97 colour-space [23] and the HSV colour-space [21], [25], [34]. Many combinations of these colour-spaces can be used to perform the desired task. We can see, for instance, that YUV colour-space segmentation was carried out by Shadeed et al [25] on U & V channels of YUV colour-space. The configuration was positive and negative values for red colour channel for U & V respectively. After that, the HSV colour-space was seen in action as the H channel was combined with the above U & V outcome to segment the red-coloured traffic signs. A quad-tree histogram method was implemented by Gao et al [23], which was used to perform segmentation of the H channel and colour-values of CIECAM97 colour-space based on an image. In implementation by Malik et al [25], the H channel of HSV colour-space was thresholded to perform segmentation of the red-coloured traffic signs. On the other hand, there exist methodologies [20], [36] that completely choose to ignore the colour-information and use shape-based information. A system was proposed by Zelinksy and Loy [36], which identified and highlighted the interest points utilizing the radial symmetry to detect different shapes of traffic signs. Histogram of oriented Gradients was utilized to extract features of traffic signs, from an image, in some recently proposed methods like [30], [37]. An

heading: 13 of 61  19 May 2018
content: extension of Histogram of Gradients algorithm was carried out by Creusen et al [30], with the purpose of accommodating the colour-based information utilizing the YCbCr colour-space and CIELAB. Two different compositions of Histogram of Gradients features were proposed by Overett et al [37], with the purpose of detection of New Zealand traffic signs (speed signs to be more precise). There are a lot of convolutional neural network-based systems present containing the classifiers trained on datasets of traffic sign images which are labelled manually [30], [17], [18]. This method is vulnerable to errors, consumes a lot of time and repetitive in nature. There are also methods that only classify signs based on graphical representation of traffic signs, e.g. by Gomez- Moreno et al [24], using a traffic-signs repository [38]. There are a lot of Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based approaches with high accuracies of classification. But they also pose a problem of limited detection (based on predefined classes) with possibility of suffering from false positives on similar signs missing during training like twenty classes in [29], forty-two classes in [18], and seven classes in [17]. These systems also propose slower speeds, making it unsuitable of real-time scenarios, like in [17], [24], [39] and [40]. There exist some commercial solutions for traffic signs recognition like [41] and [42]. These solutions also come with a limitation of classes for detection of traffic signs. For instance, there was a traffic signs recognition system by Mobileye [42] that detected speed-limit traffic signs and no-overtaking traffic signs only.

heading: 5.1 Pipeline / Architecture
content: • Compute the camera calibration matrix and distortion coefficients given a set of chessboard images. • Apply a distortion correction to raw images. • Use colour transforms, gradients, etc., to create a thresholded binary image. • Apply a perspective transform to rectify binary image ("birds-eye view"). • Detect lane pixels and fit to find the lane boundary. • Determine the curvature of the lane and vehicle position with respect to centre. • Warp the detected lane boundaries back onto the original image. • Output visual display of the lane boundaries and numerical estimation of lane curvature and vehicle position.

heading: 5.2 Camera Calibration Matrix and Distortion Coefficients
content: In our method, we first remove the camera distortion which ca n cause erroneous results for  the necessary calculations like radius of curvature and vehicle position with respect to the centre of the lane.  To calibrate the camera and remove the distortion, the camera calibration matrix is computed first and then the distortion coefficients for removal of distortion. Chessboard corners are used to remove the distortion from camera while  being an important step for performing the calibration. We started this step of our architecture by preparing “object points”, which are the (x, y, z) coordinates of the chessboard corners in the world space. Here we first assume that chessboard is fixed on the (x, y) plane with z=0, such that the object points are the same for each calibration image. We run the detection of object points  on all distorted chessboard images. Thus, an array holding the object points will be appended with a copy of it every time we successfully detect all chessboard corners in the images. Whereas, image points are

heading: 5.6 Detect Lane Pixels and Fit to Find Lane Boundary
content: Now that we have lanes in our perspective transformed image, we can detect the lane pixels and fit a 2 nd order polynomial to identify their positions. Our first and foremost  step is to identify the peaks of pixel values in form of a histogram. Here is the sample of a peak identification on segments of the road including lane lines.

heading: 33 of 61  19 May 2018
content: Figure 26 – Lane Pixel Peaks using Histograms Then the identified peaks are considered as lane pixels. After that, we implement sliding windows on the image to compute and identify lane lines . The left and right indices are computed for the sliding windows and centre is computed within the provided threshold i.e. 50. If the sliding window centre is greater than the threshold value, the mean of X pixels is taken to compute the centres. After this, the lane positions are extracted using the indices on both x and y directions. Here is the sample of sliding windows on a lane image: The above image also contains the output from a polynomial fit. The polynomial is fitted in the end for both left and right lanes. The stacked windows in pieces follow the lane pixel even if the road bends. This methodology is not computationally  cost effective, so we implemented a method which computes the lane fit values based on previous fit values. This avoids the sliding windows search and directly fits the polynomial resulting in greater efficiency.

heading: 5.7 Curvature of Lane and Vehicle Position
content: These two measurements are necessary for self -driving vehicle. With this, the vehicle can know its position with respect to centre of the lane and it can be aware of the lane curvature for better adjustment of steering angle. We implemented method which comp utes the radius of curvature for both lane lines based on given pixel positions in meters. The conversion from pixel space to meters is done for both X and Y directions to get the accurate measurements. Radius of curvature for a 2 nd order Polynomial is given as: Radius of Curvature = [{1 + (2Ay+B) ^ 2} ^ (1.5)] / |2A| To compute the position of vehicle with respect to centre, the pixel to meter conversions are carried out. Like 3.7m wide road = 3.7/700 while 700 pixels are covering the road. The difference from current position is calculated using bottom line positions and base position difference. The polynomial is fitted here to get the bottom line position based on current positions. The resulting difference is multiplied by 3.7m i.e. 700 pixels in X direction. The 2nd order Polynomial formula in terms of Y axis is (Ay ^ 2 + By + C). A class is implemented for the lane lines to hold the coefficient values for the polynomials. A queue holds the recently detected lane fit coefficients in ima ges. So, if queue is full, the topmost value in the queue is popped and average is computed to get smooth coefficients.

heading: 5.8 Warping Detected Lane on Original Image
content: Now our warped image has fitted lane lines on it. So, we create a blank image of same size of original image and fill it with the lane drawn image. The Polygon is filled to get a visualization of lane surface. Then the transformation of perspective is carried out to get back the original portrayed lane lines. The result is then merged with the origi nal image which was passed to the pipeline. The resulting image also contains the radius of curvature of lane and vehicle position with respect to centre.

heading: 6.5.5 Solution Design Approach
content: The research of Nvidia and Comma.ai provides us with appropriate models because these models are tested in real-world scenarios. In order to know how well the model was working, we split the image and steering angle data into training and validation sets. It was found that Nvidia’s model had a low mean squared error on training set but high mean squared error on the validation set. This implies that the model was over-fitting. To combat this, we modified the model so that it generalizes better. Both the Nvidia and Comma.ai models are crafted well for single camera image-based learning. But we used 3 camera images instead of 1 on nearly stock models. Wh ich caused lower accuracy rates and training uncertainties. There were many training attempts using different parameter values like batch size, number of epochs, dropout value and training samples to test the model performance. Finally, we used the best saved training model to test the performance on track from where the data was collected.

heading: 6.6 Test the model
content: The model was tested on the track from where the data was collected. It successfully completed the track without leaving the lanes. We also tested the model to drive the car in opposite direction of the training data. It also performed very well without leaving the track. To simulate the autonomous vehicle, we compiled methods to connect to simulator using sockets. After connection, t he simulator provides image in “autonomous mode” to the model and the model predicts the steering angle. The outputs to the simulator include steering angle and throttle value. We set maximum throttle manually to 10 mph. The simulator also outputs only imag es of centre camera in autonomous mode so that the video of the run can be compiled. The video is compiled by joining all the images in sequence and setting frames/second. We set 25fps on our resulting video.

heading: Abstract
content: Pick me is an Android Application based on Ride Sharing concept in COMSATS Institute Lahore Campus. By using this application, students can share their vehicles with other non-vehicle students of institute. The one who has a vehicle can give ride to other students, faculty and staff at the fair division. The students, faculty or staffs who miss their institute bus or class timing not matched with institute bus timing can also be facilitated with this application which is low in cost and time saving for the COMSATS Institute Lahore Campus students. Table of Content

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: This application basically provides a platform for ride sharing. The application has two types of users.  One  is  the  Person  who  has  vehicle  (vehicle  owner)  and  the  other  who  needs  ride (passenger). This android application is designed to communicate between the vehicle owner and rider. If the vehicle owner and the rider travels to same destination regularly at the same time and have  common  route.  They  can  communicate  with  each  other  and  share  ride  using  this application. For example, vehicle owner daily travels to his university by covering the distance of 25km daily by car and travels alone. By using this application, riders can search the vehicle owner in its map nearby. The vehicle owner can active his status to show his status online on the map. The current location of vehicle owner is its source. Riders can search for the ride using their current location. Before booking the ride, rider can see vehicle owner profile by clicking the active vehicle owner on the map. The rider also communicates with vehicle owner using chat feature and confirm the availability of seats.  They can  also contact  each  other  for weekly or  monthly ride  sharing purposes. The scope of this application is only for the students of COMSATS Institute Lahore Campus  so  the  students  can  share  ride  with  other  students,  faculty or staff members.  This application will help the students in case of his buss misses or buss is not available at the route where student lives. Same is for faculty or staff members. So it’s very helpful for COMSATS community. For the security purposes the administrator can check other student/faculty/staff identity card to verify that they both are of same institute. Students can share ride both on and off of institute timings. They can also make different packages for ride sharing with each other. They can also specify whether they want to share ride daily or monthly. They can also exchange their contact numbers after finding the perfect vehicle owner for ride sharing purposes so they contact each other easily and comfortably.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: The main objective of this application is to establish trust between rider and driver and secure the ride.  Our  goal  is  to  provide  facility  to  the  students  and  faculty  members  to  make  them comfortable by developing trust and help in serving each other by sharing transport vehicle in COMSATS Lahore Campus.

heading: 1.3 Problem statement
content: The purpose behind this android application is that students and other faculty members are finding difficulties in searching the transport convenience and are uncomfortable in asking for a lift from unknown persons due to trust issues. For that purpose, this application is developed to facilitate  the  people  in  finding  the  transport  facility  because  of  unavailability  of  transport medium by creating communication among the people who go through common destination on the regular basis at the same time. This application also provides opportunity to female students and faculty members who are not comfortable with male drivers to resolves their comfort issues and travel with female drivers.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & constraints
content: • This application is only limited to COMSATS Lahore student. • This application can only be used by students currently registered in the university. • This application assumes that the user provides valid information. • This  application  assumes  that  the  user  only  using  this  application  only  for  riding purposes. • This application assumes that the rider has internet connectivity to book and explore ride.

heading: 1.5 Project scope
content: This application can be used in different universities but initially we use it for COMSATS Lahore because a lot of students/faculty/staff members have same destination and they can use it and can take advantage. Application explained below:

heading: Rider Side:
content: For  request  and  book  ride  rider  must  have  to  register. For  registration  he  has  to  give necessary information for account creation. The system shall verify his account information before account activation. Rider must have to login for requesting and booking ride. Rider must have to give necessary information about destination and number of seats he wants to reserve. Rider can book ride. He can pay only cash on ride end. He can see vehicle owner profile, vehicle information, fair division, total distance and no of seats available. Rider can cancel ride within 5 min of booking confirmation. Rider can see the vehicle owner which show their status online on its map nearby. Rider can communicate with the vehicle owner by using chat box and can discuss in more details. Rider can see total distance and the fair that they have to pay for a particular destination. There is fair division among all riders and they can see fair before booking ride. Rider can use discount packages for weekly and monthly rides. Riders can give feedback and ratings about vehicle owner after the ride to help other riders in the selection of vehicle owner.

heading: Vehicle Owner:
content: For registration vehicle owner has to give necessary information for account creation. Admin shall  approve  his  account  request  after  careful  verification  of  account  details  and  the documents  provided  by  the  vehicle  owner.  Vehicle  owner  needs  to  give  necessary information about the vehicle and number of free seats. Owner can confirm a ride request. Vehicle owner can accept a weekly or monthly package request if the requested package details suits him. Vehicle owner can also give feedback about rider.

heading: Admin Side:
content: Admin can verify a rider. Similarly, he can also block a rider in case of negative ratings or feedback. Admin can verify and reject the vehicle owner.  For poor feedback and ratings admin can warn vehicle owner.  Admin can block vehicle owner account on continuous poor feedback and ratings. Admin can also update the per kilometer chargers due to ups and downs of petrol rates..

content: Blablacar.com website is functional in European Areas. This website is first asking three things to find a ride. Departure, Destination, Dated. The one who posted his/her ride in that date is shown to rider. It also asks rider to select seats how  many seats he needs.  There  is also conversation  Window  for  the  user  and captain  to communicate or used for conversation. [1]

heading: Model:
content: The Model component corresponds to all the data-related logic that the user works with. This can  represent  either  the  data  that  is  being  transferred  between  the  View  and  Controller components or any other business logic-related data. For example, a Customer object will retrieve the customer information from the database, manipulate it and update it data back to the database or use it to render data.

heading: View
content: The View component is used for all the UI logic of the application. For example, the Customer view will include all the UI components such as text boxes, dropdowns, etc. that the final user interacts with.

heading: Controller
content: Controllers act as an interface between Model and View components to process all the business logic and incoming requests, manipulate data using the Model component and interact with the Views to render the final output. For example, the Customer controller will handle all the interactions and inputs from the Customer View and update the database using the Customer Model. The same controller will be used to view the Customer data.

heading: 1.1 Introduction:
content: In Pakistan for domestic job the selection of blue -collar workers has always been a challenging task. For instance, the search for an electrician or plumber means first visit a market or hardware store then after negotiation take labour with you and after the completion of the work drop him to the store. A search for a person that resolve domestic issues of users is a big problem, we overcome this problem by making an Android Application that fulfil the user queries in an efficient manner, because people enjoy to use Smart phones and smart App that resolve their issues. As scope of the android application is concerned, statistics indicate that the trend of surfing internet on smart devices has seen a steep increase during the past few years. This trend is li kely to continue due to drop in cost and availability of smart devices. Pakistan, being a developing country has huge potential in the field of mobile software industry and rise in smartphone usage is most likely to be a perpetual entity. These types of ap plications can increase employment opportunities for handymen sector which is far left behind from the society, where technological advancements are progressing day by day and people  tend to depend more on technology to meet their requirement than ever. With the evolution in both the technology and new market trends people are looking towards experts to solve their problems in minimum time possible efficiently and accurately. The desire to live an easy life regarding finding a worker for household jobs le ads users to android handyman services. For instance, the search for an electrician or plumber means first visiting a market or hardware store, then after negotiation, taking labour with you and after the completion of the work dropping him to the store. M oreover, to manage time regarding finding a person to fix house errands, instead of hustling and bustling of daily life, raised demand for a customized system where they can find someone easily without leaving their comfort zone.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: This project i ntends to provide cost effective, secure and relia ble skilled labour services.  for instance, for electrical and plumbing work, repair work, construction /renovation and maintenance services. By using our website or android  application, the user can easily contact Handymen to solve household tasks. It is evident that such an android application shall not only benefit the end user but also increase the employment chances of skilled labour. For instance, electrical and plumbing, repair, construction or renovation and maintenance services. By using this application, the user can easy contact Handyman to solve the household queries. Handyman is a term used to describe technicians including a Carpenter, AC Mechanics, Plumbers, Car Mechanic, Electricians and Painter. Then we will send the relevant worker to the address based on the timing slot, a maximum 24- hour window. There is even an option to book an emergency visit, based on the nature of issue by contacting on the phone number provided both on website and mobile application.

The booking for a handyman will require a basic description of the customer request the price will be shown according to the task. Minimum charges applied will be Rs. 500 while in areas like Defense and LDA minimum charges will be Rs. 800 if the customer wants to get some other task done which is not in our list of services

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement:
content: As a student of computer science and a user of Android applications we were interested in development of such applications which will target a real-world problem and provide an elegant solution for it. The inspiration behind this was the difficulties one would face of finding a skilled person to solve the household issue. Currently people have no android based platform to get in contact with these handymen. Also, there’s no standard way to ensure that the handyman is of calibre and have performed well on past jobs . Moreover, the availability of them is also of concern along with no standardized charging. Furthermore, as scope of our website and android application is concerned, statistics indicate the trend of surfing internet on smart devices has seen a steep increase during past few years , also people prefer to use website for online shopping, hotel booking and other kind of daily routines . This trend is likely to continue due to drop in cost and availability of smart devices. Pakistan, being a developing country has huge potential in the field of mobile software industry and rise in smartphone usage is most likely to be a perpetual entity. To summarize above paragraphs, it is evident that such application shall not only be of benefit to end user but as well as increase the employment chances of skilled labour.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions and Constraints:
content: For our project of android handyman services certain assumpt ions were made which include that the web application is necessary part of our project with the help which we can fetch data and use in our mobile application. Each and every handyman connected with the service provider must have an android based mobile on which he will be notified in case of any orders assigned to him. • Handyman Services will not need to register the customer. • Milestones of Handyman Services will be developed by the developers as scheduled and explicitly mentioned in planning phase of this project. Constraints of our application include due to the limited storage capacity of mobile devices we cannot store large amount of data on them. It is compulsory for the user to have an internet connection all the time in order to get services and it is  also important for the service provider, because in case of the order cancellation from the user the service provider will be able to respond him quickly and address his other queries through CRM (customer relationship management).

heading: 1.5 Project Scope:
content: Handyman application will provide services to the local people who have handyman related issues at their houses both using website and android based mobile application. The domains used for this purpose are web and mobile application. The user can request for the required service using their mobiles having android handyman services installed on it and the service provider can easily track the details using mobile and web applications. It is aimed for such areas where people are so busy in the hustle and bustle of their daily life that they are unable to fix their household queries or tired of the behaviours of local handyman by installing this application on their smart phones. This project is intended to be completed and successfully deployed at the end of December 2017.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: As we directly jumped to the development task while ignoring the analysis efforts which were required. This took a lot of time and still we are unable to achieve our desirable objectives which were possible if we have not skipped that part of documentation . As far as lesson learned is concerned it is evident from our own experience that we should spend more time on requirement analysis before heading for the execution part. Also, finalizing this report was not an easy task. We have to work day and night to finish it properly. The first problem arises when we have to define the scope of android handyman services. Most of the time we all have need of electrician, plumber, painter etc., and we have to put lots of efforts starting from the bargaining until the job is done. We underestimated an easy solution to that problem from the start therefore we have to work hard on our Android Development Skills all of which we learn is from the internet. The second part of the difficulty includes when we have to gather th e requirement for software requirement specification (SRS). As there w ere no such users for this application so we have to start from the beginning by making the prototype first and conducting a Thinking Aloud test. In this test, we gathered some of our class mates and friends and recorded their videos how they will react to particular interface. The third part comes when we have to make sequence diagrams, activity diagram, use case diagram, use case descriptions and test cases. As this area covers lot of f unctions and actors the proper distribution of tasks was a complete headache. The major problem which we are facing these days is that as a student of university we were never offered with android development course and whenever we face the problem in deve lopment we have go to internet and search all by ourselves for the right solution which sometimes take 5 to 6 hours. These are some of the important problems which we have faced until this day. We consider them as challenges instead of problems and we learned from them more then we have ever imagined.

heading: 5.2 Project summary
content: Handyman Application provides users with a fast and reliable mean to contact best odd -jobbers around them. In Pakistan, for domestic job the selection of blue-collar workers has always been a challenging task . The main focus of this survey is to create our own mobile based android application where people can contact handymen. Handyman is a term used to describe technicians, including a Carpenter, AC Mechanics, Plumbers, Car Mechanic, Electricians and Painters. The application was developed using Android Studio, code is written using Java and Android SDK, and to store data of odd-jobbers SQLite was used. Research was conducted on the basis of similar work in the form of literature review and related websites. The inspiration behind this was the difficulties one had to face in finding a skilled person to solve his/her household issues. In Pakistan, there is no such Android based application available to provide ease to smart phone users.

heading: Introduction
content: Have you ever tried a car rental service before? If yes, you would be well aware of the problems that people face. The first problem is that you have to go the car rental organization which is a little inconvenient. Secondly, there are no standard prices f or any car rental services so you have to negotiate a price which can be a little exaggerating. Moreover, the most common problem is that many car rental organizations act like thugs and often show rude behavior and do not compromise on their rates. Moreov er, there is no way to ensure your safety and comfort. The driver you get might be unprofessional or have some bad habits like smoking which can be a little irritating in case there is no check and balance from the rental organization. The worst problem is that in most of the cases there is no standard to follow, and your ride can become your nightmare. Well the above stated problems are for the general people who are using car rental services. There are several problems that car rental organizations have b een facing. The first and foremost problem is that drivers often cheat their owners with fuel consumption and maintenance or car. Secondly, most of the cars you see in a rental organization show very poor performance because these cars are not maintained and tuned up on regular time. There is no way to monitor the activities of the driver who might be driving for his own benefit. Most importantly, an organization have to maintain all of their records and finances in a ledger register or they use a specialized software for that which is constantly causing them effort and money. Well to solve these above stated problems, we are initiating our platform Wheel Tracker. Wheel Tracker will solve all of the above stated problems in an efficient way. The first and foremost focus of any organization is on its customers. The customers will be able to book a car for rent in advance using our platform so that they never have to visit a rental organization ever again. Secondly, our platform has standardized the prices for each destination and defined everything in advance so that the customer does not have to spend a lot of time in negotiating terms. Moreover, our platform has set some standards which will ensure that you will be safe and secure in your ride and will enjoy a pleasant ambiance and professionalism. To facilitate the rental organizations, our platform will keep track of all the drivers and their locations while they are on a ride so that the respective organization can check whether the driver is following the authorized route or not. You do not have to worry about remembering the dates of services or mileage ever again because the smart algorithm of our application will calculate everything on its own and will alert you when your car

In admin panel the organization will be able to generate several reports including performance reports, revenue reports, salary reports, cost reports, etc. with the help of graphics and visual charts so that everyone can understand it in more depth. “Wheel Tracker” works with Google Maps to track your vehicles instantly or you can say “Real Time Tracking”. It does not matter where you are right now, you can easy get all information about your vehicle/vehicles in the palm of your hands within a matter of seconds. In short, you can just sit back and relax knowing that you your vehicle/vehicles are safe.

heading: MOTIVATION AND SCOPE
content: Let’s start with the simplest problem, many enterprises have faced this problem. Suppose you have a driver in an enterprise for a specific vehicle and he/she is on a tour. What if the vehicle consumed 20 litters of fuel and the driver mentioned 25 litters in his records to benefit himself. What would the enterprise do in such a situation? The enterprise’s owner would not know if the driver has cheated or not. In such cases, the enterprise would face loss while the driver benefits. Is there a way to catch such corrupt dr iver or control your losses?  Wheel Tracker is a smart application that provides you the solution of all above mentioned problems. Have you ever seen an application that lets you track your vehicle from anywhere in the city? Well, Wheel Tracker is the Android Application that allows you to monitor your vehicle within the palm of your hand, no matter where you are. It is as be neficial for an enterprise as for a common person. Means, if you own multiple vehicles or you have an agency, you do not have to worry about your vehicles, you can add as many vehicles as you want and track them easily with a friendly interface. So, the co re objective of the application is to improve the performance of your vehicle/enterprise while you just sit back and enjoy your cup of coffee. You may have seen many situations where the vehicles performance drops over time because of not fulfilling its ba sic service needs like changing engine oil, tuning up, etc. What if it is happening on an enterprise level and most of your vehicles are getting out of shape? Such an enterprise will eradicate in no time. That’s when Wheel Tracker come to play its part. Wh eel Tracker sends you alerts over time about your vehicle condition and reminds whenever it needs service. The smart features of the application enable you track that how well your car is performing. After driving a specific number of miles, you have to change the engine oil in order to maintain the performance of the engine

heading: Page 13
content: and the vehicle. Our smart application gives a warning sign beforehand to remind you that your car needs service. This warning sign is given almost 500 KM before the exceeding limit. However, it indicates a danger light only when the vehicle is overheated and you need to cool it down before using it in order to preserve sever damage. Wheel tracker would give the such alerts to admin or those who handle the system beforehand so that you c an decrease the load on engine in order to prevent the overheating. This feature will help to maintaining the good health of the engine. Furthermore, it sends alerts regarding regular maintenances including washing service, tune-up, oil change, etc. With the help of Wheel Tracker, you will never miss out maintenance services of the vehicle because it will keep bugging you till you do what must be done or force the app to stop it. Wheel Tracker offers a core feature named “Reports” especially for the busines s owners in Vehicle Rental Services niche. It shows that reports of the vehicle on monthly basis and helps you to improve organization performance. The reports include KM driven by a vehicle, Fuel consumption report, Expenditure, Earning, Profit/Loss and their ratio, Profit/Loss ratio as compared to previous month. heading: Problem Statement
content: Let’s start with the simplest problem, many enterprises have faced this problem. Suppose you have a driver in an enterprise for a specific vehicle and he/she is on a tour. What if the vehicle consumed 20 litters of fuel and the driver mentioned 25 litters in his records to benefit himself. What would the enterprise do in such a situation? The enterprise’s owner would not know if the driver has cheated or not. In such cases, the enterprise would face loss while the driver benefits. Is there a way to catch such corrupt driv er or control your losses? Wheel Tracker is a smart application that helps you keep track of t he driver and fuel consumption so that no driver could cheat you. You may have seen situations where a vehicle heats up and you have to wait for almost 30 minutes to cool it down. What if it happens to be in a dangerous area where you cannot stay that long  because it’s dangerous? Furthermore, what if the there is a problem with the engine and your car may go in fire? Surely, nothing is more important than life. There is no such system that alerts you beforehand in such conditions. That’s is when the Wheel T racker come to play its role. Wheel Tracker sends such warnings beforehand so that you may overcome them and keep your life.

heading: Project Scope
content: Wheel Tracker is the Android based Application that allows you to monitor your vehicle within the palm of your hand, no matter where you are. It is as beneficial for an enterprise as for a common person. Means, if you own multiple vehicles or you have an agency, you do not have to worry ab out your vehicles, you can add as many vehicles as you want and track them easily with a friendly interface. So, the core objective of the application is to improve the performance of your vehicle/enterprise while you just sit back and enjoy your cup of coffee. Suppose you have a business of rent a car and you have to monitor drivers, vehicles performance which drops over time because of not fulfilling its basic service needs like changing engine oil, tuning up, etc. What if it is happening on an enterprise level and most of your vehicles are getting out of shape? Such an enterprise will eradicate in no time. That’s when Wheel Tracker come to play its part. Wheel Tracker sends you alerts about driver’s activities, your vehicle condition and reminds whenever it needs service.

heading: Project Summary
content: The trend of online is on fire in this modern era. Everything is online, we have been through several situations where finding an Online Rental Company becomes impossible. There are no standard prices for any car rental services so you have to negotiate a price which can be a little exaggerating. Moreover, the most common problem is that many car rental organizations act like thugs and often show rude behavior and do not compromise on their rates. Moreover, there is no way to ensure your safety and comfort.  Even if you get these services somehow, you will have to pay extra charges. We introduce Wheel Tracker. Wheel Tracker is an Android application. Wheel Tracker will solve all of the above stated problems in an efficient way. The first and foremost focus of any organization is on its customers. The customers will be able to book a car for rent in advance using our platform so that they never have to visit a rental organization ever again. Secondly, our platform has standardized the prices for each destination and defined everything in advance so that the customer does not have to spend a lot of time in negotiating terms. Moreover, our platfo rm has set some standards which will ensure that you will be safe and secure in your ride and will enjoy a pleasant ambiance and professionalism.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: This project is funded by a Onzite Digital, a Norwegian company. The company is making a series of recruitment software’s for different business branches in Scandinavia. This project is a part of that software product series. The aim of this project is to build Vikarpool Hotel Application. It is a cloud based system that would help companies to hire people with relevant skills in hotel industry in the specified region at any time. The administration panel will control the working and information of its users. Our company have their  own  administration panel so we don’t have to work on that. We just have to build a system that have two modules in it i.e Leader/Recruiter and Applicant. The hiring companies can register themselves in this application after buying this application and premium services using PayPal method. Company will give their Hotel Branch Number for registration because there can be different branches of one hotel. The cloud based web system would have digital CVs of the job seekers available 24/7. If some person or worker is on leave or can’t come, hiring company can post a job here describing the specialities and skills they need for this job to be done. Company can also specify the region where they want the work to be done so that only people who belongs to that region contacts. Relevant clients contact them or they contact those applicants that are of their interest. The hiring companies could find the right applicants based on skills, location, interests, education and experience easily. The applicants can register themselves by giving all the information about them. They can upload their     CV, specialities, interests other documents and their availability etc. They can search for jobs here describing the category they want to work in or have speciality in. If they find a suitable job according to their loca tion, interest, skills  and needs, they can apply for that job by sending Job request. They can also communicate directly with that company and recruiter. Company can hire them easily without any inconvenience.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: A large group of recruiters and applicants in hotel branch are tired of long recruitments processes in the country. The main goal for developing this application is to reduce recruitment process time and make it easy for companies to hire quickly. This is the reason this application is not a general recruitment platform. It is a specified application for hotel domain. The business objective of this web application is to earn from recruiters by saving their time with the help of this service. Our System will  help to avoid unintended  consequences as well as help of Recruiters to backtrack jobs from Recruiter hotel to applicant or vice versa in case of any inconvenient result. There are lots of problems which make it necessary to track hotels, jobs and applicants for safety reasons. Every single department i.e. Administration, Recruiter and applicant will play a vital and significant role in implementing this procedure .

heading: 1.3 Problem statement
content: This is a foreign company project. We are developing this system because the recruiters and applicants are no more want the long and hectic recruitment process of their country. Recruitment process normally takes 2 months from an interview to receive a job.  Many losses have been occurred due to this long process of hiring. At times, Company needs someone to join ASAP so that their company keeps running without any inconvenience and loss. But the process of hiring sometimes takes longer than usual and Company keeps on suffering . It is also difficult to find the right available person in the specif ic region of  Norway .So that is why this particular system will be developed which will reduce recruitment process time, and make it easy for companies to hire quickly.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions &constraints
content:  This proposed application will allow the user to install the product without any difficulty.  The developers will deliver the milestones and deliverables as per time mentioned in the plan.  No new external hardware will be required to install the application.  A centralized database system will be designed by us who will keep record of every user.  These records involve every isolated step of creating jobs, registering users etec  All Departments will be responsible of updating the record at each single transaction.

heading: 1.5 Project scope
content: It is expected that the Di gital Recruitment Systems empowered by A rtificial Intelligence would replace the recruitment agencies by 2020. We believe that this product has a scope and demand in the country.

content: First of all, we tested each and every critical unit of our web application. Most of the units worked as expected however in some units we faced a few bugs (that have now been solved) such as:  “Documents uploaded” message has been shown but  document was  not getting stored in database.  New user was not able to apply for a job.  System was opening the same link in another browser tab.

heading: 5.1.1 Problems Faced
content: As our project is client -based and our Client’ s Company is in Norway. So the big problem was how to communicate with our client on regular basis? We find so much difficulty in communicating with Client because of different time zones and their availability. They were not ready to communicate with us regularly because of their busy schedule. Because of lack in communication , we were not clear about our requirements.  We have to work/make changings  multiple times according to the need of client whenever we did communication. This process continues throughout the whole duration because we were only clear about the requirements they gave us during our first meeting. A big question was raised which tool and platform should be used. After long debate and analysis with client it was decided that project should be web based. Client’s requirement was to use Java Springs, Thymleaf MongoDB(nosql) as database. It was a big challenge for us to learn a new language and practice it in a bit of professional way as students. Th is period of actual product development was  more difficult than requirement s gathering and other analysis because we have to learn a different platform from scrap. We faced so much difficulty in learning this new language as these languages are new in industry and we didn’t get any proper guidance about it. There is so much less work done on this so we won’t be able to get its tutorials easily .It tool us a month to learn its basics and then we got able to start working on it. Every task took longer than usual to get finished . Mongo DB database is efficient but difficult to deal with. We can not make relationships in this so it was difficult to get all the fields on right place so that it makes relationships among them automatically . It was a big issue for us, how to create database model and test it s reliability. Database was created at -least 20 times but it could not meet our satisfaction level. We had finalized database models a fter one month of immense hardworking. Another main problem we have faced is the problem in connecting our UI with this database. We had to use JavaScript and Ajax at some places but Thymleaf does not support these languages so our whole template were broken. But after working so hard , we were able to make a good coded application Testing was not performed by us ever before that but it was compulsory to write proper test cases and perform them accurately. The m aking of the use  cases, collaboration diagram, a ctivity diagram, sequence diagram and class diagram was a tiredness procedure itself.

heading: 5.1.2 Lessons Learned
content:  We learned new languages; Java Springs, Thymleaf and MongoDB which is so efficient  We learned to skim required information from collected data.  We learned to analyze data on the basis of requirements.  We learned that how websites are working in Norway.  We learned that how people of Norway works.  We learned how to make a big application for an organization.  We learned how to write documentation.  We learned how to make a good team and work with a team.  We learned how to integrate database with a project.  We learned about database modeling.  Similarly, we also learned about website designing & development.  It was a big issue to write Queries but we learnt noSql Queries which made our work easier.

heading: 1.2 Project Summary
content: The basic purpose of this project is to build a Website that can hire people in the relevant people for suitable jobs. This project is funded by a Onzite Digital, a Norwegian company. The company is making a series of recruitment software for different business branches in Scandinavia. The aim of this project is to build Vikarpool Hotel. It is a cloud based system that would help Companies to hire relevant people in the region. Admiration panel will handle all its users.The cloud based web system would have digital CVs of the job seekers available 24/7. Applicants who want to seek jobs register themselves to get latest job posts. The hiring companies could find the right applicants based on skills, location, interests, education and experience.

Company gives their Hotel Branch No for registration because there can be different branches of one hotel. The cloud based web system would have digital CVs of the job seekers available 24/7.

They can also communicate directly with that company and recruiter. Company can hire them easily without any inconvenience.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: The prevalence of mobile devices has given rise to a lot of images pro cessing applications that benefit our lives. Applications are getting smarter and smarter to serve humans even better than ever. In this project, we try to build an application that will translate words, sentences, paragraphs and even pages of book in eith er image or text format from English to Urdu with greater precision of accuracy. The most common way of translation on mobile device is either typing the words into a dictionary or using a search engine to find the result, which make them inconvenient for the user. Therefore, we come up with the solution in the form of mobile application that besides this will also identify the font in an image correctly using the latest techniques. The following are the characteristic features of the application:  The user can either take a picture directly using the camera of the phone or can select image from the gallery. The input file can be in text format as well. It is all up to  the user whatever method he/she wants to use.  If the input is in image format, then it will  be first converted to text format file by identifying and recognizing characters present in that image.  Translation of the whole detected text will be displayed by the application with following functionalities: o User can choose from multiple translation options on selection o He / She can edit the translated file manually that will be learned and saved by the application for future use in Pdf format.  The user can identify and change the font of the text in the image.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: To develop an android app lication that will facilitate and enable the users to identity fonts and translate text from English to Urdu, whether selected individual words, a sentence or a paragraph in an image. In Pakistan the educational system is more dependent on institutes of Urdu Medium language and religious madrasas, due to which  students f ace difficulty while learning English contents and literature,  at higher levels of education so our application help those students by providing English to Urdu .If Designer want to identify f ont while editing in text picture our app will identify the font and solve his/her problem. For common people who want to get English to Urdu translation, our application will provide this facility to those people so they can cope with these problems and w ill be able to do well in society and will feel confident. There are number of applications that are providing English to Urdu translation facility, the most popular of which is google translator. But, until now there is no such software that is performing the translation directly from the image. So, our objective is to provide this facility to students and other people.

heading: 1.2  Problem Statement
content: In Pakistan dominance of English language is prominent and is causing linguistic elite over most people who did their studies in Urdu. The  method of  instruction in the state schools is Urdu medium while the ambition is to get good command over English language. This method of teaching is creating problems in effective education system and causing barrier to progress of th e whole State. Students learning in English face major problems in slow progress in reading, writing and difficulty in understanding the content . In most of the cases the family back ground discourages the student from effectively communicating in English language. This is not only causing problems in getting good education but also one of the major issues that our youth is jobless because the limited seats available are occupied by the giants who have references and have good communication skills in English language because they have studied in costly private institutes. We are losing most of the creativity of Pakistan’s youth due to this barrier. Currently, government is planning strategies to widen access to the English language through upgrading state sc hools to English medium but still the content is uneven, and the quality of education is still not enough to cope with the problem and learners are not able to make basic progress in English language. At Present, it is necessary to gain skills in English language to any kind of job in the civil service. The use of mobile phones is increasing dramatically, that is why we suggest domesticating English language through our application. The second problem that we are trying to solve through our applicat ion is faced by the profession of designing. The use of font is very crucial in designing but when designer come across a font best suiting his/her design, he/she needs to see some expert to get it recognised but it is not the case most of the time. Mostly people wonder how to get it done and post on different websites seeking a solution. Here we took a stance to solve this issue by get the font recognized through the small device almost everyone keeps along with them. We purpose a reliable and efficient way of recognizing font style through the font recognition functionality in our application.

content: Applications these days are regularly updated with the change in technology, software-based upgrades are very costly . Every time an upgrade is needed the team will have to integrate that change with previous features intact.

heading: Time Restrictions:
content: We are developing two applications with two main features i.e, Font detection and Translation.We had a plan of doing cloud computing and making a data server and web-based application but due to the time limitation we have planned this part for future work and are only working on android applications and research work for now .

heading: Project Quality Control:
content: There is no such mobile app that is doing 100% font detection. There are some web applications that detects font but they give you four to five options that are similar to your text's font. in our project we are trying to achieve 80% to 85% font detection if we will not be able to achieve this than we are not managing our product quality, so this will lead to our project's failure. Dynamic nature of Project: Research and development Projects are usually dynamic in nature, as they may require more time to review the literature and other work done in this field . It may also happen during the review session of our project that some additions features are to be included or some of them may be removed. Depending on the time needed to accomplish and complexity of these additional tasks the project will be in a threat of delay in delivery time;  moreover, the resp onsibilities of the member may change  from time to time and team members may have to learn new skills and techniques that can increase the complexity of the project.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: Designers have been known to choose fonts for designing projects like the wa y we choose an outfit to wear. Font chosen represents and emphasizes the contextual meaning of the document. Therefore, it is very important for the designers to choose correct font for their projects. But problem occurs when a designer finds a font used i n some text that is perfect for his/her project, but he/she does not know the name of the font. Although, there are some sites that are doing the job to guess what font is being used in the image, but until now there is no such android application that giv e the facility to take picture and get instant results, that is the reason we are adding this feature to the application. The school level education system of Pakistan can be divided into following three categories on the bases of instruction medium being used.  The government vernacular -medium schools with Urdu and regional languages  as their medium of instruction.  English medium schools which teach almost all the subjects in English language.  Religious seminaries(madrassa) However, there is no other medium of education other than English at university level. As for as English medium Students feel relatively fewer problems in coping with environment but Urdu medium and madras sa students feel more difficulties because lectures being delivered, and the books being used  are in English  language, so they face many problems in understanding contents. This is one of the major issues  that Pakistan is unable to yield from majority of the genius minds. We are developing an application that will help that kind of stude nts to cope with

heading: Abstract
content: The Internet of Things (IoT) technology has revolutionized the retail industry by providing innovative solutions for improving customer experience and increasing operational efficiency. One such solution is the IoT based automated shopping cart, which combines IoT devices and sensors to automate the shopping process. This paper reviews the literature on IoT based automated shopping carts, with a focus on their benefits, challenges, and future possibilities. The benefits of IoT based automated shopping carts include increased efficiency, reduced checkout times, and enhanced customer experience. On the other hand, challenges include high implementation costs, privacy concerns, and technical difficulties. Case studies of successful implementation in retail stores demonstrate the potential for IoT based automated shopping carts to transform the retail industry. In conclusion, this literature review highlights the promising future of IoT based automated shopping carts in the retai l industry. With the integration of advanced technologies such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, these shopping carts have the potential to revolutionize the way customers shop and retailers operate. vi Table of contents

heading: 1 Introduction
content: 1.1 Brief System Overview. The IoT-based Autonomous Shoppin g Cart is a smart shopping system that utilizes the Internet of Things (IoT) to provide customers with a convenient and efficient shopping experience. The system consists of various components that work together to achieve its purpose. [1] The shopping cart itself is equipped with sensors, and other technologies that allow it to interact with its environment and the shopper. For example, t he shopping cart uses RFID scanner to detect the items being added or removed, and sensors to track the cart's location and movement. [2] The data collected by the shopping cart is then transmitted to a central system, which could be located in the store or in a cloud-based environment. The shopper can interact with the shopping cart through a mobile app or a touch scree n interface on the cart itself. This allows them to view their shopping list, add or remove items, and check out using a secure payment method. [3] The autonomous shopping cart also has the ability to navigate the store autonomously, using a combination of sensors to avoid obstacles and navigate to the correct aisle. This eliminates the need for the shopper to push the cart and reduces the time and effort required to complete the shopping trip. [4] In summary, the IoT -based Autonomous Shopping Cart provid es a seamless and efficient shopping experience by leveraging IoT technology to automate various aspects of the shopping process. The system uses sensors, algorithms to interact with the shopper and the store environment, providing a unique and innovative shopping experience. Figure 1-1:Abstract Design of Cart [1].

1.1.1 Problem Statement. Shopping Malls are beneficial because all necessities can be found in one location rather than driving for hours to buy different products. People go to malls to buy products they use every day. We've seen long lines in the shopping centre that take a long time. People face many problems while shopping, such as worrying about the money they brought or having insufficient information about the products. [5] People also have difficulty finding the location of a specific product. Products are placed in a trolley after they have been chosen. They finish their shopping and proceed to the billing counter to pay. The products are scanned with a barc ode scanner and the bill is generated. This takes a lot of time and makes the line at the counter exceedingly long. [6] The idea we propose is called the Smart Shopping Cart. A barcode scanner is mounted on the shopping cart's top. The trolley has a product tracking system installed, and when a consumer searches for a product, the LCD displays the product's location guidance. Customers use barcode scanners to scan products. A microprocessor compares the product's barcode ID with the database to obtain inf ormation about the product, such as name and price, which is then displayed on an LCD. For solo shopping, the planned trolley also has a feature for online bill payment. [7] The cart will be ready for the next round of shopping once the consumer has paid t he amount. An autonomous shopping cart that follows a human customer around a store and assists with carrying items could improve the shopping experience and potentially increase efficiency for both the customer and the retailer.[8] However, implementing s uch a system would require addressing a number of technical challenges, such as creating a reliable and safe navigation system, ensuring the cart is able to follow the customer seamlessly, and integrating with the store's existing infrastructure and system s. Additionally, there may be privacy and security concerns with collecting data on customer behaviour and storing it on the cart's IoT devices. [9] 1.1.2  Solution to the Problem. A potential solution to the problem of creating an IoT -based smart human -following cart could involve the following steps:

Navigation system: A navigation system would need to be developed that allows the cart to follow the customer smoothly and safely through the store. This could involve using sensors and cameras to track the cus tomer's movements, and algorithms to plan the cart's path and avoid obstacles. Integration with store infrastructure: The cart would need to be integrated with the store's existing systems, such as its inventory management and payment systems.

heading: This
content: would allow the cart to automatically update the customer's shopping list and calculate the total cost of their purchases. Billing Management: The cart's billing system would need to be integrated with the store's inventory management system, allowing it to p rovide accurate pricing information for items and keep track of product availability in real-time. User interface: A user-friendly interface would be required for the customer to control the cart and view their shopping list. Smart carts may move independently and use path planning to explore and understand their surroundings. The robot is then given a path to follow as it moves around the area.

Movement control in an IoT -based human following smart shopping cart typically involves the following steps: Human Follow : This involves using sensors to detect the human shopper and their position. Movement Control : This involves controlling the motors or actuators of the cart to move it along the planned path. This may involve feedback from sensors to adjust the movement in real-time.
