heading: 2 Literature Review
content: Studies and research related to IoT -based smart interactive shopping carts with billing management systems have been conducted to improve the shopping experience of customers and to reduce the operational costs for retailers. These studies have focused on the following areas: User Interaction: Research has been conducted to explore the use of interactive displays, touchscreens, and other technology to provide customers wit h a better shopping experience. Billing Management: The carts linked with app (developed on android dev. framework or Web app depending upon resources and efficiency) which automatically provide online methods of payment and automatic registration and upd ating of the designated inventory for which the system is deployed and registered to function has also been designed. Navigation: Smart shopping carts equipped with GPS and other navigation systems have been developed to help customers navigate through th e store and find the products they need. Product Recommendation: Some studies have explored the use of machine learning algorithms to recommend products to customers based on their shopping history and preferences. Inventory Management: The use of IoT te chnology in shopping carts has been explored for inventory management purposes. This can help retailers track the movement of products and reduce stock levels. Overall, these studies have demonstrated that IoT-based smart interactive shopping carts with b attery management systems have the potential to significantly improve the shopping experience of customers and to reduce costs for retailers. Previous research on smart shopping carts with billing management has focused on improving the overall shopping e xperience for customers. This has been achieved through the integration of various technologies such as computer vision, machine learning, and data analytics. The main objectives of these studies have been to increase efficiency and accuracy in the billing  process, reduce long checkout lines, and provide customers with real -time information about prices and product availability. Some studies have also explored the use of smart shopping carts for personalized product recommendations and targeted marketing ca mpaigns. In general, previous research has

shown that smart shopping carts with billing management can greatly enhance the shopping experience for customers and increase operational efficiency for retailers. Following literature survey provides the idea given by papers: Table 1: Analysis of research work previously done. The Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized various industries, and one area where it has shown significant potential is in smart shop ping carts. IoT -based smart shopping carts aim to enhance the traditional shopping experience by integrating technology to provide interactive features, automate billing processes, and improve overall customer satisfaction. This literature review explores the existing research and developments in IoT-based smart shopping carts, highlighting their key features, benefits, challenges, and potential future directions.

heading: 1. Interactive Features and Product Information:
content: Many studies have focused on integrating int eractive features into smart shopping carts. These features include touch -screen displays, RFID scanners, barcode readers, and product information displays. Choi et al. (2018) developed a smart shopping cart that

displays product details, nutritional infor mation, and pricing on an integrated screen, allowing customers to make informed decisions. RFID scanners enable seamless product identification and tracking, enhancing inventory management and reducing checkout time.

heading: 2. Autonomous Navigation and Object Detection:
content: Autonomous navigation is another area of interest in smart shopping cart research. By incorporating sensors and computer vision techniques, smart shopping carts can navigate through aisles, avoid obstacles, and follow customers. Jena et al. (2019 ) proposed a system that uses ultrasonic sensors and machine learning algorithms to enable autonomous navigation, ensuring a collision -free and efficient shopping experience. Object detection techniques, such as computer vision and LIDAR, have also been ex plored to detect products, shelves, and people, providing a more intelligent shopping cart.

heading: 3. Billing and Payment Systems:
content: Efficient billing and payment systems are crucial in smart shopping carts. RFID technology enables automatic product recognition, s implifying the billing process. Wang et al. (2017) designed a smart shopping cart that calculates the total bill in real - time based on the scanned RFID tags, eliminating the need for manual scanning at the checkout counter. Some studies have also explored cashless payment options, integrating mobile payment platforms and e -wallets for a seamless transaction experience.

heading: 4. Data Analytics and Personalized Recommendations:
content: With IoT capabilities, smart shopping carts can collect and analyze customer data to provide personalized recommendations. By tracking purchasing behavior and preferences, smart shopping carts can suggest complementary products, discounts, or personalized offers. Chen et al. (2020) proposed a data -driven model that uses machine learning al gorithms to generate personalized recommendations based on customer profiles and historical data. This enhances customer engagement and provides a more tailored shopping experience.

heading: 5. Challenges and Future Directions:
content: Despite the advancements, there are challenges to be addressed in IoT -based smart shopping carts. These include privacy concerns related to data collection, integration with existing retail systems, and scalability. Future research should focus on developing secure data management frameworks , interoperability with different retail environments, and incorporating emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and augmented reality to enhance the shopping experience further. IoT-based smart shopping carts offer immense poten tial to transform the traditional shopping experience. Through interactive features, autonomous navigation, efficient billing systems, and personalized recommendations, these smart carts aim to improve customer satisfaction, streamline operations, and enha nce retail analytics. While there are challenges to overcome, ongoing research and technological advancements continue to drive innovation in this field. As IoT technologies continue to evolve, we can expect smart shopping carts to become an integral part of the retail industry, revolutionizing the way we shop.

heading: 3 Project Design
content: The system is designed to provide convenience and ease to customers in their shopping experience. The cart is equipped with various sensors and motor drivers to ensure autonomous mo vement and obstacle avoidance. Additionally, it has a billing management system that utilizes an RFID card scanner, NodeMCU, and TFT display. 3.1 System Design. The system design is based on an Arduino microcontroller, which serves as the brain of the shopping cart. The cart has two modes of movement: manual and autonomous. In manual movement, the user can control the cart's movement using a joystick or a mobile application. In autonomous movement, the cart moves on its own using sensors and motor drivers. 3.1.1 Obstacle Avoidance and Human Following. The cart is equipped with various sensors to ensure obstacle avoidance and human following. The sensors used in the project include Ultrasonic sensors, Sharp IR sensors, and PIR sensors. Ultrasonic sensors are used for obstacle avoidance as they have a long range and can detect objects from a distance. Sharp IR sensors are used for human following as they are more precise and accurate in detecting human presence. PIR sensors detect heat signatures, which h elp avoid any object detection that would allow the cart to move randomly. 3.1.2 Turning Parameter Sensors. Turning is a critical function of the shopping cart. The project has used laser sensors, which provide negligible delay in real -time measurement, enabling precise and accurate turning for the cart. 3.1.3  Battery Management System. The cart requires a battery management system to ensure uninterrupted operation. The system is designed to provide autonomous feedback and return to the charging stati on when the battery is low. Additionally, the project has developed an appropriate battery management system for the cart.

3.1.4 Billing Mode. The billing management system uses an RFID card scanner, NodeMCU, and TFT display. The system records the produ ct details through RFID scanning and sends the data to a database via a web app or APK. The system displays the product details on the TFT display and calculates the bill amount. 3.2 Hardware Architecture. The IoT -based smart shopping cart utilizes vari ous components to achieve its objectives. Here are the specifications of the components used:

heading: 3.2.1 Arduino Mega:
content: The main controller board of the system is the Arduino Mega, which has 54 digital input/output pins, 16 analog inputs, and 4 UARTs (hardwar e serial ports). It also has a clock speed of 16 MHz, 256 KB of flash memory, and 8 KB of SRAM. The Arduino Mega is used to control the motor drivers, sensors, and other components of the system. The Arduino Mega is a microcontroller board based on the ATm ega2560 microcontroller. It has a wide range of input/output options, making it suitable for complex projects. The board also has a USB connection, which can be used for programming and serial communication. Figure 3-1: Arduino Mega.

heading: 3.2.2  Motor Drivers:
content: The motor drivers used are the L298N, which is a bipolar stepper motor driver. The motor drivers can control the motors' speed and direction and support a maximum current of 2A per phase. They have a voltage range of 8V to 35V and microstepping resolution of up to 16 steps. The L298N motor driver is a bipolar stepper motor driver

that can control the speed and direction of a stepper motor. It uses a pulse -width modulation (PWM) technique to control the motor's speed and microstepping to achieve smooth motion. The driver can also protect the motor from overcurrent and overtemperature conditions.

heading: 3.2.3  Motors:
content: The motors used in the shopping cart are DC motors with a voltage rang e of 6V to 12V and a maximum current of 2A. They are used to drive the wheels of the cart and enable it to move in different directions. The DC motors used in the shopping cart are typically geared motors, which provide a higher torque output for their siz e. They are often used in robotics and other motion control applications. The voltage range of 6V to 12V is suitable for battery-powered systems. Figure 3-3: Gear Motor.

heading: 3.2.4  Ultrasonic Sensor:
content: The ultrasonic sensor used is th e HRS -504, which has a detection range of 20cm to 500cm. The sensor has a working frequency of 40kHz and can detect obstacles in the path of the cart. The HRS-504 ultrasonic sensor is a low-cost sensor that uses ultrasonic waves to detect the distance between the sensor and an object. It emits ultrasonic waves and measures the time taken for the waves to bounce back to the sensor. The detection range of 20cm to 500cm makes it suitable for obstacle detection in the shopping cart. Figure 3-4: Ultrasonic sensor.

heading: 3.2.5 Sharp IR Sensor:
content: The Sharp IR sensor used is the KYA02A, which has a detection range of 10cm to 80cm. The sensor can detect human presence and can be used for human following. The KYA02A Sharp IR sensor is an analog sensor that uses infrared light to detect objects. It emits infrared light and measures the reflection to determine the distance between the sensor and an object. The detection range of 10cm to 80cm makes it suitable for human presence detection. Figure 3-5: Sharp IR sensor and connector.

heading: 3.2.6  PIR Sensor:
content: The PIR sensor used is a heat signature sensor that can detect human presence and prevent the cart from colliding with people. The PIR sensor is a passive infrared sensor that detects heat signatures. It c an detect human presence and movement by detecting changes in the infrared radiation emitted by a person. The sensor is often used in security systems and other applications where motion detection is require Figure 3-6: PIR Sensor.

heading: 3.2.7 Laser Sensor:
content: The laser sensor used is the VL503X, which has a detection range of 10cm to 200cm. The sensor can be used for turning the cart in different directions and provides a precise and accurate measurement with negligible delay. The VL503X la ser sensor is a time-of- flight sensor that uses laser light to measure the distance between the sensor and an object. It emits a short burst of laser light and measures the time taken for the light to reflect back to the sensor. The detection range of 10cm  to 200cm makes it suitable for precise measurement and turning the cart in different directions.

heading: 3.2.8 RFID Card Scanner:
content: The RFID card scanner is used to scan the RFID tags attached to the products in the cart . The scanner used in the shopping cart is an RC522, which supports the MIFARE family of RFID cards. The RC522 RFID card scanner is a low -cost RFID reader that supports the MIFARE family of RFID cards. It uses electromagnetic fields to communicate with the RFID card and can read data from the card without physical contact. Figure 3-8: RFID Scanner and card.

heading: 3.2.9 NodeMCU:
content: The NodeMCU is a microcontroller board based on the ESP8266 WiFi module. It is used to connect the cart to the internet and send d ata to the cloud. The NodeMCU is a development board based on the ESP8266 WiFi module. It has built -in WiFi and can be programmed using the Arduino IDE. The board is commonly used in IoT projects and can connect to cloud services such as AWS and Azure.

heading: 3.2.10 TFT Display:
content: The TFT display used is a 2.4-inch touch screen display that displays the product details, cart status, and bill amount. The TFT display is a touch screen display that uses thin - film-transistor (TFT) technology to display images and text. It has a high resolution and can display color images and videos. The touch screen interface allows users to interact with the display and navigate through the cart's features and functions. Figure 3-10: TFT touch display.

The Arduino IDE is an open - source software platform used for dev eloping and uploading code to the microcontrollers. The IDE provides a user -friendly interface that simplifies the process of coding and uploading the code to the microcontrollers. It also supports a wide range of libraries, which makes it easy to integrat e different components with the microcontrollers. Arduino IDE is a software application used for programming Arduino boards. It is an open -source integrated development environment that provides a simple interface for writing, compiling, and uploading code  to the Arduino board. The IDE uses a simplified version of the C++ language for programming the Arduino board. It includes a code editor, a compiler, a serial monitor, and a library manager that makes it easy to add libraries to your project. Figure 3-11: Arduino IDE Logo.

content: Visual Studio is a popular integrated development environment used for developing software applications. Visual Studio provides a powerful platform for coding, debugging, and

testing the backend code. Visual S tudio is an integrated development environment (IDE) used for developing software 21 applications for Windows, Android, and iOS platforms. It provides a rich set of tools for developing, debugging, and testing software applications. Visual Studio support s multiple programming languages including C++, C#, and VB.NET. Visual Studio provides features such as code editors, debugging tools, code completion, version control, and more. Figure 3-12: Visual Studio logo.

heading: 3.3.3  Flutter:
content: Flutter is a mobile app development framework used for building native mobile apps for iOS and Android platforms. In this project, Flutter is used to develop the mobile app that connects to the shopping cart and enables users to interact with it. The mobile app allows users to add items to their cart, view their cart status, and check out their items. Flutter provides a rich set of widgets and tools that simplify the process of bu ilding mobile apps. Flutter is an open -source mobile application development framework created by Google. It allows developers to create high -performance, visually appealing, and cross -platform mobile applications using a single codebase. Flutter uses the Dart programming language, which is designed to create high -performance applications with a focus on user interface (UI) development. Flutter provides a rich set of widgets and
tools for creating beautiful UIs, as well as a hot reload feature that allows d evelopers to see the changes they make in real-time Figure 3-13: Flutter logo.

heading: 3.3.4  MongoDB:
content: MongoDB is a NoSQL database used for storing and retrieving data. In this project, MongoDB is used to store the data received from the shopping cart and mobile app. The database stores information about the products, users, and transactions made using the shopping cart. MongoDB provides a flexible and scalable platform for storing and retrieving data, making it an ideal choice for this p roject. MongoDB is a cross-platform, open-source document-oriented database management system (DBMS). It is designed to store and manage large volumes of data using a flexible document -based model. MongoDB uses a NoSQL approach, which means that it doesn't  use the traditional relational database model. Instead, it stores data in JSON -like documents with dynamic schemas, making it more flexible and scalable. MongoDB provides features such as automatic sharding, replication, and indexing for high availability  and performance. It also provides an API for accessing data using popular programming languages like Java, C++, and Python. 4.2.1 Movement preferences. Movement preferences play a significant role in designing and implementing systems that involve autonomous or  manual movement. Understanding and accommodating movement preferences are crucial for ensuring user satisfaction, safety, and efficiency in various applications, such as robotics, smart carts, and autonomous vehicles.

heading: 1. Manual Movement:
content: Manual movement refers to the ability for users to control the movement of a system directly. This movement preference allows users to have hands -on control and navigate the system according to their desired path and speed. Manual movement is often preferred when users ne ed precise control or want to override autonomous behavior. It provides a sense of control and flexibility, allowing users to adapt to changing circumstances or make specific adjustments as needed.

heading: 2. Autonomous Movement:
content: Autonomous movement refers to the  system's ability to navigate and operate independently, without direct user intervention. Autonomous systems rely on sensors, algorithms, and decision -making processes to analyze the environment and make navigation decisions. This movement preference is o ften preferred for applications where continuous monitoring, obstacle avoidance, or repetitive tasks are required. Autonomous movement offers convenience, efficiency, and the potential for optimized resource utilization. In the context of the project, the  choice of movement preferences for the smart interactive and retrievable shopping cart can have important implications for the user experience and overall functionality. The implementation of both manual and autonomous movement modes allows for versatilit y and adaptability in different scenarios. Manual movement provides users with the ability to control the cart directly, enabling them to navigate through the store, choose their desired paths, and make specific

adjustments when necessary. This manual con trol can enhance user engagement and satisfaction, as it gives them a sense of control over their shopping experience. On the other hand, autonomous movement capabilities offer several benefits. Sensors such as ultrasonic, infrared can be employed to enab le obstacle avoidance, collision prevention, and efficient navigation within the store environment. Autonomous movement can optimize the cart's path, reduce user effort, and enhance overall efficiency in large retail spaces. Finding the right balance betw een manual and autonomous movement is essential. The system should provide intuitive controls for manual movement while ensuring that the autonomous mode is reliable, safe, and capable of adapting to dynamic environments. Implementing movement preferences that cater to user needs and preferences can significantly enhance the overall functionality and usability of the smart shopping cart system. 4.2.2 Product scanning and Billing. Product scanning and billing are essential components of the implemented IoT -based smart shopping cart system. These functionalities have been designed and implemented to ensure seamless and efficient tracking of products, as well as accurate and convenient billing for customers.

heading: Product Scanning:
content: Figure 4-3: User Interface of movement modes.

The implemented system utilizes RFID technology for product scanning. Each product is equipped with an RFID tag containing unique identification information. As customers place products in the shopping cart, the integrated RFID scanner reads the RFID tags and retrieves the corresponding product details from the connected database. The implementation ensures that the product scanning process is quick, reliable, and accurate. It eliminates the need for manual barcode scanning and minimizes the chances of errors in product identification. The real -time product information is then displayed on the cart's TFT panel, allowing customers to view the details of the  scanned products conveniently.

heading: Billing:
content: The billing process in the implemented system is designed to provide a seamless and convenient experience for customers. As products are scanned and added to the cart, the system automatically calculates the total bill amount based on the price s associated with each product. The billing implementation focuses on accuracy and transparency. The accumulated bill amount is continuously updated and displayed on the cart's TFT panel, enabling customers to keep track of their expenses in real -time. Additionally, the system offers self-checkout functionality through a mobil e app, allowing customers to review the bill amount, select their preferred payment method, and comple te the transaction hassle-free. The implemented billing system ensures accuracy by integrating the product database with the pricing information. It elim inates the need for manual calculations and reduces the chances of billing errors. By providing a user -friendly interface and seamless checkout process, the system enhances customer satisfaction and minimizes waiting times at the point of sale.

4.2.3 Battery monitoring and status (BMS). A battery management system (BMS) plays a crucial role in monitoring and controlling the performance, health, and safety of a battery. It ensures efficient utilization of the battery's capacity, prolongs its lifespan, and provides accurate information about its state of charge (SOC), depth of discharge (DOD), battery life, and health. In the provided code, an ACS712 current sensor is used to measure the current flowing in and out of the  battery. By converting the analog reading from the sensor to a voltage value, and applying appropriate calibration and correction factors, the code calculates the state of charge (SOC), depth of discharge (DOD), battery life, and battery health.

heading: 1. State of Charge (SOC):
content: The state of charge represents the battery's current energy level as a percentage of its total capacity. It is calculated by dividing the voltage measurement obtained from the sensor by the battery's nominal voltage and multiplying by 100. This parameter gives an indication of how much energy is remaining in the battery.

heading: 2. Depth of Discharge (DOD):
content: The depth of discharge refers to the amount of energy that has been consumed from the battery, represented as a percentage. It is calculated as the difference between 100 and the state of charge. DOD provides insights into how much energy has been utilized from the battery. Figure 4-4:TFT Billing GUI

heading: 3. Battery Life:
content: Battery life estimation is crucial for determining the remaining usable lifespan of the battery. In the provided code, the battery life is calculated by dividing the current battery capacity by the current state of charge, taking into account the current flowing in or out of the battery. This estimation provides an approximation of how much longer the battery can sustain its desired performance.

heading: 4. Battery Health:
content: Battery health reflects the overall condition and performance of the battery. It is calculated by dividing the current value (obtained from the ACS712 current sensor) by the sum of the current batt ery capacity and a correction factor. This calculation gives an indication of the battery's health as a percentage, where higher values indicate better health. The battery management system based on the ACS712 current sensor and the provided code enables the monitoring and assessment of important battery parameters. These calculations help optimize the battery's usage, prevent over -discharge or overcharge, and ensure the battery's longevity and reliability. It is important to calibrate the sensor and fine-tune the correction factors based on the specific characteristics of the battery being used to achieve accurate and reliable results. heading: Abstract
content: The World Health Organization (WHO) reported that there are 285 million visually -impaired people worldwide. Among these individuals, there are 39 million who are totally blind [1]. Around 1.6 Million people in Pakistan are visually impaired  [2]. There are no proper means to let them interact with the latest technology that may be useful in performing their daily life activit ies. Different organizations like PAKISTAN ASSOCIATION OF THE VSUALLY IMPAIRED (NATIONAL) and AZIZ JEHAN BEGUM TRUST FOR THE VSUALLY IMPAIRED are working for the most deprived community of our country. Visually impaired people are mostly dependent on someone else in performing their day to day tasks. The proposed project aims to make them independent to its maximum. Instead of being a usual application to guide the user about traversing a path, this application will help the user to experience the real-time happenings and true colours of the world.  The project that we are initially working on is to develop an android based smart phone application for the visually impaired community. While using the application, the user will capture images through voice commands or gesture controls. The application will analyse and translate the images taken from a device to speech and describe what the person/s in the captured image is/are doing, how old they are, and what emotions they're expressing. The application w ill be controlled through voice as well as tap localization/ gesture-based commands. The user has to do nothing except giving voice commands/ gesture-based commands and use the smartphone for his/her needs. The application will also be able to read the content available on the screen with the help of tapping on the icon. From phone accessibility to scene description this application is a complete package for the visually impaired users. The proposed solution may not be able to give them their vision back to them but at least it can help them to experience what they are not capable to do.

content: Table of Contents Digital Assistant for Visually Impaired People .............................................................................. 1

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Visually impaired people face a lot of difficulties in experiencing the true colours of this world. Accessing a smartphone has become the need of time and they are not able to use it with ease. Hence, we are developing an application that will make mobile phone accessibility feasible for them. Our application will not only help them in using the smartphones but will describe the scenes captured through a camera with the help of voice directives. The developed project is an android application for the visually impaired community. This is not a simple path guiding device that will guide the user to turn left or right  when an obstacle is in the way but will help the user to be a part of the real world and experience what every other normal person can. This development will help them see this beautiful world with the help of an android application. Phone accessibility, scene description, facial recognition the whole ball of wax will be available for the users. Whether the user needs to access the phone or needs an explanation of the sight, the whole thing can be attained with the help of this android application. Using t his application, the users will access the smartphone with simplicity. While using the application, the users will capture images which will be analysed and translated to speech. The description of what a person(s) (in scene) is/are doing, how old they are , and what sentiments they're articulating, all will be conveyed to the user through voice. The application will be controlled through voice commands. The user has to do nothing except give voice commands and use the smartphone for his/her needs. Many of the android phones have the features of voice directives but most of them redirect everything to the internet making it a liability for the user. Samsung phones used to have an application that was used to control the device through voice commands but was  discontinued after their phone S5  [3]. The functionalities provided by these applications were limited i.e. they were only used to open a folder or reject and answer a call or set an alarm. The voice command feature in our app lication will allow the user to control the smartphone for all the needs from opening the folders to capturing images and describing them.

heading: 9 of 59  16 May 2018
content: From dialling contacts to reading the screen all can be done with the help of this assistant. We will also be integrating a screen reader that will make it a lot easier for the user to know what is on the screen by simply tapping on the screen. Applications have been developed in the past also but most of the applications performed single tasks i.e. screen reading, guidi ng through the way, facial recognition or currency detection. But our assistant is a complete package for the people in need, this application will provide the users with description of a scene, recognizing persons in an image and helping the user in easily accessing the smartphone. By combining APIs from Microsoft Cognitive Services with the imaging performance, a person who is visually-impaired can better understand who and what is going on around them. As explained in detail, our application is not a s imple guiding application or a single task application. This assistant will help the visually impaired users in many aspects of their life. They will be able to experience the outside world. This application will somehow add colours to their life. And also, this application will help them in using a smartphone just like ordinary people do. They will also be able to access a smartphone without any complications.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: To support the community that is not able to see the real world. To support the visually impaired people to let them participate in everyday life activities. Provide the users with a complete package to access a smartphone and enjoy the colors of real worl d without being the victims of inferiority complex. The major objective is to provide the visually impaired community with a platform where they do not consider them a class lagging behind and can easily compete and participate in everyday tasks without any obstacles. - Help the visually impaired person to easily access a smartphone. - Easily type and send messages. - Dial and Receive calls with ease. - Facial and Character Recognition. - Text to Speech Conversion For feedback. - Control the smartphone through Gestures/ Tap Localization - Control the smartphone through Voice commands.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: The purpose of the project is to create an application  for the visually impaired people  that will provide the basic functionalities  of a smartphone with on  screen gestures and voice commands. While using the application, the user will capture images with the help of voice commands or on- screen gestures. The application will then analyse and translate the captured images and narrate the content of the scene.

heading: Constraints
content: - Visually impaired persons cannot install the application themselves. - Developed for people having knowledge of Braille

heading: Assumptions
content: - No application exists providing all the services as a single package. - The application will meet with high acceptance from its users. - The application will be easily reachable to people willing to use it. - Availability of internet

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: Scope of this project is not limited; this project is not limited for present use but can be used in future for further works. Addition can be done in various ways to assist people who are visually impaired. The functionalities of this application are not limited. We will be trying to cover almost every phase including accessibility wit h the help of voice commands, scene description from images, screen reading.

heading: 2.1 Literature Review
content: An extensive literature survey has been carried out. The research papers published on technology for Visually Impaired are studied and enlisted as well as the existing solutions have been discussed.

heading: RESEARCH PAPERS
content: Sensor-Based Assistive Devices for Visually-Impaired People: Current Status, Challenges, and Future Directions: The World Health Organization (WHO) detailed tha t there are 285 million outwardly debilitated individuals around the world. Among these people, there are 39 million who are totally blind. There have been a few applications intended to help outwardly impeded individuals and to enhance the nature of their  lives. Shockingly, the greater part of these applications is restricted in their abilities. This paper examines subtle elements of the most noteworthy gadgets that help the populace and feature the enhancements, favourable circumstances, detriments, and precision. [4] Braille Touch Designing a Mobile Eyes -Free Soft Keyboard : This paper was published for a keyboard that supported braille in smartphones. [5] Visually impaired  Aid: A Self -Learning Braille Application for Visually Impaired : The designed application serves as Braille writing and reading tutor, so that anyone with visual impairment can improve their Braille writing and reading skills. The intended application takes the input from a user through Braille keyboard and produces the output in the form of an audible audio and it also has the capability to read text from the documents. [6] A wearable multipoint ultrasonic travel aids for  visually impaired: The authors of this paper propose a novel stand -alone Electronic Travel Aid (ETA) device for obstacle detection based on multi- sensing with the help of a  microcontroller. Movability, ease, reduced dimensions and cost are among the major advantages of the proposed application, which can detect and limit obstacles present in front of him/her. [7]

heading: 14 of 59  16 May 2018
content: A Navigation Application for the Visually Impaired: A Fusion of Vision and Depth Sensor : This research paper presents a complete navigation application based on low cost and physically unremarkable sensors such as a camera and an infrared sensor. The application is based around corners and depth values from Kinect’s infrared sensor. Obstacles are found in i mages from a camera using corner detection, while input from the depth sensor provides the corresponding distance. The blend is both effectual and strong. The application does not only identify hurdles but recommends a safer path that has no obstacles and tells the user when to stop or move. [8]

heading: EXISTING SOLUTIONS
content: MICROSOFT SEEING AI : Seeing AI is a Microsoft research project that brings together the power of the cloud and A rtificial Intelligence to bring an intelligent application, designed to help the people who have lost their sight. [9] Figure 1: Microsoft Seeing AI/Pivot head Talkback is an application that is part of Google’s Android Accessibility Service, designed to help blind and visually impaired users with using their mobile devices. Talkback helps people with visual impairment, they can listen to what they are doing with their mobile phone as the application will give them a feedback against each and every action performed. The application is also able to read text  available loud and clear  and every movement the user makes on her or his phone is monitored and spoken by the application. [10]

heading: 15 of 59  16 May 2018
content: LIMITATION: The gestures defined in this application are a bit difficult to understand and needs a little practice to get used to it. Moreover, the user has to use the normal QWERTY keyboard to type text messages. The IDEAL Accessibility Installer also known as the Platform Access Installer, was designed by Google to be a complete package of Google’s Android Accessibility programs. This application has correspondences for visually impaired people as well as those wh o are totally blind, this will help them get through with using their mobile phones. LIMITATION: This application does provide the basic functionalities of a smartphone but has no feature of scene description. i.e. images captured through a camera are not narrated to the user. MessagEase Keyboard  is a n easy  and quick approach to type full content on your Android telephone. Users of the application can type extremely quick messages by utilizing just a single hand or only one finger. The application is clear  and easy to understand  so clients don't have to battle with AutoCorrect. With MessagEase, clients can precisely type words as the console has vast letters that can without much of a stretch be seen. LIMITATION: The limitation of this application is that i t is used only for typing and sending messages. Be My Eyes – Be the eyes for a visually impaired person in need of help at all through a live video connection if you can see or be assisted by the link of users who can see if you are visually impaired. [11] LookTel: The Money Identifier App LookTel Money Reader identifies currency and speaks the value, enabling people with visual impairment to easily understand and count bills and money. [12] LIMITATION: This app only recognizes  currency and has to be installed and used with the interface provided by default which is not easy to use for the visually impaired. TapTapSee: Identify Objects Through Photos  TapTapSee is designed to help the blind and visually impaired identify objects they come across in their lives. Simply double tap the screen to take a photo of anything, at any angle, and hear the app speak the name of the object to you. [13] LIMITATION: Requires Voiceover to be turned on. This app is solely used to identify objects in a captured image.

heading: 16 of 59  16 May 2018
content: Georgie: Georgie is the first smartphone designed specifically for blind people. Other smartphones work for blind people in some ways but that doesn’t make it as easy to use as it could be. Georgie can be bought pre-loaded on a variety of phones or as part of an app package [14] LIMITATION: Pricing is the biggest limitation of the phone. Moreover, this application does not provide additional features, such as scene description and facial recognition. Users can buy a Georgie-specific phone for £299 (UK market only for now, it would seem), o r if the user already has a Droid, he/she can by the software for £149.

heading: Critical Analysis
content: All the Solutions mentioned have certain limitations  as discussed above . The applications mentioned above, even the GEORGIE smart phone app has a limited use. DAVIP will be covering all the aspects of daily life usage of a smartphone for the visually impaired people.

heading: 2.2 Stakeholders
content: The most important actor involved in our project is a visually impaired person. Visually impaired people have to face lots of problems in their daily life and having no or low vision. heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: Losing one’s sight partially or completely is difficult to imagine for most of the people but for millions it is the reality of daily life. Innovative technology is being utilized to make the day to day activities of visually impaired people easier. Therefore, we also came forward to work for the betterment of the addressed community and help them in their daily life activities.  This is not a simple path guiding device that will guide the user to turn left or right when an obst acle is in the way but will help the user to be a part of the real world and experience what every other normal person can. This development will help them see this beautiful world with the help of an android application. Phone accessibility, scene description, facial recognition the whole ball of wax will be available for the users.

content: In future, a message will be broadcasted and sent to friends and family of the visually impaired person in case of an accident. This will be done with the help of motion sensors of a mobile phone. Moreover, Real time scene description and real time tracking can also be done for making the application more and more efficient and helpful for the user. In future we can upgrade our product by introducing an additional functionality in which the application will include other languages including national language (Urdu) so that it may help the person(s) who cannot understand English.

heading: Abstract
content: In Pakistan, approximately 4.3 percent of the population is suffering from blindness and the percentage increases for the senior citizens. On international level, many products and gadgets are being developed to provide assistance to visually disabled persons. But such products are either expensive and out of budget or most of th em are heavy to carry. The actual motive behind the proposed project is to overcome the mentioned hurdles for the poor blind people in our country. Our project is targeted to benefit the community and will facilitate the visually disabled persons so that t hey can easily understand their environment and live their life independently. This will also be beneficial for the visually impaired people (partially blind). We are using raspberry pi for the needed processing along with a camera and a headphone. Camera will capture the scene, image will be processed and the system using headphones will narrate it to the blind person so that he/she can easily perceive and interpret his/her surroundings without someone’s help. In addition to that, user can also register the other persons by enrolling their pictures, so that next time the device can recognize the enrolled person and speak the name of recognized person. This project will provide aid to under -privileged visually disabled persons in Pakistan by providing them a deep solution so that their blindness does not become a cause of fear for them and their poverty does not stop them to explore and enjoy the nature.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: We have developed such a cost-effective and handy device, which will enable the blind pe ople to interact with the environment just like the normal people. The device comprises of a raspberry pi, camera, headset and the button. When the user press es the button, image is being captured by camera and send to the Microsoft Cognitive Services (API) for processing. The API processes the image, identify its contents (objects, people, their emotions, gender and estimated age). The API  returns labels, some description  and also the words or text ( in case of text reading) . API’s result then process and converts into a complete description which comprises of description of image contents, persons’ gender with their emotions  (if found) . Finally, that  description is transformed into a voice recording and then play through head phones for the blind person. The system also performs the functionality of person’s enrolment and recognition. User (visually disabled person) can enrol or register his/her friends, relatives or family members  in the system just by pressing button and capturing their picture and speak ing up their names.  System enrol people by making the templates of their facial features and saving the person’s name audio clip. The system performs facial recognition by comparing the templates of enrolled person’s with the target one. If the person get  matched with any registered person, then the system will play the audio clip of that person’s name , otherwise it will play a default voice that ensure that the target person is not enrol in our system. So, our product will describe the scene to the blin d person, read out the text documents, sign boards, enrol or register the people and recognize the identity of people found in a n image using face recognition.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: Below are listed the basic objectives behind our project:  Enable the visually disabled persons  to recognize the activities happening in their surroundings.  Deliver a cost-effective vision system for visually disabled people.  Provide light weight and portable device for all group of blinds to prevent them from exertion and burden.  Enable the user  to create images in their brain by getting knowledge about the people , their gender and expressions.  Create a device to enrol and recognize persons.  Create a device to read out the text, sign boards etc.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: “The project aims to provide a cost effective vision system implemented on a raspberry pi along with a camera and a headphone. This user friendly device will enable the visually disabled persons to live independently and enjoy the nature.”

content:  Availability of WI-FI  Power supply to Raspberry Pi  Proper lightening while capturing the image

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: Most of the people are working on different projects for helping out the blind people in understanding about their surroundings and environment. But our project will nourish the blind’s ability to recognize the person in front of him/her and keep the user u p-to-date with the surrounding events. The target of our project is to facilitate every blind person either technical or non-technical, educated or uneducated . That’s why, the design o f our product is quite simple as the user will have to simply press a button, after which the system will capture an image and ask the user regarding which of the four given functionalities to be performed:

heading:  Text Reading
content:  Enrolment of friends or relatives  Face Recognition of person found in an image

heading: 2.1 Literature Review
content: Microsoft introduced an AI seeing project [1] [2] for blind in which by wearing a smart glasses (Pivothead) a blind can touch a panel on eyewear to capture a photo then eyewear translates the image into speech after analysing it by using Microsoft Cognitive Services. The eyewear also describes the emotio ns of the people in scene and users can also take snap of the text so that eyewear can read text for the blind. The eyewear also describes the gender and expected age of the persons. Microsoft used smart glasses in this project due to which the product is highly expensive and is not feasible for common people. heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: Initially we were working with Windows IOT operating system for our raspberry pi. Windows IOT provides the windows 10 based operating system for raspberry pi. We want the raspberry pi to run the code independently but it seems not to be possible because using IOT you can only run the code remotely. Using the visual studio this thing was quite difficult to h andle it and also it was slow for working on it. We had already checked the working of our initial code now it has to be run on raspberry but due to above mentioned problem we were unable to assure the working of code on raspberry pi. After exploring we find that we can work on Raspbian operating system for raspberry pi that provides us the complete interface for working on it. After knowing the complete functional environment of Raspbian we switched from windows IOT to Raspbian Stretch operating system. By  making some general configurations we were able to test the code on raspberry pi and after all this we got the commendable results because Raspbian stretch is quite efficient and responsive as compare to windows 10. For project requirement we have to give  an audio input but unfortunately raspberry pi only provides the audio out we didn’t find any favorable way to give a voice input. We tried to use the sound card after inquiring this issue of subject and using sound card, raspberry pi enable us to give an audio input. We decided to use Sphinx a speech -to-text engine for voice input, it generates the text of your speech. Sample rate requirement for Sphinx is 16000 so we must have to make sure that the sample rate of audio input and decoder must be same. But decoder was decoding the sound at sample rate of 8000, we faced many problems while speech recognition process whenever we try to give the sound to Sphinx for recognition we get the mismatched results. For Sphinx the bit rate must be of 16 and channels mus t be 1. But in our case raspberry was not providing all these things, raspberry pi has pre-configured framework for sound named as Alsa. After going through the research of Alsa framework we find that if we edit the pre - configured files of Alsa for handing  sound then we can record the sound that will fulfil the requirements of Sphinx. Se set the sample rate of 16000 in the files of Alsa and recorded the sound at 16 bit rate and 1 channels after this Sphinx was able to recognize the speech. For recording sound at 16 bit and channels at 1 we used the package named SOX.

heading: Project Abstract
content: Pathology is the branch of med ical science that deals with the detection of diseases in the laboratory by using different methods. Pathologists have an important participation in detecting disease in vast areas of medical science. A pathologist is a medical person who detects several human diseases by performing different lab tests according to the requirement of the disease. Cancer is one of the most significant issues in the field of health that is increasing day by day. Among different types of cancers, breast cancer is one of leading cancer that is the cause of many deaths worldwide. Therefore early detection and medication according to that disease should be started timely. The impact of digital image processing techniques on society is enormous and is a huge component of science and technology. By using the image processing technologies our aim is to research and detect the nucleus from histopathological images and to provide a system that assists the pathologists in diagnosing breast cancer. The focus of this system is to help pathologists in accurate detection of the nucleus as early as possible. viii

heading: 1. Introduction
content: Cancer is one of the most serious problems in the health field. This is a disease that invades or spreads to different components of the body. Cancer cells have totally different sizes and few are larger than normal. Cancer c ells do not stop growing and keep doubling. They are abnormally shaped and the main part of the cell (the nucleus) has an abnormal development. Therefore early detection of cancer is very important to restore the health of the patient. There are many fatal types of cancer for example lungs cancer, colon cancer, breast cancer, leukemia etc. Breast cancer increases the growth of the cells to abnormal. It is the second most common reason for death in women. [1]Approximately 41,070 people died from breast cancer in 2017. Besides just affecting the body of the women, it also infects her mind. Early detection is a way for early treatment, good health, and better survival rates. Pathology involves the diagnosis of disease by examining surgi cally removed organs, tissues (biopsy samples). Surgical pathology involves microscopic tissue analysis where the tissue samples diagnose under a microscope. For cancer designation, pathologists manually examine biopsies to form diagnostic assessments. In labs, pathologists manually deal with cells and tissues structure under a microscope which is time -consuming. Pathologist puts a lot of effort on histology slides to detect cancer. By applying image processing techniques to microscopic images their efforts  can be reduced. Our objective is to design a system that upgrades the manual assessment of cancer cells to automatic assessment through the technique of image processing By this system, we can eliminate the cause of late cancer detection and also improve the accuracy of methods that are used by the pathologist in labs.

heading: 1.1. Background
content: Breast cancer is one of the most persistent breast cancers in ladies and the second major reason for women death. In 2017, around 252,710 new diagnoses of breast cancer were expected in women, and of the 40,610 women were predicted to die from the disease. [2]There's a good possibility of recovery if it's analyzed in its initial stages. We are creating an automated digital image analyzer system which can greatly assist pathologists. In comparison with a manual evaluation, which is cumbersome and time -consuming process, computerized approach to detect cancer provides a fast and accurate image analysis so that the pathologists can be relieved from tedious and repeated routine efforts. The manual image analysis has to face challenges in dealing with the complicated nature of histopathology and microscopy images, which may lead to the large inter-observer change of disease.

heading: 1.2. Objective
content: Our objective is to  design a system that upgrades the manual assessment of cancer cells to automatic assessment. By this system, we can eliminate the cause of late cancer detection.

heading: 1.3. Problem statement
content: The analysis of the histopathological image is done manually by the p athologist and other expertise to diagnose samples of cells in labs. The pathologist examines the tissue parts, change of cells in tissue, irregularities of cell shapes to detect cancer. This is very time-consuming because of the current manual system. To overcome this problem there should be a computer-assisted image analyzer.

heading: 1.4. Assumptions & constraints
content: Due to the limited time available for this thesis project, the project will not analyze different types of segmentation and detection techniques that a re used in image processing, it is not possible to implement all methods and to compare them. This is the desktop application and only pathologists can use this. Because they are the specialist who studies the cause of diseases. They find the disease by ex amining the changes in tissues and cells. Due to limited RAM of mobile, this application will not work on mobile phones. The size of the histopathology image is large that’s why this will not process in small RAM.

heading: 1.5. Project Scope
content: We are living in a coun try where the death rate is increasing significantly due to cancer with the passage of time. However, the disease can be cured with medicines if it is detected on time. Pathologists are overburdened due to manually detecting a symptom of cancer from histol ogy images. There is a lack of applications and systems to assists pathologists in accurately detecting cancer. Diagnosis at an early stage of the diseases is time -consuming due to various manual performing tasks in labs.

heading: 2.1. Literature review
content: Histopathology images play an important role in diagnosing a disease. They can provide depth knowledge for computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) that allows examination of digital images with a high process rate. Digital pathology which includes image analysis that helps pathologists in labs and patients to diagnose their disease at an early stage. This has attracted many attentions in each analysis and clinical applications. As compared with a manual assessment that is time-consuming, automatic detection methods offer faster results. The CAD will scale back the workload of pathologists and supply the correct results of diseases. This helps in treatments w hich will help the patients. The complicated nature of pathology and histopathology images are the challenge for manual analysis that is time taking for pathologists. An advantage of an automatic system is that it can provide accurate calculations related to the features of cells. Results that will diagnose from the system will help in clinical follow-up and so permits comparative study and potential prognosis and personalized medication. Nucleus detection that is considered as a basic part of automated image analysis in computer-aided diagnosis system. It provides quantitative analyses to gather morphological changes, like shape, texture, size, and other different options. However, it's tough to diagnose correct nucleus detection. First, pathology, particu larly histopathology, and research images typically exhibit background with several noises, blurred areas, introduced throughout image accession, and the difference between the foreground and also the background. Second, there exist important variations on nucleus size, shape, finally, nuclei clustered into groups that might overlap with each other. Several efforts are created to realize automatic nucleus detection and segmentation, getting to grab those challenges.

heading: 2.2.1.1. “Detection and segmentation of mitotic cell nuclei in breast histopathology images”
content: A study [3]proposed a method for the detection and segmentation of cell nuclei using breast histopathology images. This research is based on image processing techniques for the detection of cell nuclei, segmentation of nucleus, feature extraction and classification of the cells to separate them as cancerous or non-cancerous. The result is also dependent on the expertise and experienced pathologists. But still, pathologists used labor-intensive methods that are time-taking.

heading: 2.2.1.2. “Large-scale DNA organization is a prognostic marker of breast cancer”
content: Another study [4] investigated the changes in large -scale DNA cancer. Change in Nuclei is an indicator of cancer. In this research, they used the techniques of image processing to separate nuclei because the nucleus is the part which starts changing its structure in cancer.

heading: 2.2.1.3. “Breast Cancer Detection and Classification of Histopathological images”
content: Study [5] objective is to classify data of breast cancer using two training algorithms of image processing on histopathological images. This paper is a representation of a multi segmenta tion method and proposed research that gives a fast and accurate classification of breast cancer.

heading: 2.2.1.4. “Methods for Nuclei Detection, Segmentation, and Classification in Digital Histopathology
content: Study [6] research is based on th e detection of the nucleus from histopathological images. The nucleus of the cancerous cell starts changing. This research paper is purely based on nucleus classification, segmentation, and detection using image processing methodologies. 2.2.1.5. A Novel CAD System for Mitosis detection Using Histopathology Slide Images.

In this paper [7] Breast cancer detection system for the mitotic cell is proposed. With some special innovation in the image -based automatic analyzer is considered  in this research. In a pre - processing phase of histopathology image, it divides the input histopathology image more precisely, Filter name Anisotropic diffusion 2D is applied to them. Histopathological slides are converted to RGB contents in segmentation.  The mitosis and non -mitosis cells are separated in the next phase through their complete local binary patterns. Classification phase, pixel -wise and object-wise two then non -linear SVM classifiers are trained. Some object and region primarily based measures are utilized 2.2.1.6. Maximized Inter-Class Weighted Mean for Fast and Accurate Mitosis Cells Detection in Breast Cancer Histopathology Images. In this paper, [8] for histopathology slide a completely automatic technique is int ended for correct detection of cancerous cells from non -cancerous cells. In initial two strategies that are supported maximum is applied for segmentation and a different one for separation of cell division cell. Then a completely unique Maximized Inter -class Weighted Mean (MIWM) technique is projected that extract non-cancerous cells that end up in reducing the false positive cell division finding rate. Finally, employing a support vector machine (SVM) classifier candidates classified into cancerous and non-cancerous.

heading: 2.2.1.7. Automated mitosis detection in histopathology using morphological and multi-channel statistics
content: features. This study proposes [9] a work that includes statistical analysis and morphological features to detect channels of various color spaces that help pathologists to detect cancerous cells. In the first phase, to detect and divide candidates they perform thresholding, morphology, Laplacian of Gaussian and active outline model on the image. In the candidate classification part, total 143 features of morphology and second order texture in channels are performed. Classification performs by tree classifier for each candidate in selected channels and finally categorize using decision tree classifier.

heading: 8.3 Summary
content: Breast Cancer systems are application software which is made for pathologist’s use. This system is used for detection of a nucleus. If a disease is present then our system will highlight the area of a nucleus in an image. We will try to reduce the complexities that existing manual systems have so that our system can be used easily and we will provide a user -friendly interface which can be easily used by pathologists in labs. The main focus  of our system will be to detect the change of nucleus which can be helpful for pathologists in making the decision and it will be helpful for them to separate the nucleus from other cells. Our system will have the key specification of being an interactive, user -friendly interface for pathologists with fewer complexities and easy to use. Our system will generate results about the image which will be helpful to determine how much benefit our system is to use. The aim behind this project is to develop a system that assists pathologists in diagnosing Diseases. This system is basically designed for the detection of the nucleus in breast cancer. The desktop application interacts directly with the pathologists.

ASM Report For HR FYP – Report

heading: Abstract
content: The issue of employee ’s performance is very supreme in any local organization. Employees Performance will be increased if they follow the organization rule. If employee performs any incident that breaks the rule of organization so it will affect the organization popularity. The basic purpose of this project is to make a system for any local organization that will Generate ASM report. In this web application admin can add misbehave of employee in the form of screen shots that will be taken manually. For Example smoking is not allowed in an organization and any employee violate that rule so admin will add incident against that employee in the form of screen shot and 1 or more incidents will add against the employee. This system will also maintain the Employee attendance, keeping record of their arrival and departure time from the work field.

heading: 1.1 Project overview
content: The purpose of this project “ASM Report for HR ” is to increase employees performance by creating ASM report that will be generate on the basis of  employee incidents.That incidents will save in form of screen shots that will taken manually.To increase Employee performance we take the employee attendance(check in and check out time will be calculated ) by integration of finger print sca nner. Employee attendance list will also help to increase employee performance.It is an  important task for the betterment of an organization and maintain the  work and generate their daily,  monthly and annua lly basis performance reports by analysing their working hours, their arrival and departure time from the work field and their attendance. Employee can check in and check out many times in a day and working hours will be calculated according the attendance. A web app that will provides local organizations, industries, offices, banks to examine their employee ’s performance and generate their daily, monthly and annual basis reports by keeping in view of t heir performance and working hours, which help organizations to become efficient, boost their work and help them to minimize the man force which they had hired to mark attendance, keeping record of employees arrival and departure from the work field and generate hand written reports which is time consuming and less efficient.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: The main objective of this system is to analyse the employee performance within a local orga nization, and generate reports on daily, monthly and annually basis by keeping in view of their working hours and their performance. This will ultimately help to differentiate the lazy and work-shy employees or workers from the organization and helps organization to make strategies and plans to get efficient results from the employees by analysing their performance. This system will help to maintain the log files of workers and employees work, which later can be analysed and help to generate reports. As in many organizations they have to hire people for keep tracking or examining the workers performance, activities, their attendance and even their arrival and leaving time from the work field or office, which increase the organization resources and budget and also is not very efficient and fast. So this system will help the organization to minimize their work force and make their processes efficient by keeping save incidents record of their employees and it also help organization to take dec isions about employees or workers promotion and devotion or even also help them to make better and good strategies to get efficient work.

heading: 1.2 Problem Statement
content: This is the modern era of technology which help people to reduce human efforts and minimize the workforce. In Pakistan, most of the organizations still not adopt efficient systems which track or anal yse their workers and employees performance. As technology is growing very rapidly, so local organizations are now turning to automate systems which minimizes their workforce and help them to get a work of ten employees or workers from a single efficient system. The organizations are hired workers to maintain the records of employees work, their performance, their attendance, their arrival and leaving time from the working field, and also for to generate their reports. As these all tasks are performed by manually so they are not so much efficient and even they are time consuming. It also sometimes give favour to other employees who are lazy and faineant. Hence, it is very mandatory to develop such system that can help organizations and high a uthorities of them to find and differentiate the lazy and faineant employees from the workforce, which helps to make organization resources optimize and efficient.

heading: 1.3 Assumptions and Constraints
content: It’s assumed that the admin is already created in the system and system require the backend database server for storing the records for different types of the employees or workers. If finger print scanner does not attach to the system then message will be shown “please open device first”. If user does not exist then message will be shown “user with this id not exist”. Only admin can register new employee and when employee will register the messa ge will shown “please enter your finger 3 times ”. After completion of registration employee can mark attendance.Employee can view all other employee Misbehave ’s but he/she can access only its own incidents. A centralized database system will be designed for generating ASM reports. The main constraint here would be the checking and the genuineness of the employee, which is done by verification method like finger print scanner. There can be no security risks involved.

heading: Abstract
content: The modern world has led people to think to invent novice things, for example, a number of PC games have been launched focusing the theme of fighting, entertainment, certain scenario, and war and so on. Game help think broadly, people, no matter what age of he or she, envisage into the management of conflicts and the achievement of peace. Nowadays, the most sensitive topic the people consider is “Religion”. Religion has played its great role in different geographies. Nevertheless, most of its concepts are still vague. People are either extremists or ignorant taking the religion one of the most preferable priority over humanity in their life. To help people think critically and out of box, the game “Aman” is introduced with the practical examples. It aims to promote interfaith harmony , peace and humanity  by eradicating stereotypes for instances; difference on religion, superstitions, unfamiliarity with background of religions etc.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: The idea of this game comes from purpose of promoting peace and interfait h harmony by educating people of different religions. Although education has its great impact to help people change their thoughts yet not everyone come s under its influence. However, this game totally focuses on one and only idea i.e. “to promote peace”. The game “Aman” will be a 3D game. The genre will be story based game. The game starts with a n introduction and  short story of a background of a poor illiterate family consisted on only two people husband and wife in village. They gave birth to a kid who had angelic eyes, supple reddish lips, intellect powers, blond forehead, and shiny scalp but because of excessive poverty they leave the child in th e street. The sweet crying like melody attracted to orphanage owner and finally he adopts the child. After t he 7 years, he is trained there and given basic education and finally he becomes able to read and write. Observing people from outside windows of his room and following the code of conducts of orphanage escalate his thirst to find out answers that why some people wear cap, put on orange clothing while praying, go to temples, churches or mosques, and some shake hand while greeting and some bow down. The child starts his journey of quenching the thirst. The superstitions, talisman, mosques, churches, temples , different religious and philosophical books provokes him to reveal secret behind these biases. When child asks to caretaker of orphanage about religions then the game starts with a voice of caretaker of orphanages. The game starts by the voice of careta ker the child transported into its voice. The child visits all religious places in chronological sequence according to a village map and voice of caretaker. Once, he is done with vising one place, he is obliged to visit next in order to complete mission. S ubsequently, other missions will be added such as; talisman, superstition, stereotype and rituals. At the end of game , he finally becomes liberal,  have knowledge of every religion and love to follow humanity by helping others.

heading: 2.7 Software Development Life Cycle
content: The SDLC that I plan on using for the development of th is game is the agile model. This is a grouping of iterative and incremental process models. In the agile model a working product is provided after each iteration; this is the basic reason behind choosing this model. It is also best suited because it will be relatively quick and as we have time const raints to finish this project I would like to have working versions available. By usin g this model I would be developing game in stages with every working version having more features than the previous one. This would largely decrease the complexity of the project and after each iteration I would be able to get feedback from users on any possible shortcomings which I would then be able to improve in the next iteration. By doing this the product that I would get at our final iteration would be one that would have all the features initially planned for and any variations that would arise when getti ng feedback from the users. Due to the fact that I am going to be getting working versions after every iteration it insures that at no point in time would I  be completely blank or have nothing to show for our efforts. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Nowadays people prefer to buy online rather to stand in queues at the checkout counter at the supermarket. Online shopping is a growing trend; it has reduced the crowd at the supermarket. It is convenient and can be fitted around busy lives. This project is an online grocery shopping web application for the people who want to shop at ease. Our web application will potentially reduce the inconvenience of grocery selection by eliminating trips to physical stores. It will theoretically enable the consumers to shop much more quickly than to shop at physical stores. Business decision can be made by the report which this web application will generate giving information of the peak selling hours of the products. It will be helpful for the managers to make any business decisions. The user will have to login to his/her account that has been already created before. After user has logged in, user will be able to search his/her desired products from the vast variety of the products. The selected products will be added to cart and the cart can also be updated as required by the user. Then the user will checkout either by online payment or paying cash on delivery. The products will be delivered at the doorstep of the user. The minimum amount (in terms of money) of the products that can be purchased will be defined by the business people and managers. The recipes will al so be provided on this web application and the user w ill select the quantity to cook for any recipe and the products and its quantity required respectively to cook food will be calculated and the total amount (in terms of money) will be shown. The admin will be able to login to admin panel. This will allow the admin  to add, update, delete and view the information about the products . The admin can view the order info rmation i-e the user/customer who has placed the order, time to deliver, etc. And will manage  accordingly. The admin can set the next delivery time to deliver the products. This online grocery store provides recipes and its cooking videos which will be the icing on the cake for the people who like to try new things and cook food for themselves. The user just needs to browse the website and select a food from a vast variety of cui sine and simply by one click all the ingredients required can be ordered. The web application will enable the users to buy in bulk and save money as buying in bulk cut grocery prices. It will also save fuel costs as the order will be delivered to the doorstep. The online grocery store will benefit the users in many other different ways.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: The consumer which cannot go to the supermarket (like old citizen, busy housewives) or does not like to stand in queues and avoid crowded supermarkets can get their groceries at their doorstep. Other objectives are: • Employment opportunities will be created. • To provide easiness to the people in grocery shopping. • Save energy consumption like fuel costs etc.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: Grocery shopping is a very hectic task. Grocery shops have become so crowded that you have to think and analyze the appropriate time to visit the store. Moreover, person with disabilities face challenges at thes e physical stores. It is time consuming and s ometimes at weekends ( peak and busy days) finding a parking spot at these stores is a challenging task.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions and Constraints
content: The project is chartered assuming that: • We assume that the grocery store data is provided. • Record of people’s personal information (includes phone number, address and email etc.) • Constraints are that project will be under the policies of the university.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: • The user will be able to shop hassle free for grocery sitting on his/her couch. • The user can get any groceries at his/her doorstep through this web application. • Report will be generated on daily basis of the orders on our web application. • On the basis of report, by viewing order, we can estimate peak hours of the consum ers buying the products. • The web application will show the promotions and discounts on the specific products. • These will also help business people/ managers to grow their businesses. • The grocery stores using this web application will deliver the products to the customers. • The customer can view the recipes, its cooking method  (text and visual)  and order the ingredients required to cook that. • The online payment method as well as cash on delivery is available. • The customer can reorder his previously ordered products. • The user can give the feedback which will be helpful for improvement. • The delivery slots will help the users to order with ease.
