heading: 2.6 Software Development Cycle model
content: There are numerous Software Development Cycle Models that are utilized all throughout the world, each of the techniques comprises of its own advantages and disadvantages. Our project can have no single software development  life cycle applied to it to maximize the development procedure. So, we have chosen a combination of the iterative as well as the as the RAD/Prototyping model as our project’s SDLC.

heading: 2.6.1 Waterfall Model
content: A normal programming development project involves the wat erfall model. The Waterfall Model is a flow in a single direction; linearly and in which the progress flows just like a waterfall downward steadily through the software implementation. In the waterfall model, another phase cannot be started until the previous state/ phase is not finished. The waterfall model comprises the following steps:  The previous built applications and systems are assessed and there are of lack is studied by talking to the users of the application are the requirements of the application are gathered.  By collecting the requirements a design is made that will help to overcome the issues in the previous application and systems.  By collecting the requirements and generating the design of the application the application is developed.  Before it is released it is checke d and tested under various experiments, the client assesses its ease.  Once the application is completed, it is assessed altogether. If any sort of change or adjustment is required the client is informed otherwise the application is released after a fruitful testing.

heading: 2.6.2  Iterative Model
content: The iterative model is used to overcome  the weakness of the previous waterfall development model. It an extensive form of the waterfall model but it works in an iterative fashion to overcome the issues left in the previous cycle. In the iterative model, the process is followed again and again until the required outcome isn’t achieved.

heading: 2.6.3  Rapid Prototyping Model
content: By keeping in view the limitations of the project, Prototyping/Rapid Application Development Model is applied to our project. By keeping in view the time, functional and non-functional properties it sets best on the project. It refers to creating the prototyping of the software applications. It is used to visualize some components of the application before starting actual development. It helps to determine specifically what stakeholders want from the product.

heading: 2.6.4 Justification
content: Interviews and Surveys were collected from different people. Using the results requirements were collected. Different existing systems were studied and by analyzing the existing systems the functionalities were recognized w hich needed to be provided. By analyzing the existing systems we got the idea and established a list of the basic user interface and the functionality we needed to provide to the user of this application. As we moved above the basic functionality; the user  requirements changed every time a new interview was conducted. So, we concluded that the requirement is variant with time and users. They had to be updated again and again according to the time. And in keeping in mind the time to time variations of the system; the best model we came up with a model that is a combination of the iterative, waterfall and the rapid prototyping model. Initially, we followed the prototyping model; constructing the high fidelity and the low fidelity view of our product and evaluated it on the basis of our basic requirements. And if any changes are required we change it according to the changing needs. After the high fidelity, we follow a waterfall model iteratively. And generates the actual product and follow the iterative approach and remove the errors and defects of the last iteration. The Life Cycle used for this project comprises of the following stages:

heading: 2.6.4.1 Planning
content: A wide perspective of the application is set up and planning is done before the creation of the application. All the problems are assessed beforehand. We assessed all the previous applications and research work is done on this nature and created a plan that would solve out the issues encountered by the users in the existing systems. After continuous meetings, we have gathered the objectives of our project.

heading: 2.6.4.2 Requirements Gathering
content: By accessing the prerequisites under consecutive meetings and gatherings the objectives have been collected. We have collected surveys and interviews to collect our requirements by accessing the needs and the requirements of the users. By collecting the user requirements and needs, and assemb ling the gathered user requirements together we calculate a traceability matrix. Whereas the functional , as well as the non-functional requirements of the project, were gathered by continuous interaction with the users. We have also accessed the current systems and the issues in those systems and then came up with the requirements that fit what our users want.

heading: 2.6.4.3 Design
content: The requirements collected provide a contribution to the design of the project. The design phase is worked by keeping in view all the necessit ies of the project. The functional and non-functional requirements contribute majorly in defining the design of the application. We designed our application by creating a low fidelity at first and then made the users access it and by continuous changing moved on to the high fidelity design of the application which helped us design the application according to what the users wanted.

heading: 2.6.4.4 Development
content: Once the designed elements were approved they serve d as an input in the development process. Each design element forced into producing more software artifacts. content: We are following the MVC (Model View Controller) architecture as our system architecture for this project. Using the MVC architecture the java files are used to define the user interface (UI) whereas the data is stored on the server and for storing data on the server SQL server is being used. As the MVC architecture divides our application into three layers/parts which are connected to each other. F irst of all, Request to process or perform a specific function is sent to JAVA class by the user interface (UI). Then the request is transferred to the third layer of the architecture that has the database system; where the request is accepted and possible actions in return for the request are applied. Model stores all the data whereas the view gives a presentation layer and data is retrieved using the controller’s commands.

heading: 3.4.1 Architecture Description
content: While designing our system we analyzed many architectures that could fit our system but the MVC based architecture fits on our application the best. The system architecture of our application is discussed below:

heading: 3.4.1.1 Model view controller (MVC)
content: Model View Controller (MVC)  is a software architecture  that comprises of three layers that are Model, View, and Controller. The MVC is a software architecture pattern that separates the information and data representation from the front end. Each of the layers has information in it. It defines the roles of the objects and the  way the objects would communicate with each other.

heading: 3.4.1.2 Model
content: Model in the MVC architecture is just used to represent the data. Its main functionality is to maintain the data. It has a direct link to the database. To process any data or information from the database the model is used due to its linkage with the database. So, to use the data from the database firstly we interact with the model. The information retrieved using the controller commands is stored in the model.

heading: 3.4.1.3 Views
content: Views are the front end of the system the user interface. It handles the data and displays the data to the user through the user interface. The view is the most important part of the system.  The front end of the system has great value as the user has to interact with t he system using the user interface that is the front end of the system. In a system view is the only part that is visible to the user and user communicates directly with the view and performs an action on the system through the view. The user interface mus t be defined in such a way that it is user-friendly; that is understandable by the user and according to the user requirements and demands.

heading: 3.4.1.4 Controller
content: The controller provides commands. It processes and accepts the request of the user and performs the action required on it. The controller interacts with services and controls the

heading: 68 of 101  17 May 2018
content: flow of application execution. The controller has all the functions, which are used for viewing purpose. The controller in our system provides Java-based methods allowing our system to retrieve the data and knowledge from the database that is required to perform the  tasks. The controllers offer with high-level queries providing transparency between the data and the action of the data (the usage of data). The collector layer collects  and filters the data from the database. Using the user interface and pages the query is performed on the data the controller manages the query performed and sends it further on to the business layer where the database is used to fetch the required data an d the fetched data from the database is furtherly returned to the controller and the controller returns back to the front end of the system (user interface).

heading: 4.2 Testing
content: Different tests are performed on the system to check if the system matches the requirements and the criteria in the requirement specification Document. The test includes unit, Integration, and acceptance testing

heading: 4.2.1 Unit Testing
content: In unit testing, the small parts of the system/ application (called the units) are tested one by one to check if they provide the proper functionality. Every module of our project/application has been made by keeping forward the software requirements specification report. Testing is done during the development of the application. For a project like ours to check our necessities, every module is tested individually to affirm that there is no error or bug or any execution breaks. So, while building our project, continuous revision and testing of the product is done. All the modules that we integrate and assemble in this project will go through various testing to assure that the quality of the project stays. We have assured to provide the requirements for maintaining the quality of the system by performing tests individually. The modules that are to undergone through testing phase are:  Data collection  Server-side connectivity  Algorithm testing  Graph generation  Job recommendations

heading: 4.2.2 Integration Testing
content: After the integration of all the modules integration testing is applied on as a whole. heading: 5.1 Tool Used
content: We are using the tool Weka (Waikato Environment for Knowledge Analysis) for applying data mining techniques to our dataset.

heading: 5.1.1 Weka
content: Weka is a data mining open source software that was made by as a result of a project by the professors and the researches of “ The University of Waikato”. Weka was made by an objective to make machine learning techniques generally available and to contribute to a theoretical framework for the field. It is a java constructed tool. Weka is basically a data mining tool. Data mining is to explore the vast data and to classify and summarize the data from a different point of view [8]. For data mining, Weka contains different applications such as Explorer, Knowledge flow, Experimenter, Workbench and Simple command line interface (CLI). The algorithm can either be directly applied to a dataset or called from our own Java code. It contains tools for data pre -processing, classification, regression, clustering and association etc.

heading: 5.2.1 Data Collection
content: We have gathered our data from the LinkedIn website with the help of web crawlers. We collected the data from the profiles of current working employees. We have collected as a total of 1000 piece of information and the data set furtherly comprises of 200 samples from PTCL, 200 samples from Telenor, 200 samples from Jazz, 200 samples from  Netsole and 200 samples from TERADATA. The dataset furtherly has been divided into training and test set. We have used cross-validation for training and testing of the data.

heading: 5.2.2 Features Extracted
content: We collected all the data of the employees; that includes his achievements, experiences, education, and skills. Firstly we consider the employee's experiences in the industry. That is the person’s current working experience, months working in the current company, total months working in the previous companies. These features indicate the person’s work experience in the industry. Secondly, we explore the skills from the personal profile of the LinkedIn account of the person. The number of skills a person has with the number of endorsement of each skill is taken into account. We also take in account the person's academic attributes like the person’s educational degree and academic institution from this undergraduate level to the graduate and postgraduate level. Some personalized attributes are also collected including th e person’s gender, his linguistic skills and achievements including the number of courses projects done and the certifications gained. We have also collected the description given on LinkedIn profiles. In summary we have collected those employee’s data that have a working experience in any of the five companies, that are multilingual and have another achievement i.e. has done

heading: 5.3 Models
content: The classifiers we have used on our dataset comprises of:

heading: 5.3.1 ZeroR
content: One of the simplest classification algorithms is ZeroR which relies on the target and ignores all other predictors. It simply predicts the majority class. It is used as a baseline model. It can be used as a benchmark for other classification methods.

heading: 5.3.2 OneR
content: OneR (One Rule) is a classifier which creates one rule for each predictor in the dataset. It creates rules that are simple for a human to interpret. A frequency table is built for each predictor a gainst the target. The most frequent class is counted and the rule assigns the value of predictor to this class. The next step is to calculate the total error of rules of each predictor. Then the rule having a minimum error is selected.

heading: 5.3.3 Random Forest
content: Random Forest is an ensemble learning method for both classification and regression problems. The first random decision tree algorithm was created by Tin Kam Ho.

heading: 86 of 101  17 May 2018
content: It is a supervised classification algorithm which creates a multiple numbers of decision trees and then uses the voting system to get the final prediction.

heading: 5.3.4 J48 Decision Trees (C4.5)
content: A J48 decision tree is a predictive machine learning model which was developed by Ross Quinlan. It is the improved version of algorithm ID3. J48 builds the decision tree based on information entropy. At each node, this algorithm chooses the attribute which more effectively splits the set of samples into subset enriched in any class.

heading: 5.3.5 Naïve Bayes
content: Naive Bayes is a supervised learning method which was proposed by Reverend Thomas Bayes used for clustering and classification of the data . It works on Bayes rule of conditional probability and uses each variable of the dataset individually. While classifying instances this method considers all attributes equally and independent to each other. The results are then produced by calculating probability gained from each attribute.

heading: 5.3.6 Support Vector Machines(SVM)
content: Support vector machines are supervised learning methods which are used for classification and regression. The best thing in SVM is we can use different kernels to transform problems. Kernels equations arrange the data instances to separate them from each other. Support Vector Machines methods are very powerful learning methods and usually show good results than other classifiers.

heading: 5.4 Algorithms used
content: The algorithms we have applied are:

heading: 5.4.1 Bagging
content: Bagging is an ensemble method meta -algorithm, that was proposed by Leo Breiman in 1994. Bagging Predictors generate multiple versions of a predictor and use those multiple predictors to create an aggregated predictor [9]. It is used to lessen the variance, improve accuracy and, to avoid overfitting. Bagging creates separate samples of the dataset and creates a classifier for each individual sample. The results are calculated for the separate classifiers and they are combined together by averaging the output or the voting [10]. Bagging increases, the accuracy of the classification but in our dataset bagging has decreased the accuracy. The maximum accuracy achieved without using bagging was 74% if we apply bagging than out result decrease significantly which affects our final outcome so, bagging cannot be implemented on our dataset.

heading: 5.4.2 AdaBoost
content: AdaBoost is a machine learning algorithm that was proposed by Yoav Freund and Robert Schapire, It is used with other machine learning algorithms to increase the performance and accuracy. AdaBoost works by assigning equal weight to each instance and choosing a base algorithm. On each iteration, we increase the weight of the incorrectly

heading: 87 of 101  17 May 2018
content: classified instances. The algorithm is iterated n times and the base learner has applied again with the updated weights. AdaBoost is used to produce a strong and classifier or accurate prediction by combining the weak classifiers and rules [11]. It is a self -adaptive algorithm. We have applied AdaBoost on our dataset; one of the dataset with description and the other without description. On our dataset adaboost worked better when we applied it on the dataset with description as it increased our accuracy. AdaBoost worked better while working with the string type attributes.

heading: 5.5 Cross-validation
content: Cross-Validation is applied to the dataset collected to extract information and make predictions. It is used to validate the results and to get a better accuracy and assures that your model is giving an unbiased result. We have used the k -folds method on the dataset which 10 folds; which divides our dataset into 10 subsets. One subset of the dataset is used for testing the data while the other sub  sets are used for training and this activity is performed 10 times (number of folds) on the data, selecting each different subset every time on the data. The n results are again averaged (or otherwise combined ) to produce a single estimation.

heading: Abstract
content: Employees are the most valuable asset o f an organisation. Every organisation has its own employee leave procedure for its employees .However, traditional leave management systems involve paperwork for employee leave/special vacation that is employee have to submit an application for vacation. T he application is then approved or disapproved. Moreover employees don't know about the status of their application while being processed. To provide ease to employee and remove paper work we are going to introduce online leave management system.  Here come s the Business Process Management that is for the improvement of this process . The whole process will be workflow based in which tasks and information is passed from one participant to another for some action.  In our system , employee have to login into sys tem & select apply for leave option. Fill the required form and send it for approval. This application would be receive by approval authority. Which may approve your leave or send it to another authority for further approval. So whole process will be workflow based, at the end decision that was made by approval authority on application would be sent to employee. In a result employees will stay tuned about the status of their application and the all the work is online which is time saving.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Technology is all around us which is providing ease in every situation .In this project we are going to introduce paper free process for employee leave management. Everyone wants to solve their problem technically. There is a headache in tracking the flow and managing the process when paper work is involved. So what we are going to  do is, remove the paperwork and solve this problem technically.  Workflow ensure that right work is done by the right person at right time, so we will use workflow technique to solve our problem. We are going to build an online system for comsats employee, so they can apply for leave online & avoid from traditional system. System will register employee & then enable employee to fill application form and attach required documents like medical certificate if leave is more than 5 days, if there is any duty/lectures of employee on leave then employee enable to provide alternative, employee enable to send request to alternative to take their responsibility , system enable alternative to s elect accept/reject for  request. After completion of form system enable employee to apply for leave. System will enable employee to view remaining leaves &  previous history of taken leaves. Leave form will fill by employee and it goes to HOD for verification. HOD will be allow to approve/ disapprove or send it to HR for further verification. As HOD, HR will be allow to approve/disapprove application of emplo yee & send it to Director for verification. That will last step of verification which leave have to pass from Director. Director will approve/disapprove and notify employee for final results. Every approval on leave system will update leave form  like if HO D approve and send leave to HR then system not ify employee that HOD has approved . Employees are able to see status of their leaves & system enable employee to check who disapprove your application.

heading: 2.1 Literature review
content: A HRMS refers to the systems and proce ses at intersection b/w  human resource management (HRM) &  information technology. It merge  HRM as a discipline and in particular it’s basic HR activities and processes with the information technology field whereas the programming of data processing systems evolved into standardized routines and packages of enterprise resource planning (ERP) software. [1] The two most popular Web -based HR applications, which used today are self-service for employees and self -service for managers.  These applications have enables  companies to shift responsibility for viewing and updating records onto single  employees and have fundamentally changed the manner in which employees acquire information and relate to their HR departments [2] An organization/ company with a very large numbe r of employees manages a large number of data. This activity/task can be difficult without a more appropriate tool to store and retrieve data. The different levels of sophistication can be examined by looking at the changing aspects of HR technology. These aspects can be characterized into four different stages of development,  Paper-based systems, early personal computer technology, electronic databases & Web-based technology. [3] Benefits of automated system  are becoming widely kn own to HR and other areas of business. The  focus has shifted to automating system  as many transactions as pos sible because automated system is highly effective and efficient. The technology of future will be about faster  access to accurate curr ent information, and more reliable  to access this information via multiple systems will give organizations a strategic ed ge. We are going to develop a system for comsats, which facilitate both approval authority & employee. Employee facilitate in term of apply for leave without any paperwork effort and save from time wastage. Approval authority get benefit in processing appl ication of employee, check previous history of employee & check remaining leave for employee. In this way decision would be make in efficient manner. This new system will remove traditional system for applying for leave through paperwork. New system based on web application leaves will submit and process online. A r ecent study by  Hackett Group, a business process advisory firm found that high - performing organizations spend 25%  less than their peers on HR because they use technology effectively. [4]

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: The goal of artificial general intelligence is to achieve computationally compatible human -like intelligence. This requires that an agent must be modelled using certain aspects of consciousness, learning algorithm, emotions, memory systems, motivations, theory of mind along with other components as described in following literature  [1], [2], [3]) and such agents are called cognitive agents. A cognitive agent is designed using bio -inspired constructs that implements cognitive and psychological aspects associated with intelligence and consciousness. Among these aspects socio- cognitive behaviours, perceptions, attention, awareness, memorization, learning, knowledge representation and processing are vital [3]. The engineering challenge is to design and implement these features in such a way that they generate response in real time and are synchronized through cognitive cycles [4], [5]. It is assumed that by implementing aforementioned features may result in an agent which may possess certain level of consciousness and can generate believable behaviour. These behaviours are vital in a social setup where the agent needs to induce in human partners a sense of its co -presence. This co-presence is a kind of a n innate belief that the agent is someone who is intelligent, conscious, transparent and trustworthy. In order to develop such entities, a socio-cognitive dialogue based agent needs to be implemented using previously mentioned cognitive feature. Indeed, n umber of attempts have been made to develop dialogue based interactive system under the umbrella of chatbot. A chatbot is a program that reacts like an insightful entity when chatted through text or voice. ALICE Bot is a popular example of chatbot, which u tilizes AIML pattern matching techniques. Chabot’s have as of late turned into the concentration of more prominent research attention. Unlike objective situated dialog systems, do not have any speciﬁc objective that aides the cooperation. As a result, trad itional evaluation metrics, such as task completion rate, are not again subtle. [6] According to the research study by Mindbowser in association with Chatbot Journal [7] IBM Watson is the first choice as a bot-building platform for 61% of businesses  [8]. The biggest messaging platforms, such as Facebook Messenger and Skype, announced dev eloper programs to support chat bot applications. At the same time, smaller messaging platforms, such as Slack and Telegram, launched "bot stores" and investment funds to attract developers. Indeed, these chatbot and dialogue based systems are being used in online customer relationship software, intelligent tutoring system and in so many  other areas but still they lack number of cognitive feature, mentioned previously. Therefore, progress is still needed before we can implement a generalized computational agent which possess general intelligence. Few efforts have been made in this to develop cognitive dialogue based agents like LIDA, IDA and IBM Watson. Among which LIDA encourages the production of simulations in confined areas that try out cognitive hypotheses. The LIDA Model is steady with biological cognition, but it does not desire uti lization to be dependable to biological models. Furthermore, Watson learns from interactions with subject matter experts and serves up probabilities and evidence, rather than definitive responses. Their limitations are that they possess domain specific a -priori knowledge. Generally, they are implemented for softbots rather than robotics. Few of these have been interfaced by robotics

heading: 2.1.4 YARP:

heading: 4.2 Deep Learning Based Agent
content: Deep Neural Networks(DNN) are greatly capable machine learning models that accomplis h phenomenal performance. DNNs are effective because they can perform parallel calculation for an unassuming number of steps.

heading: 4.2.1 Seq2Seq
content: Sequence To Sequence model presented in Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder- Decoder for Statistical Machine Translation  has become very important for developing dialogue systems. It contains two recurrent neural networks  and uses LSTM as a recurrent unit . One is encoder and other is decoder. The job of encoder is t o process one word from a sentence at each timestep. The encoder also converts cycle of words into fixed size vector  called a context vector. This vector encodes only important information in the sequence of words. The decoder converts this vector into sequence of words. Input and output sentences can be different because there is no one-to-one relation between input and output sentences.

heading: 4.2.1.1 Model
content: The agent model is based on Recurrent Neural Network(RNN) which interpret input sentence and forecast output sentence. During training of this model, the correct output sentence is feed into the model, so learning can be finished with back propagation. The RNN is a generalization of feed - forward neural network.

heading: Figure 13. Seq2Seq
content: In above example, input sentence is “How are you” and output is “I am fine”. We used a RNN and train to map “How are you” to “I am fine”. The hidden state in this model stores information about sentence when it receives end of line tag <EOL>.  The quality of this model lies in  its generality. We use this model for conversations without changes in the real architecture. This model will not be able to be completely solve the conversation dialogue problems because it does not achieve actual objective through human conversation.

heading: 4.2.1.2 Datasets
content: For this model, we used two datasets: Corpus Movie Dialogue [30]. This dataset contains a collection of conversations taken from movie scripts. - 200K conversations between 10K pairs of characters. - 9K characters from 600 movies - 300K statements

heading: 4.2.1.3 Training
content: For training, we used 3 layers with 256 cells of deep LSTM’s with encoder and decoder vocabulary of 20,000. The complete training details are described below: 1. We used fixed learning rate 0.5 with decay factor of 0.99. 2. We used batches of 64 sequences.

heading: 28 of 35  25 May 2018

heading: 4.2.2 Neural Machine Translation
content: Sequence to Sequence models have delighted in awesome accomplishment in machine translation. Neural Machine Translation(NMT) is the first successful platform for seq2seq models. Previously translations were done by making chunks of input sentences and translated them clause by clause. This was not like humans translate, which led to not fluent translation output. This technique was first developed for translation from English to French. We used it for English to English because it trains by mapping input to  output sentence using deep multi -layer RNN for both encoder and decoder which is unidirectional or bi-directional and uses LSTM as a recurrent unit. The encoder gets the input without making any forecasting; the decoder, however operate the output sentenc e which forecasting the next words. The difference between simple seq2seq and NMT is that NMT uses Dynamic Recurrent Neural Network. This allows NMT for variable sequence lengths to run RNN for true number of steps on those sentences that are shorter than max length.

heading: 4.2.2.2 Training

heading: Abstract
content: Video sharing social media platforms like YouTube, Dubsmash and Snapchat etc. are undoubtedly very popular and cater millions of users every day. This is because they target various genres of video sharing (like documentaries, music videos, lip syncs etc.) very effectively. Since people ranging from teens to even adults love t he content that hits these apps/websites, the companies benefit hugely from it and earn billions of dollars in revenue. Realizing the potential in the idea of a video sharing social media platform, we have decided to develop an android based application featuring advanced video recording filters that unlike other websites/applications, strictly targets only three genres of video sharing but caters a very large user base. These genres include Diss Tracks, Lip Sync Battles and Creative Challenge videos. Apart  from this, our platform will help creative content creators like music artists, lyricists and producers to share their content to a global audience. By doing this, they will get instant recognition because of limited video sharing genres that attract social media savvies. Lastly, people that spend their time on social media need the kind of content that is short but interesting, funny and creative at the same time and this defines our core objective for this application. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: The purpose of limiting the type of content to be posted on our application is to keep our users focused and interested throughout the time they spend on our app. We will develop the interfaces and special filters that will go along with every video that user uploads through our app.

heading: Special Video Filters:
content: The unique video filters that we will design is what will set us apart from other applications on the market. For each video  sharing/recording module there is going to be a separate interface for recording that will include advanced filters to make the content more interesting. Like Diss Track module will have an interface option to select a track for background music and other editing tools to go along with the content. For lip sync battles, we will create special video filters like fast forward, time lapses, slow motion etc. which gives the user the power to upload the video the way they like.  Apart from this, user would be able to include to text and emojis to their existing videos through the interface designed entirely by us. How It Works? The app works the following way: • The user downloads and signs up for the app using his/her Google account. • Once signed in, the user is able to update his/her profile (Display Picture, Bio, Tagline etc.). • User can watch already uploaded videos for each module separately by swiping left or right and then tapping on the video they like. • For each module, there will be an upload button that would lead to the video recording interface where user can record the video using special filters. • After the video is recorded, the app will process it and allow the user to edit it before uploading. • Once uploaded, the user can view their video on their profile. • The user can follow the content creators they love and can also like and comment on videos and vote for the winner for any lip sync battle.

heading: 8 of 36  04 January 2018
content: Below is a detailed description of our three video sharing modules:

heading: Lip Sync Battles:
content: A lip sync battle  [1] is a competition involving participants that lip sync or mime to a p articular song and then one of them is declared the winner either by the audience or by judges (if present). Though the concept of lip syncing is already present in other apps like Dubsmash, but the idea of having a lip sync battle using an app is very unique. People would love to challenge their friends over a lip sync battle using filters like slow mo, time lapse and fast forward and the idea of letting other users decide the winner within five hours after the battle has concluded, stimulates a sense of community and competitiveness among the people that would get them hooked to our app instantly.

heading: Diss Tracks:
content: A diss track  [2] is basically a rap song that artists create to decide who is better than the other. These kinds of tracks have been done by many p eople including well known music artists and YouTubers and the idea of any person being able to record one is quite interesting.Tracks like these really demonstrate one’s skill in making quality tracks with catchy lyrics in limited time space. Our interface would play music selected by the user in the background with special effects like custom writing on the video to make it more interesting.

heading: Creative Challenges:
content: A lot of challenges like ice bucket challenge, bottle-flip challenge, mannequin challenge [3] etc. have surfaced the internet and went viral in no time. Such type of challenges occur quite frequently and stay relevant for weeks. By including this feature, we will allow people to broadcast their attempt  using special filters, in response to the specified challenge to as many people as possible through our app. The person with the most creative attempt (based on likes/upvotes) to the challenge will make his/her way to the list of top content creators on our app thus giving that person instant recognition.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: We are developing this application while keeping following goals in mind: • To create a video sharing social media platform for specific domains that cater larger audiences. • To be the first in Pakistan to develop such an app and compete with successful companies like Dubsmash, YouTube and Musical.ly. • To encourage creative content creators to upload their content and showcase their work to a global audience. • Allow users to have fun and be creative at the same time. • Give instant recognition to those creators that make quality content. • Give user the power to judge any competition like Lip Sync Battles and declare the winners. • To instill competitiveness among the users to keep them interested in our app.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement:
content: Video sharing sites contains tons of videos from various genres which can sometimes be good for a certain creator but bad for another even though their content is good. Our app will focus on three genres of videos including Lip Sync Battles, Creative Challenges and Diss Track to target specific users to give instant recognition to the creators and make a viral video app to attract a lot of users.

heading: 2.6 Software Development Life Cycle Model:
content: The model chosen for app development is Agile Method, also known as incremental model which involves development of the software in small rapid increments. Each increment is b ased on a previous build of the software but is an improved version that undergoes various testing routines.

heading: 2.6.1 Justification for the Designated Model:
content: This model has been chosen as it delivers working software for each increment and hence problems and bugs can be rectified easily with each build. By using this model, our application can easily adapt to changing circumstances due to which we can save considerable time. Therefore, by using this model we can achieve technical  excellence and phenomenal design in a relatively short period of time.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned:
content: Following are the problems faced during the development process: • Recording interface was difficult to develop as it had loads of features. • Overall interface must be simple and easy to understand for the user. • The application needs to use some sort of compression algorithm to reduce size of videos being posted to cut server costs. • The video filter for each module was very difficult to develop. • Realizing the work we had to put on our app, we decided to switch to Google’s Firebase hosting and developing databases. • Firebase integration was a new experience for us; the we faced problems while migration. • We need capital to initialize real-time databases using firebase. • Many of Firebase functionalities are in beta phase and hence may be unreliable.

heading: 5.2 Future Work:
content: In future, we would like to add following features to our project: • Apply Digital Image Processing Techniques to build creative filters like that of Snapchat to make our content even more interesting. • Launch our application on other mobile operating systems like iOS and Windows Phone. • Add advertisement features in our app to generate revenue. • Invite leading music producers to creative custom music tracks for our app. • Add live video-casting feature to our app once we accumulate greater user base. • Buy our own servers to maintain scalability. • Introduce new video filters that are possible by only editing in Adobe After Effects. • Introduce live Lip Sync Battles. • Include AI to make sure the comments and videos are according to community guidelines. • Add spam detection techniques to avoid fake comments. • Seek permission from music labels to lease us their songs to be made available to users for free.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary:
content: Our application is directly hitting the community that loves the idea of viral videos that hits the internet. The three separate modules will focus on three aspects of video genres i.e. Lip Syncs, Diss Track and Creative Challenges will help us target a large user base for our application. Apart from the whole viral aspect, the app will definitely help content creators to get instant recognition and get their creative work out for the whole world to see.  Video sharing social media platform s like YouTube, Dubsmash and Snapchat etc. are undoubtedly very popular and cater millions of users every day. This is because they target various genres of video sharing (like documentaries, music videos, lip syncs etc.) very effectively.  Music artists c an benefit from contributing to the music library of our application and getting the credit,  they deserve. Thus, we expect our app to revolutionize the genre of viral video sharing.  Apps like these are no joke as they have built successful careers for crea tive artists who dedicate their time uploading content religiously on a daily basis for millions of people who are eager to watch them whenever they upload.

heading: 1.1 Brief Introduction
content: Our Project is the basic need of the C OMSATS University because currently manual system is being used in this advanced era of technology . Our application is for the final  year project s management committee in COMSATS University because there  is no such online system for tracking previously done final year projects and their source code & data storage . To keep record of the previous and ongoing final year project digitally, we will design the System called eProject Management System. To full fill the needs of student of Final Year Project, in our applic ation students will get updates about their projects through our portal. In every university it is compulsory to complete final year project, for the completion of degree. Our application will be used by the Students, Supervisor and the committee member of  final year project. For this our project is designed in such a way that it includes the signup and sign in option which allows the user to use our application. In our project students are allowed to submit the proposal online. This facility is not availab le in our university. So, for this purpose our project is design to help the student as well as the supervisor also. It helps the student and both supervisor to work on time and arrange meetings to develop a communication between them. Supervisor will see the online working and the timeline of Final year project. As time line is uploading by the admin, the student will get the information for the timeline. The students are working according to the time proposed by them. The project analysis is done online by using our project which saves the time of both supervisor and the student. The eProject Management System will facilitate fyp-committee members for proposal, fyp-report 1, and fyp-report 2 submissions online. Evaluator will be able to  evaluate assigned project online and also submit their feedback via our system.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: To create an automated system that follows complete final year project’s lifecycle and maintains repository of all projects. It manages notifications and due dates.  It is completely programmed framework with online accessibility. It will keep updated student and supervisor meeting logs and it will also allow examiner to review and evaluate projects.

content: Every semester many of the projects fail because o f barriers of communication between supervisor and students. Students mostly face the problem of meeting the supervisor, timeline and deadline mostly supervisors don’t have the updated document of the project. Students usually don’t have idea of projects t hat have already been made, since there is no repository of such projects are available.

heading: Abstract
content: The aim of this project is to develop to develop an Android and web base application for shopkeepers and customers of Hafeez Centre market. We know time is very precious for  everyone. This application is helping the customers to find that shop in Hafeez Centre in wh ich their requir e products are available. This application is also saving the cost of shopkeepers which they spent on pamphlets and banners. When customer is search their desire product, this application show them list of shops in w hich that product is available. Customer can select one shop from that list and this application will show them 3D map from their current position to that shop. Shopkeepers entered their data through website and customers are using this application on their Android devices. Page 5 of 96 Table of Contents

heading: 1.1.Introduction
content: HallyApp is an Android Application. It is facilitating the user to find that shops in Hafeez Centre market in which their desire products are available. Shopkeepers of Hafeez Centre market were uploaded their products through website. Customers ofHafeez Centre m arket will use this application on their Android  devices. User will see a search barin application. He will search the product name in search bar. Then user will see a list o f those shops in which that product is available. He will select one shop from that list. Application will shop him 3D map from his current position to that shop. He will easily find that shop. Shop keepers ofHafeez Centre market were used website for uploading their products. When shopkeepers open the link https://hallyapp.000webhostapp.com/index.php     they will see Sign in and Sign up button. If they already have account then they will Sig n in otherwise they will need to sign up. When they click on Sign up button, they will navigate to new page in which they require to give their name, password, floor number, shop number, shop name and phone number. When shopkeepers fulfil the sing up form, they will navigate to next page. That page divided in to two sections. In one section they see a product details which includes serial number, product name, product company, product model, product price and product photo. In other section, shopkeepers see  a form for product details. In that form, shopkeepers are require to enter product name, product company, product model, product price and product photo.  There are three more buttons for shopkeepers. The names of these three buttons are Update Profile , U pdate Product and Log Out. In Update Profile, shopkeepers can update their profiles like they can change their name, password, floor number, shop number, shop name and  phone number. In update product , shopkeepers can update product details like product nam e, product company, product model, product price and product photo. Shopkeepers can also delete product from inventory. Admin of this application also use website. He sign in with user name and password. When admin sign in, he sees a list of registered shops. Admin have the authority todelete any shop from list. Admin can update their profile in which they can change their name and password. Page 8 of 96

heading: 1.2. Objectives
content: Customer goes to the Hafeez Centre market to buy his require product. He search ed many shops to find that product. This will waste his time. The time that customer spent in searching the product can be utilized in other important activities. A lot of time and hard worked spent to solve the above problems. Our project is addressed all these issues. Our proposed solution saved the time of customers and help shopkeepers to find customers without promoting their shops and products using pamphlets and banners. To achieve these objectives, we planned to divide our projects in different goals which are following.  It must execute with high performance.  It must be interpreted, threaded and dynamic.  It must save the time of customer.  It must provide the customer to the shopkeeper.  The application is to be open for business after the six months of project completion.  It must be robust and secure.  It must provide comfort to the customer.  It must be simple and familiar.

heading: 1.3. Problem statement
content: Hafeez Centre market is a very large market. There are total six floors in Hafeez Centre. There are almost thousand shops in Hafeez Centre.Customers have to go on more than one shop to find his desire product. This process wasted precious of customers. Shopkeepers also used banners and pamphlets to caught maximum customers. They invest a huge amount on this. We planned on developing an application which facilitate both customers and shopkeepers. Shopkeepers used websites in which they entered the products that are available on their shops. Customers are using Android application in which they search their require product name and find those shops in which that product is available. This application is saving the time of customer. heading: 1.5. Project Scope
content: To fulfil the demand of shopkeepers and customers, we have proposed the solution of HallyApp. Our proposed solution is providing facility to both customers and shopkeepers.  The scope of this project i s following.  A user friendly environment and real time response to the queries of user.  Investigate the value and benefits of developing a system for shopkeeper and customer needs.  Study the feasibility to enhance customer and shopkeeper experience and efficiency.  Explore location-based service.  Separate accounts for shopkeepers of Hafeez Centre market.  Design and develop Android application which searching the shops and give list.  Evaluate and review the pros and cons of project outcome, seek and identify for further improvements. heading: 2.1. Literature review
content: There are many 3D virtual  shopping malls applications in USA, Australia, Japan, etc. These applications are for windows and IOS operating systems. In these applications, we can only view the internal structure of the building. There are  no search options in these applications by which customer can search the products and the applications show the lists of those shops in which that product is available. Our application providing the facility of searching desire item in search bar and select shop from list and find that shop with the help of 3D mapping.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: 5.1.1: Wrong choice of Tool for 3D Modelling During early stage, we used Maya for 3D modelling of Hafeez Centre. Maya is very d ifficult tool. We spent more tha n one month in this tool. The integration of Maya file with Android application is very difficult. We discussed with our supervisor. Our supervisor advised us to use Blender instead of Maya. Then we used Blender for modelling and complete our project. The lesson learnt from this project was that we should take advice from experts before wasting time on different tools and technologies. 5.1.2: Images for 3D Modelling We find many difficulties for 3D modelling of Hafeez Centre. First we decide to take pi ctures of all shops in Hafeez Centre. We took pictures of all shops of Hafeez Centre. The distance between two shops that are in front to each other is very small. In that small distance, we were unable to capture the whole shop in a picture. Still we took  pictures and use those pictures as a texture file in Blender. At the end, we design a model with those inappropriate pictures. That model was not satisfied. Then we decided to took a picture of any laptop and mobile shop and edit those pictures by removing and adding shop numbers. The lesson learnt from this problem was we should not attach those inapprop riate images. Those pictures looked inappropriate still we wasted time on attaching those files in Blender.

content: Page 76 of 96 Page 77 of 96 Page 78 of 96 Page 79 of 96 Page 80 of 96 paper text: Abstract The aim of this project is to develop to develop an Android and web base application for shopkeepers and customers of Hafeez Centre market. When customer is search their desire product, this application show them list of shops in which that product is available. Customer can select one shop from that list and this application will show them 3D map from their current position to that shop. Shopkeepers entered their data through website and customers are using this application on their And roid devices. Chapter 1: Introduction 1.1. Introduction HallyApp is an Android Application. It is facilitating the user to find that shops in Hafeez Centre market in which their desire products are available. Shopkeepers of Hafeez Centre market were upload ed their products through website. Customers of Hafeez Centre market will use this application on their Android devices. User will see a search bar in application. He will search the product name in search bar. Then user will see a list of those shops in which that product is available. He will select one shop from that list. Application will shop him 3D map from his current position to that shop. He will easily find that shop. Shop keepers of Hafeez Centre market were used website for uploading their produ cts. When shopkeepers open the link https://hallyapp.000webhostapp.com/index.php they will see Sign in and Sign up button. If they already have account then they will Sign in otherwise they will need to sign up. When they click on Sign up button, they will  navigate to new page in which they require to give their name, password, floor number, shop number, shop name and phone number. When shopkeepers fulfil the sing up form, they will navigate to next page. That page divided in to two sections. In one section  they see a product details which includes serial number, product name, product company, product model, product price and product photo. In other section, shopkeepers see a form for product details. In that form, shopkeepers are require to enter product na me, product company, product model, product price and product photo. There are three more buttons for shopkeepers. The names of these three buttons are Update Profile , Update Product and Log Out. In Update Profile, shopkeepers can update their profiles li ke they can change their name, password, floor number, shop number, shop name and phone number. In update product, shopkeepers can update product details like product name, product company, product model, product price and product photo. Shopkeepers can al so delete product from inventory. Admin of this application also use website. He sign in with user name and password. When admin sign in, he sees a list of registered shops. Admin have the authority to delete any shop from list. Maya is very difficult tool. We spent more than one month in this tool. The integration of Maya file with Android application is very difficult. We di scussed with our supervisor. Our supervisor advised us to use Blender instead of Maya. Then we used Blender for modelling and complete our project. The lesson learnt from this project was that we should take advice from experts before wasting time on diffe rent tools and technologies. 5.1.2: Images for 3D Modelling We find many difficulties for 3D modelling of Hafeez Centre. First we decide to take pictures of all shops in Hafeez Centre. We took pictures of all shops of Hafeez Centre. The distance between two shops that are in front to each other is very small. In that small distance, we were unable to capture the whole shop in a picture. Still we took pictures and use those pictures as a texture file in Blender. At the end, we design a model with those inapp ropriate pictures. That model was not satisfied. Then we decided to took a picture of any laptop and mobile shop and edit those pictures by removing and adding shop numbers. The lesson learnt from this problem was we should not attach those inappropriate i mages. Those pictures looked inappropriate still we wasted time on attaching those files in Blender. 5.2: Project Summary HallyApp is a web and android based application that would help shopkeepers and customers of Hafeez Centre market. Shopkeepers gave de tails of the products that available on their shops. This helped them to caught maximum customers without wasting money on pamphlets and banners. We know shopkeepers used pamphlets and banners for promoting their shops and products which are very costly. T his application reduced the costs of pamphlets and banners for shopkeepers of Hafeez Centre market. Now customers will find those shops easily in which their required products are available. We at this time, every common man have smart phones. They just ne ed to install this application. By using this application, customers can search their require product in search bar and this application will show them lists of those shops in which that product is available. When they select one shop, this application wil l show them 3D map from his current position to that particular shop. This would help them to find that shop easily. This application saved time of customers. 5.3: Future Work In future, we are planning on developing same application for Hall Road market. Hall Road market is the largest Asian market of computers and electronic Page 96 of 96 components. We know 3D modelling of Hall Road market is very difficult because it is very large market who have many streets and plazas. Even each plaza also have many streets. There are also many shops in Hall Road market. In 3D modelling of Hall Road, we need to take pictures of all shops or edit images for some shops and then use those shops as a texture files in Blender. This will a very hard working and time consuming project. Aft er HallyApp, we get courage and we believe that we will complete same project for Hall Road market. heading: Abstract
content: General purpose e-commerce solution is a platform that provides features to manage their website in term of page making, admin login, customer login, link pages.  General purpose e -commerce solution are online web based project that  allows clients to make their own websites. It is useful for people that doesn’t know much about web development. It is as simple and easy interface that enable clients to make their own website just by few clicks and apply various themes for website’s enhancement. Dynamic database will be build which will store and retrieve client’s data. This project will also cater database wit h dynamic Meta data. Clients  can make cha nges to website according to their needs. Clients have the privileges to act as admin once they sign up . After sign up, they can categorize the products and related data according to their needs. Online payment methods will also be provided to the clients so that, they can manage their sales. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: E-commerce website are highly  used website in the modern world. The primary purpose of e - commerce websites is to sell goods and services to world-wide. Our project will be general purpose e -commerce solution that will allow the user or customers to build their own e -commerce websites with just few clicks on the screen. From our shop builder platform, the users can make their online shopping websites through which different customers can buy products, review them, rate them and change descriptions of any products. This e - commerce website will be built on whole new architecture with the help of themes and plugins that will provide customizability to their websites these all things will be provided by our platform for the user and customers for their websites building.

heading: Security:
content: To keep our system secure our system will use latest Php hashing standard (password-hash). Most of the development engine uses old practices but our system will use OAuth (Open Authentication Protocol). OAuth is mechanism that allows the users to share their information about their accounts with the third-party applications or websites and this practice is mostly used by the world popular companies like Google and Facebook. It provides users a secure access to the servers on behalf of the resource’s owner. It allows the resource owners to authorize third party access to servers without sharing their credentials.

heading: Performance:
content: After the release of Laravel 5.5 the performance has been increased that enable the users to develop the product with high performance as compare d to other existing platforms for web building. In our system will use themes plugins that will help users in their work. Plugins will range from simple to complex in functionality that will not any impact on user due to his knowledge about the web languages he just has to make few clicks.

heading: Extensibility:
content: For extensibility development of plugins and its functionalities  will be done.  That will provide users with various functionalities and for this purpose we will make the plugins in such a way that it will not make the platform heavy in load because in most web building platforms plugins give much load to the platform that will reduce the extensibility of the platform. For this we will test our plugins that we have made to make them put less load on the platf orm to increase its extensibility. Page 20 of 216

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content:  To develop a platform that allows users to create their personalized websites of shops or whether e-commerce by just few clicks. Having complete control over the look and feel of website.  To provide users with the accessibility of using new themes, plugins and other updates to their websites this ensures high extensibility.  To launch a website quickly without knowledge of web coding then our platform will allow user to launch their website in quick way due to our simple interface that anyone can interact with.  To provide user with accessibility to add more functionalities in his e-commerce website.  Payment options in the shops (that are generated by our solution) against orders will be available using several payment gateways.

heading: 1.3 Problem statement
content: The purpose of this General E-Commerce system is to provide users provides features to manage their website in term of page making, admin login, customer login, link pages. General purpose e- commerce solution is online web-based project that allows clients to make their own websites. It is useful for people that doesn’t know much about web development. It is as simple and easy interface that enable clients to make their own website just by few clicks and apply various themes for website’s enhancement. Basically, our solution will be for customized e -commerce sites that will allow the user to use new themes, functionalities to their e -commerce sites. This allows the customers to create marketable e-commerce sites based on our system that will be independent in operation. General E-commerce solution is a platform for those users or customers that have no knowledge of making a website and have no knowledge of any web programming languages. Therefore our system will provide the user or customers with such platform that they can make their own website without any knowledge of programming languages.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & constraints

heading: 2.1 Literature review / Existing system study
content: There are many different paid and free platforms developed that are limited in functionalities. Following are these platforms.

heading: Drupal
content: Drupal is also a platform for making websites that are highly flexible and scalable. Drupal includes lot of functionalities like: advanced menu management, graphics modification tool, user’s management and much more. These functions make it possible to create simple or advanced websites, blogs, discussion boards, social networking pages, Drupal allows to create many  content types like videos, texts, blogs, user managements and statistics etc. It has the availability of many plugins in its website. [1] The main disadvantage of this platform is that it requires high knowledge to be installe d and modify. In comparison to other web building platforms it is not easy to use but the features that Drupal offers are good than other web building platforms. Getting used to its script will take some time to learn. The websites made by Drupal are not e fficient because if the website made by the Drupal is large then the server load generated will be much more but there are some plugins available that will load the website to the server cache that will decrease the server load. If the websites made by the Drupal are gathering much more traffic than ordinary sites than servers shut down these sites due to heavy traffic loads. The plugins and themes are mostly priced and some of them are mostly overpriced. [2]

heading: Word Press
content: WordPress is the world most popular web making platform. It has got thousands of plugins and has much more functionalities than Drupal. It is choice mostly for most bloggers but can also be used to make simple websites. It doesn’t require knowledge about html and CSS like what Drupal needs. It is very easy to install due to preinstalled templates and plugins all you need is to click on that template or plugin for its installation. Strong and major plugins are available that make it more popular than Drupal but some of the plugins are overpriced. [3] Thousands of graphical templates are present that helps to beautify a website and make changes to its graphical appearance. Both free and paid templates are present in this web building platform, but paid ones are more in functionalities and are more advanced than the free ones. It has a major functionality of menu functionality that can be modified to be include pages and categories of a product etc. it also has some disadvantage that include knowledge of Php language. In removing a data filed it requires some knowledge of Php language. Mostly the changes are made due to change in data fields. Many graphical templates are present and mostly are alike to give a new look to the website you should have a knowledge about CSS and html. Unlike other web building platforms WordPress needs to install various plugins that causes many efficiency issues in the platform. In most cases plugins consists of clones it means many functionalities are same in two or more plugins that are developed by different developers that can cause many efficiency Page 23 of 216 issues. This platform is not protected as other platforms. Modifying a table and graphical formatting is much more complicated in WordPress. [4]

heading: Joomla
content: On basis of complexity joomla is something between WordPress and Drupal. It is popular among those website developers that want to build advanced websites. It is simple to install it takes ten minutes to download and then work on this platform starts. It is not simple as WordPress but is simple than Drupal. It has also thousands of plugins like WordPress and Drupal. But like WordPress you don’t have to install lots of plugins before work that causes efficiency issues. When the page  design is ready then there will be a time that will allow the platform to install and modify it. User can also do it from web. There are also many disadvantages of joomla despite having many modules and templates it always has the disadvantage of having some advanced users but still better in case of WordPress. Expandability of a website have effects on server parameters. It means if a website is large and it has thousands of visitors then there will be no problem in the beginning. Mostly like other platforms joomla has also paid plugins and templates and are mostly overpriced that make the users to think about them before buying. There may be some functionalities problems in the plugins because some functionalities need knowledge of php. Advanced users mos tly recommend it as their website builder platform. It provides a system of choice for multimedia sites. [5] [6]

heading: Typo3
content: Typo3 is an open source platform that is used mostly by high level programmer s that are looking for applications that are high in functionality. News sites mostly prefers typo3 for their high scripts. Functionalities can be expanded by using image galleries etc. Many management systems allow for only one administrator but in typo3 a user can make a through view of page content or administrator who manages it. Typo3 gives many types of contents (e.g. you can manage your page layout when you are adding images, tables and text you don’t have to use pre-fixed blocks orders and sections. It has also some disadvantages it cannot be installed easily it takes more time than joomla and WordPress it is not for beginner programmers but for advance programmers it is lot harder to master it. Websites from simple advanced portals are mostly made on this system. [7] [8]

heading: Quick
content: Quick is the simplest platform for building simple websites.it stores data in flat files because when you make a file you just set permission for catalogues on the server. Managing page layout things like making a change in images, tables and plain text does not requires person knowledge and skills about any programming language. Positioning of quick is good because of its simple and clear html language code. It has also the availability of mobile view version that enables the user to view the website on his/her mobile by making the graphics of the website low. Aside its easy use and many other good factors it has also some disadvantages many of the plugins are missing in this management system and plugins that are free on other management systems are available in this system in paid versions. It stores database in subpages that decreases the efficiency of the website. It also requires knowledge of Php and html and CSS. For example adding an additional field will not be easy in this system. [9] DotnetDuke Dotnetduker is also a world leading CMS(Content management system) that is from Microsoft ecosystem. This CMS(Content Management System) buil ds websites that are for commercial use and the websites build from this cms are professional looking and easy to use. It provides an easy development process that doesn’t requires the knowledge of user in any form of programming. It provides a rich text e ditor library and it has large memory of file management system. This CMS(Content Management System) is written in c sharp language. [10] Page 24 of 216

heading: Plone
content: Plone is another famous CMS(Content management system) that allows user to maintain and create public websites. It uses intranet with web browser. It offers a large number of add -ons and extensibilities development. It is written in python language. it requires the knowledge of php from user if the user doesn’t have any knowledge about the programming language then he cannot operate it. But it also uses drag and drop rendering of contents. [10] Security in Web Content Management System In today’s world most of the web developers use web content management system that allows the users to make websites using drag and drops and just few clicks but no one knows the security risks of these web content management systems. Any internet connected thing is vulnerable  to hacking, phishing, Spam, Trojans and SQL injections. A web content management system must have the authentication process that requires the verification of the peoples that they are real or not. Confidentiality means to hide information from an unauthorized person. Integrity means to prevent any unauthorized access to people that can delete information or can make changes in it. Availability means to perform operations according to the purpose given. [11] Mostly website nowa days have many security threats, advance security in website contains three main things one is scripting attacks, AJAX and SQL injection attacks. Ajax attacks includes JSON injection and JSON hijacking are currently two aspects that causes security threats. Cross Site scripting occurs when web pages displayed are dynamically made and are not validated properly. Cross site scripting is also known as XSS in this a malicious attacker act as normal visitor on a website that he visits and uploads a script that contains JavaScript codes. In SQL injection the attacker deceives database server to execute unauthorized access by adding extra SQL statements in the end of inquire statement in application programs. [12] Meta Data in Web-based management system Mostly the websites that exist today use approach of dynamic web development that includes database metadata that can hold significant amount of database information. This causes a separation of contents, logic and tasks that cut down the recompiling cost when a minor upgradation is needed [13]. Some of the metadata is fetched by using XML schema file and XSL asset. A simple web based application uses XML schema file and XSL asset process stylesheet to display a  simple form that the user need to enter the metadata. [14] Advantages/Disadvantages of content management system Content management systems plays an important role in todays internet evolution age. Many software provide development of websites by providing ease of use to their customers. High level of efficiency and usability provided are main advantages of a web content management system. But mostly these web content management systems are vulnerable to hacking and malwares due to integrations of plugins and extensions because hackers can inject malwares on these extensions and plugins. [15] Database performance tuning Database tuning is a thing in which a database application is made to run more qu ickly that means higher throughputs and this makes response time faster for more time-consuming web applications. To retrieve data from the system SQL queries are used because the use of these queries are important when performance is considered. [16] Page 25 of 216

heading: 2.6 Software development life cycle model
content: Agile model is used for this project. It is based on incremental process models and it focuses on adaptability of changing product and enhancing customer satisfaction through fast delivery of product features. The Waterfall development method follows strict phases, sticking to the requirements and design plan created at the beginning of the project. Small increment are released based on previous functionalities. It is used to develop intense applications that need though development with testing. Figure 6: Agile model Here are the main advantages of using agile modelling  Regular adaptation of changing circumstances.  If the requirements are late than this will not be an issue any requirement is welcomed anytime.  Customer is satisfied by fast and continuous delivery of software.  Face to face conversation is done which will clear any form of ambiguity.  Design is mainly focused throughout the project. heading: 3.4 Software architecture
content: Laravel is a Php framework that will be used in this project . This framework uses MVC (model, view and controller) for implementation. This architecture pattern is best suited for designing web applications. The user requests some services and these services are sent to routers and then the router sends the request to the controller where controller act as interface between view and models. MVC is an architectural pattern that separates the web application into three main components

heading: Model:
content: All the web application domains are built on model they represent the data that is being transferred to both the controller and view components. Models are stored outside the applications and are mostly database. When data changes it also updates controller. It mostly acts as a data storage system.

heading: View:
content: View represents the data that model contains it is the visual representation of the context of models. It is used for graphical user interface of the application. It show the data of model on the page according to the requirements of the users that they had en tered. It only displays data in form of GUIs.

heading: Controller:
content: The controller act as a connection between model and views to process all the requests of the users and business logics. It manipulates data using model component and interacts with view component to render final input. Page 177 of 216 Figure 96: MVC architecture Page 178 of 216

heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: General purpose e -commerce solution are online web based project that allows clients to make their own websites. It is useful for people that doesn’t know much about web development. It is as simple and easy interface that enable clients to make their own website just by few clicks and apply various themes for website’s enhancement. We will develop a dynamic database which will store and retrieve client’s data. We will also cater database with dynamic Meta data.  Clients can make changes to website according to their needs. We will provide clients the privileges to act as admin once they sign up . After sign up, they can  categorize the products and related data according to their needs. We will also provide the feature of online payment to the clients so that,  they can manage their sales. General E-commerce solution is a for those users or customers that have no knowledge of making a website and have no knowledge of any web programming languages. Therefore we will provide the user or customers with such platf orm that they can make their own website without any knowledge of programming languages. Page 211 of 216
