content: CHAPTER 3: 3 Methodology Figure 7: System Architecture of system  Figure 7. Gives a detailed description of our system. There are two panels of our system: 3.1 Panels 1) Entry Panel: Upon entry, following information of rider is stored: • Rider's Face

heading: 36 of 73  16 May 2018
content: • License number of bike 2) Exit Panel: Upon exit, face of rider and license number is matched with registered riders.  • Correct match will allow the rider to exit. • Wrong match will not allow the rider to exit. 3.1.1 Entry Panel Image Acquisition Upon entry, rider’s face image and image of number plate of bike is captured via two cameras: front and back. There are two modules of this system: • Face Detection and Recognition • Number Plate Detection and Extraction 3.1.1.1 Face Detection and Recognition Module: Figure 8: Face Recognition Module Figure. 8 shows steps involved in Face Detection and Recognition Module. Input Image is received via image acquisition process. In this module, we will only talk about the face image of rider. The following techniques are used in this module:

heading: 37 of 73  16 May 2018
content: 3.1.1.1.1 Face Detection: Viola Jones Algorithm Face Detection is done through Viola Jones Algorithm. This is the first object detection algorithm which performs object detection in real-time. It was proposed in 2001 by Paul Viola and Michael Jones. It is mainly used for face detection. The algorithm has four steps: 1. Haar Feature Selection 2. Creating an Integral Image 3. Adaboost Training 4. Cascading Classifiers Reason to choose this algorithm: We chose this algorithm for face detection in our system because of its following good characteristics: • Robust Nature: This algorithm has very high positive detection rate and very low false detection rates. • Face Detection: This algorithm performs face detection and distinguishes faces from non-faces.  3.1.1.1.2 Feature Extraction: Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG) The next step after face detection is the feature extraction for which we used Histogram of Oriented Gradients (HOG). HOG is a feature descriptor used in image processing and computer vision for object detection. It makes use of direction and gradients magnitude to describe all parts of an image. Figure 9: Block diagram of HOG algorithm

heading: 38 of 73  16 May 2018
content: Figure. 9 shows the block diagram of HOG algorithm. This algorithm reduces the impact of light on the image. It then performs gradient computation by applying a derivative mask. In simpler words, it calculates the directional changes in intensity of image. A histogram using magnitude and direction is then build from where the algorithm gets its name. Reason to choose this algorithm: We chose this algorithm from other algorithms i.e. Scale Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), Speeded-Up Robust Features (SURF), Local Binary Pattern (LBP) because of some key points which are mentioned below: • HOG does feature extraction from all parts of an image unlike SIFT and SURF which generate feature vectors of only key points of an image.  • HOG works well when view angle changes but SIFT and SURF fail here. • LBP produce feature vectors which are high dimensional and thus it is more sensitive to noise. • HOG is invariant to geometric transformations which is its major advantage. • The HOG descriptor is majorly used for human detection in images because of coarse spatial sampling and fine orientation sampling techniques. 3.1.1.1.3 Classification: Support Vector Machine (SVM) Classifier SVM Classifier looks for an optimal hyperplane which separates matching objects with non-matching ones. In our system, we have used Multi-class SVM for classification of HOG features.  Reason to choose this classifier: We chose this classification technique from other techniques because of the following key features: • Training of face images through SVM is relatively easy than that of Neural Networks. • Training of face images through SVM is computationally less extensive than that of Neural Networks. • SVM is robust to noise and works well in high dimensional spaces even when the training set is small. In our system, four images are used for training. • Independent Component Analysis (ICA) consumes more computational time than SVM. Moreover, SVM has the highest accuracy rate of 95.6% on ATT database.

content: 3.1.1.2 Number Plate Detection and Extraction: Input Image is received via image acquisition process. In this module, we will only talk about the processing of number plate of rider’s bike. The following techniques are used in this module: 3.1.1.2.1 Cropping Number Plate Region: The input image is taken from a distance so the first step is to crop the number plate from the whole image. Cropping is achieved by Point Feature matching. This method works best with number plate because they exhibit non-repeating texture patterns which gives some unique feature matches. Following are the steps: Finding license number plate: • Finding SURF (speeded up robust features) of the reference image and scene image. • Extracting feature descriptor at interest point in both images.  • Finding considerable point matches of both images. • By finding geometric transformation related the matched point in previous step we eliminate the points which are not in the correct place. • Get the bounding polygon of the reference image. • Transform the polygon into the coordinate system of the scene image. • Convert the polygon into region of interest. • Crop the scene image based on region of interest. Finding the white region of the number plate: • Binarization • Opening for Noise Removal (Morphing) • Finding the biggest connected component based on area. • Calculate ROI of the connected component found.  • Cropping of license plate image based on region calculated 3.1.1.2.2 Finding ROI (Region of Interests) of characters: We used Maximally Stable Extremal Regions (MSER) features to find the ROIs of characters because of the consistent color and high contrasts of the characters lead to stable intensity profile. The following are the steps involved in finding the ROI of characters: • Detecting Maximally Stable Extremal Regions (MSER)  • Using Region properties to remove non-text regions on basic geometric properties • Further Removing non-text regions based on stroke width variations • Merge overlapped Region of Interests 3.1.1.2.3 Arranging ROIs: The ROIs obtained in previous step is not in order so we designed an algorithm which uses x and y coordinates of ROI to arrange them in order. Following steps are involved in this step:

heading: 40 of 73  16 May 2018
content: • Sort all ROIs based on y-axis • Find the mid-value of arranged ROI y-axis values • Separate the ROI values into two groups based on calculated mid-value • Sort both groups separately based on x-axis values • Merge both groups 3.1.1.2.4 Detection of text using Tesseract OCR Engine We trained Tesseract OCR Engine using standard number plate fonts. In standard plate, there is year number next to alphabets and sub-year alphabet next to digits. We ignored the unwanted ROIs based on the mid-value calculated in the previous step. We then passed each ROI through trained OCR Engine. 3.1.1.3 Storage in Database Storage in database is done by checking the following conditions: 1- Person is not already registered  If the person is not registered in our system, the operator will manually enter the name of the rider. His detected face image and license number plate will be stored automatically. 2- Person is already registered If the person is already registered. Our system will retrieve the details of rider i.e. face image and license number of bike from the database. 3.1.1.4 Check-In After taking the details of the rider, an entry of rider will be made in the database with date and time stamp. 3.1.2 Exit Panel 3.1.2.1 Authentication At Exit Panel, we again acquire image of rider’s face and license number. We authenticate the face with already registered faces in database which returns us a label of that face image as well. Label in this case is the license number of rider’s bike which is registered with his face. The returned label is matched with the license number extracted at the exit panel. If the match is successful, the rider will be allowed to exit. 3.1.2.2 Check-Out After successful authentication, the current records are checked. If the bike is entered and has not exited yet, the rider will be allowed to check-out.

content: 5.2 Unit Testing Unit testing is a process in which the smallest units of a system are tested and scrutinized independently and individually for proper operation. Unit testing is automated but can be done manually as well [24]. It is applied to each testable part of a system, called units to check the behaviour of the system i.e. its success or failure. We have designed working modules of Face Acquisition and Recognition and License Number Extraction using MATLAB. We have passed data set to these modules. During the testing phase of Face Acquisition and Recognition Module, the system acquired the image of the person through the camera and detected the face of the person from that image. This satisfies the functionality of Face Recognition Module. To check License Number Extraction Module, we passed different license plates to the system. The system extracted the License numbers from those images correctly. Hence, both components showed accurate results after unit testing and even helped us understand the concepts of Digital Image Processing. 5.3 Integration Testing Integration testing involves the testing of individual system modules combined as a group. It is performed after unit testing so we will perform integration testing on our system once we have completed our development phase of the system and have also performed unit testing on all the units of our system successfully. In the phase of integration testing we group together all the components/units of our system and test them as a whole. Separate functions were made of all of our working modules. For integration, we developed an authentication module in which we integrated Face Module with Number plate module. A Registration module was developed as well in which Face module, Number Plate Module and Database Modules are integrated. We then designed the GUI using Matlab App Builder and integrated all functional modules of our system there.  5.4 Acceptance Testing Acceptance Testing is the type of testing in which the system’s acceptability is tested. It is used to evaluate or cross check the system's compliance with the user’s requirements to get user’s satisfaction [25]. Acceptance testing gives us the idea that whether the developed system is acceptable for delivery or not. Acceptance testing is applied on developed system so it is done after unit and integration testing. Our system conforms to the requirements which were specified during requirement analysis.

content: CHAPTER 6: 6 Conclusion This chapter crystallizes everything discussed above. It will provide a summary of all the topics covered in the report and will provide a synthesis of the key points. Different aspects like problems faced during the development of the project, lessons learned and future work are discussed in this chapter and are made transparent to the reader.  6.1 Problems Faced and Lessons Learned 6.1.1 Problems Faced During our FYP-1 phase, we explored the basics of Face Recognition and Character Recognition techniques. These two techniques provide basics required for the development of our system. So many other concepts come under the umbrella of these two techniques as they constitute major part of expert system like this. Learning and understanding these complex techniques was a big challenge. Then the next problem we faced was to collect the dataset for our project. We required dataset for our Face Recognition Module as well as for License Plate Recognition Module. It was a time-consuming process to gather face images of different people and then to test Face Recognition Module on each one of them. Similar was the case with License Plate Recognition Module, for which the dataset requirement was to gather different number plates images captured in different conditions i.e. in dim light, bright light, some captured from far, some from near etc. Thus, collecting the dataset was a very time-consuming and problematic process. Then third problem we faced was to determine the algorithms or techniques which we had to choose for our system development. There were so many ways in which the tasks could be performed but we had to focus on accuracy and effectiveness while choosing a particular algorithm or technique. We had to search for different techniques which could be used to achieve our desired result but with efficiency and effectiveness. Following are the problems we faced while developing our Face Module: Face Detection: • Selection of suitable face detecting technique. • Raw images presented for face detection did not give satisfactory results by Viola Jones algorithm.  • Unnecessary artefact detected while face detection. Face Recognition: • Selection of suitable face recognition technique.

heading: 68 of 73  16 May 2018
content: • Selection of intelligent feature type for face recognition. •  Big size images generate greater number of features.  •  Number of features is directly proportion to execution time and hence the overall efficiency of system. Number Plate Module: • Front number plate was not visible most of the times. • Text of front number plate was congested and very difficult to separate. • Finding the front number plate was difficult because of its size. • Due to the angle of the letters of number plate, simple pattern matching was not giving satisfactory results. • Region of Interests (ROI) found by MSER processing were not in order. • The year number and sub year letter in standard number plate were not needed. 6.1.2 Lessons Learned The following are the lessons we learned during our FYP-1 period: • The first thing we learned was time management. As, we worked we learned how to prioritize our tasks and how to complete our tasks on time. • We also learned about technologies and concepts related to our project domain during our project research. This helped us to gain expertise in these particular domains and helped us to learn new technologies and techniques. • We also learned team management. We learned how to listen to the views of others and create an environment where everyone could share their ideas and work together in perfect harmony. We learned how to do work with coordination. This helped us to achieve efficient and better results. 6.2 Project Summary Parking security systems are application software which are made for everyone’s use. These systems satisfy the need of people who wish to have security in their parking areas so theft cases can be avoided and reduced and vehicles can be safely parked in the parking areas. The security systems currently available in the market are general security systems which lack proper design for parking security. These systems can be deployed anywhere. They do not provide a proper framework and channel from entry to exit and such deficiencies will be handled by our proposed system. Our system not only recognize face image of rider but also use face recognition as vital components for required security features.      Our software not only use face recognition technique but also employ it to provide one of the best security solutions. We also focused on reducing the complexities of such systems so that they can be used easily. This required a lot of effort. We also focused on developing a user-friendly interface so system can be operated easily. The main focus of

These reports provide information about day to day operations. These reports can be used in determining how efficient the system is. heading: Abstract
content: The purpose of this project is to entertain the users in Virtual Reality system on mobile platform i.e.Android devices. User will experience new depth of fear of zombies in better graphics using the reality system. Virtual Reality  headset is a head -mounted device that provides virtual reality environment for the wearer.  In this project, user will wear Virtual Reality  device on his/her head and a controller in his/her hand operating the in -game character  functions. Zombies coming out of doors trying to reach the user without getting killed.User needs to clear the wave before he gets killed by zombies in order to clear a specific stage. The main purpose of this game-project is to provide gamers a new game with improved graphics on mobile platform, in order to s imulate user’s mentally and physical presence in a virtual or imaginary environment.

heading: 1 Introduction
content: A mobile game is a video game played on feature d phone, smartphones etc. These have been developed , since 1994 , to run on a huge variety of technologies and platforms. Famous platforms which are widely supported are iOS by Apple, Android by Google and Windows by Microsoft. Virtual Reality system is a computer technology that generates realistic images, sounds and other sensations with the help of sensors that helps to simulate the user to feel himself in a new different virtual or imaginary world. It was first introduced i n 1960 and the device named as Telesphere Mask. The environment created by this technology engage his senses to feel himself as a game character. In technical terms, Virtual reality is the term used to describe a three-dimensional, computer generated environment which can be explored and interacted with by a person. That person becomes part of this virtual world or is immersed within this environment and whilst there, is able to manipulate objects or perform a series of actions. Virtual Reality system needs a virtual reality headset that displays virtual dimension to the user and controller to operate. Virtual Reality Headset consist of 2 lenses which are responsible for mapping the distance of eye with the lenses for wide field of display view. It is important to avoid readjusting focus to prevent eye strain. Lenses provided different angle of view. This project is based on Virtual Reality technology consisting of a main character and zombie models. These models are designed using blender in cycle render option. User using virtual reality headset has to kill all the zombies to clear wave and the stage as well. Points will be earned by the users each time it kills a zombie, to buy extra options of weapon and featured grenades. User will use different type of guns and grenade to achieve its goal.

heading: 1.1 Zombie Doors VR
content: Our Project is on game development for Android platform from 4.4.4 KitKat version to onwards using VR(Virtual Reality) API Unity package by Google and Unity Game Engine by Unity Technologies. Our game will consist of a character player which will be controlled by user. As the project name describes “ZombieDoorsVR”, they(doors) will be open wave to wave having zombies behind it. When the door will open zombie will try to reach at user’s character and user will shoot them with provided balls to save himself/herself. Balls are actually used as bullets over here. User will be allowed to have upgrade option of different type of weapons. User need to manage bullets quantity in the challenges to survive.

heading: 1.1.1 Game Story
content: The story of our game is that we have a virtual character stucked in a room full of zombies . The whole city is infected with a x-virus causing people to turn into zombie. Zombie search for human beings to infect them as well. Our virtual character finds some guns  on the same floor where he faces zombies as enemies. There is a helicopter at the roof of the building where he is stuck, in order to reach it he needs to kill all of the zombies to avoid any danger before reaching it. On his way to helicopter he finds more zombie chasing him, the only way to escape the infected city is thru helicoper so he flew the helicopter and escapes the city successfully. There is also a survival mode in this game in a graveyard where our user will experience unlimited number of zombies coming in wave form. User needs to kill all of zombies and needs to survive as long as he can. The purpose of survivial mode in which the player must contin ue playing for as long as possible without dying in an uninterrupted session while the game presents them with increasingly difficult waves of challenges with only one single life and needs to start all over again when dies.

content: • Coin system , user will automatically receive some coins on killing per  zombie, user has to buy new weapons or upgrades or featured grenades by spending these coins. • HP (Health Points),  HP will represent the health of character being controlled. It will decrease as user gets hit by a zombie. • Bonuses during gameplay: user will get a chance to collect small weapon upgrades having limited time • TimedGazeInput Feature to operate menu of game with head movement.

heading: 1.2 Virtual Reality Technology
content: Virtual reality is an artificial environment which is created with software and displayed to the user in such a way that the user suspends belief and agrees to accept the displayed environment as a real environment. On a computer, virtual reality is primarily experienced through two of the five senses: sight and sound.  The simplest form of vir tual reality is 3D image that can be explored in every angle using a input device on a computer. Currently virtual reality is divided into : • Development of an imagined environment for a game or interactive story. • Simulation of a real environment for training and education. For education purpose virtual reality technology is being used for training medical students. i.e Training methods to perform surgery, Driving simulators

heading: 1.3 Virtual Reality Headset
content: Virtual reality headset is the only tool to deal with this technology. It is a head mounted device that provided wearer a virtual reality environment. These are widely used in computer games, mobile games and also gaining popularity in other applications including simulators and trainers etc. The low cost version comes with the lenses and a box to hold user’ • Low cost version comes with only lenses to have a wide angle view and a box to hold the user’s device. E.G. Google cardboard, ETVR, Samsung Gear. • High cost version gives a sound system i.e. hands-free and controller along with the lenses and box and different type of sensors are installed on it to create a new interaction with user’s experience. E.G. HTC Hive, Oculus Rift, PSVR For this project we have used ETVR having a FOV (field of view) of 120 Degree.

heading: 1.4 Android Bluetooth Controller/Gamepad
content: A Bluetooth controller is a device used with games and other applications to operate by sending input signals over Bluetooth communication technology, typically to operate a character or an object of the applicati on. Purpose of Bluetooth controller here is to allow the person to control user’s character while viewing in virtual reality.

heading: 1.5.1 Blender
content: Blender is a professional, free and open source 3D computer graphics software toolset , used for creating models, visual effects, animation for animated films or videos games. It include features of rendering, texturing, rigging and skinning as well. Models for this projects are designed in this toolset software. i.e. User’s Character, Zomb ies , Weapons, Balls, Play Arena. As well as the movement of objects in other words animation of objects is also done in blender.

heading: 1.5.2 Make Human
content: Make Human is also an essential tool for creating a structured model of a human character which can be modified later on if needed according to one’s requirements. This application allows to get all major details that human body requires. Our zombie model was modified from human model which was taken by this application.

heading: 1.5.3 Unity
content: Unity is one of the famous game engine for video games for any platform i.e. iOS, Android, PC, PS etc. It is a cross -platform game engine developed by Unity Technologies use for developing both 2D and 3D videogames and simulations. After the release of Unity 5, only one language remains supported and that is C#.

heading: 1.6 Objectives
content: What is the object of the game? What are the players trying to do? This is often one of the first things you can ask yourself when designing a game. The main objective of our project is to provide a game which they can enjoy with better graphics interface and get their mind sharp on managing resource they have in game while playing it.

heading: 1.7 Problem Statement
content: Why we decided to build this game as a final year project because they are no virtual reality games with an interface and also graphics comparison wise. Most of the virtual reality games are built for personal computer and launches on platform known as  STEAM(world most popular pc games platform). Providing our users a better gameplay with better interface and graphics will attract the virtual reality mobile game development industry to develop more games for this platform. People who cannot afford highly cost virtual reality headset, will be able to enjoy it in less budget. Even with Google Cardboard users can enjoy.

heading: 1.9 Project Scope
content: Games in these days are very trending on mobile phones and people dem ands more and more realistic games day by day. Virtual reality headset provides very much realistic look of graphics so the user can fell that he is actually present in that environment that is why we added VR (Virtual Reality) in our project. Our estimate is that “Future Belongs to Virtual reality”. This is kind of bluff and our game is very dependent on success of virtual reality if the VR succeeded in future then idea of our game will InshAllah be succeeded. We see our project scope is very broader that from our game’s idea others can inherit it and utilize it for their own purposes.

heading: 2.1.1 Plants vs. Zombies (Android & PC)
content: It’s a game developed by EA (Electronic Arts) in this game  zombies come from road side to an open garden and try to enter in a house user’s aim is to prevent them entering in the house by planting different types of firing plants in the zombie’s way. In t his game, coins are collected as sun. purpose of sun base coin system is to generate an army of plants which are actually weapons of the user to kill zombie wave before they reach garden. To unlock new types of zombies user needs to clear stage and s/he n eeds to manage its army inventory according to stage difficulty. Different sort of  zombies are displayed in this list at the time of selection that helps the user to select its army inventory.

heading: 2.1.2 DEAD TARGET: FPS Zombie Apocalypse Survival Games
content: It’s an android based FPS (First person shooter) game in which we see only hands and a gun. In this game user is surrounded by many zombies and he has to kill them all by his gun of bullets. All the zombie characters randomly spawns and move towards user’s character. In this game user needs to buy different types of weapon, those weapons are more powerful than the stock ones using points gained from killing zombies.

Famous platforms which are widely supported are iOS by Apple, Android by Google and  Windows by Microsoft. Virtual Reality system is a computer technology that generates realistic images, sounds and other sensations with the help of sensors that helps to simulate the user to feel himself in a new different virtual or imaginary world. It was first introduced in 1960 and the device named as Telesphere Mask. The environment created by this technology engage his senses to feel himself as a game character. 1In technical terms, Virtual reality is the term used to describe a three - dimensional, computer generated environment which can be explored and interacted with by a person. That person becomes part of this virtual world  or is immersed within this environment and whilst there, is able to  manipulate objects or perform a series of actions. Virtual Reality system needs a virtual reality headset that displays virtual dimension to the user and controller to operate. Virtual Reality Headset consist of 2 lenses which are responsible for mapping the distance of eye with the lenses for wide field of display view. It is important to avoid readjusting focus to prevent eye strain. Lenses provided different angle of view. This project is based on Virtual Reality tech nology consisting of a main character and zombie models. These models are designed using blender in cycle render option. User using virtual reality headset has to kill all the zombies to clear wave and the stage as well. Points will be earned by the users each time it kills a zombie, to buy extra options of weapon and featured grenades. User will use different type of guns and grenade to achieve its goal. 1.1 Zombie Doors VR Our Project is on game development for Android platform from 4.4.4 KitKat version t o onwards using VR(Virtual Reality) API Unity package by Google and Unity Game Engine by Unity Technologies. Our game will consist of a character player which will be controlled by user. As the project name describes “ZombieDoorsVR”, they(doors) will be open wave to wave having zombies behind it. When the door will open zombie will try to reach at user’s character and user will shoot them with provided balls to save himself/herself. Balls are actually used as bullets over here. User will be allowed to have upgrade option of different type of weapons. User need to manage bullets quantity in the challenges to survive. 1.1.1 Game Story The story of our game is that we have a virtual character stucked in a room full of zombies. The whole city is infected with a x-virus causing people to turn into zombie. Zombie search for human beings to infect them as well. Our virtual character finds some guns on the same floor where he faces zombies as enemies. There is a helicopter at the roof of the building where he is stuck, in order to reach it he needs to kill all of the zombies to avoid any danger before reaching it. On his way to helicopter he finds more zombie chasing him, the only way to escape the infected city is thru helicoper so he flew the helicopter and escapes the city successfully. There is also a survival mode in this game in a graveyard where our user will experience unlimited number of zombies coming in wave form. User needs to kill all of zombies and needs to survive as long as he can. The purpose of survivial 4mode in which the player must continue playing for as long as possible without dying in an uninterrupted session while the game presents them  with increasingly difficult waves of challenges with only one single life and needs to start all over again when dies. 1.1.2 Models ? On a computer, virtual reality is primarily  experienced through two of the five senses: sight and sound. The simplest form of virtual reality is 3D image that can be explored in every angle using a input device 19on a computer. Currently virtual reality is divided into : ? 8Development of an imagined environment for a game or interactive story. ? Simulation of a real environment for training and education. For education purpose virtual reality technology is being used for training medical students. i.e Training methods to perform surgery, Driving simulators 1.3 Virtual Reality Headset Virtual reality headset is the only tool to deal with this technology. It is a head mounted device that provided wearer a virtual reality environment. These are widely used in computer games, mobile games and also gaining popularity in other applications including simulators and t rainers etc. The low cost version comes with the lenses and a box to hold user’ ? Low cost version comes with only lenses to have a wide angle view and a box to hold the user’s device. E.G. Google cardboard, ETVR, Samsung Gear. ? High cost version gives a sound system i.e. hands-free and controller along with the lenses and box and different type of sensors are installed on it to create a new interaction with user’s experience. E.G. HTC Hive, Oculus Rift, PSVR For this project we have used ETVR having a FOV  (field of view) of 120 Degree. 1.4 Android Bluetooth Controller/Gamepad A Bluetooth controller is a device used with games and other applications to operate by sending input signals over Bluetooth communication technology, typically to operate a character or an object of the application. Purpose of Bluetooth controller here is to allow the person to control user’s character while viewing in virtual reality.

heading: Abstract
content: Pakistan has largest labor and manpower resources in the world. In 21 century there is a huge advancement in technology which changes the people’s demands accordingly. They want a quick response to fulfil their needs. We  are  providing  Online  Manpower  services  by  dealing  with  the  authorized contractors, which formed a view point to provide a comprehensive services to foreign  principals  as  well  as intending  refugees.  The  idea  of  developing  this application is intended to provide people with reliable and analytical coverage of labor. The basic purpose of this app is that people will acquire this service at their homes. This Online Labor Hiring System will provide the labor to the users and in vast scope this will reduce the rate of unemployment in Pakistan. This website will help in reducing the rate of poverty by providing the jobs to the labor. We directly contact with the different type of contractor which provide his labor according to user demand.

heading: 1.1Introduction
content: The  problems  of  labor  staffing  and  scheduling  have  received  consequential importance in the Current situation of our country. We introduce a platform to avoid the problem of labor staffing and scheduling by providing different types of services for local communitiesto fulfil their demands. Collectively,  we also ensure the delivery of a minimally acceptable level of service within no time. This website will provide service in the least expensive way of delivering a specified accumulated level of customer service by providing labor  staff  in  a  scheduled  manner.  We  ensure  the  highest  level  of  service obtainable with a fixed amount of labor. This website will help in saving the time and cost utilizing in travelling. Our  website  will  hire  different  type  of  contractors,  which  provide  labor  of different  categorieslike  Technician,HomeBased  and  Constructionservices  to facilitate our users.Theuser will avail these services by simply signup on our website.Users will hire the fixed amount of the labors account of their need. Hiring Labor is a Prime issue in these days where people cannot find the fixed amount of labor at fixed cost.We provide a footplate where users can get an acceptable  level  of  their  work  with  an  aggregated  amount  of  time  at  their homes.This system can help us to overcome issues related to labor staffing and scheduling. Provide different services at homes,we use google map which shows the nearest contractors available for providing services.User  can  easily send a request to his/her nearest contractor.The contractor will receive a notification from the user and  get  his  cell  number  and  location.  The  user  can  easily  contact  with  the contractor whom he called.

heading: 1.2Objective
content: • To develop the best website for the people which provide labor quickly without labors interaction. • To facilitate people by saving their time by providing quick response to their request. • To reduce the rate of unemployment by providing jobs to the labor. • To satisfy the people demands through fair dealing with contractors. • To  maintain  a  single  platform  for  requesting  labors  online  to  attain services. • We provide customers with the ability to handover tasks to trustworthy contractors who provide good quality services. 1.3Problem statement Now a days problem of finding labor is a very common issue. People cannot get a fixed amount of labor easily.We facilitate  people with different labors at their homes.We not only providing people with labors in their homes, but in vast scope we also provide jobs to labors by hiring different contractors.These contractors provide labors according to customers demand. Our website will provide service in the least expensive way by delivering labors in a scheduled manner. Through this website, we are helping people to save their time and cost utilizing in finding labor. 1.4Assumptions & constraints

heading: Time Constraint
content: Our project must be completed by the given deadline.

heading: Scope Constraints
content: Online ManPower Services not only provide different labors for services, but exclude the risk of getting uncompleted work. Users will see the status of a project and a project is not being stated as completed until users will not mark it as completed. It ensures the fair dealing between the contractors and customers for hiring of labors by fixing the cost of per day labor. Moreover,project rating will shows which contractor is fairly complete the project according to customer satisfaction.

heading: Cost Constraint
content: Our project must be completed within the cost which is discussed in our budget

heading: Assumptions
content: The system is being developed to solve problems for hiring labor. Assuming the system is only for those people who will be registered on our website to avail our services. Real time scenarios will need this application and hardware. 1.5Project scope We are providing following features in one platform: • A platform where users can hire different labor at their homes. • A place where users can hire the fixed amount of  labor at a fixed cost, to calculate the correct estimation of a project. • It will allow the users to markthe status of their project as completed, not completed or exit. • It will also allow the contractor to see the status of their project as running,completed or not completed. • To provide the user with the nearest contractor,we add google map which shows the nearest contractor so that the user can easily send request and avail the desired service within  the  time.  •Customer  will  also  rate  the  project  so  that  the  specified  project contractor will be rated and shown on his/her profile, so that highly rated contractors will be shown at first.

heading: 2.1 Literature review / Existing system study
content: Literature review We searched and studied many application related to online manpower services which have different working related to provide services. Some of them are as follow.

heading: Uber
content: Uber user just open up the app, turn on his location and enter his destination point where he wants to go. The app tells the user the total distance and estimated  fare  for  his  destination.  The  driver  of  the  cab  just  receives  the location of the user. When the user reaches at his destination, he and the driver of cab receive the notification about the total fare. After the ride user rates the driver in stars. [1]

heading: Washio
content: Washio is a US based service which provides laundry and dry cleaning services to customers. It provides on-demand pickup service in 10 minutes and 24 hour turnaround. [2]

heading: Vint
content: Vint is an app that provides you with your own personal trainer for work outs. The customer can summon the trainer at his/her desired location that may be the Gym, the park, his house etc. [3]

heading: Nokar Online
content: Nokar Online is a web based service currently available only in Bahria Town Lahore. It provides home customers with the service of bringing grocery from all nearby stores in Bahria Town Lahore in a fee of as low as just Rs.10 for each time groceries are delivered. [4]

heading: Roadie:
content: Roadie is an application competing with big companies like TCS, DHL and UPS. It provides package delivery services where registered Roadie drivers can choose which gig or task they want to do and perform it to deliver the package from A to B. [5]

heading: 2.3.5 Software Development Life Cycle Model
content: We have selected Incremental model” for project expansion .The incremental model is more suitable  for the development of the software. The incremental build model is more suitable  for the development of a software where each module of the product is passes through the requirement designed, implemented and tested phases (a little more is added each time) until the product is finished. The product is define as finished when it fulfil all of its requirement.it involve both  development and maintenance.

We chose Incremental Model for our project because we want: 1. The requirements of the project are clearly define and understood. 2. To lower the initial delivery cost. 3. To develop main functionality first. 4. Customer can response to each features. 5. It is easy to test and debug each increment. 6. Each requirement are implement by phase wise.

heading: Abstract
content: Over the years’ mobile phones have changed from a simple communication device to an operative tool that becomes the major point of many growing businesses due to its amazing features of high speed data access and interactive interface. Thus, importance of mobile application in everyday life and activities is definite and endless. In this new era of technology “Smart Tailor” is an android based application with admin portal that provides facility to customers to search out best tailors in city and provide tailors a platform to advertise their best designs and get customer interactions on large scale. The major aspect of our project is to development. Moreover, the basic functionality of our application helps out those customers who want to change their tailor, locate good rated tailor in city along with latest designs, get good booking deals and help tailors to advertise their designs, show their location on map and direct link to customers.

heading: 1.1 Brief introduction
content: Smart Tailor is an android application, which will help customers who newly move to city and those who wants to find best tailor shops in the city. Smart Tailor will help customers to locate tailor shops on the map. Customers can search gender base tailor shops. Customers can also read tailor shop information provided by the owner of the shop and contact tailor using contact information.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: In this project, we expect to make a system that enables customers to access, search and inquire about the best tailor shops in the city. As of today, we are not aware of a single application that is dealing this problem specifically for customers who are moving to new city. Basic objectives to build our application are as follows  To provide sign in consoles for customers and tailor (user).  To provide a search panel where customers can search to get results.  To provide a list of tailor shops along with their information.  To provide customers wide range of latest men and women clothing designs.  To provide customers online booking.  To provide a mapped location for customers to locate the tailor shops.  To get feedback from customers by liking the tailor shops.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: In Pakistan mostly, tailor shops working on manual system and manually record customer size measurement and clothes delivering data. Customers can visit tailor shops on regular basis to give his/her size measurements and get c lothes booking. On the decide date customer again visit tailor shop to get his/her clothes back. Therefore, customers mostly visit nearby tailor shops due to regular visits. Further, new customers in city have no access to nearby or distant tailor shops due to unawareness of local areas.

heading: 11 of 110  02 January 2019
content: Smart Tailor application provides customers user -friendly interface to search best nearby tailor shops in city. Thus, it provides customers list of tailor shops and display distance path from customer current location to se lected tailor shop. Our application also reduces customer shop visits by providing online booking which includes online selection of designs, enter size measurement and get clothes booking. Smart Tailor allows tailor to display their shops on Google Maps a nd advertise their clothing styles. The aim of our application is to specifically target those tailor shops which are not on Google maps.

heading: Assumptions:
content: The following assumptions were made in developing the project plan:  Technology like android OS, people and budget is in place to implement the project.  Customers (users) are interested in this project.  Tailor shop owners are interested in participating.  Java Toolkit is available for developing the project.  Internet availability to ensure the mapped location of shops.

heading: Constraints:
content: The following constraints were believed to possibly limit the development of the project:  Availability of owners of shops.  The project must be completed within the allocated budget and resources present.  Project must be operational by the end of the academic year.  Availability of software for testing

heading: Project Description:
content: Smart Tailor is a useful application for those customers who wants to search new tailor service in city and have desire to select wide range of latest designs for their clothing. Our Project’s idea reflects the aim to help customers to locate best tailor service in ci ty, select wide range of latest clothing designs, and provide facilities to tailors to expand their businesses to larger extent.

heading: 12 of 110  02 January 2019
content: The application first end user is customer, which can create its profile and can add its personal information including phone n umbers and home address. Thus, customer can search new tailor services through application search facility and can check tailor profile and select latest men and women clothing designs . Smart Tailor also facilitate customers if they want online delivery of  clothes, thus our application provide s service where customers select cloth designs, body measurement s and send order to tailor for online delivery. Customer can also provide its feedback by liking Tailor shops. There is second end user of application, Tailor the owner, which can create its profile and can upload its latest men and women clothing designs separately along with their prices. Moreover, it can upload its personal information including phone numbers, location and booking timings. Once the custo mer sends booking request, the tailor can respond to request based on its booking schedule,  deliver clothes to customer address, and receive cash on delivery.

heading: Boundaries:
content:  Initially Smart Tailor is limited to one city (Lahore).  Smart Tailor supports only android mobiles/operating system.  Smart tailor only displays location and profile of tailor selected by customer.  Smart Tailor not provides online payments via credit card rather it provides payments on delivery.

heading: 2.1 Literature review
content: Around the globe various applications are working and providing tailor shops and clothing designs related information to the people but none is focusing specifically on customers who want to access nearby best tailor shops in city and those who are moving to new city. Some other related applications working around the globe are as follows

heading: The Mobile Tailor
content: It’s an android application available on google play store working in Nigeria. This application belongs to professional tailoring company offers direct tailoring to clients with complete cuttings and sewing precisions. This application includes fabric pickup, push notifications, special promos, fashion blog like features and thus deliver desire clothing to client within one to four weeks. [1]

heading: Tailor
content: It’s an android application available on play store working in India. The major task of this application is to store customer details and clothes measurement in android mobile rather than the physical notebook. This application main features incl udes tailor can update, delete, change and see customer measurement. Further application allows tailor to backup and restore data and search customers with name and phone numbers. [2]

heading: Tailor Pro
content: Tailor Pro is Nigerian application available on paly store. This application provide platform for both tailors and fashion designers to organize their tasks and optimize performance. Thus, tailor pro application has facility of keep records, measurement book, store customer information and provide quick customer filtration on basis of their names, selecting criteria with online data backup. [3]

heading: M Tailor
content: M Tailor is an android based application available on google play store working in San Francisco. This application provides the feature of getting customer measureme nt online by using customer mobile camera in less than five minutes and provides customization of clothing in just few taps. It basic feature is to sell clothing online and provides money back guarantee if anything is less than perfect. [4] All these applications do not work in Pakistan but are only available within their countries.

heading: 2.7 Software Development Lifecycle
content: Waterfall model is the most suitable development lifecycle for our project “Smart Tailor”. Why this particular model is chosen?  This model is very simple to understand and easy to use.  Waterfall model best suits our project because our requirements are clear and completely understood.  Waterfall models is best choice to complete our project because we have less human resources and have only a development time period of one year  The waterfall model let us avoid performing activities like risk handling and testing in multiple phases which will consume time.  Waterfall model works well for smaller projects and thus it is easier to manage our project with this model.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content:  We were unfamiliar with the market knowledge of Shops and hence had to understand the different business models.  We had to learn Android Application Development using our own resources.  Integration of Google API’s took a lot to handle according to our project.  Learning AngularJS was a plus point to build the Admin panel.  Bower components and node project manager (npm) were also learned to handle the front-end and back-end dependencies used in Admin Panel development

heading: Abstract
content: The Android gaming industry is blooming in the current times and the number of players worldwide are increasing with a rapid pace. There is a constant supply of fresh games in all the genres. However, there is a lack of story-based games on the android platform, as compared to the PC and other gaming consoles. Specifically, games that provide fast -paced games along with a rich storyline are missing from the android games market. We plan to take this lack as an opportunity and develop an action/adventure game for Android smartphones that will feature an engaging story, a fast-paced gameplay, and visually stunning graphics and artwork.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: The game is about a character’s journey to the top of a mystical route, to a place where he has dreamt of going his entire life. The player would be shown a title video in the beginning of the game, where our character, Andy, describes a magical place that is said to exist only in myths and legends. He describes the past efforts and all the struggles that people have  made to reach that place. However, no one has ever been successful in reaching the top. Andy also describes his life and all the hardships he has faced. He talks about how he has been bullied throughout his life and feels worthless. His grades are poor and even his parents are disappointed with h im. He decides to prove his worth to his parents and anyone who has ever bullied him, by climbing up to the top of this difficult route. This is when the player will take control of the character, and begin his ascent. The game will start at the bottom of  the route and the player would encounter new levels and environments as Andy progresses up the route. The objective of the game is to reach the top, while facing all the hurdles, obstacles and enemies on the way. The player will control the character by swiping left and right on the screen to move the player respectively and tapping on the screen to use his special power . There will be other controls apart from these basic few, depending on the situation the character is in. The different environments will include sewers, mountains, buildings, etc. Each environment will feature new textures and unique things to climb, such as pipes, rocks and ropes. The enemies will also change depending on the environment. For example, you’ll face bats in the sewers and eagles in the mountains. There would be collectibles along the way that would either make his journ ey simpler or more challenging. These would eithe r increase or decrease the player’s speed, thus making the game harder or easier, respectively. The game would also implement a stamina system. The player needs to use his special power i.e. the power of will to battle the enemies. Once the power is used, the stamina diminishes and is restored after a while. Thus the player needs to accurately time the use of his power, in order to fight off the enemies and continue the journey. The game will feature various cut scenes in order to create a strong storyline.  These can be in the form of animated sequences or a slideshow of pictures. During the journey, the player will also get to know Andy’s thoughts. His observations or thoughts will be displayed in the form of text at the bottom of the screen at various poin ts throughout the game. This will let the user know what’s going on in Andy’s mind at the time. He could be thinking about something from the past, or his current situation, or about what he plans to do once he reaches his destination. Showing this thought process will help strengthen the storyline.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: Our aim is to create a standalone build of the game that could later be published on the Google Play Store and made available to people around the world. The objective is to create all the 3D models  and artwork, and integrate them into our game inside the game engine. We plan to work on all the following tasks: • Creating the 3D models required for our game, including the character and environment models, such as trees, rocks and mountains. • Creating the artwork for the game’s logo, title screen etc. • Using a game engine to design the game by integrating the 3D models and coding the functionality and game mechanism. • Test the game on various devices and finalize a build.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: The Android gaming industry is saturated with a lot of fast -paced games. The games such as Temple Run, Subway Surfers and Piano Tiles have dominated the Play Store for a long time. However, these games lack an important feature that many gamers are looking for: a deep storyline. A storyline enables the user to form an emotional connection with the character in the game. We take this lack of storyline as an opportunity to create a complete game that satisfies the users in every aspect.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & Constraints
content: The Play Store is saturated with countless games, as they are being developed by both indie and large studios at a rapid rate. In this crowded collection of redundant games, the users are inclined to look for games that provide something unique. Our game has the upper hand in this aspect, as it provides what the other games lack.

heading: 1.4.1 Constraints
content: Firstly, there is a constraint lying on the Android version of the user’s device. Our game will support Android versions 5.0 and above. Any device running and Android OS version lower than 5.0 will not be able to run the game. Similarly, the user’s device must have at least 1 GB of RAM to run the game smoothly. Secondly, we need to keep the size of the game small, while maintaining the quality. This is because the users prefer to install games of smaller download sizes. Finally, the number of permissions required for the installation and functioning of game should be kept at a minimum. Asking for too many permissions, especially access to the gallery, contacts or other personal data, causes doubt in the minds of the users. This can cause us to lose many users, as they would avoid

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: We want to create a game that is addictive and keeps the players hooked, a game that the players can count on for entertainment. Our audience will include people of all ages that love to play games on their smartphones. The genre of the game is completely in line with what’s trending. People love fast -paced games and a good storyline, and they’ll be getting both through our game.

heading: 2.1 Existing System Study
content: There are various games that are partially related to ours. Games with a deep storyline can mostly be found on PC e.g. Alan Wake [1], COD: Black Ops [2], etc. However, the amount of games with a fetching storyline is relatively low on smartphones. A few related titles are discussed below:

heading: Climb! :
content: This game features a character climbing on a single mountain with varying weathers and difficulties. The objective is to reach the top of the mountain. Our game does indeed involve the concept of going up, but the game elements and game mechanism is comple tely different. Our game addresses the shortcomings of this game. The character is not customizable in Climb!, neither are there any upgrades or tools available to the character. The game also lacks a storyline, which our game would provide. Furthermore, Climb! only includes a single game mode and there is nothing else left for the player to do once he reaches the top of the mountain. Our game, however, features two game modes, a story mode and an endless mode. So the game does not end when a player finishes the story mode, rather he can play on in the endless mode, to beat a friend’s high score or simply to make a new personal best. [3]

heading: Temple Run:
content: Our game is similar to Temple Run, or any other endless runner that has a character, in the sense that both of these games require the use of quick reflexes to overcome the hurdles and keep moving. However, all such endless runners lack a good storyline. This is where our game takes the lead. Andy’s Ascent will feature a deep storyline that will connect the audience to our main character and his struggles. Thus, mixing both of the elements: a swift gameplay and a great storyline. [4]

heading: 5.1 Problems Faced and Lessons Learned
content: The team was faced with various challenges along the development process. Although we were familiar to the game engine, but the 3D modelling tool was relatively new to us. Designing the character, its various attires and the environmental models was proving to be very time consuming. Thus, we used the character available on MIXAMO  [6], as well as royalty -free 3D models from other websites including OpenGameArt [7], TurboSquid [8], etc. Creating the animations took up a lot of time as well. Unity does not have a very sharp learning curve. You don’t face major problems while using the game engine. However, writing the code scripts is a tricky part. C# language was used for coding, and creating the logic for various game mechanisms took a lot of effort. We learned that once you define the logic, the rest of the process is quite simple. Syntax of the engine -specific code can be found in the documentation or at other online resources. Once you figure out the logic, you can easily convert it into the desired code. Another thing we learned is that sometimes we overlook the little mistakes which cause big problems later on. While focusing on the big picture, we accidentally make some spelling-errors or place some lines of code in the incorrect order. These mistakes happen when we don’t pay attention to detail. Going back to the editor and debugging a code once it fails to compile, is also very time consuming. Thus, it is better to be careful while writing the code, so that we don’t make these little mistakes in the first place.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: The project aims to design a game that the Android gaming world currently lacks. heading: 1.1. Brief Introduction
content: Cloud computing is being adapted by many of the organizations due to its dynamic scalability and virtualized resources [1]. Now -a-days cloud storage systems have provided ease to people by providing online storages where they can store their huge amount of data. Cloud computing, particularly cloud storage, has been proven in multiple real -world use cases to simplify Information Technology (IT) operations helping companies to save millions of dollars. Indeed, the era of Big Data would not be possible without the emergence of highly scalable cloud storage [2]. Cloud storage provide ease to users i n variety of ways like providing faster accessibility, rapid deployment and strong protection for  data security, backup, and disaster recovery of data. Other benefits of clouds include backing -up of data and data accessibility from any part of the world. D ue to extensive use of clouds, problems pertaining to it are becoming noticeable. For example, virtualization vulnerabilities, and manhandle of cloud services. [3] Similarly the load over the servers is getting heavier due to which the system must look ove r more advisable methods to minimize the load. For that purpose, distributed file system and cloud storages come handy which addresses many of the problems discussed above, in which a dataset is divided into small chunks and these chunks are then stored ov er different servers to minimize the load on the single server hence also increasing the efficiency and security [4]. Many goals have been achieved by data distribution like fault tolerance, ability to store maximum data size and managing it efficiently, a llows append operations on file, ensures reliable communication among different machines. However, attention is still needed on the domain of retrieval of distributed data completely in its original form. This project focuses on distribution and retrieval of data which is stored onto different servers. This can be achieved by the help of information retrieval algorithm which will facilitate us by maintaining the order of data slices for same file so that while fetching, it can be arranged into a complete file.

heading: 2.1.2. Data Splitting & Encryption Techniques:
content: Cryptography is a secure communication technique used now a day when there is presence of malicious third-parties—known as adversaries. Encryption which is a main module of cryptography uses an  algorithm and a key to transform an input known as plaintext into an encrypted output called ciphertext. Algorithm will always decrypt the cipher text/block into plaintext if the same  key is provided. This algorithm is considered secure because if any of the encrypted data (cipher block) is lost, info from this block cannot be retrieved until the same encryption key is given.

heading: Data Encryption:
content: • Symmetric Encryption:  This is the simplest kind of encryption that involves only one secret key to cipher and deci pher information. Symmetrical encryption is an old and best -known technique. It uses a secret key that can either be a number, a word, or a string of random letters. It is a blended with the plain text of a message to change the content in a way. The sende r and the recipient should know the secret key that is used to encrypt and decrypt all the messages. • Asymmetric Encryption: Asymmetric algorithms use two keys, one to encrypt the data, and either key to decrypt. These inter -dependent keys are generated together. One is labeled the Public key and is distributed freely. The other is labeled the Private Key and must be kept hidden. • Hash: A hash function is a mathematical function that takes input/data of an arbitrary length and then generates fixed length has h based on Table 1: Summary of Literature Work P a g e  16 | 54 input. Hash has a great property to calculate the hash easily but very difficult to generate the original data only if the hash value is known. Data splitting: Cryptography splitting is an algorithm that splits the input/data into equal or random number of chunks. Splitting is done at bit level. A secure key is used to control splitting and splitting is done randomly.

heading: Data Security:
content: Blowfish, AES, RC4, DES, RC5, and RC6 are used for encryption to enhance security. Whereas the most widely used algorithm are AES-128, AES-192, and AES-256. Why AES-256? • Low memory cost. • High speed algorithm • The key used to encrypt, and decrypt is same. • Cipher block and plain block are of same size. • Fast both is software and hardware.

heading: Abstract
content: Toxic Comment Detection refers to the detection of the toxic comments during online text -based conversation. The background of the problem originates from the multitude of online platforms, where -in people/users belonging to various religious, region, culture and fields of life actively participate and make comments, social applications are the best example for this. There are many social applications where users mostly do text-based interactions. There is a possibility that the pattern or selection of words  during online text-based conversation may expresses the culture, religion and norms of the users. So, there is a chance  that the comments sometimes may be abusive, insulting or ever hate -based, it becomes the responsibility of the hosting organizations to ensure that the conversation are not of negative type. This problem raises the importance of toxic comments detection and to develop  a model that could make prediction to classify the co mments. S ome applications are also developed including Perspective API, Friendly Chat, Facebook Suicide Detection. The main aim of this project is to apply n-gram models. We explored two variants for n-gram model: word n-gram and character n -gram. The length of word n-gram varies from one to three  and the length of character n -gram goes from three to ten.  For feature extraction , we used TFIDF vec torizer and COUNT  vectorizer. We used supervised machine learning technique for binary classification. Regarding machine learning algorithms, we explored RandomForestClassifier, DecisionTreeClassifier, LinearSVC, AdaBoostClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier, RidgeClassifier, MultinomialNB and BernoulliNB. For training these models, we used train_test_split technique. For validating all these Machine Learning algorithms, various evaluation measures are used including Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 and ROC_AUC. The best Accuracy and F1 score for binary classification are 0.66 and 0.48 respectively. In deep learning, we used bi -directional LSTM and got 61.09% Accuracy. The final product of our project will be a prototype system which  will predict the unseen/new toxic comments in English Language. content: Our research focus is to prepare  dataset of toxic comments  and develop a recommender system for toxic comment detection (for English Language only).

heading: 1.5 Contribution of the Study
content: We develop and apply Syntactic Features and Deep Learning Features to detect toxic comments using variou s classification algorithms  and deep learning algorithms. Supervised machine learning technique is used for binary classification . We explored various feature extraction methodologies. In Syntactic feature extraction, we used n -grams with is two variants: word n -grams and character n-grams. In word n-grams, we used word uni-gram, word bi-gram and word tri-gram. In character n-gram, we did experiments with character tri-gram, character 4- gram, character 5-gram, character 6-gram, character 7-gram, character 8-gram, character 9-gram and character 10 gram.  For feature extraction, we used TFIDF vectorizer and count vectorizer. Regarding machine learning algorithms, we used RandomForestClassifier, DecisionTreeClassifier, LinearSVC, AdaBoostClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier, RidgeClassifier, MultinomialNB , BernoulliNB. In deep learning, we used bi -directional LSTM. For validating all these algorithms, various evaluation measures are used including Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F 1 and ROC_AUC.

content: Following are the objectives of this study: o Explore the problem of RS  (Recommender System) for toxic comment detection in detail. o To model data to make predictions and recommendations o To make online conversation better o To test and validate predictions to ensure that they are meaningful o To learn how recommender system implementations could improve business o To analyse datasets and transform them into representations that will permit recommender system to make recommendation to get useful data insight o To develop recommender systems to solve real-world problems o Investigating state-of-the-art methods for toxic comments detection o Use various classification algorithms and select best one

heading: 1.7 Scope of the Study
content: One of the most important things for the toxic comment detection is availability of Wik ipedia comments dataset for toxic comment detection. There are several applications available which allows users to do decent online conversation and don’t let them to send any lethal comment. Thus, there is a need of a recommender system for toxic comment  detection. Our main goal is to develop  a recommender system for Toxic Comment Detection for English language only  and evaluate state of the art techniques for toxic comment detection.

heading: 2.2.2 Corpus for Spam Comments Detection
content: In [2], the authors collected comments using Sina  Weibo API to build seed spam dictionary. Keeping the number of comments in consideration, the authors collected comments of 10 well -known users from microblogs between 12/15/2015 and 02/14/2016. The authors organized many people for selecting spam words . These spam words are collected from Chinese microblogging comments. The selection of words is done by using s election strategy. A  word was included into seed spam dictionary after 2/3 people’s selection. The authors collected 675 seed spam words. These words include five categories: advertising, vulgar, criminal words, politically sensitive and erotic.  1000 spam comments and 1000 normal comments were artificially labelled by authors. After this artificial labelling the dataset looks like “1,0,1,0.33,0.37, Y”. Here “1,0,1,0.33,0.37” are features/input vectors and “Y” is the label/output. Finally, the authors selected 70% for training phase and 30% for testing phase.

heading: 3.1 Recommender System
content: Predictive tasks are concerned with human activities, behaviour and thoughts are acknowledged as Recommender System. Recommender Systems (RSs) are the software tools that produce recommendations of the products that a user may want to use. These are used to get related information/recommendations to users for products that might attention them. RS s are the software that are used for information processing and they energetically collect different types of data to generate the suggestions. There are three phases in the recommendation process: Information/Data Collection Phase, Learning Phase, Prediction/Recommendation Phase . For a recommender system, Item, user and transaction are most important components. These are discussed below:

heading: Items
content: Items are those objects or things that are recommended/suggested to the user. These substances can be categorized w.r.t value, use, or complication. The value of an item can be positive (+ve) or negative (-ve). The value would be positive and negative if the item is beneficial to the user and if the user is incapable to make the right conclusion when choosing it respectively.

heading: Users
content: Users of a Recommender System (RS) may have very various goal line and characteristics. RS utilizes an amount of information related to the users. This information can be organized in different ways. The selection of what data should be Chapter 3: Recommender System for Toxic Comment Detection modelled depends on the recommendation practices. Behavioural pattern data is used to describe the users. Let say, the patter to search a website (in a Web -based Recommender Systems). A Recommender System might use this information/data to suggest objects to users that were favoured by similar users.

heading: Transaction
content: Transaction means, log-like data that stock significant data formed throughout the human -computer interaction, this information is valuable for recommender system. For instance, a product may have feedback (Normally , an opinion right after the usage of product). This feedback can be taken implicitly or explicitly. This feedback can be Numerical ratings  such as 1 -5, Ordinal ratings  such as strongly agree, agree, neutral, disagree, strongly disagree and Binary ratings  such Good or Bad, Yes or No and True or False.

heading: 3.2.2 Content-based Filtering
content: While using Content -based filtering, the items are recommended to user/customer X like preceding objects rated highly by X. Content -based filtering’s techniques and procedures are grounded on an explanation of an object and a  profile having user’s fondness . The currently recommended items are like those that are loved by the user earlier. T his tactic has its origins in information accessibil ity and its filtering research. Basically, these methods use an item profile to define the item within the system. The systems produced the user’s content -based profiles. These profiles are built based on item features’ weighted vector. The reputation of each feature is symbolized to the users by these weights. By using various methods, we can compute from independently rated content vectors. Simplest practices utilize average values of evaluated item ve ctor when other sophisticate practices utilize machine learning procedures including Bayesian Classifiers etc. to approximation the likelihood that the user will like or rate positively this item. This disadvantage is also known as serendipity problem. It highlights the propensity of the content -based system to generate suggestions with an inadequate degree of innovation.

heading: 3.2.3 Hybrid Recommender System
content: Hybrid recommen der systems are the mixture of Collaborative filtering and Content-based filtering. These overwhelmed the boundaries of native Collaborative Filtering (CF) practices. It progresses the forecast presentation/performance. Prominently, it reduces the Collabor ative Filtering difficulties including sparsity and loss of information.  When two or more basic recommender system techniques are given, a new hybrid system can be produced b y using many proposed practices . Though, they have amplified complicati on and cos tly to code/implement . Typically, many commercial recommender systems are hybrid, for example, recommender system of Google news.

content: In this final year project, we have developed a tool which will detect and discard the toxic comments written in English language. One of the most important things for the toxic comment  detection is the  availability of Wikipedia Comments dataset. We prepared binary label dataset with size of 29999 (15000 are toxic and 14999 are non-toxic) in train and 29999 (15000 are toxic and 14999 are non -toxic) in test. There are several applications available which allows users to write normal comments and discard the lethal comment.  Thus, there was a need of Comment Detection. Our main goal was to develop a Recommender System for Toxic Comment Detection for English Language.  We used supervised machine learning technique for binary classification . We explored two variants of n -gram model: word n -gram (ranging from 1 to 3) and character n-gram (ranging from 3 to 10). For feature extraction, we used TFIDF vectorizer and count vectorizer. Regarding machine learning algorithms, we used RandomForestClassifier, DecisionTreeClassifier, LinearSVC, AdaBoostClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier, RidgeClassifier, MultinomialNB, and BernoulliNB. In deep learning, we used bi - directional LSTM. For validating all  these algorithms, various evaluation measures are used including Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1 and ROC_AUC. Overall, we got best results on word 1 -1 gram using maximum features 2500 and on character 3 -3 gram using maximum features 2500.  In specific, AdaBoostClassifier gives highest 69% Accuracy on char 5-5 gram with 5000 &10000 maximum features and on char 6 -6 gram with 2500 maximum features. F 1 result is 48% on word 3 -3 gram using 5000 maximum features. In deep learning, we got 61.09% Accuracy using LSTM. As far as Classifiers are concerned, LinearSVC performed well for all character n -gram and word n -gram using 2500, 5000 & 10000 maximum features. Throughout this project TFIDF gives better results as compare to COUNT. We also had some issues while the development process. Due to having large amount of data, it was difficult to apply maximum algorithms and cross validation technique that is why we used train_test_split technique. User’s input needs to be converted into 1-D array before passing to vectorizer in Application phase , that really took time to identify. We had some issues while accessing the Tkinter’s attributes for making User Interface. We were having issues with our original dataset also, it was not balanced.
