heading: 1.1  Introduction
content: DPP (Doorway Printing & Press) is a platform that provides digital and offset printing services. It has several sellers under its wing offering their p rinting services. It provides a platform to sellers where they post the detailed templates of their des igns and choose relevant category and sub- category. The details of a template include title, price, quantity, and description, and template image. A specific price is not mentioned in a template because the cost of printing services mainly depends on the price of the paper and the price of the pape r changes after 24 hours in all over the country. Let’s say the price of the paper in Lahore on a specific day is PKR 10 per square foot and the price in Sialkot is PKR 11 per square foot. Right after 24 hours, the prices change and the price in Lahore become PKR 10.7 per square foot whereas the price i n Sialkot changes to PKR 10.2 per square foot. Therefore, standardizing the price is not an option. To overcome this issue and to ensure proper interaction between buyers and sellers, DPP offers a chatting module where the buyer and seller can exchange words related to requirements a nd negotiate a price for a specific order based on the paper rate. The buyer can browse through 1000’s of Sellers’s profiles and their templates to determine which suites their needs. Furthermore, the buyer can also place a custom order with a unique design which can be discussed in the chat. Once the seller and buyer are on agreed terms, it’s time for the buyer to place the order. The order will be placed using Escrow. The seller and buyer will agree on a deadline for the completion of the project. The sel ler will ship the order to the designation of customer on the deadline or even before. Both buyer and seller leave feedback for each other when the contract is closed but it’s hidden from each other so that they may not leave a biased feedback. With the help of rating system, the new buyers get to know about the seller and the quality of his/her services. Feedback system also help in determining the top-rated sellers. Furthermore, the News Feed on the buyer’s end shows him/her all the templ ates that are available on the platform. DPP provides escrow system to support the successful de als among the buyers and sellers. It also provides a Support & Resolution Centre to resolve disputed deals.

heading: 1.2  Objectives
content: DPP facilitates its users by providing them a commo n platform for their marketing/advertisement purpose. The main objective is to gather all the be st press companies in one place and sell their products to the common people while making sure tha t both the seller and buyer have a great experience. The seller (Press Companies) can upload templates of their designs that they are selling, while the buyer (Customer) can select a template fr om 1000’s of templates or ask for a custom design according to his/her needs (Only in the chat). A contract is made between both parties. The seller ships the product to the address provided by  the buyer before deadline. The personal information of both client and buyer is kept confidential and the escrow system provides payment protection. The Help & Support Centre is there to s olve the queries of the users and may help to resolve a dispute over some contract.

heading: 1.2.1  Broad Market
content: (a)  Marketing is the need of time. Every business perso n wants to expand his/her business which compels him/her to advertise it. The press an d publication market is the root of advertisement. DPP gathers the best press companies from all over the Pakistan at a single platform to serve the needs of people. (b)  All the press companies will register as sellers and they will be able to upload the templates of their designs for sale with description and details. A seller can add as many templates as he/she wishes. (c)  Multiple sellers offer multiple services which makes sure that there is not a single printing service that the platform could not provide. (d)  Such a broad market has several common templates fo r same purpose with a different design and price. This means a buyer can have sever al options to choose from according to his/her needs.

heading: 1.2.2  Utilize technology dynamically & enhance adaptability
content: (a)  The system will be an Android based application. Fr ameworks and conventions will be followed. Hence, it will be more maintainable, adaptable and extendable. (b)  Android is open source; hence, maintainability will be easier.

heading: 1.2.3  Serve the customer faster
content: (a)  The customers face a lot of difficulties related to  late delivery, especially in peak days which may affect their business. DPP ensures that every order gets complete in time.

heading: 1.2.4  Improving the quality of products
content: (a)  As there are 100’s of best sellers on the platform and almost offer same services, the competition is very high. The competition between s ellers, results in better quality of the product. (b)  DPP have set some standards and each product should  follow these standards. These standards make sure that the product is of high quality. (c)  The customer/buyer can reject the product if it does not fulfil his/her criteria.

heading: 1.2.5  Controlling Conflict
content: (a)  DPP isn’t like local presses where we have seen many conflicts that resulted in fights later. Initially, DDP makes sure that there is no conflict  between buyer and seller by checking everything according to their standards. (b)  Most importantly, they provide Help & Support Centre that plays the role of the third-party and resolve the conflict between two parties if any.

heading: 1.2.6  Remote Control
content: (a)  DPP platform is based on Android which means the users can use it no matter where they are as long as they have an android phone and an active internet connection. (b)  DPP saves you from the trouble of going to a local press and spending your hours.

heading: 1.3  Problem Statement
content: During the peak days (elections days, new admissions in schools or colleges) it becomes quite hard to get the printing and press services as most of t he companies have their hands full of orders. As most of such service providers are not free, either they do not take new orders or put the new orders in the queue, which results in late delivery of the order or compromise on the quality of the product. Furthermore, the high demand in these days results in higher prices of the products. All in all, it becomes quite difficult for a common person to get his/her work done in peak days. We are proposing to launch such a platform that will help everyone to get their work done in a timely fashion with assurance of great quality at most aff ordable rates. This platform will help printing and press companies to expand their business on a considerable scale and the competition between several companies will motivate them to provide qua lity services within the best prices. On the other hand, the platform’s greatest emphasis is to facilitate the buyer. The buyer will be able to order any product available on the platform from an y seller, and the order will be delivered to his/her doorstep within the given deadline. Hence, the platform helps both buyer and seller to do their business remotely without wastage of time.

heading: 1.4  Assumptions & constraints
content: We assume that there may be one or more admins and all of the admins will be at remote locations. All the admins may be using different operating systems i.e. Windows, IOS, Android, Ubuntu, etc. So, all of the admins may not be able to access the admin panel as we are offering Android services only. Moreover, an admin performs several tasks simultaneously ranging from, generating reports, printing, managing profiles, etc. To perform all these tasks concurrently on an android device may be catastrophic. To address this problem, we will provide a web-based admin panel which will be free of operating system constraint and will allow multiple functions to be performed at the same time. As our applications is specifically for Andro id users, both seller and buyer must have an Android device to get benefits from our application. As stated earlier, Android OS is mandatory to use our application, many sellers and buyers do not have access to it. So, the users can use a virtual machine and install Android OS on it to get our ser vices until we offer IOS and Windows Application. The team of three people will work on this project.  Each member will spend 2 hours daily. The budget of the project should not exceed $5000. The timeframe for the complete project must not exceed 8 months.

heading: 2.1  Literature Review
content: Taiba print [1] is a web-based printing and press p latform originated from Multan, Pakistan. The core features of the platform include Printing Serv ices, Handling Customer Complains, and 24/7 online Helpdesk Services. However, the printing ser vices offered by the platform are limited to offset printing only which includes advertising pad s, bags, barcode stickers, boxes, brochures, business cards, cake boxes, and much more. To buy a product from the platform, a user must sign- in, select the corresponding product. A visitor (No t Registered) can select the products and check their details, however, he/she must sign-up before giving an order or checking out. While giving the order, the user can select specific size of the product along its different properties i.e. material. To confirm an order, the user has to pay with PayPa l/Visa Card/Master Card while checking out. Taiba Print [1] covers a vast range of offset printing services which may not be possible for a single company which gives it quite an edge over other loc al companies and their prices are just cherry on ice. Taiba Print [1] raised to its occasion and expanded quite quickly until recently, when they made a partnership deal with another company which bounded them to offer their services publicly. For the time being, they are providing their servic es only to that specific company unlike before when they were getting orders from all over the Pakistan. Print Stop [2] is one of the leading web-based prin ting and press platform originated from India. This platform offers a variety of services ranging from digital to offset printing services. The user can actually interact with the design which means t he platform offers services where the user can create a design of his/her own. However, Print Stop  [2] offers only a limited printing services in each category (Digital & Offset). Some digital and offset printing product that Print Stoop [2] offers includes Booklets, Window, Brochures, Banners, Direct mail, All direct mail products, Direct mail postcards, and a few more . Customer have to sign up and then sign in order to  proceed the order. The customer can upload the file of desired size an d design requirements. The platform accepts PayPal and visa cards as a source of payment to proceed the order further. The platform also takes feedback from the buyer to make sure the products are of good quality and users are satisfied with the services. Print Stop [2] is an Indian company and operates in specific areas of India only. Smart Press [3] is another web-based platform that deals in a few digital and offset printing services. This platform is not for regular people because it takes large consignments only means they offer their services to large scale organizations only. S mart Press [3] offers different services which include Custom Quote, Order Samples, and Direct Mail Services. Typically, the customers have to create an account to avail the services. The platform also contains rating and review system where Customer can give the feedback about their services and quality of the products. Ps-Print [4] is a small scaled web-based printing a nd press platform. It facilitates its users with some traditional digital and some offset printing services at their doorstep. The services offered by the platform include Custom Printing, Design Services, Die Cutting, and Foil Stamping. As usual, the customer must sign-in to giving order. The customer can select any product of his/her desire to check its details and order it. Ps-Print [4] does h ave a rating and review system that helps them determine the satisfaction of the customers and the standard of their products.

heading: 2.7  Software development life cycle model
content: We used Prototype Development Life Cycle and Increm ental Development Life Cycle for our project after carefully assessing our situation, resources, budget, and deadline. Obviously, we could have used any Software Development Life Cycle, but we preferred these two because of the following reasons: We used Prototype Model to get the requirements in detail since we did not have clear requirements in the beginning of the project. Once our requireme nts were clear, we used Incremental Model to actually build our system.

heading: 2.7.1  Reasons of using Prototype Software Development Lif e Cycle
content: The following are the reasons why we used the Prototype Software Development Life Cycle: • As all of the requirements were not clear in the start of the project, we preferred Prototype Model. We designed a prototype(Dummy) interface and showed it to the sellers and noted down their feedback to get better requirements. • We designed a prototype application in which users could actually interact with the it and navigate it to get proper understanding of the flow. After receiving their valuable feedback, we revised our prototypes until we got most of the requirements. • We used prototype model till we got all or most of the requirements. • Errors in the requirements can be catastrophic and can be costly to rectify at later stages of project, so to avoid this, we used prototype because a quick feedback is available because of the active involvement of the stakeholders(users). • A good system is easy to use and user can easily interact with it, so to build what the user requires, you must have involved the user actively to get better requirements.

heading: 2.7.2  Reasons of using Incremental Software Development L ife Cycle
content: The following are the reasons why we used Incremental Software Development Life Cycle: • After using prototype model all or most of our requ irements were quite clear so, we had two options, we could have used waterfall model or incremental model according to the system. However, we are only starting out and we ar e only offering a limited number of functionalities at the moment. We plan to add sever al more functionalities which is why Incremental Model was good option. • Our system is continuously evolving, so, the best option is to use the Incremental Model. • We needed a working product with acceptable number of functionalities till a deadline, so Incremental is the only model that fulfils these needs. • The official implementation of escrow is not available at the moment because we are not a verified company and we do not have a tax report, s o, we do not have the resources to complete the functionality and we will implement it  on a later stage, that’s why the Incremental is the best choice in this scenario. • The systems developed using Incremental Model are m ore flexible and less costly when the scope changes.

heading: 7.1  Problems Faced and Lessons Learned
content: During this project report, we gained a lot of experience in making documentation. We learnt that before starting any project, we should focus the ta rget market and stakeholders. We learnt that spending more time on getting requirements is bette r than to face requirements creep. We faced issues while collecting requirements because we vis ited our client’s office many times with appointment but most of the times, he was not available due to some issues. Each and every phase of the software development lifecycle is important. If we do not make mistakes in initial phase, our next phase will be easier for us. One of the greatest problem that we faced was that we had to work in a language(Android) that was alien to us. We had never worked in Android before, so this was our first experience and we had to learn the language from the scratch. Another proble m was the selection of database, for almost 2 weeks we could not decide which database should we use (SQL or NoSQL). NoSQL seemed to be very promising and its functionalities were just wow. There are several companies offering NoSQL but the problem was that each one is different from the other, i.e. one company provides key value structure whereas the other provide documentation structure. So, after giving it a thought, we ended up using SQL. The worst problem of all time was implementing Escrow in our platform. You have to be a verified company with all the text details and government au thorizations to use an Escrow account which we did not know previously. So, the only option we had was to use the development Escrow which will allow us to perform all the functionalities of  Escrow, but there was a catch that all the transactions had to be made through the Escrow Interface and we would not have any control over any transaction. We did not have any choice, so, we  implemented it. However, after 1 week, they turned their Development Escrow down to improve its  functionalities. The link is still down and the company has not confirmed when it will be live again. We have to present our Project in a short while and we just cannot sit back and do nothing about it because this way one of our functionality will be missing. So, we decided to make our own Escrow (Prototype).

heading: 7.2  Project Summary
content: The trend of online shopping is on fire in this mod ern era. Everything is online, so the question is why not Printing and Press Services? We have been t hrough several situations where finding a printing/press service becomes impossible because o f the high demand. Especially, it becomes impossible to attain printing and press services du ring elections or at academic result dates. Even if you get these services somehow, you will have to pay extra charges. We introduce DPP (Doorway Printing & Press). DPP is an Android application that connects a buyer of these services to someone who sale them. The best thing is that you a buyer can browse through 1000’s of templates to choose from or even upload his/her own custom template in the chat. DPP allows a buyer to choose the size and material of the product and makes sure the  same quality is delivered to the customer on his/her doorstep. On the other hand, DPP provides a great opportunity for sellers to expand their business and prove themselves in the National market. Aside from the t hrill to compete with other giant companies, there is a room for every seller to make a mark for  himself/herself. A seller can post as many templates as he/she wishes to offer. Both buyer and seller will be able to communicate through our application as we have integrated a chatting service in our application.

heading: 7.3  Future Work
content: At the moment, our application is only accessible on an Android device or Virtual OS, we plan to provide an IOS application, Windows Application, an d web-based platform to our users in future so that everyone can get the benefits of our platform. All of the details regarding a design are discussed  in a chat at the moment and the seller has must already have a template to post it on the platform, however in future, we plan to add a drawing tool that will allow sellers to create their template by using freeform, layers, cutting, and drawing tools. For the time being, our application shows recent 20  templates on the dashboard and the user will be able to perform searching operations using keywo rds to search a post, however, in future, we plan to add several other options in news feed and search which will show you the best rated, and user preferred templates in the news feed. So, only the best templates or buyer specified templates will be shown to a buyer. In future, we plan to add  a functionality which we call “Featured Templates”. Featured Templates will charge an extra fee from the sellers so that their template may reach more buyers. The sellers will have to pay upf ront fees to use this functionality. The fee will be calculated based on the number of buyer they want to reach and the time period till they want to feature their template.

heading: Abstract
content: The aim of this project was to propose a concurrent human-computer interaction system based on hand gestures using limited resources. The system  consists of three com ponents: hand detection on both dynamic and static  backgrounds, gesture recognition according to the contours of the hand and human computer interaction according to th e recognized gesture. The aim was  to improve the existing process by combining several algor ithms of scaling, normalization and image filtering to recognize hand gestures and make it possible to recognize relatively complex gestures using only cameras o f hand-held devices. We have used bitmap data as image pointers and a combination of algorithms  to achieve gesture processing as opposed to the traditional hardware based methods. Dur ing the HCI stage, we made sure to avoid  false recognition caused by background noises, improving the reliability of the sy stem. The developed system is  highly extendable for C# image processing projects and  applicable in computer -human interactive environment with more multifaceted formats rather than just handheld devices. Table of Contents

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Gesture is a representation of emotional expression or physical behaviour. During daily life, it is a natural communication method mostly used by people with disabilities. It includes both hand gesture and body gesture. It falls into two sub -categories: dynamic gesture and static gesture. For the former, the movement of the body or hand denotes a sign while for the latter, the gesture of the hand or the posture of the body conveys some message. G esture recognition can accomplish human-computer interaction and is greatly different from the conventional hardware based methods. Gesture recognition decides the user intent through the recognition of the movement or gesture of the body or body parts. Ha nd gesture recognition has immense value in the fields of augmented reality (virtual reality), robot control and sign language recognition for people who use different gesture languages. We realize that vision based technology of hand gesture recognition i s a vital part of human - computer interaction (HCI). In the former years mouse and keyboard has played a significant role in the human -computer interaction. However, due to the recent development of sophisticated software and hardware, there is a need for b etter technologies. Both technologies of speech recognition and gesture recognition receive immense attention in HCI. Nowadays, two methods are commonly used for gesture recognition. One is based on professional electro -magnetic devices like special gloves while the other utilizes computer vision. The former is expensive and is used in film industry, rendering useless in certain environments while the latter involves image processing. Even though the performance of gesture recognition based on image process ing is relatively limited, advanced sensors like Kinect has deliberately improved their value. However, such devices are not suitable for large -scale application of HCI since they are expensive and not reliable under certain conditions. The workflow of han d gesture recognition is described as follows. First, the hand region is identified from the original images from the input devices. Then, the features are extracted to describe hand gestures. Last, the recognition of hand gestures is accomplished by determining the match of the feature data. When the region of interest is identified, features are needed to be extracted from the ROI region. Brightness, colour and gradient values are extensively used features. Various features can be used for identifying han d region including t he Gabor filter response, BRIEF , ORB, SIFT, and HOG, etc. For the recognition of hand gestures, various classifiers, for example, HMM (hidden Markov model), CRF (conditional random field), SVM (support vector machine), are adapted, to d ifferentiate hand gestures. Although the recognition accuracy of these refined classifiers is good, the time cost is pretty high. In this project, we present a fast and efficient method for hand recognition because the previous systems developed uses techn ology which is either too expensive or the algorithms applied are outdated and does not bring results which are convenient in today’s time.  Our project makes sure that both of these issues are recognized and eliminated so further researc h can be built upo n our completed work. First, an image is taken from live feed using the camera of a hand -held portable device. The image points of the input image are recognized by the system and compared with the ones stored in the data set. The bitmap data was  used as i mage poi nters using the .NET technology.

heading: 11 of 55  20 May 2018
content: This scheme is suitable in the scenario where there is no high demand on the speed of the HCI and where the cost is limited since the gesture processing needs to be done using limited resources but full CPU usage. Basically, the proposed HCI system follows three principals: low cost, reliable and real time. The system is quite extensible and allows the accomplish of more complex tasks with a little modification.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: Objectives of our proposed project are as below: ● To recognize useful gestures by taking images as live feed. ● To match the recognized gestures with the inbuilt data set. ● Achieve fast gesture processing using limited resources and full CPU usage. ● Development and application of  effective algorithms of scaling, image normalization and image filtering. ● To provide image processing researchers with faster and more reliable algorithms. ● To aid deaf people with a system that recognizes their hand gestures and performs functions according to the recognized gesture.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: In order to accommodate people with disabilities, image processing researches and low resource personal computer holders, a system  was needed to be developed that identified  gestures and performs actions a ccordingly. In additio n it needed  to be fast, efficient and inexpensive.  This is what we have tried to achieve in our gesture recognition project.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: In today’s time we are practically living in the “digital” era and our lives are surrounded by several technologies, with the purpose  to ease and simp lify our lives in numerous aspects. The keyword for this is human -computer interaction and communication. This term is vital when we realize any technology that will interact and communicate with people directly . These days we have innovation s t hat don’t r each everyone since  not all users are skilled and can learn them easily. We aim to spread these innovations to all types of consumers regardless of their technical knowledge and skills.  We aim to develop this system to cater to the  inability of older peopl e in interacting with new devices and in order to stimulate healthy physical movements. The main purpose of this project is to allow older and disable people to use any new devices with comfort and ease because this is the key target audience of this project.

heading: 2.1 Literature Review
content: There is very less work related to the above topic in recent years but there exist research papers and new methodologies that were developed in years 2010-2014 and overview of some of them is given below: [1] A Research paper on “ A real time hand gesture recognition system using motion history image” published in 2010 describes how most hand gesture recognition systems work under only restricted environments but they used and discussed new techniques such as the use of an adaptive skin colour model grounded on face detection to detect skin colour regions like hands. To distinguish the dynamic hand gestures, a simple and fast motion history image based method was developed. Four different types of groups of directional patterns were trained for the up, down, left, and right hand gestures classification, including the fist and waving hand gestures, there were total six hand gestures defined. Several experiments were done on this approach which gave results that show the accuracy is 94.2% in average and the pro cessing time is 3.71 ms per frame. The data set for this research paper consists of only 6 images which had defined hand - gestures that were recognized by the system. The project that we are making has a greater data set and it builds upon the technology used in this paper. [2]Research paper on “ Hand Gesture Recognition using Multi -Scale Colour Features, Hierarchical Models and Particle Filtering” was published which presented an algorithm and a prototype system for hand posture recognition. Hand postures are represented as hierarchies of multi-scale colour image features at different scales, with different postures having qualitative inter-relations in terms of scale, position and orientation. Detection and identification of multi - scale colour features is performed in each image. Hand states are then detected simultaneously and tracked using particle filtering. All these components were then integrated during the development into a real-time prototype system and the system was successfully tested. This paper uses an algorithm for the edge detection which is outdated and does not yield a clear result. W e can see from the images that the image extracted is not clear which makes the identification of the hand gesture hard and increases the probability of error s. The algorithm used by us is very efficient which makes gesture recognition more accurate. [3] Research paper distributed in 2012 with the subject "Motion Recognition for Natural Interaction with Applications" talked about incorporating Kinect sensor wit h a set -top box that has been produced in past undertakings by Fraunhofer, highlighting a basic UI that gives the client the capacity to cooperate with that interface by utilizing basic signals rather than the typical remote control. This system implemente d the gestures characterized by the old people, in driver Kinteract, utilizing diverse structures that have as of now tools to recognize developments like cursor keys. The developments to control the events "Left", "Ideal", "Up", "Down" and "alright" are a ll around characterized, on the grounds that they relate to the signals made by the older people in the tests. The application utilized the fundamental tools to implement the framework like Microsoft Kinect, RGB Camera, Engine, Microphones and 3D Depth Sen sors. The primary motivation behind this application was the recognition of hand gestures for natural interaction, Lee and Chun [19] introduced a strategy for controlling virtual items, in a 3D co -ordinate system.

heading: 14 of 55  20 May 2018
content: The detection of gestures on virtual objec ts is done through a system that is designated by YCbCr3, which is a model of colour space used to detect the region of hand effectively. The technology used in this research which includes equi pment like Microsoft Kinect, RGB camera, Engine microphones a nd 3D depth sensors is very expensive. This is not feasible for people with low resources who need gesture recognition. Our project caters to the needs of the people who cannot afford such expensive equipment; all the need for using our project is using a computer or phone with a camera. [4] Research paper with a different technique was published in 2004 “ A Gesture-Based Control for Handheld Devices Using Accelerometer ” which discussed the technique how the signals from an accelerometer can be processed to precisely recognize user gestures after applying a small accelerometer to a handheld device. The signals detected from accelerometers were divided into acceleration and dynamic acceleration, and then the signal patterns of the accelerometers in relation to simple gestures were analysed. A device control module was created and its operating process was matched to that of a normal control device to evaluate and analyse the usability of gesture recognition. Due to which gesture-based control was found to be ea sy to use, reduced the preparation process, and produced a rapid system reaction. Consequently, gesture -based control would seem to be an effective user interface for handheld devices primarily used in mobile environments. The accelerometer is an external device which might not be compatible with all the phones. It might not be available in an area which is not technologically advanced and the resources are limited. In our project there is no such requirement of external devices; all you need is a smart - phone with a camera which is easily available even in all the third-world countries. [5] Research paper published in 2012 with the subject “ REAL-TIME DYNAMIC HAND SHAPE GESTURE CONTROLLER ” focused on the problem of recognition of dynamic gestures although it described Static Gesture Representation and Dynamic or Motion -based Gesture representation. This paper described the process to develop methods to recognize useful gestures from a continuous stream of input frame sequence and divide them into one of the specific classes. The dominant gesture which is considered for detection and recognition are sequences of distinct hand shapes. It considered single handed gestures which are sequences of distinct hand shapes. A given hand shape can experience motion and distinct changes. These gestures are distinguished on the basis of contours involved and the nature of motion. In this work, a Dynamic Programming based gesture recognition system was developed which uses both the temporal and shape characteristics of the ges ture for recognition. The system is robust to background noise, runs in real time and does not require any special gloves to be worn. This is a paper which we have built upon, however we have realized that this system takes a lot of time to recognize the dominant gesture when going through the stream of input frame. In order to eliminate this problem we have enabled the user to take a picture of the dominant gesture which makes it easier the system to process the image and bring accurate result.

heading: 2.4 Software Development Life Cycle Model
content: Software Development life cycle models are methodologies which divide the software development in to various phases in order to make a better quality product. There are many types of Software Development Process models such as Waterfall Model (which is used when requirements a re highly structured and it becomes prohibitively expensive much sooner in the development process), Rapid Pr ototyping Model ( used when programmers have unsteady requirements that are sometimes ambiguous), Spiral Model (which is used when risk and cost evaluation is vital) and Incremental Model ( used when basic functionalities of the system are acknowledged but requirements creep over time). For this project we have used the fountain model which is a logical improvement to the waterfall model. The steps are in the same sequence as in the waterfall model; however we can fall back at an earlier step when required. The fountain model recognizes that some activities need to be done before moving to others for example design phase needs to be completed first bef ore moving on to coding but there is a considerable overlap of activities throughout the developmental cycle which makes it easier for the programmers to fix errors. heading: 4.1.1 Edge Detection
content: Edge detection  is an image processing technique for finding the boundaries of objects within images. It works by detecting discontinuities in brightness. We studied various edge detection filters and applied many of them to our data set. The different edge detection algorithms tested on our project are:

heading: 4.1.1.1 Laplacian of Gaussian:
content: The Laplacian is the 2nd spatial derivative of an image in a 2-D isotropic measure. It is often used for edge detection because it highlights regions of rapid intensity change. Image that has first been smoothed with something like the Gaussian smoothing filter in order to reduce its noise sensitivity is then applie d with the Laplacian filter. The operator inputs a grey level image and produces another grey level image as output.

heading: 4.1.1.2 Canny Edge Detection Algorithm
content: The Canny algorithm is an edge detection operator that utilizes a multi-stage process to detect the edges in an image. It was developed in 1986 by John F. Canny. He also created a computational theory of edge detection explaining why the technique works.

heading: 4.1.1.3 Robert’s Cross Operator
content: The Roberts Cross operator executes a quick to compute, simple, 2 -D spatial gradient measurement on a chosen image. The estimated absolute magnitude of the spatial gr adient of the input image at that point is represented by pixel values at each point in the output. The operator consists of a pair of 2×2 convolution kernels.
-1 0 Figure 9-Robert’s Cross Algorithm

heading: 4.1.1.4 Sobel Operator
content: It is a  discrete differentiation operator , computing an estimate of the  gradient of the image intensity function. At each point in the image, the result of the Sobel –Feldman operator is either the conforming gradient vector or the  norm of this vector. This oper ator is centred on convolving the image with a minor, distinguishable, and integer -valued filter in the vertical and horizontal directions and is thus comparatively economical in terms of computations. +1 +2 +1

-1 -2 -1 Figure 10-Sobel’s Algorithm After closely examining the results of the aforementioned operators, we chose Sobel’s Operator for edge detection because it gave the clearest result with distinct edges. The quality difference between Sobel an d other algorithms was significant as well which is why we chose it in our project.

heading: 4.1.2 Grayscale Filter
content: Grayscale image is one in  which the value of each  pixel is a single  sample representing only an amount of light, that is, it carries on ly intensity information. Images of this sort, also known as black-and-white or mono chrome, are composed exclusively of shades of  gray, varying from black at the weakest intensity to white at the strongest.

heading: 4.1.2.1 Filter Logic
content: To apply the grayscale filter on the input image we applied the formula of the average. Average = (R + G + B) / 3 The rgb values of every pixel is taken and the average function is performed. The average value is then substituted in the corresponding pixel.

heading: 4.1.3 Inversion Filter
content: The invert filter inverts the colour samples in the input image.  Its result is a graphical effect that can change the appearance of an input image by changing the colours to its contrast.

heading: 4.1.3.1 Filter Logic
content: Three variable are taken with i nverted values of the red, green and blue pixels. Those inverted values are then placed in their respective r,g,b values in the same pixel.

heading: 4.1.4 Data Set
content: Since we wanted to encourage the application of our  project in other research based projects which can benefit deaf people, we have used the American Sign Language as our image set medium. We chose this language because its widely used all over the world and it utilizes gestures using a single-hand which was appropriate for our project. We have used the ASL alphabets and numerals to develop a data set from scratch. There are around 3000 images in the data set which ensures that its very comprehensive and works for different hand types and skin colours.

heading: 4.1.4.1 Photographs
content: A number of volunteers were invited to make the data set so diversity can  be embodied in our project and a single gesture could have multiple pictures. heading: 4.1.4.2 Application of Edge Detection
content: To gather the image points of the data set, we constructed a loop where every image went through the edge detection filter. The process took a few minutes to complete and the new images were saved in a separate folder.

heading: 4.1.4.3 Noise reduction
content: After the edge detection was applied, we noticed th at the images were too noisy for accurate gesture recognition if they were to be compared with the input images. We manually removed the noise in the images, it was very effective as it cleaned the images very thoroughly despite the fact that a few hours were consumed in doing so.

heading: 4.1.5 Gesture Recognition
content: To recognize the gestures, a lot of algor ithms were applied. The process of trial and error was adopted so a thorough research could be conducted and the best algorithm of colour extraction was applied which yielded the most accurate results in dynamic background. The algorithms that were applied are:

heading: 4.1.5.1 RGB
content: This algorithm of colour extracti on was the simplest of the all but it  only worked on static backgrounds. The RGB colour space is the colour space used by computers, graphics cards and monitors or LCDs. It consists of three components, red, green and blue, the primary colours. Any colour can be obtained by mixing the three base colours. Depending on how much is taken from each base colour, any colour can be created. We identified a range of skin colour values in rgb and used that range to extract the skin colour so the template matching algorithm was applied in order for the gesture recognition to take place. Figure 23-RGB 1 Figure 24-RGB 2

heading: 4.1.5.2 HSV
content: HSV stands for hue , saturation, value of an image. The algorithm is a little complex to implement but it only involves two main steps are as follows:

heading: STEP 1 - RGB TO HSV CONVERSION
content: We want to convert the image to HSV because working with HSV values is much easier to isolate colours. In the HSV representation of colour, hue determines the colour you want, saturation determines how intense the colour is and value determines the lightness of the image. As can be seen in the image below, 0 on the wheel would specify a mild red colour and 240 would specify a blue colour.

heading: STEP 2 - APPLY A THRESHOLD MASK
content: To isolate the colours, we have to apply multiple masks. A low threshold and high threshold mask for hue, saturation and value. Anything pixel within these thresholds will be set to  1 and the remaining pixels will be zero. Figure 25-HSV 1 Figure 26-HSV 2

heading: 4.1.5.3 YCbCr
content: YCbCr is an encoded non -linear RGB signal, commonly used for image compression work. It is represented by luma (which is luminance computed from nonlinear RGB) constructed as a weighted sum of RGB values. The transformation simplicity and explicit separation of luminance and chrominance components makes YCbCr colour space. In this format, luminance information is stored as a single component (Y), and chrominance information is stored as two colour- difference components (Cb and Cr). Cb represents the differe nce between the blue component and reference value. Cr represents the difference between the red component and a reference value. YCbCr values can be obtained from RGB colour space which can be used for skin detection. After the application and testing of all the algorithms, YCbCr was chosen for skin detection because it gave the best results. Figure 27-YCbCr 1 Figure 28-YCbCr 2

heading: 4.1.5.4 Noise Reduction On Input Image
content: Due to the difference in lighting and the existence of colours in the background which were in the range of skin detection, we noticed that there was a lot of noise in the input image. To reduce the noise we applied morphological operations and smoothing.

heading: 4.1.5.4.1 Morphology
content: Morphology is a broad set of image processing operations that process images based on shapes. Morphological operations apply a structuring element to an input image, creating an output image of the same size. In a morphological operation, the v alue of each pixel in the output image is based on a comparison of the corresponding pixel in the input image with its neighbo urs. There are two functions in morphology:

heading: 4.1.5.4.1.1 Dilation
content: The value of the output pixel is the  maximum value of all the pixels in the i nput pixel's neighbo urhood. In a binary image, if any of the pixels is set to the value1, the output pixel is set to 1.

heading: 4.1.5.4.1.2 Erosion
content: The value of the output pixel is the  minimum value of all the pixels in the input pixel's neighbo urhood. In a binary image, if any of the pixels is set to 0, the output pixel is set to 0. After the application of this technique, we saw that it distorted the input image to the point where the gesture recognition was impossible so we discarded the whole technique. heading: 6.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: ● Since limited research is available on this particular topic, it was quite hard to find academic papers that served our purpose and offered insight. ● The research papers which were relevant to our project required money to be bought, so we had to request authors to provide us access to the papers since we were only students. heading: 6.2 Project summary
content: In this project, we propose a continuous human -PC collaboration framework in view of hand - gestures utilizing constrained assets. The framework comprises of three parts: hand discovery on both static and dynamic backgrounds, gesture acknowledgment as per the shapes of the hand and human computer interaction as per the perceived motion. The point is to enhance the current procedure by joining a few calculations of scaling, normalization and picture filters to detect signals and make it feasible to perceive moderately complex hand gestures utilizing just camera s of hand -held gadgets. We have utilized bitmap data as image pointers and the  idea of multithreading to accomplish gesture processing instead of the conventional equipment based strategies. Amid the HCI organize, we ensured that we took care of  false recognition caused by background noise. The created framework is  extendable and w ill be appropriate in human - automated or other computer- human interactive environment with more complex layouts instead of simple handheld gadgets.

heading: 6.3 Future work
content: Since the idea of our system is fairly new and not a lot of literature is available on hand ges ture recognition, our research can be used by other image processing researchers who are looking for faster more reliable algorithms for image filtering and scaling. The idea of hand gesture recognition system using primitive resources can be applied at a lot of places which could aid a lot of people especially the one who cannot afford fancy gadgets with high quality cameras. Our system can work even with a 2 megapixel camera  (which is a bare minimum in today’s time). Further applications can be developed especially for deaf people who can use their gesture to convey messages to other people who are unable to understand sign language. The applications can further work on creati ng subtitles for the recognized gestures or convey the message by speaking a loud. The applications can further include a larger dataset which can contain the sign language recognition of other countries. An application can also be made to teach kids who a re losing their ability to hear properly due to any disease, the application would then need to be more interactive and catchy. Furthermore, systems can be created for elderly or technology

heading: Abstract
content: This project depends on deliver maintenance through an android application. The application  will be designed in such a way that it actually provides Electrical Services at homes. The purpose of the project is to provide services for people at their home so they don’t have to go outside seeking for the respective service provider. The project also aims to provide comfort to the Customer and service provider. We tend to develop our application using the latest tools and technologies for better results. The main reason for selecting this project is when we see there is no such application in Pakistan which provides services at home. There are some applications which is providing the services but it is providing in specific areas not in large scale. We als o thinking about to release our application on commercial scale which can cover the large geographical area. At this time, we are providing electric related services but in future we will provide more services.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: This project depe nds on deliver maintenance through an android application. The application will be designed in such a way that it actually provides Services at homes. The purpose of the project is to provide services for people at their home so they don’t have to go outside seeking for the respective service provider. The project also aims to provide comfort to the Customer and service provider. We tend to develop our application using the latest tools and technologies for better results. As you know in this age of t echnology, people are using the facility of internet from shopping to eating. You don’t want to go out of your home. For example, you are at your home and your refrigerator is out of order. You want a repairman to come at your home without you going outsid e the home to call him. So basically our application gives the service without you going outside the home. We provide two options in the application named as “Service seeker” and “Service Provider”.

heading: Application Features
content: You can select either Service Provider or Service Seeker in the initial based on your requirement. In both option you will make your profile, enter your email, phone number, address, password. You can add query at any time. Our application will be linked with the location services provided by the Google maps. To facilitate people by saving their time instead of checking the service provider going outside themselves but through an app installed on their phones.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: Following are the Objectives of our project: Introduce fewer advertisements in this application as it annoys the users. To utilize our smart phones in such an effective way that we can get maximum benefits out of it. By using them in a more smart way so our daily routine task can be performed in a more systematic way. Provide a real life time environment of application. Make this application free. It should be a source of comfort for the people. Promote services with the help of this application in such a way that everyone can get benefits through this application.

heading: 1.3 Problem statement
content: We plan to build a system that would not only provide the services in easy way .This would not only save money and time but would also enable the users to post their own required services and also directly link to the provider.

heading: 1.4.1 Assumptions
content: The Delivery Maintenance system assumes that the individual utilizing the system possesses a smart phone running the Android OS version 1.6 or greater. The hardware specifications of the phone should meet or exceed that of the new technology mobiles for example (Samsung, Sony, LG) etc. Assuming the system is only for those people, which will be registered in our application and could use our mobile application. Real time scenarios will need this application and hardware. It must be created in such a way that it can be expanded in the future to cover a larger geographical area. We are try our best in the implementation of application and whatever it holds within it. We have made it much more interactive and user friendly as we can.Team members will provide their best effort in finishing given task in timely manner without any compromise on the quality.

heading: 1.4.2 Constraints
content: The team members are very new to the knowledge of android developing application technology. The technology involved in the project is very advance and time consuming to learn. There is occurrence of problems and bugs in making the application.

heading: 1.5 Project scope
content: This project will help to promote the application development in Pakistan. Now a days, developing applications and launching them is a very necessary skill to learn because it covers all the aspects of designing an environment and then scripting it using a programming language to actually live in it. The thought behind developing this application is to make people aware about the ongoing development in the field of IT for making their livelihood easier. Once the application has been launched people will tend to create such more applications related to the domestic use and professional use in various other fields.

heading: 2.1 Literature review / Existing system study
content: The purpose of this application is to motivate and inspire other app developers in Pakistan. A detailed analysis was done on the existing application relevant to the services category. These application are available on Google Play Store. The purpose of this analysis was to have appropriate ideas of how should application design must be or what sort of application attracts the users We study Urbanclap (1, 2017) we study in deep as it is providing services at homes. But the problem is its performance is not good. When customer request for service it accept the services but don’t send the related person to it, and it take online payment  in advance and can’t fulfil the commitment. So we try to make such a system which is highly efficient and provides services in real environment. We study Mrelectric (1, 2017) it is providing repair services and new electronics. But it don’t covering the wide area it is in specific area. And the services it is providing is so slow means not optimized performance. We study Laser Electric (1, 2017) it is providing services like plumbers,electrician.But after reading their client reviews we analyse it is taking too much profit no doubt their services are good but simple people can’t afford. Their primary focus on industrial customer. We study Sakoon.pk (1, 2017), it is providing maintenance services and repairing services. But you have to call on the number and done you have to deal with it. There is no location work in which you will see the location of the repairman. We study House joy (1, 2017), it is android application which is providing repairing services. There is many interface problem in this applic ation. And the customer review about this application is not good. It can’t give check warranty and it comes only once.

heading: Software Development Life Cycle Mode
content: We have chosen “Incremental model” for the project development. The incremental build model is more suitable way to develop a software where the product is designed, implemented and tested incrementally (a little more is added each time) until the product is finished. It involves both maintenance and development.

heading: Reasons:
content: We chose Incremental Model for our project because we want:  To make faster initial product delivery.  To lower the initial delivery cost.  To develop main functionality first.  Get customer response to features.  Risk to be reduced  Less work burden.

heading: 5.1 Problems Faced and Lessons Learned

The lesson learnt from our mistake was that previously all the development was being done in parts and the deliverables were scattered but now ever thing is moving through a proper channel and at a decent pace.

heading: Abstract
content: There are number of reasons for the failure in Information Technology projects which leads to financial losses, time mismanagement and lack in quality for the companies or individuals that are managing those projects [1] . So what this project aims? It pro vides users the ease to manage the project and gives full control over it. It helps project manager to handle its project with its team dividing the p rojects into tasks  and subtasks. It is a user friendly platform for companies , freelancers to manage their large and complex project s effectively. It provides a fully functional social colla boration tool which  share each and everything related to project management. It provides the ease to track your project progress and meet deadlines. There will be complete scope for managing your project right from requirements gathering to task management and team management . It will help clients to see their project reports and get invoice of their projects  .The programmers working on a single project can chat inside the bind project to discuss the details of project, finalize the requirements and share their problems and errors in real time. Concluding we can say that combination of all these tools / mod ules would help in managing efficiently by enhancing the communication gap between the project members.

content: Project management approaches are evolving to be more flexible and adaptive to meet the challenges associated with an increasingly complex and dynamic environment [14]. Project management is concerned with principles, skills, tools used in planning, control, monitoring of projects and techniques to proj ect activities to meet the project requirements. content: So this platform is being designed for managing the project where users would be able to manage the project using tools of task management, requirement manage ment , timers for calculating time, viewing Gantt Char ts . Precisely, the main aim of project management is to control and monitor the best of cost, quality and time efficiently through this project. The platform is required by the developers for handling their projects and manages  them because in managing project, there is a lot of stuff to ha ndle like gathering assigning tasks, solving issues, generating reports etc. So developers need any platform where they have facilities and features which handle them efficiently. After requirement the next step is to handle the project in an organized and systematic way. On this platform there is a complete proj ect managing tool where you can check your work like how much work has been done and what is left also that what task is assigned to which team member. It can make a record of all the developmen t, record and save data shared over this site with other members. We made this project management website and make them  ease for  task managing, schedule managing, time management . There is a broad hierarchical component which improves proficiency at the individual and gathering levels. Tasks can be characterized for  oneself or appointed to a partner, or designated in the wake of being gotten. Any project can have a devoted gathering where the greater part of the files, documents, and tasks relating to that project are put away and got to just by those clients who are pertinent to the task. heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: The primary objective of our project was to provide a platform where developers can handle their projects in an organized way and according to the present need of the hour with latest tools and features. The objectives of our web application include the following: • Learning one of the famous frameworks ‘Laravel’ and major modern techniques of the web development. • Learning Angular 5 for front end development alongside node restful APIs for server- side. • Creating profile of the user showing Display picture, name, email, contact info and the description of his/her work. • Visually show team members that which task is related to which team member. • To show developer that how much time is being spent on a task via timer. • To display Gantt charts making record of a parti cular task . Completed tasks are shown with Green colour and uncompleted tasks are in red colour. • Design an attractive User Interface “UI” and provide such functionalities so as to captivate our web application users. • To create invoice of the projects for clients .

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: Utilizing the Project management profile, it is recognized project failure is connected with an arrangement of authoritatively controllable variables [3]. The current platforms where developers can deal with their projects aren't mostly providing full features and facilities and those who provide all features of project managing tools are very costly. Currently there are m any freelancers and they have to manage their projects so they need any platform which will be cheap enough so that they can afford it and avail all features  at one place. Now a days there is a trend in which projects are out sourced and freelancers from r emote locations are working on the same projects. We  know that to manage the project is not that easy, so freelancer has to go through many hurdles to build a project as there are many phases in developing a project. Freelanc ers have to manage tasks, sched ule them properly and deliver the project on time, so to avoid doing it manually they need a platform for that. So this is a tool which helps them out in such sticky conditions. Similarly, many small companies do their project management manually where there is a chance of losing some information or may be misplaced and also they are not able to see or make look at the progress that how much work has been done and which team member is given enough time. Also, they are not being able to meet the dea dlines of their deliverables as they have no proper way of making a look at the dates so their project managers need some platform where they manage their teams and assign tasks to them.

Most of the web applications do not provide proper managing tools and a re not fully embedded with the required feature. Some web applications give that feature, but they are much more costly that are not affordable by these users, so we will give relief to them and they can utilize all the features in less cost so that they can manage their projects efficiently.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & Constraints
content: The assumptions considered for this project are: • We assumed that the users must be clients/ customers or developers managing their projects. • The clients or customers do not know anything about the project management. • There would be Project manager with managing skills, who would assign task to the members of specific project. • All team members will be available for any kind of project related tasks as needed. • All team members must abide by the guidelines described in the project plan. The constraints that were faced during the development of the project area: • As it is a web based project, so we needed a live server for testing some functionalities as they cannot be run on the local host. • Server should be active 24 hour, so users can have an access anytime. • There are some plugins of laravel which needed to be updated every time. So some errors were faced during the development phased as they need some new requirement for an updated version of the plugins. • Projects must be there to be managed • For the purpose of time management of specific project, the task of the project must be assigned to some developers. As we worked on different modules, so there many problems of code merging. So we needed to be very careful about the working directory of the project.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: In this project we made a web based application for companies and individual s to manage their project in an efficient way as the user has to do all the management at different platform so it is very difficult for a user to manage on different platforms. We were using Microsoft Visual Code for our development phase and laravel (a famous move based framework of PHP). We were using Xampp as localhost for running the project locally. We used Mysql for making our database. The front end was made using Angular 5 . We used bootstrap for making our website fully responsive. At the end of th is project we had a product that we were able to handle the project management phases effectively. The user is able to manage things in time while development of the projects, This work provides project members considerable amount of development experienc e in all the technologies mentioned and will supplement for future development. The project member is able to design a website and is able to make a web application using these tools.

heading: 3.4.1 Laravel Framework (Back End)
content: We used the architecture of laravel framework which is MVC based. So all most our application is following the same architecture which is describe in Figure 46. So there is user who requests for the web page and the request is go to the route and it will be handle by the routes. Then user will be login by his given username and password and it will be then passed through controller and authentication phase of the frame given by middleware. So data from database will come from database through model classes and query is build using these classes. There are migration and seeding in the framework which is used to create schema and storing the data in database respectively. The data is then passed to the view of the framework and user is able to interact with our application. NgModules collect related code into functional sets; an Angular app is defined by a set of NgModules. An app always has at least a  root module  that enables bootstrapping, and typically ha s many more  feature modules . • Components define  views, which are sets of screen elements that Angular can choose among and modify according to your program logic and data. • Components use  services , which provide specific functionality not directly related to  views. heading: Abstract
content: Fatwa is a legal opinion from a qualified person of an Islamic centre usually known as mufti. Mufti gives his legal opinions on a problem according to Islamic laws. His opinions have significant importance in Islamic society. But it is not an easy task to get a fatwa from a mufti, as one has to personally visit the Islamic centre, write a letter, and call the Islamic centre or via email. To make the whole procedure more efficient there is a need for a tracking mechanism which could increase the efficiency of the organization to which the mufti belongs and the satisfaction of the person seeking fatwa. We have developed a Fatawa Management System in which user can interact with portal, instead of visiting personally, writing letters or calling the Islamic centre. We have provided user with the option to choose between English and Urdu. As our website is used by the people from different cultures and countries.  The system assigns the user ’s problem/question to a mufti. Mufti acknowledge it and the system take record of the date the query was received. The system reminds mufti frequently by popups and user receives notification on his/her portal . This tracking feature keep s our  user satisfaction in the system. That was the main problem in previous systems as the user had no idea that how someone was dealing wit h his query or how much work is  done and sometimes even the query of the user  was lost in the pile of papers . Another issue was to access previously given fatwas. The old fatwas were kept in thick registers which were difficult to maintain and search. This system provide s a fast searchi ng facility which make s it easy to search previous fatwas making system efficient. Table of Contents

heading: 1.1 Introduction:
content: A Fatwa is a legal opinion from a qualified person of an I slamic centre usually known as m ufti. Mufti gives his legal opinions on a problem according to Islamic laws. His decisions have significant importance in Islamic society. But it is not an easy task to get a fatwa from a mufti, as one has to personally visit the Islamic centre, write a letter, and call the Islamic centre or via email. To make the whole procedure more efficient there is a need for tracking mechanism which could increase credibility and the user satisfaction. When Muslims face any problem related to the traditional issues, they usually consult some mufti(s) appointed by religious institution of their sect. These dedicated people give their opinions on issues pertaining to the Islamic rules. These Muslims  Scholars are called as Muftis and they possess an extensive knowledge and expertise in the Is lamic world. They are auth orized to give their expert opinions on the subject according to the Islamic rules and scripture. The opinion of a Mufti regarding a pro blem is called a Fatwa. With problems mostly on different aspects of life for example; problems of inheritance, the problem of divorce, problems related to business etc. We have developed a Fatwa Management System in which user interacts with the system, instead of visiting personally, writing letters or calling the Islamic centre. The syste m assigns the user problem to a mufti. Mufti acknowledges it. The system keep reminding mufti frequently through notifications. This tracking feature keeps user satisfaction in the system. That was the main problem in previous systems as the user was kept in dark about his query, he had no idea  how much work was done and could be easily misplaced. Another issue was to access previously given fatwas. This system provides a fa st searching facility which  makes it easy to search previous fatwa making system efficient.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content:  Automate the manual system  Minimize the human errors  Make the process of getting a fatwa much easier  Motivate people to get the answers of their questions  Make the process of fatwa more efficient and quicker  Save the resources and time by effectively distributing the work load  Cost and time saving through reliable searching mechanism  Global access to everyone, so anyone can facilitate through this system  Availability of this facility to everyone

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement:
content: We have developed a Mana gement System in which user  interacts with the system , instead of visiting personally, writing letters or cal ling the Islamic centre. The main problem in previous system was the factor of uncertainty and the possibility of human error. Sometimes even the query of person was lost in the paperwork. The following are the problems that occurred in the past, with their brief explanations:  The most common way of asking the problem was to visit the respective institution or Islamic centre. The problem was orally and verbally consulted with the muftis. Because of the verbal conversation the problem and its solution were not recorded. This resulted in computing a new solution for the same problem.  Most of the people who could not come to the Islamic centre. So they usually consulted through telephones and the fatwa was communicated to the concerned person. The problem that arose was that those answers were neither preserved nor documented. This resulted in no history. Hence can’t be published.  The major drawback of previous system was that a lot of time and resources were wasted while preparing the f atwa on similar topics. There was  not a proper way of keeping the record of all issued Fatwas. Searching a Fatwa from b undles of Fatwa’s files was also a time consuming and very difficult task. Sometimes that fatwa was lost or misplaced in piles of paper.  And once the pe rson receives the fatwa there was  no record where that piece of work is gone. Hence if similar cases occur m ufti had to rework and come up with new f atwa that took a lot of energy and time. So, there should be a proper storing mechanism which will help to search and track the old fatwas. Moreover, it will later help to publish the book of the Fatawa.

heading: 1.4.1 Assumptions:
content:  The questioner (the person who ask the question) of our website has prior knowledge of using websites.  Our Website is accessible through desktop (PC, Laptop) and Mobile phones.  Our website is accessible to all the people around the globe.

heading: 1.4.2 Constraints:
content: Scope Constraint: The web application is only for admin, mufti and questioner. It can be only used for fatwa management and for questioner’s query related to the different aspects of life. Time Constraint:  When the client submits his request the system  provides an instantaneous response.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope:
content: Fatawa Management System provides a platform for the questioners to get an advisory opinion on different issues from an Islamic Scholar (Mufti). This system supports both English and Urdu language. The user can submit his question in either document file, pdf file or in a plain text. The system also provides a questioner with the facility to ask any question online. The questioner can also search from previously stored fatwa for the most relevant answers. If a questioner request for a fatwa, the head mufti assign the questioner’s query to a mufti. Hence our system overcomes the flaws faced by the previous systems.

heading: 2.1  Literature review / Existing system study
content: We have reviewed the existing website like Darul-ifta [1] which is one of the most important sectors for asking fatawa. Most people living in foreign countries get guidance on different issues  from this site. These issues include marriages, divorce, heritage, decency and so on. The existing website provides facilities to their users to ask fatwa on different controversial problems. The first page of the website is especially for those people who simply want to search the answers by keywords. If the person is satisfied from the answers given in the list of categories then the user  don’t need to directly contact the mufti. If a user is unable to find the answer to the problem in the provided categories he may contact directly with the mufti through “Ask Question” section, where he can directly request fatwa with mufti by asking a question. The client has to register himself/herself before requesting a fatwa.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: We have faced different kinds of problems during our final year project. Moreover, our scope is not fully defined up till now due to which our requirements are changing iteratively. We have faced problem during arranging meeting with our stakeholders. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Upserve Dining is a web base platform whose basic feature is to connect the food lovers with the restaurants so they can enjoy the meals at their favorite restaurants at any point of time. The main purpose of this web application is to let the user know about the restaurants in the desired area and then allow them to reserve a table. Table can be reserved from 1 person to 20 persons, varies for different restaurants. After reservation, the user and restaurant is notified via text message or email. User can remotely update their reservation on the go. User earn and redeem points by dining out using our application, these points provide user with the discounts and different offers. This application also provide user with the feeds of the restaurants. These fee ds are the activities that are happening in the restaurants. Application has a tab named as “Feeds”, in which the user can see the activities of their favorite restaurants. Users have the option to star restaurants, these restaurants are considered as favo rite restaurants of the users. User can like or unlike those activities. User can also see reviews, popular dishes, menus, discounts, photos and all the other deals restaurants are offering. Application also have a tab name as “Jobs”, in this tab user can explore the jobs offered by the restaurants. If a restaurant wants a waiter or a cook, it’ll post the advertisement of the job in that job tab, user can review that job and select that job. This provide users with the job opportunities and help restaurants to hire employees easily. Restaurants can create their accounts on this application by simply signing up using their email addresses or phone number. This process creates the profile of the restaurant. These profiles contain the information about restaurants, such as their locations, menus, deals, discounts, number of seats and all the other facilities restaurants are offering. Restaurants can post activities, photos, videos and more on their profile which then can be seen and like/unlike by users. Restaurants can also post jobs on their profile, it help s restaurants to hire employees easily. This application also provides restaurants with tons of optional features such as payment, catering, group discounts etc. Restaurants can use any of this optional feature as they like.
