heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: Our basic goal was to provide a better environment for a user and a restaurant to communicate in a better environment using the app. The objectives of our project/website are given below: • To provide a facility for a user to reserve a table in a restaurant. • To provide list of restaurants in a sorted way, and their menus and deals to the user. • To provide a dashboard for restaurants to upload activates i.e. pictures, videos, events. And let them upload menu and deals. • To provide restaurants with various option features such as delivery, loyalty card offers, special seats, group discounts, catering and more. • To allow the user to rate and review the restaurants. • To allow a user to compare two deals and select the suitable one • User can see activities of the restaurant in feeds and can like and review them • To allow restaurant to upload a job vacancy, if any, both part time and full time.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: People now a day are too busy with their lives. They want to do things more efficiently and quickly. In this era where people are adopting new technologies rapidly, there still exist so many things that consume time more than they should. People all around the world like to treat themselves with the good food and for this purpose they go out at different restaurants. With the unlimited demand of food and good restaurants  seating problem rise. People must wait to get a seat at their desired restaurant and this waiting could result in the consumption of their important time. This problem was solved by the help of our web application, our application let user reserve seat(s) before their arrival at the restaurant. It also let user know if there is any seat(s) available at the restaurant or not. Deal of the day, deal of the week and all kind of attractive offers are also part of our application. People can see different deals  in the feed section and select the restaurants according to their budget.

heading: 1.4.1 General constraints
content: • The app is only for customers and restaurants of Lahore. • If google map is not working user will not be able to find the location of the restaurant via app. • Internet is necessary to use the app. • Interface will be in English language, no other language supported. • Useful APIs are too difficult to find and learn.

heading: 1.4.2 General Assumption
content: • App is responsive so it works same on ever y device. It has both mobile view and desktop view. • Response time is minimum. • This application provides user with the proper feedback of what he/she is doing or should do. • It will work for all the major restaurants of Lahore. • The app will be responsive and will run on each sized screen.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: Eating out with family or friends is becoming the major habit of most people. To eat out we need restaurants. With the increasing demand of eating outside problem of having free table in the restaurants arises. People usually face difficulties because there was no free table available for them. Our application covers this problem and let the users know if there is any table available in the restaurant or not and let them reserve it so they don’t have to face difficulty later. This application solved most of the problems that people who love to eat outside faces. From reserving the table, ordering online, seeing and availing recent deals, this application solved every problem that one can face. It will help people to save time as this application let them reserve table online. User can see photos, videos, events and everything that restaurant is offering in the feed section of the application. Discovering nearby restaurants, getting job in restaurants is also the very important part of this application. User can have their personal accounts by just signing up with the help of Gmail or just by the help of Facebook.

heading: 2.1.1 OpenTable [1]
content: It is an online restaurant-reservation application in United States and UAE that lets users to reserve tables remotely. It also allows user s to see reviews of restaurants and by reserving using this application user earn point which they can use later for free  meals or anything restaurant is offering. User visit this site and reserve table but this application does not provide us with the feeds or jobs, our application provides jobs opportunities that different restaurants are offering and feeds of the restaurants i.e. deals, today’s special etc.

heading: 2.1.2 Dishcuss [2]
content: This application provides food lovers the platform where they can share their reviews about food. This application is newly created and people are liking this because of the feeds option, everyone’s review can be seen by everyone. Like this our application, along with the reservation, provide users with the feeds. People can not only see feeds but order and reserve using our application while in Dishcuss people can only review restaurants.

heading: 2.1.3 foodpanda [3]
content: The foodpanda provide food delivery services. This application is working on global scale and available in Pakistan. They provide free home delivery from anywhere you want. Our application provide s restaurants with the option that they can also c all foodpanda delivery service to deliver their food to customers home. Using this feature of our application restaurants can manage their activity more effectively. This option is helpful for both customers and restaurants.

heading: 2.1.4 Discounto [4]
content: By using this application people can avail the discounts in different restaurants near them. What this application do is that it let user search nearby restaurants and show how much discount different restaurants are offering. Users visit the restaurant and show the discount tab of this application and they get discount. This is related to our application as our application is also offering discounts to its users. Different restaurants put their deals and offers on the application and people can avail it by visiting t he restaurants.

heading: 2.1.5 Rozee.pk [5]
content: It provides users with the opportunities of getting jobs online. Like freelancing.com and other freelancing sites people go these sites to find jobs and then they select the job they like best.

Our application also offers  the jobs for anyone who is seeking one but as our application is restaurant specific, the jobs our application will be offering will only be related to the restaurants. After going to application users will go to the “Jobs” tab, here they can find jobs of fered by different restaurants.

heading: 2.6 Software development life cycle model
content: The SDLC we are going to use in this application is the Hybrid of rapid prototyping and incremental approach. Rapid prototyping is used when the user is ambiguous about what he/she really wants. Incremental approach refers to break the system in modules and priorities them. The high priority modules are developed first and in each increment a module is developed.

heading: 2.6.1 Justification
content: As the application is new in Pakistan and there is no such app which is entirely based on restaurant reservation system. Hence the users are not aware of how the application will work and how should it look. For this purpose, we use prototyping technique and give users a prototype of the application and their feedback will lead us to the right application design. heading: 5.1 Problems faced and Lesson Learnt
content: Completing this document has not been without its challenges. We decided to develop a single platform for the food lovers so they can do everything with the help of single website. And merging all those existing system into one was not easy for any of us. The various module of this document wasn’t new for us we had worked on them throughout the course of this degree but applying them was relatively new to us. The first real issue we faced was when we were deciding the scope of this application. When you’re an active user of application like ourselves you always want to create something that solve almost every problem that one can face. We had to create this app by keeping two things in mind; the time constrain and the users. We had no idea how much time a module going to take and how many problems of the users are going to be resolved so we had to think long and hard before deciding to add feature to our application. Gathering requirement was another problem. This was only really a problem because of the extremely short stakeholders. There was no specific customer for whom this application was being developed. From whom we could collect most of the requirement. The requirements mainly came from the restaurants and public. Developing use case models, sequence diagrams, ERDs and the system architecture to be used was another problem. Because this was the first time we were actually using all those concepts for the real project. After doing some research; looking samples and with guidance from our supervisor we managed to complete that. These were the few major problems that we faced but we would refer to them as challenges rather than problems and we got to learn from them.

heading: Abstract:
content: Limited campus automation system tool (LCAST) is an automated system to fulfil the navigation in campus, communication and monitoring between the faculty, administration and students, for all these features we have planned to use beacons. this system will ease the campus notification serving as an electronic noticeboard, based on the location of student as determined by the beacons, notifications will be transmitted to student’s smartphone application. Moreover, it will automate the attendance system, every classroom will have a unique beacon which will automate the process of attendance via beacons according to date/time and course. it will provide the indoor navigation system for the campus, an indoor map will be generated for the campus, User location will be identified on the basis of his presence within the range of Beacon. Beacons are BLE (Bluetooth Low Energy) sensors that behave as a lighthouse which repeatedly sends Bluetooth signals to be detected by devices such as smartphones.

heading: 1.1  Introduction:
content: LCAST is a system based upon the application of campus automation which covers the modules of notifications, attendance and content management. The backbone of the application is based upon the concept of IOT (Internet of Things). We have planned to use Beacons for the purpose of user identification, navigation, monitoring and notification. Beacon is a small low energy Bluetooth transmitter which repeatedly transmits single signal that other devices can see. When other devices detect this signal, some specific action is performed on them accordingly. There are two modules of our system: •  An android application which will serve as a user end platform •  A web-based beacon controlling application which will be used by teachers and administrators for handling the working and functionality of various beacons. The android application will be highly responsive and user friendly and will notify the student with some specific notification whenever the smartphone enters the zone of a beacon. The notification can be campus based generic notifications e.g. holiday, results, offers etc. and it will also serve as an information medium for teachers, officials and campus map. The other functionality of application would be the automated attendance marking whenever a student appears in the zone of a beacon in a specific class which will be programmed in such manner. The server-side web application will be used by authorized users to manage the content being communicated to users, manage the beacons and their range, zone and working. This automated system will allow efficiency and ease of access to every student on the campus, it will ease the student/teacher and administration/student communications. It will also improve the attendance system removing the effects of proxy system.

heading: Application Features:
content: • You will be able to Login with Username and Password provided by the University. • The android application will make your Cell phone an electronic noticeboard when you are within the range of the beacons installed in the campus, you’ll receive announcement and reminders from administration or your Professors. • You can view all the notification received from the administration or your teacher and you can set a reminder to any of the notification so the application will remind you regarding that notification afterwards.

Steps of development: • First of all, we need to order Estimote beacons according to our requirement • Then we’ll start building an android application which is able to catch Bluetooth signals being broadcasted by the nearby beacons. • Then we’ll start designing our Database as it will be playing a key role in the success of this Project • Implementing the web-Based portal for registering or controlling the beacons would be out next target. • Then we’ll start implementing are functionalities which are as follow o Notification System o Automatic Attendance o Campus Navigation • After implementation of the functionalities we’ll move towards thorough testing the system and after we have done with testing and debugging the system will be deployed in the respective campus.

heading: 1.2 Objectives:
content: • To develop a user friendly and responsive android application to provide students with class and campus level notifications based on the working of beacons. • To develop a high-end web portal to handle all the administrative options such as creating notification and monitoring attendance. • To automate the attendance system without any human effort or concern. • To reduce the proxy rate and false attendance as well as any kind of mismanagement by the instructor by automating the system. • To serve as an E-noticeboard, in order to personally communicate any message by the teacher or administration • To serve as a content managing application which might be delivered by any instructor.

heading: 1.3  Problem Statement:
content: To make an android application that serves as electronic noticeboard within the campus, automates the attendance of the students on the basis of their cell phones within the range of beacons installed in the classrooms and providing students with the ease campus navigation

heading: 1.4.1    Assumptions:
content: • This System will provide ease not only to the students but also the teachers and the administration. • Administration or teachers will send reminders or announcements to all the students rather than texting to some students and commanding them to convey to others. • Students will receive important updates and announcements on their cell phones. • Attendance of the students will be automatically marked upon their presence within the range of the beacons.

heading: 2.1 Literature Review:
content: The purpose of this application is to motivate and inspire developers and IT industry in Pakistan to work on this technology and its other uses. A detailed analysis was done on the existing application relevant to physical web category. These applications are available on Google Play Store. The purpose of this analysis was to have appropriate ideas of how an application’s design should must be and what sort of interface attracts the users. These apps are mentioned below: [1] Nav&Go is an indoor navigation solution app for Egypt. It makes indoor navigation easy in malls, airports, events, universities, museums and public places easier. It benefits users with unfamiliar routes. [2] TIBCO Beacons is an app that allows you to learn more information about booths and breakout sessions, it was specifically designed for 2014 TIBCO NOW user conference. It provides in and out details of a certain booth being operated using a beacon, it displays information on users app. [3] Social Retail Toolkit is an app that allows you to set up and sync beacons to the social retail platform. It sets up one’s own beacon powered notifications that are triggered on users app. [4] FYI Beacons is an app that provides connection to variety of hyper-local content, promotions and interactivity. When it detects a beacon, it will provide a notification with the option to view more information related to that beacon.

heading: 4.2 UNIT TESTING:
content: A unit testing is basically a level of software testing in which each component of the system is tested individually. The purpose of this testing is to make sure that each and every component of the system is working as designed. Since we are developing a system with multiple modules. These include: • Submission of Notification from Portal: Ensuring that notification is properly sent over to database from the portal. • Receiving notification in Application: Ensuring that notification is properly received in from the Database • Marking Attendance: Ensuring that attendance of right student is marked. • Navigation: Ensuring correct location of the student is viewed in the application. • Navigation Algorithm: Testing the algorithm for calculating location of the student.

heading: 4.3 INTEGRATION TESTING:
content: A phase of software testing which is done by combining different software components are combined as tested a group. In our application, we combined different units and tested them as a group. These groups include: • Application and beacons: Integration of beacons with the android application for the purpose of checking presence of smartphone within the range of beacon so that attendance can be marked or notification can be received in the application. • Application and server: Integration of application with the server API for the purpose of communication between application and server.

heading: 4.4 ACCEPTANCE TESTING:
content: Acceptance testing of our system will be done by the users once the mobile application is uploaded on the play store and portal is hosted. The purpose of this testing is to evaluate whether the System has met the requirement specifications or not. The acceptance testing of our System will mostly be based on user reviews. A questionnaire will also be conducted once the System is deployed. It would be designed to answer the following questions: • Was the user Interface friendly? • Was the colour scheme used suitable for the system? • What sort of changes would the users like to see? • Would the users like to have this application in IOS as well?

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and Lessons Learned:
content: As the development team is new in this field and the technology is new so problems in learning the new technology of beacons with very less research content available was the major difficulty faced up till now. The major lesson learned by the team was that each and every member is an important stakeholder of the project as they add different values into different dimensions of the project. Moreover, the team was introduced to many various opportunities in Pakistani software and IT industry which will help them to carve their ways into the industry.

heading: Abstract
content: Technology is gaining control on our life to make our everyday task easy and save us time. We are living in an era where we use smartphones and smart TV’s most of the time in our daily routines either to earn our living or to surf the internet. But  the ways we use the apps mostly are time consuming. We either have to search for the required app from the apps we have downloaded or sometimes we have shortcut for it which is a very rare case in smartphones but in smart TV’s there is no such option. We have made an android application for both the smartphones and smart TV’s that help ’s user to access applications faster by recognizing user’s facial gesture. It allows a user to scroll through the app with the related motion of us er’s face. In smart TV’s i t is time saving as compared to scrolling through screens using a remote. It ease the use of applications inst alled on a smart TV. The camera identifies  the facial gestures of user’s to open applications and screen scrolling. If user tilts his face up ward or downward the screen scrolls according to his face. When the user performs  any facial gesture like win king or raising eyebrows it  opens the app associated with that gesture. Table of Contents

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Android industry is working hard to provide best to their users. But still there is room for improvement in the products they provide. The way user’s open downloaded apps is not the easiest way to access the applications on smart phones or smart TV’s. Users have to find the downloaded application from the installed applications in his device. The more the installed applications, the harder it will be for user to find the application he wants to open which is very annoying sometimes for user. We have made an application that allows the user to control his device using facial gestures. This application is on basic leve l that  only provide s some limited functionalities to user. The functionality that user is able to perform includes open applications and screen scrolling. User is able to set applications corresponding to the gesture that he would perform and is able to do screen scrolling through i t. Our application  opens apps but without a mou se pointer. The application uses facial gestures detection with the help of camera for this purpose  [1]. Our application uses front camera to take pictur e as a background application and detect user face from the image and identify the expressions using TensorFlow, OpenCV, Dagger, and AWS SDK. Based on those expressions it launches the application associated with that expression. User can set the facial ge stures for mostly used applications of his device. User will set his facial gestures to open specific applications in his device. The application works in a way that while on home screen when us er makes the specific facial gesture corresponding to which he  had associated an application that specific installed application would open on his device. The facial gestures include winking, raising an eyebrow or opening mouth. For example, while on home screen if user opens his/her mouth  then Instagram application will open and if he/she raise s his/her eyebrows then Gallery or any other application associated with it will open. The other part of application includes screen scrolling through facial movement. User can set the speed of screen scrolling i n application settings. It works on all kinds of applications that allows vertical scrolling. Whenever an application is opened the camera detect s the facial movement. Vertical Facial movement is detected by the camera and the screen is scrolled with respect to the movement of user ’s face. If the user move s his/her face upward then the screen will be scrolled

heading: 11 of 53  17 May 2018
content: upward and if his /her face direction is in downwards, the screen is scrolled downwards. If the user’s face is still neither slightly up nor slightly down, the screen will not scroll. Our application works better with good camera and good light conditions as it would be easy to detect the facial gestures of the user’s face.

heading: 1.2 Objectives:
content: • Our application detects user’s facial gestures and head movement. • Our application has many shortcut options for user to set. • User is able to set shortcuts to open apps. • User is able to open apps using facial expressions. • User is able to scroll his device screen within an app through facial movement. • User is able to select scrolling speed.

heading: 1.3 Problem statement:
content: When the user has too many apps installed on his/her mobile phone, he/she is looking for a certain app. He/she gets confused by looking at so many apps. He/she can easily access that application using just a single expression. For amputee people, who don’t have hands or complete arm, would be able to use mobile phone applications. He/she would open an app lication using his expression and scroll through the application with movement of his/her head.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & constraints:
content: Following are the assumptions and constraints of our application:

heading: 1.4.1 Assumptions:
content: • The user knows how to use an android phone. • The user knows about the revolting technology. • The user knows the purpose of this application before he installs it.

heading: 1.4.2 Constraints:
content: • User’s device must have a front camera. • User’s device camera must be good enough to detect user’s face. • In low light, the application won’t be able to detect facial expressions and head movement accurately.

heading: 1.5 Project scope:
content: Our application provides fast access to apps. Our application saves time. Our application provides screen scrolling by movement of user’s head. Our application provides shortcuts to multiple applications by detecting user’s facial gestures. Our application does not have shortcuts for all the apps. Shortcuts are for most important and most used apps. Too many shortcuts might confuse the user remembering the gestures he/she  had set. Our application won’t provide clicking function e.g. if he/she wants to click at som ething using his/her gestures.

heading: 2.1.1 EVA Facial Mouse:
content: This is an android application that displays a cursor on the mobile screen  [2]. It captures  the movement of the user’s face from the front camera and then moves the mouse pointer according to the movements of the face. To open any app we take the pointer to it and hold our face still for some time and it will click on it and the app opens. It is a good application but it lacks in some functionalities as we are unable to do screen scrolling and the click time is too short. Figure 1 EVA Facial Mouse Figure 1 contains the images of the EVA Facial Mouse applicatio n. The most left image is its home menu. The centre image shows the menu of speed control of the mouse pointer. The most right image shows the working of the application.

heading: 2.1.2 Eye Type:
content: This android application detects our eyes and eyeballs and their movement s to type something from the keyboard given within the application  [3]. Depending upon eye movements a letter is typed. This app only types words within the app, so it has no use outside of it. It a good application as it gives us next word prediction and has many other good functionalities but it is not compatible with devices with small screen and have some operational issues (not understanding the typing concept).

heading: 2.1.3 Samsung Smart Scroll:
content: Some of Samsung smart phones used to have  built-in smart scrolling feature  [4]. It was only in their flagship devices. It enabled users to do vertical screen scrolling only by detecting users head motions when the device is hold steady right in front of the users’ eye . It uses front camera to detect the motion of users head. When a user tilts his head or his device upward the screen start scrolling upward and vice versa. It was a good feature but it only works with the built-in applications only.

heading: 2.1.4 XPRESS – The Natural Face Expression Changer:
content: This is an android application that changes the expression of a picture. It takes a picture of a person from the user’s device and changes its expression by identifying his face and change its expression as per user desire.

heading: 2.1.5 Micro Expressions:
content: This is an android application that teaches us the difference between different emotions like happy, sad, anger, fear. This application helps user to identify the difference between different emotions in two phases of learning and testing. It first teaches the user these expressions and then take a test whenever user is ready.

heading: Abstract
content: There has been an increasing trend of games incorporating themselves into our everyday life; playing an important role if we want to “blow off some steam” and relax. To that end, given that every other person possesses a mobile phone nowadays; hand -held devices have become the platform for people to indulge in a wide array of games in order to escape from the harsh realities of life; even if it is for just a moment. As a result, coming up with novel, unprecedented ideas in order to differentiate itself has become necessary, given the sheer amount of games already present. Our game, albeit of game modes that have been done previously, has a lore that revolves primarily around the concepts of chemistry. It’s a quest of an unknown atom in an unknown world to find its true identity over the course of the game. The protagonist is faced with several obstacles and choices throughout the game as he traverses the plot. Game progression is entirely based on the choices the player makes which; as a result incorporates “butterfly effect” concept in our game. Explanation of what is happening based on how chemistry as a science functions we will guid e user throughout the course of the game. All in all it will be an amalgamation of competition, entertainment and excitement. Initially, this game will be targeted for Android platform however we will try our best to introduce it on iOS platform as well.

heading: 1.1 Game Plot
content: It all began with the interplanetary war between radioactive planet and other planets in the solar system. Radioactive Planet named “Uri” ruled by Uranium element of the periodic table declared war on other planets because of its destructive, disruptive and deadly nature [1]. Uri wanted to conquer the entire universe to achieve stability in his own planet. Acquiring stability was only possible with equal amount of matter to traverse it into another form of matter. Consequently, mass massacre of atoms took place in other planets. Uri’s army spared none. Most of them fought for their lives and land however, they could not withstand the mighty power of ‘Uri”. They had no choice but to flee somewhere safe which was unknown and unheard o f and that place, became a refugee camp for all those atoms who somehow managed to survive the atrocities of the war [2]. Among all those atoms landed the main character of the story “ AL”, who is unaware of his identity his behaviour and past. AL being un aware of his surroundings sat out to explore the refugee camp. He did not know how he got here and he could not remember the past either. All he could think of was some distorted and disconnected flashes from the past. He had to figure it out and connect the dots. When things started to get clear for him as to why was, he brought here. Hell broke loose over refugee camp, Uri’s army found out about the refugee camp and they attacked it as well [3]. Attacked caused havoc in the refugee camp, the head of the c amp “Poseidon” called an emergency meeting of all the atoms to formulate their action plan. As they all gathered, Poseidon decided in greater good of the society to stay and defend the camp instead of abandoning yet another planet. AL agrees and accepts t he action plan as laid by Poseidon and therefore he begins the quest for search of his identity while defending this land and its people. The game begins from this point [4]. In the game, the player starts as an “Entity”. This Entity has a quest to gain closur e in terms of what it is – what element, from a Periodic Table point of view, to be more specific. This closure is facilitated by several game types, helping narrow down what group of elements our Entity belongs to, what the charge is on it, and finally, w hich element it specifically is from the aforementioned elements that had been narrowed down from a chronological perspective, the Entity, at first, is faced with levels that leave the protagonist with series of choices. Based on the choices the player mak es by the end of this choice -based game -mode, the element the Entity might potentially be is narrowed down from the Periodic Table as a whole to certain “groupings” within it, based on the characteristics those certain groups of elements possess. After ha ving made it through the first mode, the player is then thrust into another – one that mimics the “Space Shooter” game type. In this game mode, the player has to shoot down as many targets as possible before his life-points run out, and he succumbs to the damage to his spacecraft from hostiles. During his ascent into the level, the targets he is meant to shoot down  to determine charge on a “freely existing ion” of the elements that the Entity might potentially be. For instance, NaCl includes two oppositely charged ions: Na with a positive charge, and Cl with a negative charge. Reiterating, whichever type of targets (positive or negative) the player has destroyed more of in this game-mode will determine the element in terms of the charge present on freely

content: existing ions of that element; helping narrow down the el ements present in the group of     e lements narrowed down from the first game -mode even further.  The final game -mode featured in this game will be that of a “2-D Side Scrolled”. That is, the Entity wil l have to traverse through various terrains in a bid to “end” the game; with the end being the Entity actualizing the element it was. Based on how the player had played the earlier game -modes. This game -mode will be the biggest one, with the focus being on  surviving the terrain, and collecting resources along the way. These resources, in tandem with the previous game modes, would eventually end with the Entity becoming the element it was meant to be.

Player character will lose health points (HP) when collided with enemies or lethal obstacles. In order to defeat an enemy, the character will utilize the provided weapons and combat system. heading: Abstract
content: Sometimes you keep running over little health issues where you need a doctor’s advice and take after their remedies. But numerous patients who living far away can't approach the specialist they need to get their assessment. As it is the world of technology everyone needs to get their answers in a couple of seconds. The Health Verdict website provides you the platform for direct collaboration or correspondence from the authorize doctor of your choice. It facilitates the patients as well as doctors. This thought originates from developing countries. We want to apply this thought here to encourage our country where innovation is progressing.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Health Verdict is a website, which gives one platform through which specialists can enlist them according to their specialization. The user can access the doctor from anywhere in the Pakistan. Doctors can share the precautionary measures, symptoms, and causes of different viral disease on their profile. Users can follow the doctors to read the informative blogs. It encourages them to pursuit specialists proficiently in the field of classifications they need. Users may register them as an FCPS (The Fellow of College of Physicians and Surgeons Pakistan) and FRCS (Fellowship of the Royal College of Surgeons) doctors through their PMDC (Pakistan medical and dental council) number. Doctors can provide their area of the private work environment for the patients in authentic cases. They also classified by their gender, cities, hospitals and zone of specialization. It provides the facility to the patients and doctors of video and voice calling for their checkup solutions. Users can pay online, prescription charges which would set by the specialists.It will defeat the issue of building up centers in all the Pakistan's urban areas by saving the time and money utilizes on traveling and so on. Specialists provide their accessibility hours as indicated by weak days according to their schedules. Furthermore, they might be set the limit of appointments they get. Our main focus is to develop a system which not only provides the facility to register online appointment, however, would also encourage the users to get online checkup and medicines through direct communication with the user where they get a solution for their issues by responding to a little bunch of queries.  Doctors can also give their restrictions of checkup it is possible that they give guidance to the users just or they can offer online checkup. A Survey conducted by software advice in 2014 and 2013 shows that how much patients use this approach in developed countries. 25% people rarely follow online solutions for their health. 46% people sometimes follow online health solutions. 13% people often follow online solutions. 16% never follow this route.

heading: 2.1.3 Online Medical Consultation (OMC)
content: Online Medical Consultation (OMC) is the term used to refer to web based remote patient- specialist (customer provider) medical meetings. OMC can be viewed as a major aspect of telemedicine where the expression "Remote Interview" refers to "conference by means of remote media communications, generally with the end goal of diagnosis or treatment". OMC differs from remote consultation in three main points. First, OMC does not include non internet based consultation. Second, OMC conveys an outlook change in the way patients look for medicinal meetings. Third, OMC is about direct patient-doctor consultations not doctor-doctor consultation for health education and for other reasons. The common telemedicine services are limited for patients within a specific geographical region where as OMC goes beyond that.

heading: 2.6 Software Life Cycle Model
content: Incremental and rapid prototype model will be suitable in health verdict.

heading: 2.6.1 Incremental Model:
content: In the incremental life cycle model the whole system is divided into small increments/builds. The requirement are prioritized and grouped for implementation and each increment/release contains some functionality to be delivered. Each successive release adds more functionality to the previous iteration. For the health verdict project we will use the incremental model because We have to submit the system module by module with complete functioning. It would be helpful to identify errors and debug the increments rather than testing the whole system at once. More adaptable – less expensive to change degree and requirements, when any requirement changes from doctor or patient side, it would be easier to handle change furthermore in the future if we want to make any advancement in the system it would be helpful to use incremental model because it would demand less rework. Easier to oversee hazard on the grounds that hazardous pieces are distinguished and dealt during its iteration. Some design issues may arise in incremental model and user may find difficulty for the user to learn how to use system with each new increment/ release these problems can be dealt by using prototyping. Diagram shows the main steps involved in each phase. Figure 16: SDLC

heading: 58 of 109 09 January 2018
content: 1.Requirement Gathering and Analysis: In this area, every single requirement of the implementation process are caught and documented. 2.Requirement specification: On the basis of user demand the functional requirements are categorized and decide how to complete functionality through step by step modulation process. 3.Architectural Design: in this stage we design up the functional requirements. This stage incorporates the learning of requirements from the primary stage and the design of the methodology is good to go. Technique Design helps in indicating methodology measures and furthermore helps in characterizing absolute process framework. 4.Implementation: By using the selected design in this stage we implement the small increments/builds and then refer it for unit testing and after successful testing the system will be ready to use and deployed to the user. 5.Maintenance: When the system is in use in the user environment some bugs are identify and to fix this bug we introduce upgrading of system of patches or bug fixed by the developer.

heading: 2.6.2 Rapid Prototype Model:
content: In prototype model quick working models are built for testing the functionality, features and ideas and sometime design according to the user. Prototype model can be used with any other model to produce best results so we will use it with incremental model. Prototype model will be used to make the prototypes for different modules of the system and check the functionality if all the functions are easy to use, no need of extra training necessary to use the system, system design should include all the option clearly visible because user will not have enough time to explore our health verdict system. So, after building prototypes we will use incremental model to implements the functionalities according to the user desire. For example we collected requirements from patients and doctors in various hospitals and came to know that that user spends only few seconds to judge the website so the front page should be very attractive and all the functionalities provided should also be described. We made a prototype for front layout and after approval we implement it with few amendments. Following iterative steps will be performed in prototype model.

heading: 4.1 Testing:
content: To make it sure that the software is working properly according to the requirements, health verdict use following testing techniques:

heading: 4.1.1 Unit Testing:
content: Classes will be tested independently to ensure reliability, quality and functionality within unit level. All PHP classes will be tested with the PHP Storm compiler. For maintaining the patient require, we will use SQL server will be used to maintain the database. JavaScript Unit testing of the customer side part (core part) of web application exhibit diverse difficulties than server-side testing presents. Notwithstanding testing the structural format of a page and essential application useful, you might need to check that activates execute efficiently, that a page with a lot of JavaScript has no memory spills, and that the application keeps up its useful and execution desires over different programs. It can be done by bringing productive testing environment for developers to test on a real system, easy debugging, and continuous integration. Unit testing checks the functionality of single page or class like testing, if the appointment form allows the user to enter information properly? Is there any delay in page load? No extra details should be needed to form. Use the icons that are common, people familiar with them to save their time. If it passes the test then it can be integrated with other modules.

heading: 4.1.2 Integration Testing:
content: Grouping of classes will be test to guarantee the effective working of the dynamic framework. Integrate the classes to make sure that they are working properly for the progressive health verdict system. Bottom up Technique Bottom up testing, as the name recommends begins from the most minimal or the deepest unit of the application, and steadily climbs. The Integration testing begins from the most minimal module and slowly advances towards the upper modules of the application. This mix proceeds till every one of the modules are incorporated and the whole application is tried as a solitary unit.

heading: Figure 55:Health Verdict Bottom Up
content: In the above diagram the bottom up method first the login, search doctor, make an appointment and payment functionalities are integrated to make up for online consultancy. This technique makes it easy to identify error at the start small level and easy debugging. No   time is wasted to wait until whole system is completed to perform testing because if any module is not implemented yet we can use dummy for it. It takes help of drivers for testing.

heading: System Testing:
content: Once the unit and integration testing is done its time to perform system testing to check the functionality of the system as a whole and checks if the system is according to the user needs and requirements functional as well as non-functional requirements are test.

heading: 4.2 Black box testing:
content: Black box testing would be applied to health verdict system. Complete integrated system is tested by giving different type of inputs based on the scenarios the system will be used and the result of the outputs would be checked. Now, after testing the functionalities, test if the system is user friendly or not by checking the error message system generates if any problem occur or not and language used in system should not contain any jargon. Compatibility test to check if the system will function properly on the user’s operating system and on mobile. A performance test to check how the system responds at peak usage time. Security test is very important for the health verdict because the patient record is maintained in the system and anyone should not allow login someone others account by copying the url.

heading: Abstract
content: Social response is a platform based upon pure web for receiving feedbacks from open or closed use base. The aim is to provide a platform to setup a feedback system where user, moderator, and company management will contribute to provide necessary data. Viral marketing trends will be used to make it popular. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: World is digitizing and trends towards social sharing is moving fast. People prefer use of social media for any problem they face. There is a great need of application where users can provide feedback according to their experience so that publ ic who is looking forward to the same service or product can refer to this platform for better decision. Now a days usually preferred way to provide feedback to any industry or an organization is by its Facebook page or blogs but there is no platform devel oped for this specific cause. Some organizations have their private feedback systems which are for the monitoring of their performance but this platform will be for every person seeking information or the company management intending to monitor their perfo rmance. This platform will be the first in industry for this specific purpose. Bloggers can refer to this platform as a reference to his claim by embedding information like people embed tweets. Suppose an ATM in town xyz is used by several hundred customer s. Service is often down in here or mostly there is no cash in machine. People usually put comments or reviews on Facebook page about their experience but there is no specific platform for this purpose. And here comes Social Response providing solution to the problem. Users just have to open service from any platform available, post a review, rate and exit. People rating will determine the average rating of ATM service. For instance ATM in xyz town is rated for “2.1”. Banks managing department can log on to  Social Response and monitor its performance. System will provide easy solution for people willing to use a service or product but have no knowledge about. Next time a user willing to open account in bank he will make sure that ATM is working in respective  town by reading customers comments and reviews.

heading: Abstract
content: In this project, we aim to propose a site that will receive customized orders of the bakery products of customers and they will also be able to fill their refreshment boxes. They will be able to choose the items for their order or refreshment box. They will select the product items, their flavor, product quantity and extra filling option according to their requirements. Bake my day site will enable users to purchase numerous bakery products online. A catalog of different bakery products would be displayed on the site. If the customer likes some product, he might add it to his shopping list. He will then login using some id password to process his order. The payment process shall be made through a credit card or cash on delivery. The customer will get a receipt of his shopping cart on his email address after the successful transaction.

heading: 1.1  Introduction
content: In this modern era, time is very precious so we are making such system that will not only save time but also make moments memorable for the lifetime. Here we are introducing Bake my day site. Although there are online systems present and they are working by taking any product order from the customer but in our system, we are working for the placement of custom orders so that customers can order the individual bakery product item whatever they want accordi ng to their requirement. We offer a refreshment box including various items like biscuits, rolls, pastries, pizza etc. Also, their quantity, flavours, and topping can also be selected. In case of extra filling of the products in the refreshment box, extra charges will be applied. There are some previously existing systems in which customer needs to have a physically present copy of the menu, deficiency of a visible confirmation that the order is placed properly, the necessity for the bakery to have the staff answering the phone and take orders and poor services. So we are introducing bake my day site that allows the users to check for different bakery products available at the online store, place order online and receive the item timely. Customers will check  the list of customized bakery products that would be displayed in various categories. The customer will see a current menu with all available options, adjustable prices according to ingredients, flavours, fillings, and toppings. The customer will choose t he item, add quantity, add the item to his/her shopping list and confirm the order. After that he/she will log into the system, then the customer will pay through a credit card or cash on delivery. The customer will get confirmation by receiving shopping receipt on his/ her email id after his/ her successful transaction. The time limit for pre -order of refreshment boxes will be specified so that customers can order the desired products before the mentioned time limit. After that mentioned time limit, the system will not confirm orders from the customers. This system will lessen the load on bakery by the process of automated ordering. This system will help bakery staffs to rapidly check the orders as they are placed and produce the necessary items with minim um delay and confusion. Also, the reviews given by customers on the site will help other customers to easily choose the menu items.

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: The main objective of our project is to develop a reliable and convenient Bake my day site that takes customized orders so that customer is also able to select his products, adjust the price by selecting a flavour and other options.

heading: 12 of 137  ©BakeMyDay
content:  To allow the customers to order the food items by selecting the menu.  To allow customers to choose food ingredients, flavour,  additional filling in their refreshment box before ordering.  To guarantee accurate placement of orders through visual confirmation.  To eliminate paperwork and increase the level of accuracy.  To increase speed of service.  To boost the sales volume.  To ensure client satisfaction.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: A large number of food order taking websites are available but there are a lot of drawbacks in placing orders through these sites like late delivery, placing a wrong order, not dealing customized orders, no extra filling, n o extra topping, site loading time too much and not dealing corporate level orders. The main motive of our project is to facilitate individual level customers to place their customized orders for bakery products and corporate level customers to place order s for refreshment boxes in bulk and build the trust of customers through our feedback system as previous systems are providing this opportunity with a lot of cons present. We tend to develop a system that will enable the customers to  view product menus,  select the ingredients, their flavours, additional fillings for individual order and for their refreshment box at their own will.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions and Constraints
content: Following are the assumptions for our project 1. HBL banking API will be used for transactions that will make the user's information confidential and safe. 2. The system will be responsive to computer, laptops, tablets and phone’s screen. 3. For development purpose, we need experts/consultant of this domain. 4. We need a license of Web Storm and PHP Storm tool for developing the ` project by using their licensed features. 5. Stakeholders of the project are available when a meeting of the project held.

heading: 13 of 137  ©BakeMyDay
content: 6. The Bake My Day System can potentially have hundreds of users. It is unrealistic to provide training for everyone. Therefore, the system should be designed for easy to use, providing help instructions, and appropriate error messages for the invalid administrator, customer inputs. 7. It is also assumed that all the customers and the administrator using this system are not blocked by Firewalls or proxies. Following are the constraints of our project 1. The project has to be complete in six months till Nov 2018. 2. The project needs an internet connection for its working. 3. Web support which is used for initiating the project will  have to support Angular JS. 4. Daily working hours for the project are not more than 8 hours.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: The customer can register a new account by providing his/her personal details. He/she can log into the website via Phone no. /email along with his/he r verified password. The customer can search for a product using product name. He/she can select a his\her desired product and add it to cart. He/she can review available products with ratings and comment/feedback. Customer verifies the chosen product and confirms the order. He/she can view his/her order history, the progress status of his/her order and pending orders along their proposed delivery time. Those customers who buy our product can give feedback and suggestions on the site. Cash on delivery or on line payment using a credit card is the proposed methods for payment. For bulk orders, Customer has to pay some advance payment using online payment method. A chat box is available for the customer for help and guidelines using text. The customer can selec t any deal of his choice for placing an order and pays advance payment to confirm his order in case of bulk orders. He/she can order a customized refreshment box. He/she can select items from the menu and select the filling, topping and flavor options (This order cannot be less than 25 Refreshment box). heading: 3.4 Software Architecture
content: We are using Laravel framework. This framework uses MVC (model, view, and controller) for implementation. This architecture pattern is best suited for designing web applications. The user requests some services and these services are sent to routers and then the router sends the request to the controller MVC is an architectural pattern that sep arates the web application into three main components

heading: Model:
content: All the web application domains are built on the model they represent the data that is being transferred to both the controller and view components. Models are stored outsi de the applications and are mostly database. When data changes it also updates controller. It mostly acts as a data storage system.

heading: View:
content: The view represents the data that model contains it is the visual representation of the context of models.  It is used  for the graphical user interface of the application. It shows the data model on the page according to the requirements of the users that they had entered. It only displays data in form of GUIs.

heading: 5.2     Project Summary:
content: The summary of our project is that time is very valuable so we are introducing such website that will not only save time but also make our moments more unforgettable for the sake of saving our customers time we are introducing a website  that is Bake My Day .It’s a kind of online system that will work for the placement of customer’s order. Here we are offering refreshment box that include many items like rolls, sandwiches, pastries, pizza, cakes etc. In our website customer can also be a ble to order customized order. In customized order customer can also be able to select quantity, flavours, topping and also shape of the refreshment box. The customer will choose the item, adds quantity, add the item to his/her shopping list and confirms the order. After that he/she will log into the system. Then customer can pay through a credit card or cash on delivery. The customer gets confirmation by receiving shopping receipt on his/ her email id after his/ her successful transaction. We use laravel framework in our project to make a website. Laravel framework is very popular for custom software development. The benefits of laravel are by using laravel implementing authentication become very simple. Almost everything is configured out-of- the-box. Laravel also provides a simple way to organize authorization logic and control access to resources. This system will lessen the load on bakery by the process of ordering automated. This system will help bakery staffs to rapidly read the orders as they are placed and produce the necessary items with minimum delay and confusion. Thus, this project will make easy to buy bakery items online with trust for both buyer and seller. Also, by the reviews given by people on the site, customer can easily choose the menu items.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Before the application of modern medicine, life was fugacious for humans. The environment was loaded with unpredictable dangers in the form of various diseases. Various methods were used to cure these diseases.  Gradually medical practice transformed into an organized profession and Doctors came to rescue human lives. A doctor is a person who dedicates his life and all his knowledge for the wellbeing and survival of mankind. Not only there  is an increased life expectancy, but also a massive improvement in the quality of life.   Doctors are of utmost importance to make accurate diagnosis and provide proper treatment, which can save a patient from harmful self-medication and make the things worse. In many situations, a doctor can define a narrow boundary between life and death. The country that we live in is vastly diverse as it consists of people ranging from all walks of life. It has to be taken into much consideration that our society range s from people with minimal wages who as a patient opt for public health centers, to the elites who prefer to go for private counseling. Therefore, despite of many health care systems, the approach to health care facilities and access to qualified doctors i s not possible for every individual in our society. In Pakistan, there is only 1 doctor per 1,000 patients according to University of Health Sciences (UHS). [1] If we talk about doctors, then due to rapid increase in private medical colleges, since 2007, Pakistan Medical industry is producing a large number of doctors each year, whereas government is not yet ready to accept this number and adjust them in public sectors, due to a lack of health care centers.  [2] General physicians are expected to specialize in some branch of medical sciences, in order to earn a name for themselves which takes several years before a doctor can earn a basic living. Another major issue in this field are  stressful, prolonged working hours. This is leading to a massive increase in rates of stress and depression amongst doctors. According to a study conducted in Karachi,  there was strong a relationship between depression and working hours. Doctors working m ore than 48 hours per week were highly suffering from this condition. Another study shows that doctors with working hours more than 46 per week were at higher risk to develop psychological disorders, which is an alarming situation.  According to a study conducted in 2015, in Lahore, the satisfaction rate of doctors with their jobs was too low. Only 13.3% were fully contented with their jobs with an outstanding satisfaction. 53.6% of the doctors had average to above average satisfaction, while only 10.3% of the lot had a below average satisfaction with their jobs. [3] Due to inadequate career prospects, research and study funding and overloaded work, many of the doctors are forced to move abroad. One study revealed that in year  2005, 1300 doctors moved abroad. Solely, Saudi Arabia hired 2,500 doctors in 2010 which might have a huge impact in the number of doctors serving in Pakistan in future. [4] 12 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r With the passage of time new diseases are found to  occur in humans and there are more chances of epidemics. According to Journal of  The Royal Society , in 2014 it was found that the epidemics have become much more common in recent decades. [5] Because of many factors in the modern era, there is an increased risk of disease spreading amongst people of all age groups, thus need of health care provision is rising with time. As for the other domains  of life, rapid advancement in Information technologies are breaking all barriers in the field of medicine as well.  Clinicians and patients have all the access to health - related information. This is one of the most common uses of the internet. The access t o evolving information about health helps in decision making by the patients and makes communication with the doctor much easier. But there are still certain barriers like lack of time for the doctors and inadequate knowledge of internet usage  in application of complicated systems and software in our country. Keeping in view all these issues, our project is taking an initiative to solve these problems as much as possible. This project aims at providing a  much better opportunity to doctor and patient by providing them a platform of direct interaction through android app lication on their handsets. In the developed system,  patients and t he doctors will create profiles . In time of need,  patients will login  and cho ose their health related issues . After  entering the problem, our system will suggest a doctor accordingly. Professional doctor s of all age groups and expertise  will be available. The Project will be provid ing a patient who will login  to see all the details updated by doctor on his profile, can see his qualification, work timings, response time, ratings. On the other hand doctor can also view patients profile and previous ratings by any other doctor and decide if he is feasible enough for him to see. Patient can fix an appointment with the docto r and also can call him at his home for checkups, primary care, diagnosis etc. Patient can view the current location of the doctor while he is on his way and doctor can view the location of his destination where he is expected to see his patient. Checkup d etails are recorded in application and checkup fee is also calculated. Patient and doctor can rate each other to build a trust/profile for other who visits next time. Ch eckup history and total earning  of doctor is maintained within this application. This will provide a great platform to the doctors who are struggling in the profession by providing them a me ans of earning from their homes . It saves their time and investments for setup as the system is very convenient with 24/7 availability with no w aiting r ooms, closed offices. Also for th e patients, it saves time, expensive doctor and transportation charges, frustration of long appointments and much more. The user can connect using his favorite devi ce to a user friendly interface. This provides peace of min d with 100 percent acceptance covering the whole family. So mainly, we aim at providing total care of body, mind and wallet. The rest of the report is organized as follows: Chapter 2  describes related work, functional requirements, use -case description and design. Chapter 3  includes major diagrams of system. Chapter 4 describes system testing. Chapter 5 includes conclusion, problems faced and lessons learned. 13 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r

heading: 1.2 Objectives
content: Main objective of this system is to facilitate patients by providing them opportunity to book clinic appointment or doctor’s visit to patient’s doorstep. Objectives of our system are mentioned below: • To provide nearest clinic s earch feature through which a patient can search nearest clinics. • To provide facility for a patient to view nearest clinic details and book a clinic appointment. • To provide a manual searching feature in which a patient can search doctor by selecting the distance in miles or by selecting the specific gender. • To provide appointment feature in which a patient can view doctor details and can assign a doctor for home visit. • To provide a real -time location tracking feature through which a patient can track the location of a doctor by viewing the distance in miles and duration. • To facilitate doctors by providing them opportunity to receive requests from nearest patients. • To provide opportunity through which doctors can develop their profiles by getting high ratings • To allow both users to rate each other with additional feature of review. • To provide checkup history feature through which a checkup history of a patient will be maintained. • To allow doctor to view his daily, weekly and monthly earning. • To provide user-friendly interface.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: Health issues are very common now a days especially in under developed countries like Pakistan where smoke of industries, factories and vehicles cause environmental pollution and dust. Food in the restaurants and hotels are not of good quality because there is no check and balance. There are hardly 2 or 3 government hospitals in each major city of Pakistan and their condition is awful. The ideal Doctor to Patient Ratio is 1:50, therefore in Pakistan it is a herculean task to get an early doctor’s appointment with the ratio of 1:1000. [1] Due to less number of government hospitals, many of the MBBS and FCPS doctors who cannot afford their personal clinics are unemployed because of less  number of vacancies available. Doctors strikes over pay and poor working conditions are very common in Pakistan. Many doctors want to go abroad due to few job opportunities and lack of healthcare facilities. Patients do not want to wait for so long in the  unhealthy hospital environment for their turn. 14 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r So there is a need of a system that can deal with these issues and problems. Our system will resolve these issues by providing the opportunity to unemployed skillful doctors. Doctors can receive requests from the nearest patients and check patients by going to their home with the complete health box. Doctors will be paid according to their checkup fee. In addition to this, our system will also bring ease on patient’s lives by facilitating them in a way that d octors can check them at their doorstep. Using this application a patient has a comfort by calling a doctor at home instead of going to hospital, facing traffic, environmental and noise pollution in middle and then after reaching the hospital, waiting for his turn in an unhealthy environment of hospital. Moreover, patient can also book clinic appointment if needed.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & Constraints
content: • Only for the patients and doctors of Pakistan. • If G oogle map is not working patient will not be able to find the nearest doctors or clinics. • User must be connected to internet to use this application. • Interface is in English language, no other language is supported. • Our Application is only for Android, not for IOS. • System must be completed within 1 year. • User should know about the basic usage of Android Phones. • Application can be used by the users of all age groups. • Interface is user-friendly so every person can use it. • Application is responsive and response time is minimum. • Application will provide proper feedback to the user 

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: • Doctors can receive the requests from nearest patients by simply show themselves online. • Doctor can either accept or reject the patient request within 1 minute by viewing the problem details and destination. • Doctors looking for job will get benefit from this application because nearest patients will initiate the request for checkup. • Users with low ratings will be blocked by administrator. • Patients discover nearby doctors  and clinics  by simply letting application know their location. • This application will be a great source for patients to search and appoint the desired doctor by just 1 tap. 15 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r

heading: 2.1 Literature Review / Existing System Study
content: To establish the interaction between patient and doctors is not a trivial task. Rather it is cumbersome because often the availability of doctor is not possible, owing to his preoccupations. Many efforts have been made in this regard but desired positive results have not yet been achieved. Some instances of such efforts are given hereunder:

heading: 2.1.1 Doctor on Demand
content: Doctor on Demand is an application in which a patient can select his/her problem, view the profile of doctor and can book an online appointment. Patient can consult a Doctor through online video calling. Doctor will provide suggestions on the basis of question/answer session between patient and doctor. [6]

heading: 2.1.2 Doctronic
content: Doctronic provides another facility to the patients whereby record of lab report s of the patients will be kept online and there shall be no need of taking heavy files of medical record while visiting the doctors. Patient can rate a doctor, book appointment and can view the history of doctor by using this Application. [7]

heading: 2.1.3 Lybrate - Consult a Doctor
content: Lybrate is an Application working only in India. Patient can post his/her questions and get a reply from different doctors by using this Application. Patient can book appointments with doctors, consult doctors online via video chat or text chat, receive health ti ps and can manage his/her medical records in this application. [8]

heading: 2.1.4 Marham Connect
content: Marham provides the services for online appointments of doctors along with credentials of such doctors in Pakistan only. It also provides the schedule of timings, locations, checkup fee and specialties of doctors to the patients so that they could be able to hav e an appointment with the doctor of their desired specialty. [9] 16 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r

heading: 2.1.5 Doctor Diary
content: Doctor Diary is an application in which a doctor can manage the health records of his patients. Doctor can manage all the health records of  his patient’s such as payment record, prescribed medicines, medical reports and clinical notes by using this application. [10]

heading: 2.1.6 Babylon- online doctors
content: Babylon application is providing many healthcare facilities to the patients. Patient can seek an online medical advice and appointments with qualified general physicians. This application provides an easy way to access healthcare and speak to an expert online doctor. [11]

heading: 2.1.7 Our System “Call a Doctor” Uniqueness
content: All of the above mentioned systems are providing online healthcare facilities to patients but our system tackle many other issues with additional features. In all  the above mentioned systems patient can only book an online appointment or can do video chat with doctor. Patient cannot select the searching criteria of his own choice i.e. search within specific miles or search doctor by selecting gender. Above systems cannot provide real -time location tracking of Doctors. Moreover, doctor cannot rate patient according to his behavior in the above systems. In this system, we have tackle all the issues mentioned above. Patient can search a doctor by selecting a searching criteria of his own choice i.e. search doctor within specific miles or search doctor of a specific gender. Patient can appoint a doctor for home visit by viewing the details of such doctor. In addition to this, our system provides a real time location tracking feature in which a patient can track the location of the appointed doctor along with distance in miles and time duration. Patient will receive notification when doctor is arrived to his location. Moreover, patient can search the nearest clinics with t heir details and can make an appointment as well. Doctor can rate patient as well according to his behavior and administrator have all the right to block low rated doctors and patients. All the checkup history of the patient and doctor will be maintained by this system. 17 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r

heading: 4.3 Integration Testing
content: In integration testing we have done testing of our system units after their completion. We have done integration testing of unit which is developed before with the unit developed later. In this way we have done testing on all the units which are defined above. Each of them is tested one by one with the unit developed later.

heading: 4.4 System Testing
content: In system testing we test the system’s functionality only not the inner code. In system testing we did black-box testing to test whole system. We have given input to all the functions as defined above and check their functionality that either they are giving proper or required output or not. 145 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: The problem we faced during the working are • The functionality of manual searching criteria For example, search doctor within certain miles, was one of the most challenging tasks. • Problems were faced in Real time location tracking. • It was very difficult to update User location into the database every 5 seconds. • We faced many challenges in integration of Google Maps API. • Database interaction was also very difficult. • Due to limited resources we had to use free hosting, so we were devoid of many advantages of Paid hosting. From this we learned that better resources would have helped us in easier access to many benefits in development of system. • Finding best suitable API for Location services was one of the major problems. • Faced difficulty in system testing due to budget and time constraints.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: “Call a Doctor” is an android based, user friendly application designed for  Patient as well as Doctor’s benefit. Once after getting registered on this system, a patient can search for the nearest available doctor in their location,  in times of need and can appoint a doctor to visit him at his home. Doctor will be recommended by t he system on the basis of medical condition of the patient. Both patient and the doctor can view their locations on map and can be tracked. Each and everything is calculated within this application including arrival time, checkup time and  fee of the doctor etc. Rating or reviews are included in this system to build trust of patient and doctor on each other. Administrator portal, which is web based, is there for managing or tracking doctors and patients. So basically, this system can bring a great revolutio n in the conventional system of Doctor - patient communication and appointments by performing all the necessary functionalities in efficient and well organized way. This will not only help the patients in critical situations of life or death but also help th e Doctors to earn a living without any fancy setups or long working hours. 146 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r

heading: 5.3 Future Work
content: In future we are planning to make following improvements: • To expand the scope of our application to other cities as well. • To develop this application for IOS in near future. • To add user feedback feature in which user can suggest improvements to us. • To add ambulance services with our system that will be helpful for patients if doctor suggest them to admit to hospital or for further checkups then in this case pati ent avail this service or can call ambulance  at home and track location of it just like doctor. • Link pharmacies with application that it will send medicines prescribed by doctor at location of patient. • Furthermore we have also planned to li nk transport services like UBER to give pick and drop service to doctor. [33] • Give bonus and special offers for both doctor and patients to encourage them to use this application. • We are committed to make incremental improvements in this system. 147 | P a g e                                 C a l l  a  D o c t o r

heading: Abstract
content: This project is based on the idea of an online hotel booking system. It is basically a website which will cater the needs of the user willing to book hotel anywhere in the world. Along with this, the public and travel agencies will be able to register the hotel on this website and get the booking orders. They will also have an online conversation with the customer and vice versa. A  homepage providing a unique advertising prospects for hotel companies and this page will have an advertising video playing in the background of the homepage containing two different panels; one for the registration of hotel and second for booking of the hotel. This will also provide the hotel companies to generate more business by depicting their hotel advertisement at the very first page. Along with this, Google map integration will also facilitate the customers to  locate the hotel easily. The most important thing is that the site is going to provide a very unique concept of giving the registered  hotels their own customized profile page where they will upload the information of their hotels. This profile page will have some extra advertising opportunities as well. Furthermore, it will have a menu bar containing notification and message options whi ch itself is a unique idea in this domain. Notifications will let the company know about the booking and message options will allow the customers and hotel manager to have a live chat. Premium packages will be offered by hotels in a more engaging manner on different festivals all around the globe. -- Table of Contents HBOOK ................................ ................................ ................
