content: Chapter 2 Requirement analysis

heading: 2.1 Literature Review:
content: For the purpose of achieving our goal we have done a thorough literature review. Some of the more important research papers that we have studied for this paper are as below: In a study [6], conducted by the institute organizing this competition, the authors have worked on the same dataset that we are going to work on, they have used convolutional neural networks as the major technique in their paper and have produced good results overall.

heading: 2.1.1 Forestier et. al (2012):
content: This paper [7] focuses on segmenting images of urban areas using knowledge -based systems. This is a different approach as compared to the other work done on this topic (as most of them are based on deep learning). This paper uses a 3-step process in which firstly the image is segmented. This segmentation can be done by any technique and after that we identify the concepts from these segmented portions. This can be done in the form of ontologies as done in this paper, but other methodologies can be used. [8] Lastly, we will need to implement the knowledge base that we have created onto our data. According to the paper their approach yielded better results than any other readily available market software that performed said task.

heading: 2.1.2 Maggiori et. Al (2017):
content: Another reference paper for our project is a paper published for the same competition that we are taking part in [9]. This paper uses a fully convolutional neural network approach towards the labelling of images. They use five randomly sampled patches of size 256*256 and 512*512, performing random flips and rotations, to compute the gradient in every iteration. Their main focus is training their dataset on multiple resolutions and according to them this gives better results with a significantly simpler approach towards FCN.

heading: 2.1.3 Lienou et al. (2010):
content: This paper uses Latent Dirichlet Allocation to perform the labeling of images [10]. LDA is primarily used for text analysis. It’s most common use is identifying topics in a given set of text. LDA can be used in per pixel works as well. LDA is a Three Level Hierarchical model. It categorizes pixels in the same way it would categorize any  topic in a sentence and would then label the pixel accordingly by finding out the

heading: 14 of 57  02 January 2019
content: probability of what the pixel would be. This paper deduces that the results achieved by LDA are at par, if not better than the results achieved by the state of the art techniques.

heading: 2.1.4 Kampffmeyer et. al (2016):
content: This is another paper that uses deep neural networks. It combines two approaches, a fully convolutional neural network and a convolutional neural network for better results  [11]. It uses a patch-based pixel classification approach using CNN combined with a pixel to pixel segmentation approach using FCN to give better results as compared to using both the approaches differently.

heading: 2.1.5 Casey et. al (2012):
content: This paper focuses on creating a scalable system that is able to detect objects in an image accurately [12]. This paper focuses on making the work easier by combining the use of ontologies and neural networks for this purpose. Another goal of this paper that it wants t o make this object detection easier but yet produce the same results as an individual neural network would produce.

heading: 2.1.6 Baltsavias et. al (2002):
content: Using Knowledge bases this paper provides a clear insight on how we can differentiate between different types of terrains in HSR images.

heading: 2.2 Critical Analysis:
content: Almost all of the approaches discussed above have their fair share of cons. The problem with Knowledge bases is that they are really computationally intensive and running them in real time for a mobile application is a near to impossible task. The problem with Latent Dirichlet Allocation is that it was not originally designed for image processing, but it can be used but neither does it produce as efficient results as neural networks, nor does it make implementing as easy as a knowledgebase would.

heading: 4.2 Unit Testing:
content: In this phase of software development, we are to check and test different components of the application to check their individual performances. In the case of our application we have tested all the units as per requirements. We went to on to face a few bugs (that have now been solved) such as: • Some pictures returned invalid longitude latitude due to different precision in floating points. • Opening the bugs go ap would result in our application to crash. • The application kept on asking for permissions even when we had granted it the permissions once.

heading: 4.3 Acceptance Testing:
content: In this phase of developing a software we check whether or not our software is meeting the user or business requirements that it needs to fulfil in order to be ready for deployment. In our case we needed to check that the application can: • Read images • Load co-ordinates • Pass the image as a tensor • Run through the tflite model • Produce a segmented image • Display markers on the map indicating whether or not the are is safe to go

heading: 5.1.1 Problems Faced:
content: The following are the problems that we faced throughout this project: • Started working with knowledgebases. Failed due to insufficient resources • Getting to know what a suitable Convolutional neural network would be for the segmentation problem. • Finding suitable weights for said Convolutional neural network • Estimating the parameters for said Convolutional neural network. • Plugging in the trained neural network file into an android application. • Integrating a drone with our application.

heading: 5.1.2 Lessons Learned:
content: The following are the important lessons that we learned during this project. • We took up a project in an area where not much work has been done before so we learnt to tackle problems one can face when one starts doing work from scratch • Not realizing that the reason not much work is done in this field is the lack of available datasets was a huge setback for us as we kept getting obstacle after obstacle due to it. Hence, proper study of the field we are getting into is important before actually starting with the task at hand.

heading: 5.2  Project Summary:
content: Semantic Labelling of HSR images is a probably one of the most underr ated Computer Science concepts at the moment. From detecting geographical changes to Surveillance HSR imagery can be used in a lot of ways to help humanity. This imagery can also be used to save lives in case of a disaster such as an earthquake. An earthquake is one of the most frequent natural calamities in the world. This frequency might be the reason why it is not considered as deadly as most of the other natural disasters. In the past decade or so, more than 53,000 lives are lost due to earthquakes [1].  The majority of these deaths is due to the fact that rescue officials cannot get in time to actually treat the victims of the disaster. This is either due to the fact that there are roads collapsed and the officials don’t know about it, or due to the fact that they don’t get any connectivity to actually reach the victims. This application of HSR images can be used to help rescue

heading: Abstract
content: We have developed a web application for an Electronic shop (Safi Electronics) that covers all the main strategies which are necessary in business point of view. This web application is used by the administration to handle, online sale, shipment tracking and the stock. It also keeps the records both online and offline. This web application generates the reports about the amount of sales, remaining stock, profit loss ratio etc which can only be seen by admin if logged in from the admin panel. It becomes very easy to maintain records and reports with the help of web application while doing the same thing manually might take few weeks depending upon the available items in the stock. Furthermo re, this web application is used to attract online users to  purchase or getting the information related to different products. Table of Contents

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: We have developed a web application related to Electronic shop. This web application is used by the administrator for management ( Stock, Sales, Purchase) etc and  other users for purchasing or getting the information related to different products. Following Models have implemented in our Project.

heading: Stock Management:
content: This section covers all the stock related information. Information related to each product and their total available quantity is provided in this phase. It also provides the information related to damaged product from the available stock . Whenever a new containe r came the administrator can add the new product quantity with the existing products.

heading: Sales:
content: Online selling is introduced to those people who can't visit the shop or have no extra time. Adding this facility has increased the sale ratio. Online selling is actually the demand of the time because of people busy routines . This help to compete with others by being able to open 24 hours a day , seven days a week.

heading: Shipment:
content: Shipment details and tracking of goods is also the part of our project.

heading: Report:
content: Various reports are generated at the end of the year to know how much profit or loss the company had in the year before. It makes it very easy to do with the help of web application while doing the same thing manually might take few weeks depending upon the available items in the stock.

heading: 1.2 Goals and Objectives
content: Our Primary goal was to convert the semi computerized system of an electronic shop into an online web application for the easiness of the owner, also for the customers. Both the semi computerized system and online appl ication are working concurrently. Our Primary objectives are to help the owner in managing the stocks, point of sales and report. Apart from this, it also helps the customers to purchase a product by placing his/her order on company's website.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: Safi electronics shop is a semi computerized shop where the record is kept on one single computer. In the current time, there is vast improvement in technology and the scope of technology has increased so much that almost every shop and company has changed its system to complete computerized system. Almost every electronic shop has its online business and online business is increasing day by day which made us choose this project as our final year project to convert shop into the online shop while both computerized and semi computerized system are working along so that our shop can compete with online market and it can get more and more benefits with time.

heading: 1.4 Scope of the Project
content: About the scope of the project is that this project is for a small-scale business company   basically for the company’s owner, its users and customers. We got the motivation to do this project when we got the information from the company that they want to change their semi computerized system into an online web application so we thought it is a great opportunity for us to exploit our skills and utilize them in our final year project.

heading: 2.1 Literature review
content: There is some work done related to our project previously but our main focus is that this application is customized for only this company while other projects are also customizable for random companies simultaneously which makes this project unique in its own scope. Few existing web applications related to our project are mentioned below: 1- Home shopping  is one of the leading  E-Commerce website in Pakistan . It provides online shopping facility and few models (Accounts, Stock etc.) are used and managed with the help of this web application. Reference link [2] There are many more related available E-commerce web application and each of them differ with each other according to the need of each company but most of them provide th e same online shopping facility. Few more examples of available related web applications are Kaymu[3] , Yayvo[4] , daraz[5] etc. Homeshopping http://homeshopping.pk Shophive http://www.shophive.com Daraz http://www.daraz.pk Kaymu http://www.kaymu.pk

heading: 2.7 Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
content: The software development life cycle that we have chosen is the Increment model.

heading: Reference Link:
content: “http://3.bp.blogspot.com/- rIWLNPHVNo8/T7ZG2gRxiZI/AAAAAAAAAFQ/rphbdYO93xc/s1600/Capture.PNG”

heading: Reason:
content: We choose this Incremental model because our project is a small-scale project and does require iterations as all the requirements are well understood, it will provide discipline during every phase, also testing will be easy we believe this model will make it easier during the maintenance of website by using feedback once its developed.

heading: 2.7.1 Analysis
content: The first step of every phase is analysis which includes the analysis of the current part of the project which we are going to implement. It deals with the requirements and needs of the project at that stage and their analysis for further design.

heading: 2.7.2 Design
content: At any phase of the model the design stage is the one where the planning is made to proceed with the project. Designing includes all type of functional requirements in documented and designed form or paper work as per requirement.

heading: 2.7.3 Code
content: After analysis and design the development stage has started in which we code that specific part of our project which is specified for that phase only.

heading: 2.7.4 Test
content: The test stage is very important as on the basis of testing and user feedback the current phase could be completed and we get the product of that stage. Then we proceed with our next phase by adding more functionalities. In this way on every phase we get the working product with some functionalities and ke ep on repeating the phases until we get the whole working project with full and final functionalities. In doing so the phases could be repeated for N number of times.

heading: Abstract
content: To save the time and manage the customers there is a great need of appointment systems. An appointment system/token system provides the facility to all of those businesses, shops and serv ice providers (doctors, service stations, barbers etc.) that require a token for their customers to avail the service. To get an appointment system, we have to contact software houses, give them a lot of detail of business and have to do a lot of thing. Af ter doing a lot of things, we get a specific application for our specific business. To overcome these issues, we are introducing an online platform for every service provider in the world to get a token system for their clients easily. Our project

heading: (Unive
content: rsal Token System) is an online platform for service providers (doctors, service stations, NADRA etc.) to register their service and get a token system for their clients. Following are the three project applications: • A web application for service provide rs to register their service online and get token system for their clients. • An android app for service providers to manage their clients and update their service status timely (through this app there is no need to use a computer and hire a specific compute r operator). • An android app for general public to search their required service, select their desired service provider and get appointment token with approximated time to visit the office. We know, to live a happy and healthy life, we need different types of services on daily basis. Meet a doctor, visit a bank, go to barber, register your data at somewhere, go for car wash and much more. At all of these places, we see long queues of people who are waiting for their turn and obviously wasting a lot of time. Due to these ultra - big crowds, many problems occur like fight, robbery, infection, violation of rules, etc. It's also difficult for service providers to manage their customers. Table of Contents

heading: Introduction
content: Problems that we are currently facing: As we know, we have to waste a lot of time at service stations (car washing, barber shop, doctor etc.). We waste too much time and still we are not confirmed that either we’ll get our turn or not. Mostly we see at ca r wash stations, that there is a long queue and all of them are waiting for their turn. Obviously, it’s a wastage of time for those who are in a long queue and this long queue of cars also blocking the traffic on road. Same thing happens at doctor’s clinic s and all of the places where some kind of service will be provided in the form of a queue (one by one). We know about many online ticket systems and token generators. That systems are required to be installed on a particular computer or machine and to be operated by a specific trained person to get the required result. Then those systems are limited to single f unctionality , either that can be used for car service station or for a doctor. Then we have to collect all the required data (information to perfor m the system task) from a specific doctor or service station and give them an install able software for a PC to use and get facility. So, the system is restricted to that specific service provider. And if others want this system, each of them have to get a computer and install the software on it. How will we overcome above issues? As described above, UTS will facilitate the service providers to register their service online and use a token system to manage their customers without having computers and comput er operators at their offices. Following are the main applications that are used to build up a tool:

heading: Official Website:
content: the service providers simply go to our website (utsystem s.org ) and register the service by filling out the required information form. Aft er registration, the information of that service provider will be available in our database. Client’s Android App: customer search for a service. For example, a patient search for a doctor through our android application, the application will show the lis t of nearest doctor’s clinics. Patient simply select the doctor and request to generate a token. In the result, a slip will be given to patient with ID number and approximate service time. The same process will be used for car service stations, educational offices, tickets for buses and trains, tokens for bank meetings etc. Service Provider’s Android App: the service providers use android app to manage their clients and update their service status timely (through this app there is no need to use a computer and hire a specific computer operator). Anyone who provide services to people, will register the service at our platform and inform target people to get token from android app before visit.

heading: Objectives
content: To save the time and manage the customers there is a great need of appointment systems. An appointment system/token system provides the facility to all of those businesses, shops and service providers (doctors, service stations, barbers etc.) that require a token for their customers to avail the service. To get an appointment system, we have to contact software houses, give them a lot of detail of business and have to do a lot of thing s . After doing a lot of things, we get a specific application for our specific business. To overcome these issues, we are intr oducing an online platform for every service provider in the world to get a token system for their clients easily. Following are the objectives of the project:  Develop a time saving tool  Avoid queuing system and problems occur due to this 

content:  Allow all the service providers from any corner of the world to get a token system for their clients .  Help service providers to get more clients  Chase international market 

heading: Project Scope
content: It’s a novel idea to generate tokens for service providers. Nothing like t his implemented yet and we can see its use by analyzing rush on daily basis at doctor’s clinics, educational offices, service stations, etc. It’s easy to promote at international level, because there’s no need to meet clients, install physical systems, ins ert and manage records manually. Service providers will simply go to our website, register their service and avail the facility of using tokens for their customers. One more big advantage, their regular or irregular customers can easily search their servic e, their location just by using an android application. Almost everyone uses android phone, and prefer to search their required service to save their important time and cost. heading: Use Case Summary:
content: The system shall enable admin to login to admin account by providing valid username and password.

heading: Conditions:

heading: Events
content: 1. Admin will navigate to admin login page which is accessible by limited IP addresses. 2. Admin will enter username and password, then press “Login” button to continue the process. 3. heading: 3A
content: - If the entered login details are not valid, admin will be notified about failure and asked to try again.

content: System shall allow admin to add or remove another admin from the system. Every new admin will have a unique login details.

heading: Conditions:
content: 1. Admin is logged into account and a valid login session is found. 2. Admin has the details of new admin to create an account. Flow of Events

heading: Events
content: 1. Admin will login to his admin account to add new admin. 2. Admin will navigate to “Add New Admin” tab to open the registration form. 3. Entered details will be stored in system database and a success notification will be generated in response to account creation.

content: - If admin press cancel button, the registration form will be closed and registration will be cancelled .

heading: 5A
content: - If login session has been expired, the data will not be stored in database and account registration will be cancelled .

Software development life cycle model

heading: Iterative Model
content: : The iterative model is a particular implementation of a software development life cycle (SDLC) that focuses on an initial, simplified implementati on, which then progressively gains more complexity and a broader feature set until the final system is complete. When discussing the iterative method, the concept of incremental development will also often be used liberally and interchangeably, which descr ibes the incremental alterations made during the design and implementation of each new iteration. [5]

heading: Iterative Model
content: The purpose of working iteratively is to allow more flexibility for changes. When requirements and design of a major application are done in the traditional method (sometimes referred to as BDUF or Big Design Up Front), there can be unforeseen problems that don’t surface until development begins. By working iteratively, the project team goes through a c ycle where they evaluate with each iteration, and determine what changes are needed to produce a satisfactory end product. [6]

heading: Justification:
content: In initial stage of the project, we gathered requirements according to the scope and functionality of the project. But during designing and development stages, there were lots of requirements creep and it was getting difficult to provide a suitable solutio n by using gathered requirements. Then we decided to go back at requirements elicitation stage, we updated the requirements, removed the conflicts and keep this process in cyclic way until we didn’t get a suitable solution.

heading: Integration Testing
content: To make the system proper functional, we will integrate all the developed modules and design three user end applications. While integrating all modules with each other, we will apply integration testing technique to ensure the quality and meet the goals of the project. Following are the appli cations that will be formed after integration:  Official website (utsystems.org) used for service registrations, admin management and client registration.  Service provider’s android app useable by service providers to manage their clients and handle token requests from them.  Client’s android app useable by clients to find out their desired service providers and avail required service.

heading: System Testing
content: After integration of modules, we will join all the developed apps and make them functional as a complete syst em. To test the system functionality and performance, we will apply system testing technique and test the following major flow of actions:

heading: Acceptance Testing
content: Acceptance testing will be performed to understand the acceptance level of the project by stakeh olders. The system will be deployed to test users, and they will be guided to understand and use the functionality. Their response will be recorded to find out the defects at acceptance level of the project. Moreover, we will also do ‘thinking aloud test ‘ to check that our system is efficient or not. For this purpose, we will select a team of test users who will give us suggestions to improve our system and identify problems.

Problems faced and lessons learned Following is the list of problems that we faced during the development of project. Assign a token number to client is a major part of the project, it was really a big issue to provide an efficient way for generating tokens. We researched on queue management technique and find out an awesome way to assign the token numbers and manage the list of clients in queue. Second problem was to update the client’s queue, because updating queue for one client, changes the remaining timing for all next clients. To solve this problem, we introduced a current token number and an assigned token number technique in our project. Another problem that we faced during our project was that we thought that documentation was easy part and we would develop it as early as po ssible. But it also took a long time almost two weeks. And it was too boring work for us. So, we had learned a lesson that we should start our work as soon as possible and finished in a given time frame. Another problem that we faced during the overall pro ject was the gathering of requirements. Once we gather requirements but we were not stick to those requirements. Our requirements change with the passage of time, so it also had bad impact on project. So, after a great struggle, we succeeded to stop changi ng requirements.

Maintain error logs During our development phase we came across many errors again and again. To overcome these errors, we simply had to search on internet to found the solution of these errors. But the problem that we faced during develop ment that once we solved the problem we forgot its solution when the similar problem again came. For solving this problem, we started to maintain the log of all errors that we faced in development. So, whenever error came, we simply check it into our log f ile for solution and then refer to internet.

No Proper naming conventions While we are developing our application, as we know that it is an application with a great scope. So, there are multiple of deliverables that are to be prepared and modified over the passage of time. The content of the deliverables may change with time, so we need to maintain and handle all the versions of documents. So, we need to use proper naming convention of documents so that they not mix with each other. Because, it is a great problem that we have ever experienced in our project.

Project summary To save the time and manage the customers there is a great need of appointment systems. An appointment system/token system provides the facility to all of those businesses, shops and service providers (doctors, service stations, barbers etc.) that require a token for their customers to avail the service. To get an appointment system, we have to contact software houses, give them a lot of detail of business and have to do a lot of thing . After doing a lot of things, we get a specific application for our specific business. To overcome these issues, we are introducing an online platform for every service provider in the world to get a token system for their clients easily. Our project (Uni versal Token System) is an online platform for service providers (doctors, service stations, NADRA etc.) to register their service and get a token system for their clients. Following are the three project applications: • A web application for service provid ers to register their service online and get token system for their clients. • An android app for service providers to manage their clients and update their service status timely (through this app there is no need to use a computer and hire a specific comput er operator). • An android app for general public to search their required service, select their desired service provider and get appointment token with approximated time to visit the office.

Future work In future work, we plan on automation of our system. W e also plan to increase performance, security of our system. We plan to make it better for our clients and service providers. For this we will do further improvements in interface. Moreover, we plan to add some extra functionalities in our system like buse s, trains etc. We have also plan to add some offices that request for token. We also plan to add hotels, flights reservation system in our system.

content: E-commerce is gaining popularity among the people of modern world. Rather than using old-fashioned retailed shopping process, it is much easier to stay at home and do your favourite shopping while you are using your smart phone. Today people are busier in their work, home and other activities. They have lesser time lesser strength and lesser money. They want to save their time and money and live a relaxed and less exhausted life. We want this to be more exciting and easier for people of the world by provide them a system, which will fulfil their needs of shopping with more fun and excitement. In this project, we provide a completely different and a new way of shopping. User would able to do online shopping by sitting at home with a new touch experience of 3-D clone of itself by using Virtual Reality (VR) technology. Virtual Reality is a latest and cutting-edge type of technology, which has passed the lines to jump into various industries. Simulating the actual appearance in the real and imaginary world is o ne of the main features of Virtual Reality. Using this technology, we will provide a realistic shopping mall effect through your smart phone and people can enjoy shopping from different malls while sitting in their room  Instead of going to actual shopping malls and waste their time in searching of different products.

heading: 1.1 Why VR Mall
content: In the era of digital world, people are looking towards effective and impressive ways to minimize the time factor in every field of their life. When people visit shopping malls with many options of shopping brands and visit to each one will definit ely become a troublesome task. Now days, E -Shopping is gaining popularity among the people. In respect of the following popularity, we propose a system where an individual can pay a visit to a shopping mall using VR and enjoys the same experience like a re al world shopping mall. Beside this, a user can also buy a product from the outlets we provide in our shopping mall. In addition, an official website of desired outlet will be provided when a user wants to buy any product from it. Few years back E-Shopping was not considered to be safe and effective way of shopping due to an unsafety of the products quality as well as scam issues. However, according to the survey report of year 2016, there exist 1.5 billion digital buyers worldwide. [1] About 45.4% of 3.4 b illion users of internet worldwide [2] is enough to represent the massive interest of consumers towards E-Shopping. And there is absolute certainty in increment of above given stats in upcoming years. Though there exist many ways to shop while sitting at h ome but our proposed system provides A unique and innovative way for people to experience real time shopping sensation by using VR. VR is basically the computer technology that creates simulated environments. VR creates a real time scene that makes user feel as if he is the part of that environment. [3] When a user enters to shop in the mall wearing VR, he can feel a real environment in his surroundings. He can walk as well randomly where ever he wants to.  If he wants to look towards a specific outlet in a mall, player can take trigger him directly to that outlet from where he is standing. If a user is willing to buy a product from any outlet, he just has to enter that shop and system will open the official online store of that outlet for him.

content: The main objective of this project is to minimize the time and efforts that people waste by visiting shopping malls and also in the selection and purchasing of something. This is a real hectic and exhausting work too. Keeping this issue in mind, our project will provide a platform where people can visit any shopping mall and can make a purchase while sitting in their homes with no effort and time

content: Online shopping has become the basic shopping need of the people now a day. This VR mall is providing an online shopping feature with some great virtual reality experiences for the first time.

As mobile phones, have emerged as one of the necessities of life. The number of mobile phone users in Pakistan has crossed 139.20 million, said by Pakistan telecommunication authority (PTA). The total population of Pakistan is estimated to as 186 million in 2014. It makes Pakistan to stand at 5th place in Asia in mobile phone users. According to these statistics about 75% of populatio n possesses mobile phone. These statics from a developing country like Pakistan are enough to prove that mobile phone have become necessity in our daily life these days. The world is acknowledging and realizing the construct of virtual reality, however the applying of the technology is undiscovered by most of the individuals and that they also are unaware of this revolutionary issue. Imagine a world wherever you'll be able to visit, navigate outlets or searching on-line whereas sitting in your room. All this is often currently doable and possible with virtual reality. VR is that the magic born from the womb of technology that has tantalizing potentialities and guarantees for a future bright and good. Our project aims to facilitate human by reducing the time and efforts that people waste by visiting searching malls and additionally within the choice and buying of one thing. This is often a true feverish and exhausting work too. Keeping this issue in mind, our project can give a platform wherever people will vi sit any store and might create a procurement whereas sitting in their homes with no effort and time. Furthermore, when people actually visit a shopping mall, finding a desired outlet that is essentially one among the foremost common issue there. We provide a complete 3D mall model with virtual reality experience so that any individual can visit the desired store without any inconvenience.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions
content: The main objective of our project is to design a VR based 3D mall structure through which people can visit any shopping mall and can go to any stores within the mall for shopping. All this will be done just by sitting in their homes. People don’t have to go to any shopping mall by themselves. We will provide a realistic mall environment in their hands thr ough Virtua l Reality. This will also reduce the problem that people have to face in  searching the desired store. Through this technology we can provide a less time affective, less cost affective and less effort affective system for shopping to the humans of all over the world.

heading: 2.6.1  Agile Model
content: The software development process model that we plan on using for the development of this system is the agile model. The agile model is a combination of iterative and incremental process models. In the agile model a working product is delivered after each iteration; this is the basic reason behind choosing this model. It is also best suited because it will be relatively quick and as we have time constraints to finish this project we would like to have working versions available. By using this model, we would be developing our system in stages with every working version having more features than the previous one. This would largely decrease the complexity of the project and after each iteration we would be able to get feedback from users on any possible shortcomings which we would then be able to improve in the next iteration. By doing this the product that we would get at our final iteration would be one that would have all the features initially planned for and any variations that would arise when getting feedback from the users. Due to the fact that we are going to be working iteratively, we would have a sub system or pro gram after each iteration. So, we would not be completely blank for our efforts.

heading: 2.6.2  Why choosing Agile:
content:  We can afford any iteration at any phase and fully functional software cannot be delivered at once.  A change/update can be handled and fixed very quickly  We can test and experiment our project because it costs low.  System deployment can done quicker

heading: 2.7.1 Requirements gathering Phase
content: An agile model begins with requirements analysis and the requirements of the system are defined in detail. All information is gathered from the user before entering to the development phase.

heading: 2.7.2 Quick Design Phase
content: When requirements are known, a quick design for the system is created. It is not a detailed design and includes only the important aspects of the system, which gives an idea of the system to the user. A quick design helps in developing the system.

heading: 2.7.3 User Evaluation Phase
content: In this phase strength and weakness of the system is identified. Comments and suggestions from the user is forwarding to developer.

heading: 2.7.4 Refining Prototype Phase
content: Refining phase is being deployed when there are additional features added to the system. More features are added when there is extent of user suggestions.

heading: 2.7.5 Design
content: In the design phase the all information is collected and the real design of the system is then implemented. All functionalities that are previously defined must be implemented here.

heading: 2.7.6 Implementation
content: Application development phase beg ins with designing the user Interface (UI) and then coding it in minimum time. The prototypes of the application are subject to client approval on a regular basis. Server component must be involved, in parallel engage resources to improve development efficiency.

heading: 2.7.7 Testing
content: Throughout the whole development phase, the project team follows testing process to check system functionality. They make sure that the working of every function is correct according to the pre-defined functions  list mentioned  before startin g the development phase.

heading: 2.7.8 Maintenance
content: The most important phase where developers ensure that system runs correctly without any errors. To avoid errors and bugs, the most useful strategy is to launch an update to overcome and fix all possible bugs and improve the weak parts of system. This can be done in maintenance phase.

heading: 4.2.5 Unit test:
content: Unit testing is a product development process in which the smallest testable parts of an application, called units, are separately and autonomously tried for legitimate operation. Each module to be tested to confirm that there are no bugs and performance lags. Each module that we will build, will pass through number of tests to ensure that we end up with a quality product. The modules to be tested are o Attachment of VR. o Movement in the mall must be fluent. o Shopping system works correctly.

heading: 4.2.6 Integration Test
content: Integration testing is the stage in software testing in which singular programming modules are consolidated and tried as a group. It happens after unit testing and before Acceptance testing. During the integration test plan, we plan on testing the complete functionalities that are to be performed. The modules to be tested are o Animation works properly. o Trigger to any shop works correctly. o Back to view mode of Mall after shopping.

heading: 4.2.7 System Testing
content: During the system testing we plan to check the proper working of functionalities provided by the system. For the system test, we plan to make potential users the testers. We also plan on making the usability evaluation to check the user friendliness of the interface. We plan to perform ‘thinking aloud’ test in this context so we may get a proper feedback from the actual users about the improvements that may become a part of application in the future updates.

heading: 4.2.8 Acceptance Test
content: Our team plans to deploy the sy stem after our mobile application is formally accepted by the people who will use it and in the environment where it is to be used. We will ensure the proper support to the people that will be performing the acceptance test.

heading: Abstract
content: Nowadays wedding expenses are at their peak. At such occasions, people look forward to the best quality products and services available at affordable price, and also within their reaches like for trending dresses and accessories. A perfect wedding needs a perfect dress and jewelry, a perfect venue, perfect food, decent ride and a professional photographer to capture every moment of their special day. However, it will be days before you could find any of these services at a decent price from a trustable provider. It seems impossible to ensure that you will find the best quality of these services at right time. E-Lends is a web-based service that is intended to provide a common ground for vendors and Users, where they can post up their stock, whereas on the other side customers looking for affordable desired accessories and clothing can get them on lease with a single tap. This project aims to develop a complete website along with an android application that will serve as a reliable platform offering convenience to search for dresses, accessories, and services for wedding and other daily life-related goods where they can lend rather than buy them. The system will use expert system techniques for showing the best results according to the search query. It will incorporate a store (database) of expert knowledge with couplings and linkages designed to facilitate its retrieval in response to specific queries. Expert knowledge will help the system to show appropriate suggestions to Users. By this way, the customers will save their time and money instead of actually go for shopping themselves and still fail to find what they want within their budget. Following the methods of commerce will benefit the vendors too, as their trade will also increase, once the customers get to know about the website. Table of Contents

heading: 1.1 Overview
content: With the availability of mobile devices and smartphones, business organizations can manage the cost and streamline their inward procedures along with making strides, keeping up and extending customer services. Due to the simplicity in device portability and availability of the internet, mobile technologies have become an important mean of marketing services and attracting customers, in a cost-effective and efficient way. This revolutionary trend of e- commerce has evolved the methods of trading among common people as well [1]. Gone are the days of traditional commerce that take place in conventional mode i.e. when a customer has to go to market, look at the number of products, choose the best stuff that fulfills their needs, and purchasing them by paying some amount of money. But with the rapid growth of internet later in the 1990s, the scenario has changed in e -commerce, and people can buy goods, transfer money, or pay bills at home just by a single click. Still many of the people prefer traditional commerce due to their dogma that is it’s not a safe way, however, this is just a myth. Developing countries have systems that facilitate manual transitions like for the lease of clothing, accessories, other goods, and services, for which people have to go to the market and people use social network i.e. Whatsapp and Facebook groups for this purpose but this way includes an embarrassing and texting factor that is riskier. Bridals, BestStylo and BeautyTipsMart are websites of Pakistan where people can buy dresses for brides. Dresses are suggested by different designers which may be quite expensive and out of reach of most. Weddings often cost more than million rupees and there are a bourgeois class, lower-middle-class families and to compensate for this huge amount these families often have to take upon loans. In that situation, if they have to buy a bridal dress whose cost ranges between 90 thousand to two lakh rupees, for a normal family it will be a huge burden. In subcontinent wedding, for almost everybody, it is a very special and onetime event in life and everyone wants to wear a hefty and elegant dress at this event. But not everyone can afford costly dresses. 38% percent of Pakistan’s total population belongs to middle-class families. Middle-class families seek wedding dresses on rent and through advertisements in newspapers, especially Urdu and regional dailies, and flyers and posters, it seems as if the business of renting out clothes for weddings is on the rise. But there is no such platform to support this.  No doubt that wedding- related services like catering, transport, photographers , and venues available but with the manual process that can waste the time of people to visit multiple places to compare and select the best one. The main objective of this project is to devise a platform where different Users can share their clothes and accessories to make money, on the other side the Users can get those clothes and accessories at economical rates . Users will also be allowed to post their services  like movie makers, photographers, transport, hall booking and decorators that make other Users get their services for their special events. By getting the current location of a User the system will show nearby clothes, accessories , and services posted by Users. The system will be developed by using the Machine Learning Algorithms to identify the interest of the User. It will be using search keywords and most viewed ads of the User which will help our system to show the best results to the User according to the User’s nature of interest. An android application and website will be developed with a User-friendly interface that will offer flexibility and convenience to

content: NFR02-01 The product shall be based on the web and has to be run from a web server. NFR02-02 The performance shall depend upon hardware components of the client/customer. NFR02-03 The average time of starting page of the system must be less than 2 seconds. NFR02-04 Average load time of the starting page of the system must be less than 10 seconds. NFR02-05 Average processing time taken by the system to complete a transaction/request should be less than 20 seconds. NFR02-06 System Mean Time to Failure should not be more than 60seconds within 24 hours of use. NFR02-07 Average system response time should not be greater than 5 seconds. NFR02-08 1000 customers should be able to simultaneously access the system and update the database. Table 37: NFR#02 Performance

heading: 2.3.2.3 Security
content: NFR03-01 The system must provide access to admin to make changes. NFR03-02 The system must provide access to the authorized User only that enter through the login module. NFR03-03 The system must not provide access to ANY customers EXCEPT the designated admin to update the database. NFR03-04 The system shall automatically log out all customers after a period of inactivity. NFR03-05 The system shall confirm all transactions with the customer’s web browser. NFR03-06 The system shall not leave any cookies on the customer’s computer containing the User’s password. NFR03-07 The system shall not leave any cookies on the customer’s computer containing any of the User’s confidential information.

heading: 2.6 Software Development Life Cycle Model:
content: For design, we are going to use a combination of waterfall model and Rapid Prototyping.

heading: Why Use Waterfall Model:
content: Waterfall model used when the requirements are well known, product definition is stable and technology is understood. Why use Rapid Prototyping Model? Rapid Prototyping Model is used where customers are non -technical and usually don’t know what they want and what they can have. Due to unclear requirements of what will be easy for the Users, and moderate chances of requirement changes, we will use prototyping model to provide Users with prototypes and they will update our prototypes which will help us in clearing our requirements according to those feedbacks provided by the Users, till all requirements are captured and are cleared. Then we will use the waterfall model to implement those requirements. Because the waterfall model needs clear requirements, the clear requirements will be taken to start the waterfall phases. In the waterfall model, we get a complete document at the end of a phase to verify that all the requirements are implemented according to requirement plan Figure 2: SDLC Model

heading: 3.1 Work Breakdown Structure:
content: WBS is a hierarchical and incremental decomposition of the project into phases, deliverables , and work packages. It is a tree structure, which shows a subdivision of effort required to achieve an objective; for example a program, project, and contract.[4] In a project or contract, the WBS is developed by starting with the end objective and successively subdividing it into manageable components in terms of size, duration, and responsibility (e.g., systems, subsystems, components, tasks, subtasks, and work packages) which include all steps necessary to achieve the objective. Below is the general convention for how tasks are decomposed:  Level 1 – Designated by 1.0.  This level is the top level of the WBS.  All other levels are subordinate to this level.  Level 2 – Designated by 1.X (e.g., 1.1, 1.2).  This level is the summary level.  Level 3 – Designated by 1.X.X (e.g., 1.1.1, 1.1.2).  This third level comprises the subcomponents to each level 2 summary element.   This effort continues down until progressively subordinate levels are assigned for all work required for the entire project.

heading: 3.6.1 MVC Architecture
content: The software architecture which will be used in this project is MVC (Model View Controller).

heading: Figure 73: System Architecture Diagram
content: E-Lends is a complex and huge system which is based on web -application and android application. This app enables Users to book services and browse different ads. Our project is based on MVC architecture with the ability to take a large number of data. The model view controller (MVC) architecture is used to implement interfaces. MVC is a famous choice for web apps.it separates the logic into three parts i.e. model, view and controller. The model will inform the view to update its display according to data as it contains the data that the app should use. In our project, the model will specify what data the interfaces should contain that doctors interface, nurse’s interface and patient’s interface and it  will inform the view to update display according to the changes that have occurred. The controller will handle all the logic that updates view and model in reply to input from the Users. Our project could have input buttons and forms to add delete and edi t information from their profiles, in prescriptions etc. Our project data model will be contained in the database (SQL Server) our applications controlling code will be written in javascript and interfaces will be written using CSS/HTML. This is similar to MVC. This separation of responsibilities in MVC architecture will help to make our project more flexible, secure and will increase performance.

heading: 3.6.2 Modules
content: The main modules of project include P ost Ad, Search Ads, Service Provider and Search

heading: 3.6.3 Post Ad
content: The Post Ad module provides the facility to Users to post their items which will be shown to other users. People will book their items according to their needs and budget. It will be easy to people to rent out their unused stuff like clothes, shoes and jewellery. Post Ad form will ask user the necessary details about the product, such as size, colour and rent per day.  On the other end people can filter ads based on rent and category.

heading: 3.6.4 Search Ad
content: The search Ad module provides the facility to Users to search the ads of products on the basis of their events and search key word. Uses can either select an event from given list of event or can enter the key word, product name etc. that he/she wants to search. The system will display all the products related to that. Other than that users can apply the filter modules to filter the products on the base of location, query, rent or color.

heading: 3.6.5 Service Provider
content: The service provider portal  provides the facility to registered service provider to post their services, the service provider will provide the full information of service like location, charges and contact information . It will also facilitate  the service provider by showing the booking request for services and booking history. This module will allow the service provider to accept or reject the service request.

heading: 3.6.6 Search Service
content: The search service module provides facility to Users to search the service. The user can search the services on the basis  of give service category, location, and price or by providing their radius. This module will facilitate the users to search the service of his/her need and according to their given location.

heading: 6.2 Project summary
content: Nowadays people spend a lot of money on their special events, which eventually  cause the wastage of money and resources. Many people won't do their events in an affordable range and try to get the ir things on lease instead of buying which will  eventually save the money and cause the resource utilization. There are a lot of markets in Pakistan that provide expensive dresses, jewelry and many other accessories on lease, and also service providers that provide their products and service on rent like catering, transport, halls and event organizer accessories, people who want to utilize these services are not quite familiar with these shops and markets. By sign up on E -Lends the user will get a use portal to save their items and post their ads for lease, they will get the booking requests and orders when a customer will book a product, on the other hand by sign up as service provider will get a service provider portal to post their services and see booking request, active orders. Customers can get a c hat feature to do chat related to product and service, the customer can also use customer support to get the answer of their quires from admin. Admin enables the admin to manage the user rules, view bookings, and orders history and will generate the report  to see the progress.  E-Lends will be a contribution for renting sector and service providers, where the user can post their products for sharing on lease on the other side service providers can post their service on site, where the customers can booking these products and service on a single site to make their event more special and economical. This platform will allow them to manage their booking requests.  E- Lends will also be the huge contribution toward the stability of Pakistan economy and home industry. This document contains diagrams and requirements in details which will later reflect our project. Every step was a challenging one than the previous but it cleared our ambiguities. We started creating designs of different components after our analysis was done. As there is no such platform in Pakistan  where people can post the product and services  on the lease. Our system will be a contribution towards the online lending system in the developing country like Pakistan. The system will provide the comfort zone to the Users for getting all the product and services according to their events and range, on a single platform.

heading: Abstract
content: CIIT-LAMS is a combination of e -leave and e -attendance management systems specifically designed for CIIT Lahore campus. Every organization has different kinds of leaves and each with a different leave policy so does CIIT Lahore, in order to handle the automatic processing of leaves applications we have provided an online workflow based system in which processes are designed using Business Process Modelling Notation (BPMN). CIIT-LAMS aims to provide HR department an easy, fast, and efficient way of carrying out activities related to employee attendance and leave management by completely eliminating paper work, as all the  applications and documents are created and processed online, m oreover digital signatures are used. Users are  provided with personal dashboards where they can apply for , and view status of their ap plications, similarly dashboards are provided to management, and higher authorities are also provided with management portals where they can manage and be aware of employee activities. Hence making it a lot easier for the HR department to process and manag e applications anywhere, at any time. An android application with basic e-leave features and touch id and  facial recognition featur e to record attendance is created to provide ease to employees. heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: Leave Management is mostly done manually in organizations in Pakistan, but to regulate employees and to maintain balance in the organization, leaves and attendance need to be managed efficiently, which is not possible in the manual system, as it involves lot of paper work and policies and becomes hectic at some point. The proposed system i.e. CIIT -LAMS aims to overcome all the issues in the previous system, providing a better, faster, and more efficient system. CIIT-LAMS integrates the leave management system with the attendance system, saving all the time wasted retrieving data regarding an employee’s application. It provides the employees with personal dashboards where they can view their data as well as submit applications online within a few button clicks at anytime from anywhere, moreover the new system is a work flow based system, hence the employees can view/track the status of their applications on their dashboards. It provides the HR manager with a personal dashboard as well, where he/she can view the applications as well as approve/disapprove them instantaneously as all the information required for the decision making is readily available and is accessed instantaneously, furthermore as it’s an online system, the manager can access applications even when travelling for work purposes. The paper work is completely eliminated and digital signatures of employees and manager are used for authentication. Employees shall be notified instantaneously about the approval/disapproval of application through e -mail or a notification on the system. An android application with touch id or facial recognition feature that uses location and Wi -Fi or cellular network to record employee attendance will also be created. The Android applications main purpose is to allow the employees to mark attendance using their android phones, the logic behind this feature is such that, we will bound the campus area using geo- coordinates, and the employees shall be able to mark attendance when located in this geo-bounded area and their identity is verified using touch id, or facial recognition feature. Hence conforming both the presence and identity of employee, eliminating chances of proxies. It is a work flow based system hence the leave management task is completely automated and handled efficiently as now employee just has to submit the application and authorities have to take decision on it, and the processing between and after that is handled by the system itself based on the business process models of the organization, and leave balance and attendance is monitored and automatically updated based on different scenarios as well as applications can be tracked, moreover it has its own advantages like the workload on the HR manager can be determined and employees can’t make any false claims regarding applications. CIIT-LAMS provides an efficient solution to manage, monitor and evaluate resulting in an effective leave and attendance management system.

heading: 1.3 Problem Statement
content: The HR department currently uses two ways to manage, employees leave applications manual for lower grade employees and an online system for higher grade employees which is not completely automated and a lot of work still needs to be done in excel files, and a separate autom ated attendance system with biometric verification is used to manage employee attendance. The leave management system has a lot of issues, as it is not integrated with the attendance and payroll system, so each time an application arrives, approval can’t be made instantly as it becomes a time consuming process to retrieve employee attendance and leave history in order to approve/disapprove the application and then deduct the pay if required by updating or altering the payroll system, as well as attendance and leave management system need to be updated separately. Employees need to write and submit leave applications to head of their department during fixed hours as there is no flexibility, moreover employees are unaware of the status of the application after submission. Employees are also unaware of their leave balance and sometimes might end up doing more leaves than availed. HR manager needs to be able to access the applications and data in order to approve them, which is not possible if he/she is travelling for work purposes. It gets difficult to keep track of employee leave balance as data is maintained in excel sheets and employee status needs to be monitored. A lot of paper is wasted and HR department employees are stuck in this mess when they could be doing other tasks. Overall system efficiency is poor, slo w processing of applications, difficult to keep track of things, resulting in an increased workload on the HR department and an ineffective system.

heading: 1.4 Assumptions & Constraint
content:  Wi-Fi signals or internet connection must be good for better performance of the system.  Android application will be used to mark attendance.  Android device needs to have a front camera and a finger print sensor.  System will be developed such that it is interactive and easy to use.  All transactions will be maintained through logs.  Time constraint to complete project within 8 months.

heading: 1.5 Project Scope
content: The motivating factors for this project are that it is a workflow based system that supports real time monitoring and tracking and uses BPMN (Business Process Model Notation) for process modeling, which is a first experience for us, as we want to explore these types of systems. It is a real client based project which gives us the opportunity to face deployment challenges, adding to our experience and enhancing our skills. This system can be used in any organization where employees exist like schools, universities, offices, hospitals etc. As it only needs to be integrated with the attendance and payroll system of the organization which mostly organizations have. This system can make the tasks of the HR department a lot easier and speed up the leave application process. CIIT-LAMS will reduce the workload on the HR department,  by deploying the workflow technique, and android attendance within the geo-bounded campus area using location feature along with finger print and facial recognition feature.

heading: 2.1 Literature Review
content: HR technology is used to attract, hire, retain, and maintain human resources, support HR administration, and optimize human resource management (HRM). Various stakeholders like employees and managers can use this technology, furthermore it can be accessed in different ways and be used in multiple kinds of human resource information system (HRIS). Communication with employees is now much easier and faster with the advancement in technology, so is the deliverance, gathering and collation of information. Its major potential  is to reduce the burden on the HR department, in order to help it focus on more important and significant activities like having expert discussions with managers. Research has indicated that organizations that use technology to manage their HR operations will have numerous advantages over those that don’t. [1] The introduction of workflow management tools is an opportunity to improve both the underlying business process and the existing organizational structure.  Implementing workflow management system can result in many benefits for the organization, like making the necessary organizational changes, and less intervention required to manage business process. Notifications and document sharing provide better communications better understanding of the process resulting in increased collaboration among teams. Workflow management systems tend to unify people with diverse skills into a more cohesive unit. [2] Workflow systems force organizations to reengineer their business processes by analysing and defining their business processes, considering the flaws in them. To avoid inefficient workflows, it is important to analyse an underlying process before implementation. James Kobielus suggests that an organization optimize a process with any of three goals in mind: “m inimizing process time, maximizing value-added process content, or maximizing flexibility at the initial point of customer contact. [3] Hackett Group is a firm that advises related to business process, in a recent study they found that low-performing organizations spend 75% greater  than their peers on HR because they  don’t use technology effectively. [4]

heading: 2.6 Software Development Life Cycle Model
content: To develop this system, we have decided to use combination of prototyping and iterative and incremental model. The project requirements are unclear and may probably change, the whole workflow process of the leave management and attendance management system  needs to be understood, including the leave policies in order to design the business process model. Different dashboards for different actors need to be created each with different needs. A few complex functionalities like facial recognition and geometrically bounding area also needs to be developed. Using the prototyping model, we can visualize different components of the system and clarify as well as verify requirements quickly, in particular throwaway prototyping will be used. Iterative and Incremental model, will be used along as it will make it easier to accommodate changing requirements, and development of system can be done in increments. Based on above details and considering the size of the project which is medium but involves a few complexitie s, prototyping with incremental and iterative model is the right choice.

heading: 5.1 Problems faced and lessons learned
content: Many problems were faced some of which are, designing the business process model or workflow model of the existing leave management system, as different leave policies, needed to be understood, and flow of each policy is different, and has different actors  involved in it. Secondly deciding on the way to identify the employee marking the attendance using android device is quite complex task to implement. However, things got right as we dived deep into it and hence learned a lot about new technologies, tools and services as well as the existing system and the to be implemented system.

heading: 5.2 Project Summary
content: CIIT-LAMS aims to reduce the workload on the HR department, resulting in increased efficiency of the department. Furthermore, providing employees and higher authorities flexibility and ease of use. As it will be an online workflow based leave management system with an android application which will be used to mark attendance based on user location and identity verification using facial recognition or fingerprint sensor in android device. The system will completely automate the tasks with only tasks left of applying leave (employee) and taking decision (higher authority) on it. All kinds of report generations and other processing, calculations and updating will si mply be done automatically, eliminating all the paper waste and saving time.

heading: 5.3 Future Work
content: This system can be converted into a product by somehow generalizing the policy making process. As leave management systems are based on leave policies, and every or ganization has its own policy, if we provide a mechanism to take leave policies as input from organizations and based on that the workflow model of the system is generated automatically, also dynamic forms creation algorithms could be implemented, again making the system a generic product which could be used by any organization.

heading: 1.1 Introduction
content: FRAS (Facial Recognition Attend -ware System) is a management system dev eloped for desktop using the MS Visual Studio , C Sharp , SQL server and EmguCV libraries. The primary focus of the system is attendance as its basic need of institutes  specifically in academic area. This is not the first of its kind there are other attendance management system out there also where you can mark attendance. This project is presenting new technical advancement like facial recognition, what we plan on doing is to  provide a practical, economical and easily accessible solution. The system will be developed in administration mode. A general explanatio n of what the administration mode is the way that and Admin can manage records of students and teachers. The administration view will have all the other participants immersed in the system as its main focus is on the management and maintenance The system has a module for teacher. A general explanation of what the teacher mode is to take attendance using the camera and then teacher can recognize the faces by simply clicking the detection button. The teacher c an view all the record related to its classes and students, teacher can view and maintain its record. The system has a module for student. A general explanation of what the student mode is to view the attendance details. The student can view all the record  related to its attendance, class proceedings and course information. The system will not be an open world platform while designing our desired application; we shall utilize the operative camera and image processing knowledge that could be effective in face detection and recognition. We shall also include such knowledge of MS Visual Studio, SQL server, OpenCV Libraries  and EmguCV Libraries with the programmin g language knowledge of C Sharp . We have executed an effective framework to perceive faces from pictures with some close on -going varieties. Our approach basically was to actualize and confirm the calculatio n Local Binary Pattern Histogram  (LBPH) for Recog nition, which takes care of the acknowledgment is sue for 2 -D picture of faces. Local Binary Patterns Page 10 of 117  19 December 2018 (LBP) is a procedure  whose objective is to proficiently summarize the local structures of images. The most central  property of LBPH is its tolerance about monotonic illumination changes and its computational easiness. LBPH has been used  for facial illustration in different tasks holding face detection, face recognition, facial expression analysis.

What we plan to do is provide the user with a source of services as well as facility to overcome attendance violation. With the ever -growing percentage of population in the educational department attendance is a matter for every person in the field; it is need of the time to replace a paper-based attendance system to a computer-based attendance system. We have reviewed the lists of systems, to know the drawbacks of these systems, so we can improve them and provide users with more capable product. For this project, we are hard at Page 11 of 117  19 December 2018 work to produce an application which not only reduces this violation of attendance, but also helps institutes to gets its symptoms and its outcomes. heading: 2.1.1.1 Introduction
content: Bio-Matrix System [1] , is commercially available in the market, which allow data registration by means of using an electronic card, a code or even a fingerprint. These systems  have  a  memory  that  can register cards,  codes  or fingerprints  and  as  much  as required registrations.

heading: 2.1.1.2 System Use
content: The system is not really a protected sometimes. The system occasionally doesn’t really works good on the fingerprint impressions, for instance the system sometimes mark someone else entry if the connection is not properly working. This could be frustrating for the user. And another problematic thing about this system is that, for example, losing the electronic card can be irritating and presence can be marked in alternative way - with a four digit code. And in case if card is misplaced by student, the student must report this to the institution management for new card which could be frustrating.

heading: 2.1.1.3 Critical Analysis
content: Now coming to the feedbacks about this system, this system features a facility where you can mark your presence on daily basis. Mark your presence and it will mark someone else attendance, which is very frustrating for the user. Pe ople have also complained about this problem, where you have to report to the institute management regarding your presence and could be distress for user in busy daily routine. One other thing, your friend can easily mark your attendance with the code that should be considered as proxy. Considering all these feedbacks we have decided to overcome these issues in our system. We will make sure to make our system is protected enough in order to prevent it from the substitutes. We will focus on security as it is  an open ended system and we want it be attractive for all the users’ i.e. teacher and students. Page 13 of 117  19 December 2018

heading: 2.1.2.1 Introduction
content: The Wireless Fingerprint Attendance Management system [2], was developed by Indian students as their project. This system uses a device for the fingerprint impressions, the teacher will have the hand handled device and mark his/her attendance first and then the device will be used by the students for further attendance procedure.

heading: 2.1.2.2 System Use
content: The system will be used with a hand handled device, the teacher will bring the handled device to the class, and teacher will start attendance procedure by impress of his/her fingers first and then system will assign an ID against this im pression, after this the device will be passed to students for attendance. Every student will mark his/her attendance respectively and wireless module passes that data to system application which will mark the attendance of students against their respectiv e impressions. After this , teacher will have to close attendance procedure by impression.

heading: 2.1.2.3 Critical Analysis
content: Although the system is somehow quite impressive in concern will proxies due to fingerprint impressions, but this system could be really annoying for the users as the procedure is quite upsetting i.e. in case the students that are coming late to the class and attendance is marked the teacher will again have to start the system or procedure for attendance marking or alternatively the students have to marked as absent. And, for example the wireless communication is not working properly with PC application the attendance marking procedure will be lost which is not acceptable to the users at both ends. Keeping in mind the cons of this sys tem we have decided to cover all these things in our system. We have included improvements in our system, each feedback from end-user will be considered as objectives to be completed. The user satisfaction and requirements would be our main focus as it's the goal that we are trying to achieve.

heading: 2.1.3.1 Introduction
content: The RFID Based Attendance Management System [3], was developed by Indian university for the attendance system. It was basically made for Windows. The system uses the radio frequency identification for the attendance management system which uses radio waves to transfer data. An RFID based system software was made for the automated attendance purpose.

heading: 2.1.3.2 System Use
content: This system includes the two main p arts: hardware and the software. The hardware consist of RFID reader, which is connected to the computer via a USB converter cable. The GUI interface was installed in the host computer. The system is basically based on the RFID, and the RFID electronic car d is maintained for the storing purpose on application database. Every card has a unique 10 digit RFID number which is printed on card for recognition purpose given to every respective student. Page 14 of 117  19 December 2018

heading: 2.1.3.3 Critical Analysis
content: This system involves hardware to ret ain the system in working condition, for instance keeping the RFID scanner in running condition. The system that is used for the host computer should be capable enough to run with the hardware that is embedded with system. This system also uses the card fo r the scanner as it contains code for recognition purpose. It could also be trouble the card is lost , new card with unique ID has to be made for user. The radio waves signals could be distracted sometimes and create a bothering situation. Considering all problems of this system we have decided to proposed a system where there is no such difficulties faced by the user. The system would be enough capable to mark attendance with free of proxies. The development of our proposed system is firmly controlled in order to achieve a proxy free attendance system, no such cards to maintain for the user as we are willing to develop a system that lessen user worries.
